eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Mi dispiacerebbe che la nostra amicizia finisse per questo motivo, ora che ci conosciamo cosi' bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: A mí también, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I feel the same. But still ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Anche a me, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Somos amigas, ¿no? La posición social no importa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: We're friends, right? Social standing means nothing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Siamo amiche, no? La posizione sociale non conta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Es imposible que, después de todo lo que hemos vivido, nuestro cariño desaparezca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: There's no way that everything that's happened here will just disappear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: E' impossibile che, dopo tutto quello che abbiamo vissuto, il nostro affetto sparisca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Seguro que encontraremos la forma de seguir en contacto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I'm sure that in some way or another, we'll be able to keep our connections.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Sono sicura che troveremo il modo di restare in contatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Por ejemplo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: For example ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Per esempio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Lo tengo! ¡Podrías unirte a la Orden! Así seguiríamos saliendo de aventuras y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I know! You could join the Order! That way we can keep adventuring together, and then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Ce l'ho! Potresti unirti all'Ordine! Cosi' continueremmo ad andare in avventura insieme e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Lo he vuelto a hacer...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Ah, I did it again ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: L'ho fatto di nuovo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Lo siento, siempre me adelanto a los acontecimientos. Tú decidirás qué te aguarda el futuro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I'm sorry. I got ahead of myself. I know you have your own future ahead of you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Scusa, mi lascio sempre trasportare. Sarai tu a decidere cosa ti riserva il futuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Sí, lo más probable es que nuestros caminos se separen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Yeah. We'll probably go down different paths from each other.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Si', molto probabilmente le nostre strade si separeranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Pero si las dos queremos seguir unidas, seguro que nos reencontraremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: But if we both think about wanting to meet again, I'm sure our paths will cross somewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Ma se entrambe vorremo restare unite, sono sicura che le nostre strade si incroceranno da qualche parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Cuando el equipo de investigación se disuelva, nos volveremos a ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Even after the Research Team disbands, I know we'll meet again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Quando la Squadra di Ricerca si sciogliera', noi ci rivedremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: He tomado la decisión de buscar siempre la manera de volver a verte, por muy lejos u ocupada que esté.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: After all, I've decided that I'll always think about wanting to see you again, no matter where I am or what I'm doing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Ho deciso che cerchero' sempre il modo di rivederti, per quanto lontana o impegnata saro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Venga ya, Yumia! ¿Cómo puedes decir eso sin emocionarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Oh, come on, Yumia! How can you say stuff like that with a straight face?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Dai, Yumia! Come fai a dire una cosa del genere senza commuoverti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¿Eh? Es lo que me ha venido a la cabeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Huh? I'm just saying what came to mind ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Eh? E' solo quello che mi e' venuto in mente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Vale, ¡pues no lo olvides nunca jamás! ¡Lo has prometido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Okay, then you better keep thinking about it no matter what! It's a promise!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Va bene, allora non dimenticarlo mai e poi mai! E' una promessa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¿y ahora qué te ha dado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Haha, what's that all about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Ah ah ah, ma che ti e' preso adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Claro que lo prometo! Para eso somos mejores amigas, ¿o no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: ... But of course I promise. That's what it means to be best friends, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Certo che lo prometto! Tanto siamo migliori amiche, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Vaya, vaya, pero si es Rutger. ¿Vas a algún sitio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: Well, if it isn't Rutger. Are you headed out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Oh oh, ma guarda un po', e' Rutger. Vai da qualche parte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: If you're going somewhere, can I come with you? I need to gather some ingredients myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Perfetto, posso accompagnarti? Devo raccogliere degli ingredienti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: ¿Cómo? Venga ya. Voy a buscar algo de valor, no simples ingredientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: What? Come on. I'm lookin' for valuables, not ingredients.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Cosa? Dai, su. Vado a cercare cose di valore, non semplici ingredienti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: A ganar dinero. Mira, antes de que te hagas ilusiones: no vienes conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: To make money. I'll go ahead and say this before you get any ideas—you're not comin' with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: A fare soldi. E ti dico subito, prima che ti faccia belle idee: tu non vieni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Ahí estáis, justo os andaba buscando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: There you both are. Just the people I was looking for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Eccovi qua, proprio vi stavo cercando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Hemos avistado unos monstruos cerca de la base y estaba buscando a alguien que quiera echarlos de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: We just spotted some monsters near the base. I was hoping to find someone who could defeat them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Abbiamo avvistato dei mostri vicino alla base e stavo cercando qualcuno che volesse scacciarli da qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Y, por suerte, me he topado con vosotros dos. ¿Qué me decís? ¿Lo puedo dejar en vuestras manos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: And then I ran into you two. So, how about it? Will you deal with them for us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: E, per fortuna, vi sono imbattuta io due. Allora, che ne dite? Posso lasciare la cosa nelle vostre mani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Por mí encantada, pero creo que Rutger tenía otros planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: I'm happy to help, but ... I think Rutger was about to head out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Per me va benissimo, ma credo che Rutger avesse altri piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Tsk... Como si pudiera negarme a eso. Cuanto antes nos pongamos, antes terminaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: Tch ... I don't really got a choice, do I? Let's just get this over with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Tsk... Come se potessi rifiutarmi. Prima ci mettiamo, prima la finiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..src: Andando, alquimista. No querrás quedarte atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..ref: Get moving, Alchemist. Do you wanna get left behind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_010..dst: Muoviti, alchimista. Non vorrai mica restare indietro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Por fin esos monstruos han mordido el polvo. La base vuelve a ser segura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: I'm glad we were able to take those monsters down. Now the base should be safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Finalmente quei mostri hanno morso la polvere. La base e' di nuovo al sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Sí... Están tan acabados como mis planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Si'... Finiti loro, finiti anche i miei piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Menudo día llevas... Primero te cruzas conmigo y luego con el jefe Erhard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: First you got caught by me, and then by Chief Erhard ... Well, we all have days like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Che giornata che ti e' toccata... Prima ti imbatti in me e poi nel capo Erhard.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: I don't wanna hear that from you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Non e' che mi stai rincuorando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: ¿Acaso se cree el viejo que soy su asistente personal o algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: Does that old man think I'm his personal assistant or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Il vecchio si crede per caso che io sia il suo assistente personale o che?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: ¿Y por qué no te has negado? Te quejas mucho, pero siempre haces lo que te pide.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: Why don't you just tell him no? You complain, but you end up doing what he asks anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: E perche' non ti sei rifiutato? Ti lamenti un bel po', ma alla fine fai sempre quello che ti chiede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Pues claro que sí, es el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: Of course I do. He's the chief.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: ¿Crees que soy un niño mimado que se niega a hacer lo que no le apetece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: You think I'm some kid who says no just because they can?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Credi che io sia un bambino viziato che dice di no solo perche' puo'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Hago lo que me ordenan, ni más ni menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: I do what I'm told. But nothin' more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Faccio quello che mi ordinano, niente di piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Es la mejor forma de vivir tranquilo, así de simple.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: That's the easiest way to stay out of anythin' annoyin'. Simple as that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: E' il modo migliore per vivere tranquillo, semplice cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Supongo que es su forma de sobrevivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: I suppose that's his way of getting by.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Immagino sia il suo modo di tirare avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Haz exactamente lo que te digan. Es una forma muy lógica de ver la vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: Only do exactly what one is told. It is a logical approach to life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Fai esattamente quello che ti viene detto. E' un approccio molto logico alla vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Pero, por muy lógico que sea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: That may be true, but even so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Per quanto logico possa essere pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Me pregunto si se comporta así para mantener alejada a la gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: I wonder why he goes to such lengths to keep people away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..dst: Mi chiedo perche' si impegni cosi' tanto per tenere la gente alla larga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..src: Rutger trata así a todo el mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_020..ref: That is the way Rutger treats everybody.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: A pesar de lo intimidante que se muestra, Rutger se lleva sorprendentemente bien con Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Rutger can be pretty intimidating, but Lenja seems to get along surprisingly well with him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Nonostante quanto sia intimidatorio, Rutger va sorprendentemente d'accordo con Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Será que se reserva la simpatía para los más jóvenes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Maybe he's better with kids than he looks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Sara' che si riserva la simpatia ai piu' giovani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Así es. Por lo que me han contado, ya en el orfanato cuidaba de los más pequeños que estaban en su misma situación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: He is. From what I've heard, he used to take good care of the other kids at the orphanage when he was young.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: E' cosi'. Da quello che mi hanno raccontato, gia' all'orfanotrofio si prendeva cura dei piu' piccoli nella sua stessa situazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Eh, ¿qué andáis cuchicheando por ahí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Hey, what're you two whisperin' about over here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Ehi, che vi state sussurrando laggiu'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Vaya, ¿te han pitado los oídos? Estábamos hablando de ti precisamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Ah, the man himself. We were just complimenting you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Vabbe', ti hanno pizzicato le orecchie? Proprio di te stavamo parlando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¡Sí! Y de lo bien que se te dan los niños.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Yeah! You're pretty good with kids, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Si'! E di quanto sei bravo con i bambini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Estabais hablando de mí y para bien? ¿Qué tramáis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: You were complimentin' me? What're you plannin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Stavate parlando bene di me? Che state tramando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¡Nada! Me ha pillado por sorpresa, eso es todo. Tu vida no ha sido un camino de rosas, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Nothing! I'm just impressed! It sounds like you had a tough time with things in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Niente! Mi hai colto alla sprovvista, ecco tutto. La tua vita non e' stata una passeggiata, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Y qué esperabas? Que alguien que yo me sé pierda el conocimiento delante de mí no me deja indiferente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: ... If someone I know collapses right in front of me, it ruins my mood. That's all there is to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: E che cosa ti aspettavi? Che qualcuno che conosco perda i sensi davanti a me non mi lascia indifferente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Me refería a lo que dijiste sobre vender tus recuerdos. ¿Te los pagaban bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: You said you used to sell your memories, right? Were they actually profitable?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Intendevo quello che hai detto sulla vendita dei tuoi ricordi. Te li pagavano bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Lo suficiente para no pasar hambre. Sacaba más tajada con los recuerdos en los que echaba una mano a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Enough to keep us alive. Memories of helpin' people out sold pretty well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Quanto basta per non morire di fame. Guadagnavo di piu' con i ricordi in cui davo una mano agli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Echar una mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Memories of helping people, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Dare una mano, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Te pedían ayuda? ¿Les hacías recados?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: What kind of help? Like, doing errands for them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Ti chiedevano aiuto? Gli facevi delle commissioni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: ¿Recados? Esos recuerdos no los querrían ni gratis. Cuando digo «echando una mano», me refiero a...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Errands? Memories like that wouldn't sell even if they were free. When I say "helpin' people," what I mean is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Commissioni? Quei ricordi non li vorrebbe nessuno, nemmeno gratis. Quando dico "dare una mano", intendo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Echándole una mano al cuello a cualquier desgraciado hasta que recibía su merecido. Ya sabes, ese tipo de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Beatin' down bad guys till they're on their knees and makin' sure they get what they deserve. That kinda help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Davo una mano spedendo al tappeto i farabutti, finche' non erano in ginocchio e si beccavano quel che meritavano. Quel genere di aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: A los ricachones les gusta saber qué se siente al ser un héroe sin tener que mancharse las manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Rich guys want to get a taste of what it's like to be a hero without havin' to do the work themselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Ai ricconi piace provare cosa si prova a fare l'eroe senza sporcarsi le mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Qué raro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: How strange ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Che strano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Eh, yo no soy nadie para juzgar sus caprichos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: Whatever. What rich people are into is none of my business.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Vabbe', i capricci dei ricchi non mi riguardano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Ahora que ha pasado un tiempo, ¿qué opinas de todo eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: ... How do you feel about it all now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Ora che e' passato del tempo, cosa ne pensi di tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: No opino nada. No se me presentó una oportunidad mejor y los niños tenían que comer algo, así que hice lo que debía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: I don't really feel any way about it. I had no other choice if I wanted to keep the kids fed, so I did what I had to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Non ne penso niente. Non avevo altra scelta, se volevo sfamare i ragazzini, quindi ho fatto quel che dovevo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Luchaste a pesar de tu propio sufrimiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: You kept fighting, even when it caused you suffering.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Hai continuato a combattere, anche quando ti faceva soffrire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: No quiero que se me tome por un héroe ni por un mártir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: I'm not tryin' to make myself out to be some big, self-sacrificin' hero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Non cerco di passare per un grande eroe che si sacrifica per gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Era la forma más sencilla de ganar dinero para esos chavales y punto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: It was the most efficient way to earn money to feed those brats. That's all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Era il modo piu' semplice per guadagnare soldi e sfamare quei monelli. Tutto qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Entonces, el modo que hallaste para que tus amigos no murieran de hambre fue... «echando una mano».
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: So the reason you were able to keep your friends alive was thanks to you "helping people" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: Quindi il motivo per cui sei riuscito a evitare che i tuoi amici morissero di fame era... "dare una mano"...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Los ricos no saben lo que es pasarlo mal. Compran recuerdos para satisfacer su curiosidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: The rich live without a single discomfort in their lives, buyin' memories to satisfy their desires ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: I ricchi non sanno cosa significhi avere un problema. Comprano ricordi per soddisfare i propri desideri...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: Nosotros usamos la violencia haciendo favores para poder vender esos recuerdos y tener algo que llevarnos a la boca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: And we use violence to help people so that we can sell those memories in order to stay alive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: E noi usiamo la violenza per aiutare gli altri, cosi' da poter vendere quei ricordi e avere di che vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..src: La verdad, no sé qué es peor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..ref: I dunno which side's more messed up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_030..dst: La verita' e' che non so quale delle due cose sia peggiore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: Oye, alquimista, ¿te acuerdas del arma que me fabricaste?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: Hey, Alchemist. You know that weapon you made me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Ehi, alchimista. Ti ricordi quell'arma che mi hai fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: Yeah. There's somethin' I wanna ask you about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Gia'. C'e' una cosa che volevo chiederti al riguardo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: Are you really? You're not feeling sick?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: No, es que me he olvidado de terminar una cosa. Ya nos veremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: No, I just remembered somethin' I need to do. See ya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: No, e' che mi sono ricordato di una cosa da fare. Ci vediamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: Qué raro... Me ha dejado preocupada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Che strano... Mi ha lasciata preoccupata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: A lo mejor puedo hacer algo para que se sienta mejor. Flammi, ¿se te ocurre el qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: I wonder if there's anything I can do to help him feel better ... Flammi, any ideas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Forse posso fare qualcosa per farlo sentire meglio. Flammi, ti viene in mente qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: Flammi estima que, con tus habilidades actuales, no hay posibilidad de curar un desconsuelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: Flammi surmises that with your current abilities, there is no feasible method to improve an affliction of the soul.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Flammi ipotizza che, con le tue attuali capacita', non esista un metodo praticabile per curare un'afflizione dell'anima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: Quizás no pueda curarlo, pero al menos podría intentar aliviar sus síntomas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: I may not be able to cure him, but at the very least I should be able to help alleviate his symptoms.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Forse non potro' curarlo, ma almeno potrei provare ad alleviarne i sintomi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..src: Aunque solo sea para darle cierta paz mental, me gustaría hacer algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..ref: Even if all I can do is help give him some peace of mind, I want to do something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_040..dst: Anche se l'unica cosa che posso fare e' dargli un po' di serenita', voglio fare qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Rutger, toma esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Rutger. Here, take this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Rutger, prendi questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿Eh? ¿Qué es?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Huh? What's this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Eh? Che cos'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Un Arpa serena. Como no te encontrabas bien, pensé que esto te ayudaría a estar más relajado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: It's a Calming Harp. You seemed like you weren't feeling well, so I thought this might help you relax a little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Un'Arpa serena. Siccome non ti sentivi bene, ho pensato che ti avrebbe aiutato a rilassarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Entiendo. Nunca rechazo un regalo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: ... All right. I won't say no to a gift.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Capisco. Non rifiuto mai un regalo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿Te sigue doliendo la cabeza?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Are your headaches still bad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Ti fa ancora male la testa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Además..., dijiste que corriste muchos riesgos al vender tus recuerdos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Hey. You said you faced a lot of danger when you used to sell your memories, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Inoltre..., hai detto che hai corso molti rischi vendendo i tuoi ricordi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Sí, es cierto. Hasta llegué a llamar la atención de la Orden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Yeah, plenty. I even had the Order chasin' me at times.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Si', e' vero. Sono persino arrivato ad attirare l'attenzione dell'Ordine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿La Orden? Ya, tiene sentido que persigan a la gente que haga cosas así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: The Order ... I guess if you do stuff like that, you would end up attracting their attention.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: L'Ordine? Gia', ha senso che diano la caccia a chi fa cose del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: La cosa es que también acabé vendiendo la mayoría de mis recuerdos de cuando huía de la Orden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: I ended up sellin' most of my memories of runnin' away from the Order, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Il fatto e' che finii col vendere anche la maggior parte dei miei ricordi mentre fuggivo dall'Ordine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿Y te los compraban? ¿Por qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Huh, people buy those too? Why?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: E ti li compravano? Perche'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Por el subidón de adrenalina. Por la emoción de ser «el chico malo» y escapar de las garras de la justicia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: People love the thrill. It's the appeal of bein' the bad guy, escapin' the clutches of justice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Per l'adrenalina. Per l'emozione di fare "il ragazzo cattivo" e sfuggire alle grinfie della giustizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Esos los vendía por un buen pico a los aristócratas atrapados en sus propios lujos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: For nobility stuck livin' stuffy lives, that kinda thing sells for a high price.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Quelli li vendeva a caro prezzo agli aristocratici intrappolati nei loro stessi lussi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Pero vender tus recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: But to think that you'd have to sell off your own memories ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Ma vendere i tuoi ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Luego fue peor, me dejé llevar y llamé demasiado la atención. Y créeme, lo pagué con creces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: And then I got carried away. I stood out too much and paid the price for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Poi e' andata peggio, mi sono lasciato trasportare e ho attirato troppa attenzione. E credimi, l'ho pagata cara.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Ya te lo había dicho, ¿no? Era idiota.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: I told you, didn't I? I was an idiot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Te l'avevo gia' detto, no? Ero uno stupido.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Nunca sabes quién podría traicionarte. Por eso, es mejor cubrirse las espaldas y no confiar en nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Well, you never know when you'll get stabbed in the back so you're better off not trustin' anyone in the first place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Non si sa mai chi potrebbe pugnalarti alle spalle. Percio' e' meglio guardarsi le spalle e non fidarsi di nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Y son diligentes con su trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Their way of doing things is completely efficient.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: E sono molto scrupolosi nel lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Destruir un alma no deja cicatrices ni restos de veneno. Es como si murieras de una enfermedad repentina. Limpio y sin hilos de los que tirar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Destroyin' the soul doesn't leave any wounds or traces of poison. Just looks like you died to a sudden illness. Nice and clean.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Distruggere un'anima non lascia cicatrici ne' tracce di veleno. E' come se si morisse di una malattia improvvisa. Pulito e senza fili da tirare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Y entonces fue cuando el jefe Erhard te salvó...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: ... And then Chief Erhard saved you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Ed e' stato allora che il capo Erhard ti ha salvato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Sí, ese viejo tiene buen corazón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Yeah, the old man is a good-natured guy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Si', quel vecchio ha un buon cuore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: A pesar de que conoce mi pasado, me deja vivir a mi aire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Even knowin' my past, he lets me live a free life like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Nonostante conosca il mio passato, mi lascia vivere per conto mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Gracias por contármelo. Me alegro de conocerte un poco mejor, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Thank you for telling me. I'm glad I got to know you a little better, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Grazie per avermelo raccontato. Mi fa piacere conoscerti un po' meglio, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Eh, ¿a qué viene esa sonrisa? Me has tirado de la lengua...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Tch, what're you smilin' like that for? I guess I ran my mouth too much ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Eh, che significa quel sorriso? Mi hai fatto parlare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Gracias. No esperaba que te abrieras conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Thank you. I didn't think you'd share so much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Grazie. Non mi aspettavo che ti aprissi con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: ... Is that so.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿Me lo debería tomar como que empiezas a confiar en mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Does this mean that you've started to trust me a little?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Devo prenderlo come un segno che inizi a fidarti di me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: ¿Y qué te hace pensar eso? Vives en las nubes, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: How'd you get that idea? Talk about naive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: E cosa te lo fa pensare? Vivi sulle nuvole, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: No has dicho que no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: Oh? That's not a "no."
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Non hai detto di no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..src: Puf... No puedo contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..ref: *Sigh* That's enough outta you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_050..dst: Uff... sei proprio impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Ah, Rutger. ¿Qué haces? Pocas veces te he visto tan pensativo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Oh, Rutger. What are you doing? It's not often I see you looking so pensive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Ah, Rutger. Che fai? Raramente ti ho visto cosi' pensieroso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¿Es que un chico no puede reflexionar? Estaba pensando en qué pasará cuando la investigación llegue a su fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Can't a guy do a little contemplatin'? I was just thinkin' about what'll happen when this investigation is over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Un ragazzo non puo' riflettere? Stavo pensando a cosa succedera' quando la ricerca sara' finita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Mmm... Conociéndote, buscarás otra manera de ganar dinero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Hmm. But knowing you, you're just going to keep searching for ways to make money.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Mmm... Conoscendoti, cercherai un altro modo per guadagnare denaro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Bueno, no estaría nada mal..., pero sería más interesante tener un verdadero objetivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Well, that ain't wrong ... But findin' a new goal would be more interestin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Beh, non sarebbe affatto male..., ma sarebbe piu' interessante avere un vero obiettivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Investigar me ha abierto los ojos. Entre otras cosas, ahora veo los riesgos que asumía antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: I learned a lot from this investigation. Like just how dangerous of a life I used to live.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: La ricerca mi ha aperto gli occhi. Tra le altre cose, ora vedo i rischi che correvo prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Sería una pena echarlo todo a perder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: It'd be a waste not to make use of it all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Sarebbe un peccato rovinare tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Parece que tienes un plan... Me gusta, ¿puedo apuntarme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: You sound like you've got big plans ... That's good. Can I come with you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Sembra che tu abbia un piano... Mi piace, posso partecipare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¿Eh? ¿Y por qué harías eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Huh? Why would you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Eh? E perche' dovresti farlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Me dedicaré a buscar a los traficantes de recuerdos. Solo serías un estorbo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: I'll be chasin' after the people dealin' in memories. You'd just be in the way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Mi dedichero' a cercare i trafficanti di ricordi. Sarresti solo di ostacolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¡Era broma! Aunque me gusta que tengas un plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: I was just kidding. But I really am interested in your plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Era uno scherzo! Pero' mi piace che tu abbia un piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Pero ¿a qué se debe ese cambio de parecer? ¿Es que quieres vengarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: But why the sudden change of plans? ... Are you thinking of looking for revenge?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Ma da cosa nasce questo cambio di idea? Per caso vuoi vendicarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¿Vengarme? No, no es eso. Solo quiero decirle un par de cosas a esos tipos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Revenge ... Well, you're not wrong. I wanna round all those guys up and teach 'em a lesson.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Vendicarmi? No, non e' quello. Voglio solo dire un paio di cose a quei tipi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: He aprendido unos cuantos trucos y puedo averiguar cosas que antes no estaban a mi alcance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Now that I've learned some new things, I might be able to figure out stuff I wasn't able to before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Ho imparato qualche trucco e riesco a scoprire cose che prima erano fuori dalla mia portata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Y mientras esos tipos sigan sueltos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: And as long as those types have free rein ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: E finche' quei tipi rimarranno in giro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Tú tampoco podrás vivir tu vida de alquimista en paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Your dream of alchemists bein' accepted will never come about either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Nemmeno tu potrai vivere la tua vita da alchimista in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¿Estás diciendo que harías todo eso por mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Oh? So you're doing all that for my sake?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Stai dicendo che faresti tutto questo per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¡No! Pero, si mi plan sale bien, tú también me deberías una. ¡Sería como matar dos pájaros de un tiro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: No! But if I do what I'm plannin', that'll obviously be another outcome ... It's just two birds with one stone!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: No! Ma se il mio piano riesce, anche tu mi dovrai un favore. Sarebbe come prendere due piccioni con una fava!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Cómo te gusta inventarte excusas, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Full of excuses, aren't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Che bravo a inventarti scuse, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¡Ag...! ¡No me agobies!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Aghh! Enough!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Argh...! Non tormentarmi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: Piensa lo que quieras. ¡Haré lo que se me antoje!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..ref: Whatever. I'm gonna do what I want!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Pensa quello che vuoi. Io faro' cio' che mi pare e piace!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..src: ¡Je, je, je!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_060..dst: Eheh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Y esto va a aquí... Mi colección es la caña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: If I put this here ... I've gotten a lot of stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: E questo va qui... La mia collezione e' il massimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: Rutger! What are you up to?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Estoy ordenando las reliquias que he encontrado. Algunas se venderían bien, pero no puedo decir lo mismo de todas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: Tryin' to sort through the relics I picked up. Some of it looks like it'll sell, but not all of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Sto sistemando le reliquie che ho raccolto. Alcune si venderebbero bene, ma non posso dire lo stesso di tutte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Habría recogido mucho más si la investigación no me quitara tanto tiempo. Esto es lo que he podido conseguir entre descanso y descanso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: I'd be pickin' up more if I didn't have to investigate. This is just what I grabbed with the little time I had.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Ne avrei raccolte molte di piu' se le indagini non mi portassero via cosi' tanto tempo. Questo e' solo quello che sono riuscito a prendere qui e la'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Pues no es moco de pavo. ¿No pesa llevar todo esto de un lado a otro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: Oh, you've got quite a lot. Isn't it heavy to carry all this around?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Non e' mica poco. Non ti pesa portarsi in giro tutte queste cose?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Tenía previsto viajar a Eustella de vez en cuando para venderlas, pero eso fue antes de que me pusieran a trabajar con cierta persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: I'd planned to go back to Eustella and sell them every so often. But I got stuck workin' with someone, so I can't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Avevo in programma di tornare a Eustella di tanto in tanto per venderle, ma poi mi hanno fatto lavorare con una certa persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Oye, que hablo de ti, alquimista. Ahora que lo pienso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: That someone's you, Alchemist. ... Hm, actually.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Ehi, che parlo di te, alchimista. Ora che ci penso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Eso quiere decir que tú eres la culpable de que tenga que ir cargado día sí y día también. ¿No harías un favor al pobrecito de Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: That means you're also the reason I'm luggin' this around every day. So you'll do poor Rutger a favor, won't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Il che vuol dire che e' colpa tua se devo trasportare tutto questo ogni santo giorno. Faresti un favore al povero Rutger, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Constrúyeme un almacén personal. Uno donde guardar las reliquias. Pero que sea extremadamente seguro, ¿lo pillas, alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: Make me my own personal storehouse. One for relics. And make sure it's extra secure, got it, Alchemist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Costruiscimi un magazzino tutto per me. Uno dove conservare le reliquie. Ma dev'essere estremamente sicuro, capito, alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..src: Uf... No sé para qué me meto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..ref: Ugh. I shouldn't have called out to you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_070..dst: Uffa'... Non so perche' mi metto in queste cose...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: ¿Haces estas cosas sobre la marcha? Eres una alquimista de las buenas, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: You can make all this stuff instantly, huh? That's an alchemist for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Le fai queste cose all'improviso? Sei un'alchimista di quelle brave, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Me vas a sacar los colores. Por cierto, si tanto pesan las reliquias, ¿por qué no le pides al equipo de investigación que las guarde?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: I'm flattered. By the way, if that stuff is heavy, wouldn't it be better to just leave it with the Research Team already?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Mi stai facendo arrossire. A proposito, se le reliquie pesano cosi' tanto, perche' non chiedi alla Squadra di Ricerca di conservarle?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: ¿Y dejar que las roben? La mitad de los miembros del equipo eran unos buscavidas. No se puede confiar en ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: And then what'll I do if it gets stolen? Half the Research Team used to be shady adventurers. I can't trust 'em.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: E lasciarle rubare? Meta' dei membri della squadra erano dei furboni. Non ci si puo' fidare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Tú no confías en nadie. Además, ¡como si tu no fueras un buscavidas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: You're really distrustful. Besides, you seem pretty shady yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Tu non ti fidi di nessuno. E poi, come se non fossi un furbone anche tu!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Lo que tú digas, pero a ver cómo entran a robar aquí. Esto es obra de una alquimista, después de todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: Say whatever you like. Well, those guys won't be stealin' anythin' from this. It was made by an alchemist, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Di' quello che vuoi, ma vediamo come entrano a rubare qui. Questo e' opera di un'alchimista, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Sí... Todavía hay gente que no se quiere ni acercar a mis creaciones. Creen que están malditas o algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: Yeah ... There are still people who won't get close to anything I made. They think it's cursed or something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Si'... C'e' ancora chi non vuole nemmeno avvicinarsi alle mie creazioni. Pensano che siano maledette o giu' di li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Oye, esa es una idea brillante. ¿Te importaría poner una maldición a cualquier listillo que intente entrar sin permiso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: Hm, that's a pretty good idea, actually. Mind settin' up a curse for anyone who tries to trespass here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Ehi, che idea brillante. Ti dispiacerebbe lanciare una maledizione su ogni furbo che provi a entrare senza permesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Le dijo la sartén al cazo. Da igual, por lo menos ahora podré centrarme en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: Not as odd as you. Anyway, I should finally be able to focus on the investigation now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Il bue che dice cornuto all'asino. Non importa, almeno adesso potro' concentrarmi sulla ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: Y todo gracias a ti, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: E tutto grazie a te, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: No ha sido nada. Soy yo quien debería darte las gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: It's nothing. If anything, I'm grateful to you too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Non e' stato niente. Sono io che dovrei ringraziarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: ¿Tú? ¿A qué viene eso?... ¿No estarás tramando algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: Huh? Why're you thankin' me all of a sudden? ... What're you plannin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Tu? Come mai?... Non e' che stai tramando qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..src: ¡No tramo nada! Sí que eres desconfiado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..ref: I'm not planning anything. You really are distrustful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_080..dst: Non sto tramando niente! Ma che diffidente che sei...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Eh, ¿no tenéis nada que hacer? Venid a echarme una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: You three look free. Gimme a hand real quick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Ehi, non avete niente da fare? Venite a darmi una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Antes de interrumpir mi descanso por ti quiero saber una cosa, ¿estás buscando mercancía otra vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: Whether I'm free or not depends on what you're about to ask. Are you looking for valuables again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Prima di interrompere il mio riposo per colpa tua voglio sapere una cosa: stai cercando merce un'altra volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Algo así. Me gustaría ir a ver si hay algo que merezca la pena en el Gran Árbol, pero ese sitio está plagado de monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: You're half right. I wanna see if there's anythin' good near the Great Tree, but there're monsters hangin' around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Piu' o meno. Vorrei andare a vedere se c'e' qualcosa di interessante al Grande Albero, ma quel posto e' pieno di mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Seguro que por el camino me topo con unos cuantos y sería un engorro lidiar con todos yo solo. ¿Os apuntáis o qué? Venga, por la amistad que nos une y todo eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: There's a ton of them in the way, so it'd be a pain to take them out alone. You'll help, right? We're friends, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Di sicuro per strada ne incontro un bel po' e sarebbe una scocciatura occuparmene tutto da solo. Vi unite, dai? Andiamo, per l'amicizia che ci lega e tutto quanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Y ¿qué te hace pensar que te ayudaremos así por las buenas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: And whyyy should we help you out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: E cosa ti fa pensare che ti aiuteremo cosi', senza chiedere nulla in cambio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: ¿Por qué no ibais a hacerlo? Solo quiero invitar a mis amigos a dar un paseo agradable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: Whyyy can't you? All I'm doin' is invitin' my friends to go on a nice little walk with me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Perche' mai non lo fareste? Voglio solo invitare i miei amici a fare una piacevole passeggiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: ¡De eso nada! ¡En los paseos agradables nadie se pone a matar monstruos! Yumia, di algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: No way! You don't encounter monsters on "nice little walks"! Yumia, you say something too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Neanche per sogno! Nelle passeggiate piacevoli nessuno va in giro ad ammazzare mostri! Yumia, di' qualcosa anche tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Isla tiene razón. No estamos obligados a ayudarte. Además, esas no son formas de pedir un favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: I agree with Isla. We're under no obligation to help you out. ... Besides, your attitude is annoying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Isla ha ragione. Non siamo obbligati ad aiutarti. E poi, non e' cosi' che si chiede un favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Calmaos las dos. ¿No habéis oído que hay monstruos en el Gran Árbol? Si no acabamos con ellos, podrían dar problemas por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: Settle down you two. There are monsters near the Great Tree? We should deal with them before they cause trouble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Calmatevi, voi due. Non avete sentito che ci sono mostri al Grande Albero? Se non li eliminiamo, potrebbero creare problemi da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Deberíamos intervenir antes de que alguien salga herido. Por mucho que Rutger no sepa pedir favores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: Well, it's best to deal with those monsters before they hurt someone. Rutger is being annoying, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Dovremmo intervenire prima che qualcuno si faccia male. Anche se Rutger non sa proprio chiedere favori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: Sí, Yumia tiene razón. Si hay monstruos cerca del Gran Árbol, el equipo de investigación entero está en peligro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: Yes, I agree with Yumia. If there are monsters near the Great Tree, that poses a risk to the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Si', Yumia ha ragione. Se ci sono mostri vicino al Grande Albero, l'intera Squadra di Ricerca e' in pericolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..src: ¿Cómo no se me ha ocurrido usar esa baza? Venga, amiguitos, vámonos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: I should've led with that then. All right, friends, let's get moving.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Come non mi e' venuto in mente di usare prima quest'asso? Dai, amici, muoviamoci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..ref: You're so annoying! Wait right there, Rutger!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_110..dst: Non ti sopporto piu'! Ehi, Rutger, aspetta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¡No puedo más! Pero estamos de una pieza. Algo que no podemos decir de esos monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: I'm exhausted! But I'm glad we beat them without any trouble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Non ce la faccio piu'! Pero' noi siamo illesi. Non si puo' dire la stessa cosa di quei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Y de camino yo he encontrado algunas reliquias. Venga, volvamos ya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Well then, I found some good relics too, so let's head back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: E per strada ho trovato anche qualche reliquia. Dai, torniamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¡Eres un mandón! Las enviarás a inspección, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: You're so bossy! And you do plan on submitting those for inspection, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Che prepotente che sei! Le consegnerai per l'ispezione, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Porque te recuerdo que, la última vez, encontraron reliquias de alquimia entre tus cosas y se armó una buena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Because last time, they found alchemy relics in your stuff and it became a whole ordeal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Perche' ti ricordo che l'ultima volta hanno trovato reliquie dell'alchimia tra le tue cose e si e' creato un bel pasticcio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Uf... Esa norma tan odiosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Ugh, what an annoyin' rule.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Uff... Che regola odiosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Una que me gustaría verte cumplir. Se aprobó para que la gente no sacara materiales alquímicos del continente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Please bear with it. It's in place to prevent people from taking alchemical materials out of the continent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Una regola che vorrei vederti rispettare. E' stata introdotta per impedire che la gente porti fuori materiali alchemici dal continente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Rutger, no te tomes a la ligera el tabú sobre la alquimia. Envíala a inspección cuando estemos de vuelta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: And Rutger, you shouldn't disregard the taboo. Make sure you submit them for inspection when we get back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Rutger, non prendere alla leggera il tabu' sull'alchimia. Consegna le reliquie per l'ispezione quando torniamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Todo es para saber si están relacionadas con la alquimia, ¿no? Entonces, toma. Inspecciónala.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: It's just so they can figure out if it has any ties to alchemy or not, right? Then, here. You inspect it now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: E' solo per capire se hanno qualche legame con l'alchimia, giusto? Allora, tieni. Esaminalo tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¿Qué? ¿Yo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Huh? Me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Cosa? Io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Este accesorio... Creo que es de una civilización pasada. Aunque no veo cómo podría estar vinculado a la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: This accessory ... I think it's from the past civilization. It doesn't seem to be related to alchemy, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Questo accessorio... Credo provenga da una civilta' del passato. Pero' non sembra avere a che fare con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Tampoco diría que es un trabajo de gran calidad. Dudo que llegue a venderse por un buen precio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: It's not that well-made, either. It's hard to imagine it fetching a good price.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Non e' nemmeno fatto molto bene. Dubito che si possa vendere a un buon prezzo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Con solo mirarlo, sé si algo se venderá bien o no. Por eso me lo llevé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: I can tell whether or not it will sell by lookin' at it. I picked it up knowin' that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: A guardarlo capisco subito se si vendera' bene o no. L'ho preso proprio sapendolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¿Aunque no te den nada de dinero?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Even if you can't get any money for it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Anche se non riesci a ricavarci niente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: A ver, sí, el dinero está bien. Cuanto más tienes, mejor vives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Well, sure, I like money. The more you have, the better off you are, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Beh, certo, i soldi mi piacciono. Piu' ne hai, meglio stai, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Pero, aunque no lo venda, si me gusta algo, me lo llevo a casa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: But even if I can't sell somethin', if I like it, I'll take it home for myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Pero', anche se non posso venderlo, se mi piace me lo porto a casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¡Ah! ¿Entonces te guías por la belleza del objeto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Ooh? So it's just based on aesthetics?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Oh? Quindi scegli in base all'estetica?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: ¿Y te llevas accesorios?... Bueno, en parte lo comprendo... Aunque tampoco es que quiera entenderte a ti, precisamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Accessories, huh? I kinda get you there ... Not that I could ever hope to understand anything you do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Accessori, eh? In questo ti capisco un po'... Non che abbia mai sperato di capire davvero quello che fai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Tener un baremo sobre el valor de las cosas es bastante útil. Empiezo a verte con otros ojos, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: Having an internal sense of value is a good thing. I'm seeing you in a new light, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Avere un proprio senso del valore e' una bella cosa. Ti vedo sotto una nuova luce, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Pero, lo siento, la enviarás al equipo de investigación. Aunque Yumia esté en lo cierto, es mejor ser precavidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: But, again ... Please submit them to the Research Team. Yumia's judgment is likely correct, but just to be safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Pero', ancora una cosa... consegnali alla Squadra di Ricerca. Il giudizio di Yumia sara' anche corretto, ma meglio andare sul sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..src: Qué insistente nos has salido, principito. Lo pillo. Las reglas son las reglas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..ref: You sure are persistent, noble boy. I get it. If those are the rules, I'll do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_120..dst: Sei proprio insistente, principino. Ho capito. Se queste sono le regole, lo faro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: Oye, alquimista, tengo un trabajito para ti. Necesito un estante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: Hey, Alchemist, I got a job for you. Make me a shelf.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: Ehi, alchimista, ho un lavoretto per te. Mi serve uno scaffale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: Se te ha olvidado el «por favor»...
Un momento, ¿no acabo de hacerte un almacén? ¿Ya te has quedado sin espacio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: Wait, didn't I already make you a storehouse? Isn't that enough storage for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: Aspetta, ma non ti ho gia' costruito un magazzino? Non ti basta come spazio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: No ha sido suficiente. Llevo un tiempo por estos parajes, imagina la de reliquias que he recogido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: It ran out of space. It's been a while since I got here. I've picked up a lot of relics.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: E' gia' pieno. E' da un po' che sono qui. Ho raccolto un sacco di reliquie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: (Sí que se ha dado prisa en llenarlo...)
Bueno, si necesitas uno, no voy a negarme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: Well, if you need it, I'm not going to say no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: Beh, se ti serve, non ti diro' di no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: Sí, no le des más vueltas y ponte a ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: That's enough beatin' around the bush. Go ahead and get to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: Si', basta girarci intorno e mettiti al lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..src: ¿Así hablas a quien te hace un favor? Pero está bien, te haré caso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..ref: Is that how you should talk to someone who's doing you a favor? ... But fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_150..dst: E' cosi' che parli a qualcuno che ti sta facendo un favore? ... Ma va bene, lo faro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: (He añadido más estantes, pero tenía espacio de sobra.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: (I made some new shelves, but it looks like he still had plenty of storage space left.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: (Ho aggiunto altri scaffali, ma c'era ancora un sacco di spazio.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: ¡Mírate! ¿Has mejorado desde la última vez que nos vimos? Gracias por echarme una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Haven't you gotten even better at this than last time? I appreciate it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ma guardati! Sei migliorato dall'ultima volta che ci siamo visti? Grazie per avermi dato una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Ya, bueno, no ha sido nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Huh? Oh, sure. You're welcome.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ma no, figurati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Dices que la mayoría de estas cosas no se venderán bien, pero podrías ganar mucho si las vendes todas, ¡tienes un montón!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: You said you also collect stuff that won't sell, but with this much, I bet it'd be worth a decent amount.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Dici che la maggior parte di queste cose non si vendera' bene, ma potresti guadagnare un sacco vendendole tutte. Ne hai tantissime!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Lo que tengo es buen ojo. Si he decidido llevarme algo es porque sé que se venderá por una fortuna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: That's 'cause I've got a great eye. If I do actually bring it back, I bet I'll make a fortune.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ho un buon occhio. Se ho deciso di portarmi via qualcosa, e' perche' so che si vendera' a una fortuna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Si hubiera tenido algo así desde el principio, no me habría visto obligado a vender mis recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: ... If I'd had this much loot from the beginning, I might not've had to sell my memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Se avessi avuto qualcosa del genere fin dall'inizio, non sarei stata costretta a vendere i miei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: No te pega hablar de futuros imposibles. Creía que no te arrepentías de haberlos vendido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: It's not like you to talk about what could've been. I thought you didn't have any regrets about selling them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Non ti addice parlare di futuri impossibili. Credevo che non ti fossi pentita di averli venduti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Y no lo hago. Hice lo que debía, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: I don't. I did what I had to do. But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: E infatti non mi pento. Ho fatto quello che dovevo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Cuando perdiste los recuerdos de tu madre, me hizo pensar... que podría pasarme lo mismo a mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Seein' you lose the memory of your mother got me thinkin'. The same thing might happen to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Quando hai perso i ricordi di tua madre, mi ha fatto pensare... che potesse succedere lo stesso a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: ¿Cómo?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Huh ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Come?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Mírate, perdiste un solo recuerdo y ya te cuestionaste cuál era tu objetivo en la vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Even for you, losin' just one memory was enough to make you start questionin' what you wanted to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Guardati, hai perso un solo ricordo e ti sei gia' chiesta quale fosse il tuo scopo nella vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Los recuerdos nos hacen seguir adelante. Nos cuentan quiénes somos y lo que deseamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: The weight of our memories is what keeps us goin'. They tell us who we are, and what we want from life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: I ricordi ci fanno andare avanti. Ci dicono chi siamo e cosa desideriamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Nunca recuperaré los recuerdos que vendí y, en el proceso, podría haber perdido mi verdadero objetivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: The memories I've sold aren't coming back. I might've lost what I truly want to do ever since then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Non recuperero' mai i ricordi che ho venduto e, nel frattempo, avrei potuto perdere il mio vero obiettivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: ... I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Y ¿por qué te disculpas ahora? En todo caso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: What are you apologizin' for? If anythin' ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: E perche' ti scusi proprio ora? Semmai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Soy yo quien lo siente. Te dejé luchar sola y perdiste algo importante. No supe ver el valor que tenía para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: I'm sorry. I let you fight alone and you lost somethin' important. And I never even realized how precious it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: A dispiacere sono io. Ti ho lasciata lottare da sola e hai perso qualcosa di importante. Non ho saputo vedere quanto valesse per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Vaya... ¿Eso que oigo es a Rutger pidiendo a perdón?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Wow ... Rutger, apologizing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Caspita... Ma quello che sento e' Rutger che chiede scusa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Eh, corta el rollo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Hey, knock it off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ehi, la pianti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: (Ya lo entiendo. Me pidió que le hiciera un estante para poder hablar conmigo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: (I get it now. He asked me to make him that shelf so he'd have an opportunity to talk.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: (Ora ho capito. Mi ha chiesto di fargli uno scaffale giusto per poter parlare con me.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Yo siento haber herido a un amigo. Seguro que verme en ese estado fue más terrorífico que vivirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: I apologized before because I scared a friend. I'm sure that seeing me like that was scarier than experiencing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Mi dispiace di aver ferito un amico. Sicuramente vedermi in quello stato e' stato piu' terrificante che viverlo in prima persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Pero ya lo he superado. Solo tengo que llenar el hueco de los recuerdos perdidos con otros nuevos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: But I've made peace with it. I just need to fill in what I've lost with new memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ma l'ho ormai superata. Devo solo riempire il vuoto dei ricordi persi con altri nuovi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Ja, ¿en serio? Entonces te prometo que nada más se escapará de esa cabezota vacía que tienes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: ... Hah, is that so? Then I'll make sure nothin' else falls outta that empty head of yours.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Ah, davvero? Allora ti prometto che da quella tua testolina vuota non sfuggira' piu' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Y, como de costumbre, te equivocas. Mi cabeza está llena de sueños, anhelos, amigos y alquimia, listillo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: As usual, you're not being honest. My head is filled with dreams, wishes, friends, and alchemy, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: E, come al solito, ti sbagli. La mia testa e' piena di sogni, desideri, amici e alchimia, furbetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Gracias, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Thanks, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Grazie, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: Nunca te había visto poner esa cara. Se lo contaré a todos antes de que se escape de esta cabezota mía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: ... Heh.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Non ti avevo mai visto fare quella faccia. Lo raccontero' a tutti prima che mi sfugga da questa mia testolina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: ¿Eh? ¡Ni se te ocurra, alquimista! No te burles de mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: I've never seen you make that face before. I'd better tell everyone about this before it falls out of my head.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Eh? Neanche a pensarci, alchimista! Non prendermi in giro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..src: De que se escape de esa cabezota, ¿eh? Eso no volverá a pasar mientras yo esté aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..ref: Huh? Hey, stop right there, Alchemist! ... Gimme a break.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm03_160..dst: Che ti sfugga da quella testolina, eh? Finche' ci saro' io non succedera' piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Nina, do you have a minute?
Of course. Is something the matter?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: No, solo quería charlar, me gustaría conocerte un poco mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: No, I just wanted to talk. I'd like to get to know you better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: No, volevo solo chiacchierare, mi piacerebbe conoscerti un po' meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Ahora que trabajamos juntas, he pensado que sería más agradable si nos hacemos amigas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Since we're working together, I thought it might be nice if we could be friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Ora che lavoriamo insieme, ho pensato che sarebbe piu' piacevole se diventassimo amiche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Ji, ji, me parece buena idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Hi, hi, mi sembra una buona idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: A mí también me gustaría saber más cosas sobre ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: I've wanted to learn more about you as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Anch'io vorrei sapere qualcosa in piu' su di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Me alegro. No nos hagamos de rogar entonces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: I'm glad to hear it. In that case, I'll just get right to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Me ne rallegro. Allora non facciamoci pregare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Dijiste que antes eras una mercenaria, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Nina, you said you're a mercenary, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Hai detto che prima eri una mercenaria, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: What is that like? Is the fighting any different?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Com'era? Ti sentivi diversa quando lottavi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Vaya, sí que eres directa. No esperaba que te interesara tanto esa época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: My, are you interested in the mercenary business? I wasn't expecting that to be your first question.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Caspita, che diretta che sei. Non pensavo che quell'epoca ti interessasse cosi' tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Mmm... Más que interesar, me da curiosidad saber si podría aprender algunas de tus técnicas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Hmm ... Rather than interested, I'd say I'm curious if I can learn anything from your fighting techniques.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Mmm... Piu' che interessarmi, mi incuriosisce sapere se potrei imparare qualcuna delle tue tecniche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Creo que lo entenderías mejor si lo vieras con tus propios ojos en lugar de explicarlo con palabras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: I believe it would be easier for you to understand if I showed you rather than told you about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Penso che lo capiresti meglio se lo vedessi con i tuoi occhi invece che spiegato a parole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: ¿Quieres ir a derrotar algunos monstruos? Así te harás una idea de lo que supone ser una mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Would you like to battle some monsters together? It may give you a better idea of what being a mercenary is like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Vuoi venire a sconfiggere qualche mostro? Cosi' ti farai un'idea di cosa significhi essere una mercenaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Claro que no. Además, nos servirá también para estrechar lazos, ¿no te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: Of course not. And we would grow a little closer along the way, don't you think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Certo che no. E poi ci servira' anche per stringere i legami, non trovi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: ¡Me encantaría! Sería una oportunidad estupenda para aprender.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: I'd love to! That would be a great way to learn.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Mi piacerebbe tantissimo! Sarebbe un'ottima occasione per imparare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..src: Ja, ja, espero estar a la altura de tus expectativas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..ref: *Chuckle* I hope that I can live up to your expectations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_010..dst: Ah, ah, spero di essere all'altezza delle tue aspettative.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Eres increíble... Gracias por enseñarme tus técnicas de combate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: You really are incredible ... Thank you for showing me your fighting techniques.
