eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Sei incredibile... Grazie per avermi mostrato le tue tecniche di combattimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Ji, ji, ji, el placer ha sido mío. Me lo he pasado muy bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: *Chuckle* The pleasure is mine. I had fun.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Hi, hi, hi, il piacere e' stato mio. Mi sono divertita molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Has aprendido algo sobre los mercenarios?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Do you feel like you learned something about mercenaries?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Hai imparato qualcosa sui mercenari?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Desde luego, aunque esto solo me ha hecho sentir más curiosidad por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: I do. But more than anything, it made me want to learn more about you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Certo, ma soprattutto mi ha resa ancora piu' curiosa nei tuoi confronti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Qué más cosas hacías como mercenaria?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: What other kinds of things did you do as a mercenary?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Che altre cose facevi come mercenaria?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: De todo un poco, supongo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Well, anything and everything, I suppose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Un po' di tutto, suppongo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Escoltar a personas importantes, investigaciones privadas, buscar objetos perdidos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Escorting important people, conducting private investigations, looking for lost objects ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Scortare persone importanti, indagini private, cercare oggetti perduti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Podría estar días nombrándolas todas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: There were so many things that I could go on for days.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Ce n'erano cosi' tante che potrei continuare per giorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Bueno, pero esos son trabajos ocasionales, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Aren't those more odd jobs than mercenary work?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Ma quelli sono piu' lavoretti occasionali che lavori da mercenaria, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Te sorprenderías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Oh, do you think so?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Ti sorprenderesti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Vaya, creía que los mercenarios luchabais por dinero, no me esperaba algo así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: I thought that mercenaries just fought in exchange for money. But if we're talking about what's surprising ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Wow, credevo che i mercenari combattevano solo per denaro, non mi aspettavo una cosa cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Y lo que más me sorprende es que tú fueras mercenaria, nunca lo habría adivinado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: You being a mercenary is even more surprising. To be honest, you don't really give off that kind of impression.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: E la cosa che mi sorprende di piu' e' che tu fossi una mercenaria, non l'avrei mai immaginato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Por qué elegiste esa profesión?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Why did you decide to go into that line of work?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Perche' hai scelto quella professione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Bueno, por conocer sitios nuevos. No quería estar en el mismo lugar mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Well, I wanted to visit many new places. I didn't want to stay in the same place forever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Beh, per conoscere posti nuovi. Non volevo restare a lungo nello stesso posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: «Sitios nuevos»... ¿Para vivir aventuras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: "Many new places," huh? So kind of like you wanted to go on an adventure?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: "Posti nuovi"... Per vivere avventure?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Aventuras? Sí, algo así, podría ser por eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: An adventure ... Yes, you're right. That may have been what I wanted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Avventure? Si', qualcosa del genere, potrebbe essere per quello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Y ahora que lo pienso, ¿de dónde eres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: ... Come to think of it, where are you from?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: E adesso che ci penso, di dove sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: De Eustella no, ¿verdad? Esa arma que llevas no la he visto nunca allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: It's not Eustella, right? The gun you use doesn't look like one I've ever seen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Di Eustella no, vero? Quell'arma che porti non l'ho mai vista laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Vienes de muy lejos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Are you from someplace far away?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Vieni da molto lontano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Ah, ¿no te lo había dicho? Yo soy de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Oh, have I never mentioned? I'm from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Ah, non te l'avevo detto? Io sono di qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¿Qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: What?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: El lugar donde estamos ahora es mi hogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: The place where I currently am is the place where I'm from.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Il posto in cui ci troviamo ora e' la mia casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: ¡Hablas como una verdadera aventurera errante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Huh ... Spoken like a true wandering adventurer!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Parli come una vera avventuriera errante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: Ah, pero lo digo en serio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: Oh, I'm being serious, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: Ah, ma lo dico sul serio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..src: (Cuesta saber por dónde va...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..ref: (She's hard to pin down ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_020..dst: (E' difficile capire da dove vada...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¡Vale, pues eso es todo por ahora!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: All right! This should be enough!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Va bene, per ora e' tutto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¿Segura? Cuando estemos investigando un sitio nuevo no podemos echar nada en falta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Are you sure? We're going to be investigating a new place, so we can't afford to be missing anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Sicura? Quando indagheremo un posto nuovo non possiamo permetterci che manchi qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Tiene razón. Deberíamos revisarlo por si acaso se nos olvida algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: That's right. We ought to double check to make sure we haven't forgotten anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Hai ragione. Dovremmo ricontrollare, per sicurezza che non abbiamo dimenticato qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Llevamos raciones de comida, vendas, una bolsa de aperitivos, enseres de costura y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: We've got rations and bandages, a pouch for snacks, sewing tools, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Abbiamo razioni di cibo, bende, una borsa per gli spuntini, il kit di cucito e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Ja, ja, ja, eres del todo adorable, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Ahaha. All of your things are so cute, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Ah, ah, ah, sei proprio adorabile, Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Has bordado tu nombre a mano ¡y hasta lo has adornado con flores!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: You've even embroidered your name in cursive. And flowers, too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Hai ricamato a mano il tuo nome e l'hai perfino decorato con dei fiori!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Je, je, je... Bueno, son cosas que siempre llevo encima. ¿No os alegra el día ver cosas bonitas? A mí sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Hehe. Well, it's stuff I always have on me, so by making it cute, just seeing it puts me in a good mood!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Eh, eh, eh... Beh, sono cose che porto sempre con me. Vedere cose carine non vi mette di buon umore? A me si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Entiendo... Debería probar a decorar mi pistola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: I see ... Perhaps I should try decorating my gun too, then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Capisco... Dovrei provare anch'io a decorare la mia pistola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Wouldn't that make it kind of hard to use?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Non ti darebbe fastidio quando la usi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Oye, ahora que sacamos el tema, acabo de recordar que me estoy quedando sin munición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Oh, and speaking of guns, I just remembered that I'm running low on bullets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Ehi, ora che ne parliamo, mi sono appena ricordata che sto per rimanere senza munizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: In that case, should I make you some more?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¿Lo harías por mí? Te lo agradecería mucho, pero no es como la tuya, puede que te cueste un poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Would you? That would be a tremendous help, but they are different from the ones you use. It may be difficult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Lo faresti per me? Ti ne sarei davvero grata, ma non sono come le tue, potrebbe risultarti un po' difficile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¿Qué clase de munición necesitas? Me imagino que no será igual que la mía, puesto que nuestras armas son totalmente diferentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: What kind of bullets? I assume they're different from the ones I use. Our guns are completely different, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Che tipo di munizioni ti servono? Immagino non siano come le mie, visto che le nostre armi sono totalmente diverse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¿Podrías fabricarla por mí? No quiero darte ningún dolor de cabeza, ¿seguro que no te importa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: You'll make me some? I would appreciate it, but wouldn't it be a lot of work?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Potresti fabbricarle per me? Non voglio darti grattacapi, sei sicura che non ti dispiace?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: ¡Pues claro que no me importa! Yo me encargo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: Not a problem at all! Just leave it to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Ma certo che non mi dispiace! Lascia fare a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..src: Tú me enseñaste tus técnicas de combate, así puedo devolverte el favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..ref: I mean, you showed me how you fight. Just think of this as my way of returning the favor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_030..dst: Tu mi hai mostrato le tue tecniche di combattimento, cosi' posso ricambiare il favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Toma, Nina, ya he fabricado tus balas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Here you go, Nina—I finished making those bullets!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Ecco, Nina, ho finito di fabbricare le tue munizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Son perfectas, Yumia. Te lo agradezco en nombre de mi arma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: These are wonderful, Yumia. They're a perfect fit for my gun.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Sono perfette, Yumia. Te ne ringrazio a nome della mia arma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Quizá debería pedirte ayuda más a menudo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Perhaps I ought to ask you for help more often!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Forse dovrei chiederti aiuto piu' spesso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: ¡Sería un placer! Si puedo hacer algo por ti, no dudes en pedírmelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Please do! If there's ever anything I can do for you, just let me know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Sarebbe un piacere! Se posso fare qualcosa per te, non esitare a chiedermelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: No dejas de sorprenderme, Nina... Y pensar que estarías dispuesta a confiarme algo tan importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: But you really are a strange one, Nina ... To think you're willing to trust me with so much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Non smetti mai di sorprendermi, Nina... E pensare che saresti disposta ad affidarmi una cosa cosi' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Bueno, porque soy alquimista y todo eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: I mean, I am an alchemist after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Beh, perche' sono un'alchimista e tutto quanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: El resto del equipo de investigación no confiaba tanto en mí, incluso a Isla y a Viktor les costó al principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: The other members of the Research Team, even Viktor and Isla, seemed pretty wary of me at first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Il resto della Squadra di Ricerca non si fidava cosi' tanto di me, all'inizio e' stato difficile perfino per Isla e Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Yumia, si vieras a alguien que lleva una daga, ¿pensarías que se trata de un criminal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Yumia, se vedessi qualcuno che porta un pugnale, penseresti che sia un criminale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Yumia, do you believe that anyone who's holding a knife is a criminal?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: Ni yo tampoco. Y lo mismo me pasa contigo. No hay más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Huh? No, I don't think that at all ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: Nemmeno io. E con te faccio lo stesso. Non c'e' altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..src: (Por mucha gente que haya conocido, hay algo que se me escapa. Cada vez me resulta más misteriosa.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..ref: Neither do I. I believe the same principle applies to you. That's all there is to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_040..dst: (Per quante persone abbia conosciuto, c'e' qualcosa che mi sfugge. Ogni volta mi risulta piu' misteriosa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Oye, Nina, ¿te gustaría que revisáramos juntas nuestros recursos antes de salir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Nina, do you want to go over our supplies together before we head out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ehi, Nina, ti andrebbe di controllare insieme le nostre risorse prima di uscire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Tengo la sensación de que se me olvida algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: I just keep feeling like I'm forgetting something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ho la sensazione di star dimenticando qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Ji, ji, ji, me encantaría. Vamos a hacer una lista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: *Chuckle* I'd be happy to. Let's go through it one by one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ji, ji, ji, mi farebbe piacere. Facciamo una lista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Vendas... empaquetadas y contadas. Medicina, munición extra...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Bandages ... Present and accounted for. Medicine, extra bullets ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Bende... messe in valigia e contate. Medicine, munizioni extra...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Yo también llevo. Y un Núcleo de energía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: I've got those too. And the Energy Core as well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ho preso anche quelle. E un Nucleo di Energia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¡Ay, casi se me olvida el diario de investigación! Por los pelos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Aah! I forgot my research journal! That was close.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ah! Mi stavo dimenticando il diario di ricerca! Per un pelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Ji, ji, ji, hay cosas que no cambian.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: *Chuckle* It's the same as always.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ji, ji, ji, certe cose non cambiano mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¿Cosas que no cambian? ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: "It's the same as always"? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: "Certe cose non cambiano mai"? Che vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Después de todos los problemas que os he causado, me tratas como si no hubiera pasado nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Even though I caused so much trouble for you all, you're treating me the same as before, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Dopo tutti i problemi che vi ho causato, mi tratti come prima, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¡Oye, que no tengo tan mala memoria! Es solo que... a veces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Hey, I'm not always forgetting things! ... Only sometimes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ehi, non mi dimentico sempre le cose! Solo qualche volta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Oh, no quería decir eso. Me refería a que me alegro de que podamos hablar con normalidad, sin que nada haya cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Oh, I didn't mean to imply that you are. I'm just glad we can talk about silly things like this the same as always.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Oh, non intendevo dire che lo fai. Sono solo felice che possiamo parlare di sciocchezze come sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Después de lo que te conté, me tratas como siempre, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Even after what I told you, you're still treating me normally, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Anche dopo quello che ti ho raccontato, mi tratti come sempre, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Lenja hasta me regaló ese collar tan bonito... No entiendo cómo sois tan amables conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Lenja even gave me that lovely necklace ... I can't believe how kind everyone has been to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Lenja mi ha persino regalato quella splendida collana... Non riesco a credere a quanto siano stati gentili tutti con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Tú también lo eres con los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: You're just as kind, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Anche tu sei gentile con gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Por cierto, ¿hay algo que quieras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Um, Nina ... Is there anything that you want?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ehm, Nina... C'e' qualcosa che desideri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¿A qué viene esa pregunta tan repentina? ¿Es mi cumpleaños y no lo sabía?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Oh, why do you ask all of a sudden? Is today my birthday?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Oh, perche' me lo chiedi all'improvviso? E' il mio compleanno e non me ne sono accorta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: No, es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: No, it's just that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: No, e' solo che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Ja, ja, ja, agradezco el gesto, pero ahora mismo no se me ocurre nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: *Chuckle* I appreciate the sentiment more than anything. Nothing specific comes to mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ja, ja, ja, apprezzo piu' di ogni altra cosa il pensiero. Non mi viene in mente niente di preciso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Si tuviera que elegir algo, me gustaría compartir una buena taza de té contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: But if I must choose, I suppose I would say I'd like to share a nice cup of tea with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Ma se proprio devo scegliere, direi che mi piacerebbe bere una buona tazza di te' insieme a te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Aunque... no es tan fácil. Aquí no hay sitio para sentarse y descansar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Oh, but that might be difficult. There's nowhere for us to sit down and relax.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Pero' potrebbe essere difficile. Non c'e' un posto dove sederci e rilassarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Es verdad. La base está siempre manga por hombro y hay mucho barullo. No es el lugar que se merece una taza de té.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: That's true. The base is pretty dusty, and there's always a commotion going on. It's not a good place to have tea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: E' vero. La base e' sempre un gran disordine e c'e' un gran baccano. Non e' il posto ideale per bere una tazza di te'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¡Eso es! ¡Haré el lugar perfecto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: But don't worry! I'll make us the perfect place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Esatto! Preparero' il posto perfetto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¿No será demasiado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Oh, you wouldn't mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Oh, non ti dispiace?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: ¡Para nada! Déjamelo a mí. Me has antojado esa taza de té.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: Not at all, leave it to me! I'd like to have tea with you too, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: Per niente! Lascia fare a me. Dopotutto, mi hai fatto venire voglia di bere un te' con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: Entonces, adelante. Y mientras tú te pones manos a la obra, yo prepararé el té y las pastas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: In that case, could you? And while you're doing that, I'll prepare some tea and snacks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: In tal caso, ci penseresti tu? Nel frattempo preparero' del te' e qualche biscotto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..src: <SEL_CM04_050_1_B><CR>¡Oye, que no tengo tan mala memoria!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..ref: <SEL_CM04_050_1_B><CR>I'm not always forgetting things!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_050..dst: <SEL_CM04_050_1_B><CR>Ehi, non e' che mi dimentico sempre le cose!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¿Qué te parece, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: How does this look, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Che te ne pare, Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¡Me encanta! Siempre me han gustado los sitios así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: It's wonderful, Yumia! I've always admired places like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Mi piace un sacco! Mi sono sempre piaciuti posti cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Entonces, ¿nos sentamos? Ya he preparado el té y las galletas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Well then, shall we get started? I've already set up the tea and snacks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Allora, ci sediamo? Ho gia' preparato il te' e i biscotti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¡Por favor! Y repite si te apetece, he preparado un montón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Please, have as much as you want. I prepared plenty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Prego! E se ne vuoi ancora, serviti pure: ne ho preparati un sacco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Uah... Cuánto necesitaba algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Phew ... This is so relaxing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Uah... Ne avevo proprio bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿no decías que querías conocerme mejor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Oh, that's right, Yumia. Didn't you say before that you'd like to get to know me better?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Ehi, Yumia, non dicevi che volevi conoscermi meglio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Ahora estamos solas y puedo responder a tus preguntas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Since it's just the two of us, I'm happy to talk.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Ora siamo sole, puoi farmi tutte le domande che vuoi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Sí, quería preguntarte algo... Llevo mucho tiempo dándole vueltas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: ... Then, can I ask you something? There's something I've been wondering for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Si', volevo chiederti una cosa... Ci penso da tanto tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Estuviste sola varios siglos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: You were by yourself for hundreds of years, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Sei rimasta sola per diversi secoli, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¿Cómo fue? Es algo que no me llego a imaginar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: What did that feel like? I can't even begin to imagine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Com'e' stato? Non riesco nemmeno a immaginarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Si te soy sincera...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Well, to be honest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: A essere sincera...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: No era consciente de que había pasado tanto tiempo. Al fin y al cabo, estuve dormida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: It doesn't actually feel like it was hundreds of years. I was only sleeping, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Non mi rendevo conto che fosse passato cosi' tanto tempo. Dopotutto, ero addormentata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Tal vez por eso no siento que mi estancia con la doctora fuera hace tanto tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Perhaps that's why the time I spent with the doctor also doesn't seem like it was all that long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Forse e' per questo che non mi sembra che sia passato molto tempo da quando stavo con la dottoressa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Entonces, es como si no hubiera pasado el tiempo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: So it doesn't feel like that much time has passed ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Allora e' come se il tempo non fosse passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Y todavía no he pensado en cómo me siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: I think I still haven't really processed how I feel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: E non ho ancora capito cosa provo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¿No te sientes... sola?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: ... You don't feel lonely?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Non ti senti... sola?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Puede que sí, aunque no podría asegurártelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Lonely ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Forse si', ma non saprei dirtelo con certezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¡Entiéndeme! No deberías obligarte a analizar tus sentimientos, la soledad solo trae tristeza...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Perhaps I do feel lonely. I don't really know yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Capiscimi! Non dovresti costringerti ad analizzare i tuoi sentimenti. La solitudine porta solo tristezza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: La soledad solo trae tristeza...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: I don't think you should force yourself to understand how you feel. I mean, loneliness is a pretty sad feeling ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: La solitudine porta solo tristezza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Dime, Yumia, si alguna vez me siento sola, ¿te quedarás a mi lado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Loneliness is sad ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Dimmi, Yumia, se un giorno mi sentiro' sola, resterai al mio fianco?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Algo me dice que, si llegara ese día, me sentiría mucho mejor si estás cerca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Say, Yumia. If I do feel that I'm lonely, will you keep me company?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Qualcosa mi dice che, se quel giorno arrivasse, mi sentirei molto meglio ad averti vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Claro, no lo dudes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Something tells me that even if that day does come, if I have you by my side, things will be okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Certo, puoi contarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Si alguna vez te sientes sola, yo estaré contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Of course. I'll be there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Se un giorno ti sentirai sola, saro' li' con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Je, je, je, qué suerte contar contigo cuando tenga un mal día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Well, if you do ever feel lonely, I'll be by your side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Eh, eh, eh, che fortuna poterti avere accanto quando avro' una brutta giornata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: No es cuestión de suerte, es lo que haría una compañ... No, lo que haría una amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: ... Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Non e' questione di fortuna, e' quello che farebbe una compagna... No, un'amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Compañera... Amiga...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Hehe, I'm so lucky. I'll have you with me when I'm feeling down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Compagna... Amica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¡Claro! Nunca daría de lado a una amiga que se siente sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: It's not a matter of luck. This is just what teammates—no, what friends do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Certo! Non abbandonerei mai un'amica che si sente sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Gracias, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Teammates ... Friends ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Grazie, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Nunca me he sentido cómoda en esta época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: That's right! I won't just sit around while a friend's feeling lonely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Non mi sono mai sentita a mio agio in quest'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: No conocía a nadie y la vida tal y como yo la concebía ya no existía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Thank you, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Non conoscevo nessuno e la vita, cosi' come la conoscevo, non esisteva piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Si lo pienso, puede que me obligara a viajar por estas tierras en busca de un sitio donde sentirme como en casa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: ... I've never really felt comfortable in this era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Ripensandoci, forse mi sono spinta a viaggiare per queste terre in cerca di un posto che potessi sentire come casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¿Un hogar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: I didn't know anyone, and life as I knew it had changed completely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Una casa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Nina, este es tu hogar; con nosotros, tus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Looking back on it now, I may have been wandering across the land in search of a place where I belonged.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Nina, questa e' casa tua: con noi, i tuoi amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: ¿A pesar de haber ocultado tantas cosas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: A place where you belong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Anche se ho nascosto tante cose?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Bueno, eso no cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Nina, this is where you belong. With us—with your friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Beh, quello non conta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Yo confío en ti, Nina, da igual lo que ocurra, siempre te veré como una gran amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Even though I hid something from you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Io mi fido di te, Nina. Qualunque cosa accada, ti considerero' sempre una grande amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: Eres muy buena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Well, that's a separate issue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: Sei davvero gentile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..src: <SEL_CM04_060_1_B><CR>Estaré contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..ref: Regardless, I trust you, Nina. No matter what happens, I'll always think of you as a friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_060..dst: <SEL_CM04_060_1_B><CR>Ti staro' accanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Pardon, Yumia. I have a favor I'd like to ask. Do you mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Scusa, Yumia. Posso chiederti un favore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Of course not. What do you need?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Gracias. Tú usas herramientas para arreglar todo tipo de cosas, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Thank you. Um, there are certain tools that you usually use to fix things, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Grazie. Ehm, tu usi degli attrezzi per riparare ogni genere di cosa, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Ah, ¿te refieres a los kits de reparación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Oh, you mean my Repair Kits?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Ah, intendi i miei kit di riparazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Sí, eso. Quería pedirte que me fabricaras unos cuantos. De hecho, más que unos cuantos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: That's right. I'd like to ask you to prepare some for me. However, I might need quite a few of them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Esatto. Vorrei chiederti di prepararne un po' per me. Pero' potrebbero volercene parecchi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Quite a few? What are you planning to ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Parecchi? E cosa hai intenzione di...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: ¿Los quieres para la habitación de la doctora? Las herramientas que vimos no servían para nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Are you going to use them for the doctor's room? All the tools and stuff in there were broken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Vuoi usarli per la stanza della dottoressa? Gli attrezzi e tutto il resto che c'era li' erano rotti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Ji, ji, ji, me has pillado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: *Chuckle* You caught me. That's exactly right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Eheh, mi hai scoperta. E' proprio cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Además, hemos encontrado muchas cosas de la civilización pasada, ¿no te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: And we've found quite a few things from the past civilization as well, haven't we?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: E poi abbiamo trovato parecchi oggetti della civilta' passata, non e' vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Pensé que sería buena idea restaurarlas también, después de reparar la base de la doctora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: I thought it might be nice to restore not only the doctor's base, but those as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Pensavo sarebbe stato bello rimettere a nuovo non solo la base della dottoressa, ma anche quegli oggetti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Sí que lo es. Además, eres la más indicada para esta tarea porque sabes cómo eran antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: That's a great idea. And I bet you know exactly what they used to look like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: E' vero. E poi sei la persona piu' adatta a questo compito, perche' sai come erano prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Sí. ¿No te parece una idea formidable? Voy a reparar las cosas de mi época para que perduren en el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Yes. Ensuring that the things I grew up with remain long into the future—don't you think it's a lovely idea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Si'. Non trovi che sia un'idea formidabile? Riparero' le cose della mia epoca perche' durino nel tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: Cosas del pasado que servirán en el futuro... ¡Es un concepto muy interesante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: Bringing things from the past into the future, huh? That's a very interesting concept!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Cose del passato che serviranno nel futuro... Che concetto cosi' interessante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..src: ¡Cuenta conmigo! Te traeré un montón de kits de reparación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..ref: All right, sign me up! I'll bring you a bunch of Repair Kits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_070..dst: Contate su di me! Ti portero' un sacco di kit di riparazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: ¡Nina! Te traigo los kits de reparación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Nina! I made you those Repair Kits!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Nina! Ti ho portato i kit di riparazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Me irán de perlas. Yo me encargaré de las reparaciones. ¡Muchísimas gracias! Has sido de gran ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Yes, this should do nicely. I'll do the repairs myself. Thank you so much! You've been a tremendous help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Mi saranno utilissimi. Pensero' io alle riparazioni. Grazie mille! Sei stata di grande aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: ¡No es nada! Avísame si necesitas algo más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: It was nothing! Let me know if there's anything else I can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Non e' stato niente! Fammi sapere se ti serve altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: No digas eso o al final me volveré totalmente adicta a tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Don't say that. I'll end up becoming completely reliant on you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Non dire cosi', o finiro' per dipendere completamente dal tuo aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Ya te debo demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: I already owe you so much as is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Ti devo gia' troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: ¿De verdad? ¿Qué más he hecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: You think? Was there something else I did?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Davvero? Cos'altro ho fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Venga ya, si encontré el mensaje de la doctora fue gracias a ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Come now. You were the reason I was able to find the doctor's message!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Ma dai, se ho trovato il messaggio della dottoressa e' stato grazie a te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Si no fuera porque me aceptaste como tu amiga, jamás habría llegado tan lejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Everything that's happened has been because you accepted me as a friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Se non mi avessi accettata come amica, non sarei mai arrivata cosi' lontano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Y eso no es todo... me has abierto los ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: ... And there's more. You helped me realize something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: E non e' tutto... mi hai aperto gli occhi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: El tiempo que pasé con la doctora pertenece al pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: That the time I spent with the doctor is a thing of the distant past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Il tempo che ho passato con la dottoressa appartiene al passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Es por ti que he podido encontrar todo lo que la doctora dejó, ¿o no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: It's been thanks to you that I've been able to see the things that the doctor left behind, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: E' grazie a te che sono riuscita a trovare tutto cio' che la dottoressa ha lasciato, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Y, gracias a eso, me he dado cuenta de que los días pasados no van a volver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: And thanks to that, I finally realized that the past is in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: E grazie a questo ho capito che i giorni passati non torneranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Es como si... una horrible sensación de frío se hubiera instalado en un vacío de mi corazón...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: It's as if there's a chilling wind passing through a gaping hole in my heart ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: E' come se... un'orribile sensazione di freddo si fosse insediata in un vuoto del mio cuore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Me impide respirar y me duele, pero también me reconforta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: It's painful and suffocating, but also warm somehow ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Mi impedisce di respirare e mi fa male, ma allo stesso tempo mi conforta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Me he dado cuenta de que es la soledad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: I realized that this is what loneliness feels like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Ho capito che e' la solitudine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: No pongas esa cara tan triste, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Nina ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Non fare quella faccia cosi' triste, ti prego.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Sé que dijiste que la soledad solo trae tristeza, pero no creo que ese sea mi caso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Oh, please don't make such a sad face.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: So che hai detto che la solitudine porta solo tristezza, ma non credo sia il mio caso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Para mí, esta soledad es la prueba definitiva de que hubo amor en el pasado... durante un tiempo que será irreemplazable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: I know you said that loneliness is a sad feeling, but I don't think that's the case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Per me, questa solitudine e' la prova definitiva che nel passato c'e' stato amore... durante un tempo che sara' insostituibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Quiero atesorar este sentimiento. Mío y de la doctora con la que compartí tantos momentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Rather, this loneliness is proof of the love I hold for the past ... for that irreplaceable time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Voglio custodire questo sentimento. Che e' mio e della dottoressa con cui ho condiviso tanti momenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Por eso, Yumia, voy a seguir adelante sin abandonar este sentimiento tan preciado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: And so I want to treasure this feeling. For me, and for the doctor who gave me these memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Per questo, Yumia, andro' avanti senza abbandonare questo sentimento cosi' prezioso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Quiero vivir momentos tan bonitos contigo y con los demás... Con todas las personas a las que aprecio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Hey, Yumia. I'm going to keep moving forward. Without letting go of this beautiful feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Voglio vivere momenti cosi' belli con te e con gli altri... Con tutte le persone a cui tengo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Yumia, gracias por darme un hogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: I want to make even more beautiful memories together with you and the others ... With everyone I hold dear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Yumia, grazie per avermi dato una casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Gracias a ti, Nina. He aprendido muchísimo desde que estás conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: Yumia, thank you for giving me a place where I belong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Grazie a te, Nina. Ho imparato tantissimo da quando sei con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..src: Doctora Marina... Me alegro de haber podido vivir esta época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..ref: ... Hehe. Thank you too, Nina. I've learned so much since I met you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_080..dst: Dottoressa Marina... Sono contenta di essere riuscita a vivere questa epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Je, je... ¡Ji, ji, ji! El pelo, las almohadillas de tus patas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Hehe ... Hehehe! From your hair to the pads on your paws ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Eh, eh... Hi, hi, hi! Il pelo, i cuscinetti delle tue zampe...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: ¡Qué suave es todo! Eres tan adorable que me parece increíble, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Everything about you is so soft and fluffy! I just can't believe how cute you are, Lenja ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: E' tutto cosi' soffice! Sei talmente adorabile che non ci credo, Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Se-señorita Nina, ¿no estás de-demasiado cerca?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Um, Miss Nina ... Would you mind taking a step back ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Si-signorina Nina, non sei un po' tro-troppo vicina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Qué mona... Podría pasarme horas acariciándote el pelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Adorable ... I could pet you forever ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Che carina... Potrei passare ore a accarezzarti il pelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Lenja, ¿dónde tienes el pelo más suave? Tengo curiosidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Lenja, where are you the softest? I want to feel too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Lenja, dove hai il pelo piu' morbido? Sono curiosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Anda, si es Yumia. ¿Tú tampoco puedes resistirte a lo adorable que es?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Oh, if it isn't Yumia. Have you been captivated by this fluff too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Oh, ma sei Yumia. Nemmeno tu riesci a resistere a quanto e' adorabile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Por favor, resistid...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Please, no being captivated ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Vi prego, resistete...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Dejadla en paz, estáis incomodando a la pobre Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Knock it off, you two. Lenja is clearly not enjoying this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Lasciatela in pace, state mettendo a disagio la povera Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Ja, ja, ja, venga, Nina, la estás asustando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Haha ... All right, Nina, give her a break. You're scaring her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Ah, ah, ah, su, Nina, la stai spaventando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: ¡Señorita Yumia! ¡Eres mi salvadora!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Miss Yumia ...! My savior ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Signorina Yumia...! Mia salvatrice...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Oh, lo siento. A partir de ahora, solo te admiraré una hora al día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Goodness, I apologize. I'll limit myself to just an hour a day from now on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Oh, mi dispiace. D'ora in poi mi limitero' ad ammirarti per un'ora al giorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Ñia... No tienes intención de parar por lo que veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: So you have no plans of stopping ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Quindi non hai intenzione di smettere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Nina, deberías tener en cuenta cómo se siente Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Nina, you need to take Lenja's feelings into consideration too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Nina, dovresti pensare anche a come si sente Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Es que no puedo controlarme cuando tengo delante una monada así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: I've never been able to control myself when cute things are involved.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Non riesco proprio a trattenermi quando si tratta di cose carine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¿siempre has sido así, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Haha. So you've always loved cute things, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Ahaha. Quindi ti sono sempre piaciute le cose carine, Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Sí, de pequeña coleccionaba peluches.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Yes, I have. I even used to collect things like stuffed animals.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Si', da piccola collezionavo peluche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Y me sigue apasionando todo lo que parece mullido y suave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Even now, I can't help but want to touch whenever I see something fluffy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Ancora adesso, quando vedo qualcosa di soffice, non riesco a resistere alla tentazione di toccarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: P-por favor, no me mires cuando dices eso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: P-please don't look at me like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: P-per favore, non guardarmi cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: ¿Peluches? Ya me lo estoy imaginando... ¿Eres de las que duerme rodeada de peluches?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Stuffed animals, huh? If you like fluffy stuff so much, do you surround yourself with them while you sleep?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Peluche, eh? Se ti piacciono tanto le cose morbide, dormi circondata dai peluche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Ya no, pero tengo una almohada gigante, es mi favorita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: Not anymore, but I still have a body pillow. It's my favorite one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Non piu', ma ho ancora un cuscino gigante. E' il mio preferito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Es reconfortante y me ayuda a dormir. Además, es superadorable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: It's soft to the touch, and holding it puts me to sleep instantly. And most importantly of all, it's incredibly cute.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: E' morbido al tatto e, quando lo abbraccio, mi addormento subito. E soprattutto e' incredibilmente carino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: Por desgracia, no la he podido traer conmigo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: But I couldn't bring it with me. *Sigh*
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: Pero' non potevo portarlo con me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..src: S-solo quiero decir que no pienso s-ser tu nueva a-almohada gigante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..ref: I-I'm not going to be your new body pillow, you know ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_100..dst: N-non intendo diventare io il tuo nuovo cuscino gigante, sai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Vale, he terminado el diario de investigación de hoy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: All right, that should do it for my research journal today.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Bene, ho finito il diario di ricerca di oggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Cuánto esmero, con todo lo que escribes cada día, vas a tener que pedir otro cuaderno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: You keep such a neat journal. With how you write in it every day, it won't be long before you need a new volume.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Che dedizione! Con tutto quello che scrivi ogni giorno, dovrai chiedere un altro quaderno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: No sé cómo te apetece dedicarle tanto esfuerzo, es un rollo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: You're takin' this way too seriously. This sorta thing's not worth all that effort.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Non so come fai ad avere voglia di impegnarti tanto, che noia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: El diario es parte de nuestras obligaciones. Debemos ser conscientes de la importancia de llevar un registro de nuestras ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Our research journals are a part of our responsibilities. We must understand the importance of recording our impressions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Il diario fa parte dei nostri doveri. Dobbiamo essere consapevoli dell'importanza di annotare le nostre idee.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Nuestros comentarios podrían dar lugar a grandes avances.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: In doing so, a great many things can be brought to light.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Le nostre annotazioni potrebbero portare a grandi progressi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: El jefe supervisa nuestros descubrimientos, por eso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: The chief reviews all of the important discoveries we make, which is why we—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Il capo supervisiona le nostre scoperte, percio'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Nunca cambiarás, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: You never change, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Non cambierai mai, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Solo hago lo que me ordenan. Hablando del tema, Yumia, tú también anotas tus impresiones, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: I'm just doing what I ought to do. Speaking of, Yumia, you are keeping up with your entries, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Faccio solo quello che mi ordinano. A proposito, Yumia, anche tu annoti le tue impressioni, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Sí, escribo todos los días, ya lo llevo por la mitad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Even I write in mine every day. It's around halfway full.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Si', scrivo ogni giorno, sono gia' a meta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Qué bien... Un momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: That's excellent. ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Ottimo... Un momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Yumia, el diario no es un cuaderno de síntesis. No deberías usarlo para hacer la lista de los ingredientes que necesitas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: ... Yumia. This journal is not your synthesis notepad. You shouldn't be using it to keep lists of ingredients you need.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Yumia, il diario non e' un quaderno di sintesi. Non dovresti usarlo per fare la lista degli ingredienti che ti servono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Pero ¡eso es lo que hago todos los días!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: But those are my journal entries.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Ma e' proprio quello che faccio ogni giorno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Lo importante aquí es que casi has terminado el tuyo y eso significa que hemos vivido muchas aventuras, ¿no es genial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: More importantly, you almost finishing a whole journal shows how long we've been adventuring. Pretty cool!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: La cosa importante e' che tu abbia quasi finito il tuo, e questo significa che abbiamo vissuto tante avventure, non e' fantastico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Sí, es ge... ¡Oye! ¿No estarás cambiando de tema? ¿Escribes tu diario o no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: That's true. ... Hold on, aren't you blatantly diverting the subject? You have been writing in your journal, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Si', e' fan... Ehi! Non starai cambiando discorso? Tu lo scrivi il diario o no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Ja, ja, ja... A mí también me gustaría verlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: *Chuckle* I'd like to see what your journal looks like too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Ah ah ah... Mi piacerebbe vederlo anch'io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Bueno... A ti te lo dejo ver, Nina, porque tú no me juzgarías, pero asegúrate de que no lo vea nadie más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Well ... You probably won't get mad at me, Nina, so sure. Make sure no one else gets a peek, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Beh... A te lo faccio vedere, Nina, perche' tu non mi giudicheresti, ma assicurati che non lo veda nessun altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Vuestros diarios son únicos, todo esto es muy interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: *Sigh* ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: I vostri diari sono unici, e' tutto molto interessante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Ya hace tiempo que comenzó nuestra aventura, podría decir que casi siento nostalgia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Both of your journals are quite unique. These are very interesting to read.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: E' passato un bel po' dall'inizio della nostra avventura... Potrei dire che mi sento quasi nostalgica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Sí... Supongo que echaréis de menos vuestro hogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: We've been doing this for a pretty long time now. I feel kind of homesick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Si'... Immagino che vi manchi casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Claro, esta es tu tierra natal, ¿no? Te traerá muchos recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Yes ... I can imagine you would be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Certo, questa e' la tua terra natale, no? Ti riportera' tanti ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Creía que venir aquí me daría nostalgia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: ... Right, this is your hometown, ain't it? Bein' here must be pretty nostalgic for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Pensavo che venire qui mi avrebbe fatto sentire nostalgica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Pero, al final, no ha sido para tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Pero', in fin dei conti, non e' andata cosi' male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Todo lo que conocía es pasto de las ruinas. El paisaje es el mismo, pero a la vez, muy diferente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: I certainly expected to feel some nostalgia upon coming here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Tutto cio' che conoscevo e' ridotto in macerie. Il paesaggio e' lo stesso, eppure, allo stesso tempo, molto diverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Debes de sentirte muy sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: But in the end, that wasn't the case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Devi sentirti molto sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Sin embargo, aunque solo queden escombros, me alegro de poder verlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Everything here has been destroyed. The land may be the same, but it looks completely different.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Eppure, anche se sono rimaste solo macerie, sono contenta di poterle vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Aunque la ciudad nunca vuelva a ser la que era, mientras quede algo de ella, podrá erguirse de nuevo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: That must be a lonely feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Anche se la citta' non tornera' mai come era, finche' ne restera' qualcosa, potra' rialzarsi di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Y puede que hasta la gente de Eustella venga de visita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: However, even if all that remains is ruins ... I'm happy that it's still here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: E magari persino la gente di Eustella verra' a trovarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: No sé yo... Si la gente que vive aquí ha cambiado, el lugar también será distinto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Even if the city I know won't be brought back, so long as there's something left of it, one day it can be rebuilt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Non so... Se le persone che vivono qui sono cambiate, anche il luogo sara' diverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Podría serlo tanto que ya no quede nada de su esencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: And people from Eustella may even come here someday too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Potrebbe cambiare cosi' tanto che non rimanga piu' nulla della sua essenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Rutger, no deberías decir eso delante de Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: I dunno. If different people are livin' here, they'll probably change the place as they see fit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Rutger, non dovresti dire certe cose davanti a Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: No pasa nada. Agradezco tu observación, Rutger, pero no hay de qué preocuparse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: They might even change it so much that there'll be nothing left of what used to be here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Non e' nulla. Ti ringrazio per l'osservazione, Rutger, ma non c'e' motivo di preoccuparsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: ¿Eh? Yo no estaba preocupado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Rutger, have some consideration for Nina's feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Eh? Io non ero preoccupato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Ja, ja, ja. Si seguimos trabajando, algún día vendrá alguien a vivir aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: It's all right. I appreciate the warning, Rutger. But there's no need to worry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Ah, ah, ah. Se continuiamo a lavorare, prima o poi qualcuno verra' a vivere qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Los cambios pueden causar cierta tristeza, pero no me importa siempre que alguien disfrute de este sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Huh? I ain't worried ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: I cambiamenti possono portare una certa tristezza, ma non mi importa, purche' qualcuno si goda questo posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Quiero que las risas resuenen por toda esta ciudad. Así era Aladiss... así era mi hogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: *Chuckle* As long as we continue our work, eventually, someone will be able to live here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Voglio che le risate riecheggino in tutta questa citta'. Cosi' era Aladiss... cosi' era la mia casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Imagino que sería una ciudad muy viva. A pesar de lo que ocurrió, esa gente no hizo nada malo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Change may be a lonely thing, but that's all right if it means that someone else can live here someday.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Immagino fosse una citta' piena di vita. Nonostante cio' che e' successo, quella gente non ha fatto nulla di male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Entonces, haz lo que te pida el cuerpo, como siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: I want the sound of laughter to fill this city. That's the kind of place Aladiss ... my hometown was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Allora, fai cio' che ti chiede il corpo, come sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: Claro, eso haré. Y cuento con todos vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: It must have been a lively nation. Regardless of what happened, the people who lived there did nothing wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Certo, lo faro'. E conto su tutti voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: ¡Sí! ¡Siempre estaremos contigo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: In that case, do what you like. The same way as always.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: Si'! Saremo sempre con te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..src: (Debo esforzarme para que este lugar vuelva a estar lleno de vida.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..ref: Indeed, I will. Which is why I'll be continuing to count on you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_150..dst: (Devo impegnarmi perche' questo posto torni pieno di vita.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: ¡Aquí te escondías! ¿Qué haces?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: So this is where you've been. What are you doing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Quindi ti nascondevi qui! Cosa fai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Hola, Yumia. Estaba contemplando la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Oh, if it isn't Yumia. I'm just looking out at the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Ciao, Yumia. Stavo contemplando la citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Está tan vacía... Los edificios no tienen alma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: It's so empty now. There may be buildings, but it has no soul.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: E' cosi' vuota... Gli edifici non hanno anima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Cuando la gente vivía aquí, esto estaba lleno de emociones, que han desaparecido... Ahora solo queda el esqueleto de la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: The liveliness and emotions of the people who lived here, all of it has been erased ... It's only the shell of a city now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Quando la gente viveva qui, era tutto pieno di emozioni, che ora sono scomparse... Ora resta solo lo scheletro della citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: ¿Qué opinas, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: What do you think, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Tu che ne pensi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Para Basilius... Puede que quisiera recuperar algo de lo que había aquí a cualquier coste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: I think ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Per Basilius... Forse voleva recuperare qualcosa di cio' che c'era qui, a qualunque costo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: No comparto su lógica y creo que no hace lo correcto, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: In Basilius's eyes ... maybe there was something that he wanted to get back anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non condivido la sua logica e credo che non stia agendo nel modo giusto, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Sí que entiendo la necesidad de recuperar algo que has perdido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: I can't understand his logic, and I think that what he's doing is wrong, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Capisco il bisogno di recuperare qualcosa che hai perso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: No tiene ningún sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: I understand the feeling of wanting to regain something you've lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non ha senso tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Recuperar la ciudad, recuperar a su gente... Nada podrá hacer que el Imperio aladissiano regrese.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: There's no point to all of this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Recuperare la citta', riavere la sua gente... Niente potra' far tornare l'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Hay cosas que se pierden y jamás se recuperan, eso lo sé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Bringing back this city, bringing back its people ... None of it is going to bring back the Aladissian Empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Ci sono cose che si perdono e non si recuperano mai piu', questo lo so.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: No quisiera sonar presuntuosa, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: The things we've lost can never be restored. I know that very well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non vorrei sembrare presuntuosa, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Yumia, te has hecho mucho más fuerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: This may sound presumptuous of me, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Yumia, sei diventata molto piu' forte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Yumia, you've gotten stronger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Tu voluntad de hierro es lo que nos ha traído hasta aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: La tua volonta' di ferro e' cio' che ci ha portati fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: No exageres. Si acaso, ha sido mi desesperación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: That incredible willpower of yours is what brought all of us here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non esagerare. Se mai, e' stata la mia disperazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Da igual lo que haya sido, me alegro de saber cómo te sientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: You're exaggerating. If anything, I would say it was desperation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non importa cosa sia stato, sono contenta di sapere come ti senti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Igual que yo no soy la Nina que la doctora Marina esperaba, esta ciudad también ha cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Nevertheless, I'm glad you told me how you feel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Cosi' come io non sono la Nina che la Dottoressa Marina si aspettava, anche questa citta' e' cambiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Mi hogar... ya no existe. Es una verdad que estoy dispuesta a aceptar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Just as I wasn't the Nina that Doctor Marina was hoping for, this town is ultimately something different too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: La mia casa... non esiste piu'. E' una verita' che sono disposta ad accettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Sin embargo, hay cosas que nunca desaparecen del todo: los lugares que hemos visitado, los momentos que hemos vivido y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: ... My hometown is gone. I'm capable of accepting that now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Eppure, ci sono cose che non scompaiono mai del tutto: i luoghi che abbiamo visitato, i momenti che abbiamo vissuto e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: El mensaje de la doctora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Nina ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Il messaggio della dottoressa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Y te has dejado lo más importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: But there are things that remain. The places we've seen on this journey, the things we've encountered, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: E ti sei dimenticata la cosa piu' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Tú. Estás aquí y con todos tus recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: The doctor's message.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Tu. Sei qui, e con tutti i tuoi ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Yumia... Sí, tienes razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: You left out something important.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Yumia... Si', hai ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Me muero por saber qué nos depara el futuro. Quiero ayudar a mis amigos. Debemos detener a Basilius, Yumia, hagámoslo juntas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: You remain too. You, and your memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Non vedo l'ora di sapere cosa ci riserva il futuro. Voglio aiutare i miei amici. Dobbiamo fermare Basilius, Yumia. Facciamolo insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Sí, y no estaremos solas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Yumia ... Yes, you're right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Si', e non saremo da sole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: Los dos provenimos del mismo lugar, no puedo permitir que cometa ninguna locura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: I want to see what the future holds. I want to aid my dear friends. Let's stop Basilius together, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: Veniamo entrambi dallo stesso posto, non posso permettere che commetta qualche follia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..src: <SEL_CM04_160_1_B><CR>No tiene ningún sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..ref: Yes, with everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm04_160..dst: <SEL_CM04_160_1_B><CR>Non ha alcun senso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..src: Parece que toda la investigación que hemos estado haciendo le ha pasado factura. ¿Y si nos tomamos un descanso en alguna parte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..ref: It seems like all of the investigating we've been doing has worn her out. Shall we take a break somewhere?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..dst: Sembra che tutte le ricerche che abbiamo fatto l'abbiano stancata. E se ci prendessimo una pausa da qualche parte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..ref: Huh? Wait up, Lenja! Where are you going?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..src: Lo sabía... Vamos a ayudarla, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_010..ref: ... I knew it. Let's help her out, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Me alegro de que estés bien, Lenja. No nos esperábamos que salieras disparada de golpe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: I'm glad you're okay, Lenja. You surprised us by taking off so suddenly.
