eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Mi fa piacere che tu stia bene, Lenja. Non ci aspettavamo che scappassi via cosi' di colpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: ¡L-lo siento! De repente, he sentido la presencia de un monstruo y he escuchado la voz de una Neru...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: I-I-I'm so sorry! I just suddenly sensed a monster and heard a Neru's voice ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: M-mi dispiace! All'improvviso ho sentito la presenza di un mostro e ho udito la voce di una Neru...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Me ha parecido que podía estar en peligro y me he puesto en marcha sin pensar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: And as soon as I thought they might be in danger, I moved without thinking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Ho pensato che potesse essere in pericolo e sono partita senza pensarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Yo no he oído nada... Pero es increíble que hayas sido capaz de hacer todo esto, teniendo en cuenta lo cansada que estás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: I didn't hear a thing ... And you did all that even though you were so tired. That's amazing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Io non ho sentito niente... Ma e' incredibile che tu sia riuscita a fare tutto questo, considerando quanto sei stanca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Una Welleks ayudando... a una Neru... No lo entiendo. ¿Por qué...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: A Welleks helping. A Neru. I don't understand. Why ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Una Welleks che aiuta... una Neru... Non lo capisco. Perche'...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: E-eso es lo de menos. Me gusta ayudar a quienes lo necesitan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: Th-that's not important. I always want to help those in need ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Q-questo non e' importante. Mi piace aiutare chi ha bisogno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: No te ha dado ni las gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: And without so much as a "thank you."
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Non ti ha nemmeno detto grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: En cualquier caso, has sido muy valiente, Lenja. Has ido corriendo a ayudar en cuanto te has dado cuenta de que estaban atacando a alguien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: In any case, Lenja, you were very brave. You ran to help as soon as you noticed someone was under attack.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: In ogni caso sei stata molto coraggiosa, Lenja. Sei corsa ad aiutare appena ti sei accorta che qualcuno era sotto attacco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Pues sí. Hoy vamos a tener mucho que escribir en el diario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: Indeed. We'll have plenty to write about in our journal entries for today.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Infatti. Oggi avremo tanto da scrivere nel diario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: N-no ha sido nada, en serio...
He acabado dando problemas a todo el mundo. No sirvo para nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: And I wound up causing trouble for everyone else. I really am no help at all ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Ho finito per creare problemi a tutti. Non servo a niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: No le has causado problemas a nadie. Nos has ayudado un montón de veces y nosotras vamos a hacer lo mismo por ti, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: You didn't cause us any trouble. You've helped us out plenty of times, and we'll do the same for you, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Non hai creato problemi a nessuno. Ci hai aiutato tante volte e noi faremo lo stesso per te, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: Pero haberos metido en una pelea con monstruos es algo muy serio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: But pulling you into a fight against monsters is pretty serious ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Ma avervi coinvolta in una lotta contro i mostri e' una cosa molto seria...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: That's not true! You're always helping me out!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: Non e' vero! Tu mi stai sempre aiutando!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: N-no... Lo único que hago es depender de todos vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: N-no ... All I do is rely on you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: N-no... Non faccio altro che contare su tutti voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..src: (Mmm... Ojalá consiga confiar más en sí misma algún día.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..ref: ( ... Hm. I hope she can find some more confidence in herself someday.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_020..dst: (Mmm... Spero che un giorno possa avere piu' fiducia in se stessa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Uy, Lenja, ¿qué estás haciendo aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Oh, Lenja. What are you doing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Oh, Lenja, che ci fai qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¡A-ayyy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: E-eeek!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: A-ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Ah, pero si eres tú, señorita Yumia. Uf...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Oh, it's just you, Miss Yumia. Phew ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Ah, sei tu, Signorina Yumia. Uff...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¿Qué pasa? ¿Has visto algo que te haya asustado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: What's wrong? Did you see something scary?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Che succede? Hai visto qualcosa che ti ha spaventata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Pues... No, solo estaba pensando en Lili Borea. No consigo quitarme de la cabeza lo que dijo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Oh, um ... No, I was just thinking about Lili Borea. I can't get what she said out of my head.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Be'... No, stavo solo pensando a Lili Borea. Non riesco a togliermi dalla testa quello che ha detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Ya, yo tampoco... Siento que me voy a pasar la vida dándole vueltas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: ... Yeah, me too. I feel like I'll keep mulling it over forever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Gia', neanch'io... Ho la sensazione che continuero' a rimuginarci per tutta la vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: No fui capaz de hacer nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: I wasn't able to do anything ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Non sono riuscita a fare niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¿Tú también te sientes impotente, señorita Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: You feel like that too, Miss Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Anche tu ti senti impotente, Signorina Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Siempre me había dado la impresión de que eras capaz de cualquier cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: ... You always struck me as someone who could do anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Mi era sempre sembrato che tu fossi capace di fare qualsiasi cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¿Te has llevado una decepción conmigo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Are you disappointed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Sei rimasta delusa da me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: N-no, para nada, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: N-no, I'm not, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: N-no, per niente, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¿Pero...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: But?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Siempre he tenido la sensación de que todos los que tenía cerca eran perfectos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: I always felt like everyone around me was perfect.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Ho sempre avuto l'impressione che tutte le persone intorno a me fossero perfette.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Siempre cometo más errores u ocasiono más problemas que los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: No one makes as many mistakes as I do, or causes trouble for other people like I do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Faccio sempre piu' errori o creo piu' problemi degli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Así que siempre había pensado que era la única que metía la pata.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: I've always thought that I'm the only one who ever messes up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Quindi ho sempre pensato di essere l'unica a combinare guai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Claro que no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Of course you're not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Certo che no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Ya... Incluso la gente que me parece maravillosa tiene sus problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: ... Right. Even the people I thought were amazing have their own struggles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Gia'... Anche le persone che mi sembrano meravigliose hanno i loro problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Y también necesita ayuda de otras personas para superarlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: And they need help from other people to overcome them too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: E hanno anche bisogno dell'aiuto degli altri per superarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Me gustaría ser alguien en quien también se pueda confiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: That's right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Mi piacerebbe essere una persona su cui si possa contare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: En mi opinión, ya lo eres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: So I want to become someone that people can rely on too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Secondo me, lo sei gia'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: ¡Para nada! Todavía me queda mucho por avanzar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: If you ask me, you're already pretty reliable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Ma no! Ho ancora tanta strada da fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Así que... ¡voy a esforzarme aún más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Not at all! I still have so far to go ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Quindi... Mi impegnero' ancora di piu'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Mmm, no estaba insinuando que tengas que esforzarte más...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: So ... I'm going to work even harder!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Mmm, non intendevo dire che devi impegnarti di piu'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Pues, si sientes que puedes confiar en mí, tendré que asegurarme de no decepcionarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: Um, I wasn't trying to say you should be doing more ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Be', se pensi di poterti fidare di me, dovro' fare in modo di non deluderti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: Tengo que empezar a practicar todavía más con la espada. ¿Qué más puedo hacer...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: If you feel like you can count on me, I have to make sure I don't let you down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: Devo cominciare ad allenarmi ancora di piu' con la spada. Cos'altro posso fare...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..src: (No pretendía que se sintiera todavía más presionada...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..ref: I have to start practicing with my sword even more. And what else can I do ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_030..dst: (Non volevo farla sentire ancora piu' sotto pressione...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¿Qué pasa, Lenja? ¿Podría ser...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: ... *Sigh*
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Che succede, Lenja? Non e' che...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¿No te encuentras bien? No te exijas demasiado. Deberías descansar un poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: What's wrong, Lenja? Could it be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Non ti senti bene? Non sforzarti troppo. Dovresti riposarti un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Ah, mmm, no... Estoy bien. Es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Are you not feeling well? Don't push yourself. You should get some rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Ah, ehm, no... Sto bene. E' solo che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¿Tienes hambre? ¿Quieres que te sintetice un tentempié o algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Oh, no, um ... I feel fine. It's actually ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Hai fame? Vuoi che sintetizzi uno spuntino o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Mmm... No, estoy llena. Es solo que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Are you hungry? Should I synthesize a snack or something for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Mmm... No, sono sazia. E' solo che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Señorita Yumia... ¡L-lo siento!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Oh, um ... No, I'm already full. It's just ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Signorina Yumia... M-mi dispiace!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Miss Yumia ... I-I'm so sorry!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Ya entiendo. Has intentado ayudar a algunos miembros del equipo que estaban peleando contra monstruos fuertes y no ha salido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Capisco. Hai cercato di aiutare alcuni membri della squadra che stavano combattendo contro mostri potenti, ma non e' andata bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Sí. Cuando me llamaron, pensé que por fin podría serle de utilidad a alguien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: I see. So you tried to help some team members who were struggling against strong monsters, but it didn't go well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Si'. Quando mi hanno chiamata, pensavo che finalmente sarei potuta essere utile a qualcuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Como tú también cuentas conmigo, he estado entrenando con la espada todo lo que he podido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Yes. When they called out to me, I thought I could finally be helpful to someone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Dato che anche tu fai affidamento su di me, mi sono allenata con la spada il piu' possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Pero... sigo siendo tan inútil como siempre. No le aporto nada a nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: And since you've been counting on me too, I've been training with my sword as much as possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Pero'... sono ancora inutile come sempre. Non servo a nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Al final, no hemos conseguido derrotar a los monstruos hasta que se han unido la señorita Nina y el caballero Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: But ... I'm still just as useless as ever. I can't do anything for anyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Alla fine, non siamo riusciti a sconfiggere i mostri finche' non si sono uniti a noi la Signorina Nina e il cavaliere Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: He metido la pata otra vez... Y, encima, les he ocasionado muchos problemas a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: In the end, we only managed to defeat the monsters after Miss Nina and Mister Viktor joined in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Ho combinato un altro pasticcio... E per di piu' ho causato un sacco di problemi agli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Lo siento mucho, señorita Yumia. Te prometí que me esforzaría al máximo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: ... I messed up again. And as a result, I caused a lot of trouble for the others.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Mi dispiace tanto, Signorina Yumia. Ti avevo promesso che mi sarei impegnata al massimo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Escucha, Lenja. No pasa nada por depender de la gente que te rodea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: So I'm sorry, Miss Yumia. Even though I promised you I would work hard ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Ascolta, Lenja. Non c'e' niente di male a fare affidamento sulle persone che ti stanno intorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Hey, Lenja, listen. It's okay for you to rely on the people around you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: A ti te alegra mucho que la gente te pida ayuda, ¿verdad? Pues los demás se sienten igual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Ti fa molto piacere quando gli altri ti chiedono aiuto, vero? Anche loro si sentono cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Sobre todo, si es para algo que se les da bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: You know how you're happy when someone asks you for help? Other people feel the same way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Soprattutto quando si tratta di qualcosa in cui sono bravi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: No tiene sentido pasarlo mal haciendo por tu cuenta cosas que no se te dan bien. Es mejor que cada uno ayude a los demás a hacer lo que se le da bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Especially if it's something they're good at.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Non ha senso faticare facendo da sola cose che non ti riescono. E' meglio che ognuno aiuti gli altri a fare cio' in cui e' bravo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Para eso están los amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Don't struggle with things you're bad at alone. It's better if we use the things we're good at to help each other out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: E' questo il senso dell'amicizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Señorita Yumia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: That's what friends are for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Signorina Yumia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Yo siempre les pido a los demás que me ayuden a hacer cosas que se me dan mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Miss Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Io chiedo sempre agli altri di aiutarmi a fare le cose che non mi riescono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Exacto. Yumia delega algunos de sus puntos débiles en Flammi, su dispositivo autómata especializado en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: You know, I'm always asking people for help with the things I'm bad at as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Esatto. Yumia affida a Flammi alcuni dei compiti che le riescono meno, il suo dispositivo automatico specializzato nella ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¡Oye!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Exactly. Some of Yumia's weak points are delegated to Flammi, her super-high-spec independent survey device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Ehi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Por ejemplo, Flammi la ayuda a organizar los ingredientes sobrantes, a optimizar su atuendo y a evitar que se quede dormida hasta tarde. Además...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Ack—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Per esempio, Flammi la aiuta a organizzare gli ingredienti che avanzano, a ottimizzare il suo abbigliamento e a impedirle di restare sveglia fino a tardi. Inoltre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: ¡Para ya, Flammi! ¿No se te ocurría una mejor manera de dejarme en ridículo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: For example, organizing spare ingredients, optimizing her attire, and preventing oversleeping. Furthermore—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Smettila, Flammi! Non trovavi un modo migliore per mettermi in ridicolo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Es verdad. Ya no estoy sola...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Flammi, stop! Couldn't you think of anything less embarrassing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: E' vero. Non sono piu' sola...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: Gracias, señorita Yumia. Ya me siento un poquito mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: That's right. I'm not alone anymore ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: Grazie, Signorina Yumia. Ora mi sento gia' un po' meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..src: (Menos mal. Parece que esta vez se lo ha tomado mejor.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..ref: Thank you, Miss Yumia. I feel a little better now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_040..dst: (Meno male. Sembra che questa volta l'abbia presa bene.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: U-um ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¿Puedo... ayudarte con algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Hm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Posso... aiutarti in qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: No, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Do you ... need something from me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: No, a dire il vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Ah... Es que siento que llevas todo el rato mirándome...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Not really.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Ah... E' che ho l'impressione che tu mi stia guardando da tutto questo tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Solo estaba pensando que estás empezando a cambiar poco a poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Huh? But I feel like you've been watching me this entire time ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Stavo solo pensando che stai cominciando a cambiare poco a poco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¿C-cómo? ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: C-come? Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Han pasado muchas cosas y se te ve mucho más segura de ti misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: I was just thinking that you've started to change little by little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Sono successe molte cose e si vede che sei molto piu' sicura di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Aunque, ahora que lo digo, creo que esa seguridad siempre ha estado en tu interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Wh-what do you mean by that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Anzi, ora che lo dico, credo che quella sicurezza sia sempre stata dentro di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Eso ha sonado un poco engreído, ¿no...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: A lot has happened, and you seem like you've become pretty confident in yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: E' suonata un po' presuntuosa, no...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¡No, para nada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Although now that I say it out loud, I think you really had it in you all along.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: No, affatto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Si he cambiado..., es gracias a ti, señorita Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: ... I must sound pretty full of myself, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Se sono cambiata..., e' grazie a te, Signorina Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Me dijiste que era mejor que cada uno ayudase a los demás a hacer lo que se le diera bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: No, not at all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Mi hai detto che era meglio che ognuno aiutasse gli altri a fare cio' in cui e' bravo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Durante nuestra investigación ha pasado de todo y siento que he conseguido aprovechar las cosas que se me dan bien para ayudar a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: ... If I've changed at all, it's thanks to you, Miss Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Durante la nostra ricerca e' successo di tutto e sento di essere riuscita a mettere a frutto le cose in cui sono brava per aiutare gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Por primera vez en mi vida, he empezado a pensar que puedo sentirme orgullosa de mí misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: You told me before that it's better if we all use the things we're good at to help each other out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Per la prima volta nella mia vita, ho cominciato a pensare di poter essere orgogliosa di me stessa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Si quiero seguir avanzando, todavía me quedan muchas cosas en las que trabajar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: A lot has happened during our investigations, and I feel like I've managed to use the things I'm good at to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Se voglio continuare ad andare avanti, ho ancora molte cose su cui lavorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: For the first time, I've started to feel like I can be proud of myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Ya no me avergüenzo de depender de mis amigos, pero no vais a estar conmigo para siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Non mi vergogno piu' di contare sui miei amici, ma non potrete restare con me per sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: En algún momento, terminará la investigación y, con ella, también mi tiempo con toda esta gente tan amable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: If I want to keep on growing, there are still a lot of things I need to work on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Prima o poi la ricerca finira' e, con essa, anche il mio tempo con tutte queste persone cosi' gentili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Antes de que llegue el día... quiero convertirme una persona con la que se pueda contar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Oh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Prima che arrivi quel giorno... voglio diventare una persona su cui poter contare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: Ese sentimiento no ha cambiado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: I'm not embarrassed to rely on my friends anymore. But all of you won't be with me forever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Quel sentimento non e' cambiato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: La Lenja que eras cuando te conocí está empezando a desaparecer... La echaré de menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Eventually, this investigation will end, and so will my time with all of the kind people here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: La Lenja che eri quando ti ho conosciuta sta cominciando a svanire... Mi manchera'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¡N-no es cierto! ¡Sigo siendo la antigua yo! ¡No voy a desaparecer!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: Before that day comes ... I want to become someone that can be relied on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: N-non e' vero! Continuo a essere quella di prima! Non spariro'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..src: ¡Pua, ja, ja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..ref: ... That feeling hasn't changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_050..dst: Puah, ah, ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..src: ¿Crees que podría pasarme por la catedral? Últimamente no he tenido tiempo de rezar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: Do you think I could stop by the cathedral? I haven't really been able to pray recently ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..dst: Pensi che potrei passare dalla cattedrale? Ultimamente non ho avuto tempo di pregare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..src: Así que quería pedir permiso para abandonar el grupo un ratito...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: So I wanted to request permission to leave the group for a little while ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..dst: Cosi' volevo chiedere il permesso di lasciare il gruppo per un po'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..src: Muy honesto por tu parte, pero no necesitas pedir permiso. Fíjate en Rutger, que siempre anda deambulando por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: How upright of you. But you don't need permission. Just look at Rutger—he's always wandering off somewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..dst: Molto onesto da parte tua, ma non devi chiedere permesso. Pensa a Rutger, che e' sempre in giro a vagabondare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..src: De hecho, ¿te importaría que fuera contigo? Me gustaría aprender más sobre el dios de los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: Oh, actually, is it okay if I join you? I'd like to learn more about the Welleks's god.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..dst: A dire il vero, ti dispiacerebbe se venissi con te? Mi piacerebbe saperne di piu' sul dio dei Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: O-of course. I'm happy to hear that.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..src: En tal caso, ¿para qué esperar? Vamos para allá, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..ref: In that case, there's no time like the present. Let's head out, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_070..dst: In tal caso, perche' aspettare? Andiamo laggiu', Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Menudo edificio. Da igual las veces que lo vea, siempre percibo un poco de soledad en el ambiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: What a building. No matter how many times I see it, I can't help but feel that it's a little lonely in here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Che edificio. Per quante volte lo veda, sento sempre un po' di solitudine nell'aria.
Be', ora vado a pregare... Ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Se me ha olvidado traer flores...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Ho dimenticato di portare i fiori...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: Do you bring flowers every time you pray?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Porti sempre dei fiori quando preghi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Sí. Busco flores bonitas y las recojo. Pero no se me da tan bien encontrarlas como a los demás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: Yes, I do. I look for some pretty ones and pick them. I'm not as good at finding them as everyone else ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Si'. Cerco dei fiori belli e li raccolgo. Pero' non so trovarli cosi' bene come gli altri...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: ¿Y qué pasa si no tienes flores?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: What happens if you don't have any?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Mmm... Pues... Nunca lo había pensado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: Umm ... Hmm ... I've never thought about it before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Mmm... beh... Non ci avevo mai pensato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Pero seguro que hacen feliz a la deidad de la cosecha. A mí también me gusta que me regalen flores bonitas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: But I think they make the Harvest Deity happy, just like how I'm happy when someone gives me pretty flowers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Ma di sicuro rendono felice la Divinita' del Raccolto. Anche a me piace quando qualcuno mi regala dei fiori belli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: P-pero ya no puedo hacer nada al respecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: O-of course, there's nothing I can do about it now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: P-pero' ormai non posso farci piu' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..src: Je, je. Es la oportunidad perfecta para pedirle ayuda a alguien. Yo me ocupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..ref: Hehe. This is the perfect chance for you to ask someone else for help. Just leave this to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_080..dst: Eheh. E' l'occasione perfetta per chiedere aiuto a qualcuno. Lascia fare a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Muchísimas gracias, señorita Yumia. Ya he terminado de rezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: Thank you so much, Miss Yumia. I finished my prayers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Grazie infinite, Signorina Yumia. Ho finito di pregare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: No ha sido nada. Solo quería ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: It was nothing. I just wanted to help you out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Non e' stato niente. Volevo solo aiutarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Nunca me había dado cuenta de lo devota que eres. La deidad de la cosecha está relacionada con el maná, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: But I never realized how devout you are. The Harvest Deity has ties to mana, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Non mi ero mai resa conto di quanto fossi devota. La Divinita' del Raccolto e' legata al mana, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Así es. Permite que las almas que han vuelto a la Tierra sigan viviendo en forma de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: That's right. She allows the souls that have returned to the earth to continue living on in the form of mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Esatto. Permette alle anime che sono tornate alla Terra di continuare a vivere sotto forma di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Los Welleks siempre hemos tenido mucha fe en el maná. Cuando rezamos, expresamos nuestra continua gratitud.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: The Welleks have always held a lot of faith in mana. When we pray, we express our continual gratitude.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Noi Welleks abbiamo sempre avuto molta fede nel mana. Quando preghiamo, esprimiamo la nostra continua gratitudine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Y, cuando pedimos algo, hacemos una promesa a cambio. Tenemos muchas costumbres como esta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: And when we ask for something, we make a pledge of our own in return. There are many other customs like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: E quando chiediamo qualcosa, facciamo una promessa in cambio. Abbiamo molte usanze di questo tipo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Es increíble. Tanto los Silva como los Flumme veneran a la misma deidad, a pesar de la distancia que los separa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: That's incredible. Both the Silva and the Flumme worship the same god, despite being geographically separated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: E' incredibile. Sia i Silva che i Flumme venerano la stessa divinita', nonostante la distanza che li separa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: P-pero, por mucho que se hayan transmitido las tradiciones, el número de personas que creen de verdad en ella ha ido disminuyendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: B-but even though the customs have been passed down, the number of people who truly believe in her has been decreasing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: P-pero', anche se le tradizioni sono state tramandate, il numero di persone che crede davvero in lei e' diminuito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Entiendo... Es cierto que el concepto de la fe va cambiando con el tiempo. ¿Y tú qué? ¿Crees en ella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: I see ... It's true that the nature of faith changes over time. How about you? Do you believe in her?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Capisco... E' vero che il concetto di fede cambia col tempo. E tu? Ci credi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Pues... me gustaría que fuera real.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: Um ... I would like for her to be real.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Beh... mi piacerebbe che fosse reale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Para alguien tan inútil como yo, su existencia sería un gran consuelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: For someone as useless as me, her existence would be a great comfort.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Per qualcuno di inutile come me, la sua esistenza sarebbe una grande consolazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: Oye, ¿es malo que alguien que no es creyente como tal le rece a la deidad de la cosecha?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: Hey, is it bad for someone who isn't exactly a believer to pray to the Harvest Deity?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: Ehi, e' male se qualcuno che non e' propriamente un credente prega la Divinita' del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: No, claro que no. La bendición del maná es para todo el mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: Oh, no, of course not. The blessing of mana is meant to be for everybody.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: No, certo che no. La benedizione del mana e' per tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: En ese caso, yo también debería rezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: In that case, I'd better pray too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: In tal caso, dovrei pregare anch'io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: (Querida deidad de la cosecha, muchísimas gracias por el maná. Seguiré dando lo mejor de mí para ser buena alquimista.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: (Dear Harvest Deity, thank you so much for the mana. I'll keep on doing my best to be a good alchemist.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: (Cara Divinita' del Raccolto, grazie mille per il mana. Continuero' a fare del mio meglio per diventare una buona alchimista.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..src: (Sigue cuidando de Lenja, por favor. Trabaja muy duro.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..ref: (Please continue to watch over Lenja. She's a hard worker.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_090..dst: (Continua per favore a vegliare su Lenja. Lavora durissimo.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Tengo la sensación de que todo el mundo está muy cansado. Aunque llegamos hace mucho y quizá sea inevitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: I feel like everyone looks so tired. It's been a while since we got here though, so I guess it was inevitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Ho l'impressione che tutti siano molto stanchi. E' passato un po' da quando siamo arrivati, pero' forse era inevitabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Pero también se los ve tristes. ¡V-voy a preguntarles qué sucede!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: But they seem sad too. I-I'll go ask what's going on!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Pero' sembrano anche tristi. V-vado a chiedere loro che succede!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: Hold on, I'll come with you.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Sí. Los monstruos de esta zona son muy fuertes. Con un solo combate, ya nos quedamos agotados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: Yeah. The monsters around here are really strong. Just fighting them once is enough to completely exhaust you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Si'. I mostri di questa zona sono molto forti. Con un solo combattimento restiamo gia' esausti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Y, si luchas contra varios monstruos seguidos, no queda otra que rendirse pronto y volver a la base, tanto por el equipo que tenemos como por nuestro propio aguante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: And in terms of both equipment and stamina, if you fight several in a row, you have to call it quits early and head back to base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: E se combatti contro diversi mostri di fila, non resta che arrendersi presto e tornare alla base, sia per l'equipaggiamento che per le nostre forze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Cuesta mucho hacer progresos. Es una sensación muy frustrante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: It's hard to make any progress. And that's a very discouraging feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: E' difficile fare progressi. E' una sensazione molto frustrante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: No sé mucho al respecto, pero tú sabes hacer un montón de cosas, ¿no? ¿Podrías echarnos una mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: I don't really know the details, but you're able to do a whole bunch of stuff, right? Can you lend us a hand?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Non ne so molto, ma tu sai fare un sacco di cose, vero? Potresti darci una mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Pues... es difícil que se me ocurra algo así de repente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: Hmm ... It's hard to come up with something on the spot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Beh... e' difficile che mi venga in mente qualcosa al momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Mmm, ¿no podéis huir de los monstruos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: Um, couldn't you just run away from the monsters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Mmm, non potete fuggire dai mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: No son tan inteligentes... Seguro que tiran la toalla en cuanto pierdan de vista a su presa. Y, después, podéis seguir investigando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: The monsters aren't that smart ... They'll give up if they lose sight of their prey. Then you can keep investigating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Non sono cosi' intelligenti... Di sicuro si arrenderanno appena perdono di vista la preda. E poi potete continuare a indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: A lo mejor funciona, pero son muy rápidos. ¿Qué podemos hacer para que nos pierdan de vista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: That may be true, but they're pretty fast. What can we do to lose them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Puo' darsi che funzioni, ma sono molto veloci. Cosa possiamo fare per farci perdere di vista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: Huh? Oh, um ... Let me think ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..src: Tenemos que buscar una manera fiable de escapar, ¿no? ¡Es momento de dejar que la alquimia actúe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..ref: We just need to figure out a reliable way to escape, right? That means it's alchemy's time to shine!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_130..dst: Dobbiamo trovare un modo affidabile per fuggire, no? E' il momento di lasciare agire l'alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: ¿Un orbe de impacto? ¿De verdad crees que esto va a funcionar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: An Impact Orb? Will this really work?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Una sfera d'impatto? Credi davvero che funzionera'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Dadle una oportunidad. Cuando el monstruo salga volando, deberíais poder salir corriendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Just give it a try. Once the monster goes flying, you should be able to run.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Provateci. Quando il mostro volera' via, dovreste poter scappare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: V-vale. Mientras consigamos hacer nuestro trabajo por fin...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: O-okay. As long as it lets us get some work done for once.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: V-vabbe'. Purche' riusciamo a fare un po' di lavoro per una volta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: No me gusta mucho la idea de salir huyendo de esos monstruos, pero, si es la opción más lógica, habrá que hacerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Can't say I like the idea of turning tail against these monsters, but if it's the most efficient option, we'll do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Non mi piace l'idea di darsela a gambe con quei mostri, ma se e' l'opzione piu' logica, dovremo farlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: N-no tenéis que salir huyendo todas las veces. Podéis valorar las opciones y decidir qué es mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Y-you don't need to run away every time. You can weigh your options and decide what's best.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: N-non dovete fuggire ogni volta. Potete valutare le opzioni e decidere cosa e' meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Por ejemplo, si os metéis en tres peleas, podéis luchar una vez, huir la segunda y volver a luchar después... Y así sucesivamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: For example, if you get into three fights, you can fight once, run the next time, and then fight again ... and so on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Per esempio, se vi ritrovate in tre combattimenti, potete combattere una volta, fuggire la seconda e combattere di nuovo dopo... E cosi' via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: De esta forma, podréis avanzar en la investigación y perfeccionar vuestras habilidades de lucha. Y-yo misma he entrenado así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: It'll allow you to make progress on the investigation and hone your fighting skills. I-I've also trained this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: In questo modo potrete far progredire l'indagine e perfezionare le vostre abilita' di lotta. E-io stessa mi sono allenata cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Si podéis luchar y ganar, pues genial. Pero, en mi caso, no estaría aquí si no hubiera huido unas cuantas veces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: If you can win by fighting, then that's fine. But in my case, I wouldn't be here if I hadn't also run away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Se riuscite a vincere combattendo, va benissimo. Ma nel mio caso, non sarei qui se non avessi anche scappato qualche volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Ya... Gracias por la sugerencia. Hay que fiarse de los consejos de los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Huh ... Thanks for the suggestion. Can't go wrong taking advice from a Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Gia'... Grazie per il suggerimento. Bisogna fidarsi dei consigli dei Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Entrenaremos duro para poder luchar en más ocasiones. ¡Gracias a las dos! Vamos a ponerlo a prueba ahora mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: We'll train hard so we can choose to fight more often too. Thanks, you two! We'll go test this out right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Ci alleniamo duramente per poter lottare piu' spesso. Grazie a entrambe! Andiamo a metterlo alla prova subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Has estado genial, Lenja. ¡Cómo les has subido la moral!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: That was amazing, Lenja. You really raised their morale!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Sei stata fantastica, Lenja. Hai davvero rialzato il loro morale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: No, no, el mérito ha sido de tu orbe de impacto. Lo único que he hecho ha sido hablar de mi experiencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Ah, no, the real help was your Impact Orb. All I did was talk about my own experiences ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: No, no, il merito e' del tuo orbe d'impatto. Io ho solo parlato della mia esperienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Yo solo les he dado una herramienta. Pero el consejo que les has dado basado en tu experiencia ha hecho que te escuchen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: I just gave them a tool. It was the advice you gave based on your own experiences that really got them to listen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Io ho solo dato loro uno strumento. Ma e' stato il consiglio che hai dato loro, basato sulla tua esperienza, a far si' che ti ascoltassero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: ¿Mi experiencia ha sido útil? N-no me lo puedo creer...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: My experiences were helpful? N-no way ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: La mia esperienza e' stata utile? N-non ci posso credere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: ¡Espera, Lenja! Vaya, ya ha salido disparada otra vez...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: Wait, Lenja! Ah, she ran away ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Aspetta, Lenja! Ecco, e' gia' scappata di nuovo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..src: Tendremos que trabajar en su capacidad de recibir cumplidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..ref: We'll have to work on her ability to take a compliment next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_140..dst: Dovremo lavorare sulla sua capacita' di accettare i complimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¿Qué debería hacer cuando se acabe todo este viaje?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I wonder what I should do when this journey is over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Chissa' cosa dovrei fare quando finira' tutto questo viaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¿A qué viene eso de repente, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: What made you say that all of a sudden, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Come mai lo dici cosi' all'improvviso, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Solo estaba pensando en que ya llevamos un tiempo aquí y se está acercando el final.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Well, I was just thinking, we've been here a while, and things are starting to wrap up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Stavo solo pensando che siamo qui da un po' ormai e che ci si sta avvicinando alla fine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Todo lo que empieza acaba... Yo también tendré que volver a mi aldea en algún momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: With every beginning comes an end ... I'll need to return to my settlement eventually too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Tutto cio' che inizia finisce... Anch'io prima o poi dovro' tornare al mio villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Me da pena pensar en ello. Quería aprender más sobre los Welleks y que hiciéramos más cosas juntos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: That's a sad thought. I wanted to learn more about the Welleks and do more things together ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Mi dispiace pensarci. Volevo imparare ancora sui Welleks e fare molte piu' cose insieme...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Y-yo también quería poder ayudarte más... Snif...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I-I also wanted to be more helpful to you ... *Sniff* ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: E-anch'io volevo essere piu' utile per te... Snif...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Eh, que me vas a hacer llorar a mí también. ¡Todavía no hemos llegado a ese punto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Oh, you're going to make me cry too. It hasn't happened yet!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Ehi, mi farete piangere anche me. Non siamo ancora arrivati a quel punto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Aún nos queda tiempo juntos. Vamos a crear muchos recuerdos mientras podamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: We still have time together. Let's make lots of memories while we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Ci resta ancora tempo insieme. Creiamo tanti ricordi finche' possiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Je, je, es verdad. Tenemos que disfrutar del pelaje mullidito de Lenja mientras lo tengamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: *Chuckle* That's right. We should also be enjoying Lenja's fluffy fur while we still can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Eh, eh, e' vero. Dobbiamo goderci il pelo soffice di Lenja finche' possiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Espero que tengas otros recuerdos de mí además de mi pelo, ¿eh...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: You'll have memories of me aside from my fur, right ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Spero che tu abbia altri ricordi di me oltre al mio pelo, eh...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¿Qué tienes pensado hacer después de todo esto, Lenja? ¿Tu viaje de redención tiene que durar varios años?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: What are you going to do after all this, Lenja? Does your journey of atonement have to last a few years?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Cosa hai intenzione di fare dopo tutto questo, Lenja? Il tuo viaggio di redenzione deve durare alcuni anni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Mmm... No hay ninguna regla específica. Normalmente, volvemos a casa cuando tenemos la sensación de que hemos hecho suficiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Um ... There's no specific rule about that. Generally, we can return home as soon as we've accomplished enough.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Mmm... Non c'e' una regola specifica. Di solito, torniamo a casa quando sentiamo di aver fatto abbastanza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Creo que la mayoría de la gente tarda alrededor de un año.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I think it takes most people about a year.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Penso che la maggior parte delle persone ci metta circa un anno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Pero no tengo muy claro hasta qué punto puedo ser de ayuda para los demás... A lo mejor mi viaje no acaba nunca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: But I'm not really confident in how much help I can actually be for others ... My journey might never end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Ma non sono sicura di quanto io possa davvero essere d'aiuto agli altri... Forse il mio viaggio non finira' mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¡¿Qué dices?! ¡Ser parte de esta investigación debería ser suficiente! ¡Más que suficiente!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: No way! Being a part of this investigation should already be enough! More than enough!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Ma che dici?! Fare parte di questa ricerca dovrebbe essere sufficiente! Piu' che sufficiente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¿Sí? Pero tampoco he ayudado mucho a nadie...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Huh? But I haven't really helped anyone ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Eh? Ma in fondo non ho aiutato molto nessuno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: La exploración de Aladiss dejará una huella duradera en toda Eustella. Estás creando un nuevo futuro para todos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: But pioneering Aladiss will have long-lasting effects for all of Eustella. You're creating a new future for everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: L'esplorazione di Aladiss lascera' un'impronta duratura su tutta Eustella. Stai creando un nuovo futuro per tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Exacto, es una ayuda incalculable. Deberías estar orgullosa. Has pasado por tu propio crecimiento personal y nos has ayudado a todos nosotros, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Indeed, that's an incredible help. You should be proud. You've also personally grown and helped all of us, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Esatto, e' un aiuto inestimabile. Dovresti esserne fiera. Hai anche maturato personalmente e ci hai aiutato tutti noi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Ve directa a casa en cuanto acabe todo esto. Tu familia te estará esperando, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: Head straight home as soon as this is over. You've got family waitin' for you, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Torna dritta a casa appena sara' finita questa storia. La tua famiglia ti aspetta, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Si no lo haces, la próxima generación de Welleks lo tendrá todavía más difícil para volver de su viaje.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I mean, if you don't, you'll be making it harder for the next generation of Welleks to return from their journeys.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Se non lo farai, la prossima generazione di Welleks avra' ancora piu' difficolta' a tornare dai propri viaggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Puedo... irme a casa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I can ... go home ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Posso... tornare a casa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: Estoy deseando ver a mi familia... Tengo muchas ganas de hablarle de los amigos tan maravillosos que he hecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: ... I can't wait to see my family. I want to tell them all about the wonderful friends I made.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Non vedo l'ora di rivedere la mia famiglia... Ho tanta voglia di raccontarle degli amici meravigliosi che ho fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..src: ¡Tengo que seguir esforzándome al máximo hasta que llegue ese día!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..ref: I have to keep doing my best until that day comes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm05_160..dst: Devo continuare a impegnarmi al massimo fino a quel giorno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_010..src: Mi madre siempre me decía: «Ofrece tu ayuda a quien más lo necesite».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_010..ref: My mother always told me, "Be someone who lends a hand to those in need."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_010..dst: Mia madre mi diceva sempre: "Dai una mano a chi ne ha piu' bisogno".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_010..src: Solía repetir: «Si haces el bien, te pasarán cosas buenas».

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..src: Fiu, no sé cómo, pero lo hemos logrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..dst: Uff, non so come, ma ce l'abbiamo fatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..src: Parece que nos hemos quedado atrás, ¿eh? Me pregunto si podré llegar arriba escalando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..ref: Left behind, huh? I wonder if I can climb up to the top.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..dst: Sembra che siamo rimasti indietro, eh? Mi chiedo se posso arrampicarmi fino in cima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..src: Yo diría que el camino sigue por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..ref: It appears that the path continues this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..dst: Direi che il sentiero continua da qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..src: Gracias. Vamos, veamos hasta dónde nos lleva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_020..ref: Thanks. Let's see where it leads.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..ref: Huh, so you managed to survive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..dst: Sei ancora in un pezzo solo, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..ref: Don't go digging my grave just yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..dst: Sento un po' di delusione, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..src: ¿En serio? ¿Crees que va a aceptar sin más y entregártelo por las buenas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..dst: Sul serio? Credi che acconsenta e te lo restituisca di buon grado?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..src: ¡Entonces se lo arrebataremos por la fuerza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..ref: We found that! Give it back!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..dst: Allora glielo toglieremo con la forza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm00_030..ref: Give it up. There's no way he'll just meekly nod his head and hand it back.
Then we'll just have to take it back by force!
Heh ... I was right about you. You have tremendous aptitude.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Uf, uf...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: *Huff* *Huff* ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Uff, uff...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Erhard, acabo de encontrar el lugar perfecto para un Atelier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Erhard, I've finally found the perfect place for an atelier!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Erhard, ho appena trovato il posto perfetto per un Atelier.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Estoy segura de que un alquimista ocupó esas ruinas hace tiempo. ¡Incluso puede que hallemos algunas reliquias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I'm sure an alchemist used those ruins at some point. We might even be able to find some relics there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Sono sicura che un alchimista usasse quelle rovine tanto tempo fa. Potremmo persino trovare alcune reliquie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Además, está justo encima de una ruta de maná que conecta con el faro y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Not only that, but it's located on top of a mana pathway connected to the lighthouse—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: In piu', si trova proprio sopra una via di mana collegata al faro e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Yumia, despacio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Now, now, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Yumia, piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: ¿Señor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Sir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Signore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Es cierto que dije que debíamos estar preparados para todo, pero no me refería a que saliéramos a explorar cada rincón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I did say to get ready, but I didn't say to run around investigating everything quite yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: E' vero, ho detto che dovevamo essere pronti a tutto, ma non intendevo che andaste a esplorare ogni angolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Lo lamento... Solo quería ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: ... I'm sorry. I just wanted to help out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Mi dispiace... Volevo solo aiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: No, no, es culpa mía por no explicarme bien. La próxima vez, ten más cuidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: No, it's my fault for not explaining properly. But please be a little more mindful next time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: No, no, e' colpa mia se non mi sono spiegato bene. La prossima volta, stai piu' attenta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Eres muy importante para el equipo de investigación de Aladiss, pero recuerda que también estás bajo tutela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: You're a vital part of the Aladiss Research Team, but you must remember that you're also under observation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Sei molto importante per la Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss, ma ricorda che sei anche sotto tutela.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: ... I understand.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Comprendo cómo te sientes, sabiendo la opinión que tienen los demás sobre ti...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I can understand how you feel, given the way the public feels about you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Capisco come ti senti, sapendo cosa pensano di te gli altri...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Pero necesito que seas más paciente. La investigación acaba de comenzar. Mira, ya están aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: But I ask that you be patient. The investigation has almost started. ... Look, they've arrived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ma ho bisogno che tu sia piu' paziente. La ricerca e' appena cominciata. Guarda, eccoli qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Hola, jefe. ¿Ella es la chica que mencionaste?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Chief. Is she the one you mentioned?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ciao, capo. Lei e' la ragazza di cui parlavi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Sí, es la alquimista que ha venido para ayudarnos con la investigación del Imperio aladissiano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Yes, this is the alchemist I brought in to help with our survey of the Aladissian Empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Si', e' l'alchimista venuta ad aiutarci con la ricerca sull'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Como ya hemos hablado, quiero que los dos la vigiléis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: As we discussed, I'd like you two to watch over her for the time being.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Come gia' detto, voglio che voi due la teniate d'occhio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Como ordenes, jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: If those are your orders, Chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Come ordini, capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Eres la alquimista Yumia Liessfeldt, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Alchemist Yumia Liessfeldt, was it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Sei l'alchimista Yumia Liessfeldt, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Yo soy Viktor von Duerer, de la Orden de Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I am Viktor von Duerer, of the Order of Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Io sono Viktor von Duerer, dell'Ordine di Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Seguro que el jefe Erhard ya te habrá informado, pero me encargaré de supervisar tus obligaciones como alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: You must have heard from Chief Erhard, but I will be in charge of observing you and your duties as an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Il capo Erhard ti avra' gia' informato, ma sara' mio compito supervisionare i tuoi doveri come alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: No te olvides de dónde estás y cumple con tu cometido. Por supuesto, te ayudaremos en lo que necesites.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Be conscious of your position here and carry out your duties. We will of course provide support as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Non dimenticare dove ti trovi e adempi al tuo compito. Naturalmente, ti aiuteremo in cio' di cui avrai bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Ah... Vale, cuento con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I-I'll be counting on you then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ah... Va bene, contero' su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Como sabrás, el uso de la alquimia está prohibido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I'm sure you already know this, but alchemy is a forbidden technique.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Come gia' saprai, l'uso dell'alchimia e' proibito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Se te ha concedido un permiso especial para servirte de ella únicamente en la investigación. Tenlo muy presente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: You have been given special permission to use it solely to aid the investigation. Keep that in mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ti e' stato concesso un permesso speciale per utilizzarla soltanto nella ricerca. Tienilo ben presente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Viktor, echa el freno, que todavía estamos con las presentaciones. ¿No crees que estás siendo demasiado formal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Hold on, Viktor, we're meeting her for the first time here. Don't you think you're being too formal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Viktor, moderati, siamo ancora alle presentazioni. Non trovi di essere troppo formale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Como sigas así, nunca harás amigos. ¡Relájate un poco!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: If you're like that, we'll never be on friendly terms! Loosen up a little!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Se continui cosi', non ti farai mai degli amici. Rilassati un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Hola, yo soy Isla von Duerer, también de la Orden. Mi hermano mayor y yo nos alistamos voluntariamente en el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Hmph ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ciao, io sono Isla von Duerer, anch'io dell'Ordine. Io e mio fratello maggiore ci siamo arruolati volontari nella Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Un placer, Yumia. Tenemos la misma edad, ¿verdad? Entonces, olvidémonos de las formalidades, ¿te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I'm Isla von Duerer, and I'm with the Order as well. My older brother and I volunteered to join the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Piacere, Yumia. Abbiamo la stessa eta', vero? Allora, lasciamo perdere le formalita', ti pare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Un placer conocerla... ¡digo, conocerte! Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: It's great to meet you, Yumia. We're about the same age, so let's drop the stuffy formalities and just be casual!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Piacere di conoscerla... dico, di conoscerti! Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Me alegro de... bueno, es... Un placer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I-it's nice to meet you too, Miss von D— ... I mean, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Mi fa piacere... beh, ecco... Un piacere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Ya te irás soltando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I'm pleased to make your acqua— ... I mean, it's nice to meet you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ahahah! Piano piano ti scioglierai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Sois tal para cual, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Ahaha, I told you, no need for all the formalities!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Siete proprio uguali, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Lo que tú digas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: That goes for you too, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Come dici tu...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Gracias. Sé que la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Um, yeah ... Let's get along.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Grazie. So che l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: ¡Ay, un momento!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Thank you. I'm well aware of how alchemy is—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Oh, un momento!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: ¿Alguna vez habéis visto alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: O-oh! Hold on!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Avete mai visto l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Claro que no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Have you two ever seen alchemy before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Certo che no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: No se nos ha presentado la ocasión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Of course not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Non se ne e' presentata l'occasione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Entonces, me gustaría enseñaros de qué se trata.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Not like we ever had the chance to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Allora, vorrei mostrarvi di cosa si tratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Creo que sería beneficioso para todo el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: In that case, I'd like you to see it. ... What alchemy really is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Penso che sarebbe utile per tutta la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: ¿Te parece bien, Erhard?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: I think it will be helpful to the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Ti va bene, Erhard?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Claro. Tarde o temprano, deberán saberlo, dado que trabajaréis juntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Is it all right with you, Erhard?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Certo. Prima o poi dovranno saperlo, visto che lavorerete insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Gracias. ¿Os importaría seguirme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Sure. It's something they should learn about, given that you'll be working together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Grazie. Vi dispiace seguirmi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Aunque no nos lo pidas, es nuestro deber estar a tu lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Thank you. Okay then, both of you, please follow me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Anche se non ce lo chiedessi, e' nostro dovere restare al tuo fianco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..src: Isla y Viktor se han unido al grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..ref: Even if you hadn't told us to, it's our duty to go wherever you go ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_010..dst: Isla e Viktor si sono uniti al gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: This place is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Questo posto e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: ¡Mi Atelier! O al menos... eso he decidido por el momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: My atelier! ... Or at least, that's what I've decided. Starting right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Il mio Atelier! O almeno... per ora ho deciso cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Atelier?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Atelier?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Es como una base, pero de alquimistas. Por lo que he visto, deduzco que se usó para ese propósito hace mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Hmm, think of it like an alchemist's base. I think that this place was used for the same purpose a long time ago, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: E' come una base, ma per alchimisti. Da quello che ho visto, deduco che venne usata a tale scopo molto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: ... It's a dump.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: E' una discarica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Bueno, supongo que no es precisamente un palacio... Ya tengo pensadas algunas reformas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: It is currently in a less-than-ideal state, sure ... Let's just say some renovations are in order.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Beh, mica e' un palazzo... Ho gia' in mente qualche ristrutturazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Cuando dices hace mucho tiempo, ¿te refieres a incluso antes del Gran Desastre?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: By long ago, you mean even before the Great Disaster of Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Quando dici molto tempo fa, intendi anche prima del Grande Disastro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: ¿No sería entonces muy peligroso estar aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Then doesn't that mean this place is pretty dangerous?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Allora non sarebbe molto pericoloso stare qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Mmm... Yo no veo nada que se salga de lo normal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Hmm, I don't think there was anything particularly unusual here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Mmh... Non vedo niente di strano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Recurrir a artes prohibidas para controlar su mal uso... De verdad, no entiendo al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Using the forbidden to control the forbidden ... I don't understand what the chief is thinking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Ricorrere alle arti proibite per controllarne l'uso improprio... Sul serio, non capisco il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: A-ah ... ha ha ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Eh, eh...
