eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Allora, parliamo del vostro prossimo compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: El motivo por el que pedí la colaboración de Yumia en el equipo de investigación es porque hay algo que solo ella puede hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Well then, if that's the case, let's get right to the topic of your next task.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Il motivo per cui ho chiesto la collaborazione di Yumia alla Squadra di Ricerca e' che c'e' qualcosa che solo lei puo' fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¿Solo yo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: The main reason I brought on Yumia to the Research Team was for a duty only she can fulfill.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Solo io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Venid conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Something only I can do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Venite con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: No hace frío, pero tampoco calor, qué sensación tan rara...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: No heat, no cold. What a strange sensation ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Non fa freddo, ma nemmeno caldo, che sensazione strana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Esto... me recuerda a...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: This feeling, it's just like back when ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Questo... mi ricorda...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Delante hay una zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Ahead lies a manabound area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Davanti si trova una zona legata al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Como ya sabréis, el maná se crea cuando los recuerdos de una fuerza vital regresan a la tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: As I'm sure you know, mana is created when the memories engraved into a life force return to the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Come gia' saprete, il mana si crea quando i ricordi incisi in una forza vitale ritornano alla terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: En esencia, es una fuente de energía universal que utilizamos en nuestro día a día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: It is in essence a universal energy source—one that is used in our daily lives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: In sostanza, e' una fonte di energia universale che utilizziamo nella vita di tutti i giorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Pero, si el maná se concentra demasiado en una zona, puede afectar negativamente a quien se aproxima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: But if mana is too concentrated, it can have negative effects on the body.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Ma se il mana si concentra troppo in una zona, puo' avere effetti negativi su chi si avvicina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: El maná está impregnado con los recuerdos de los difuntos. Si no extremamos las precauciones al acercarnos, notaríamos dolores de cabeza y mareos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Mana is filled with the memories of the dead. Too much at once, and it can cause headaches and dizziness.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Il mana e' impregnato dei ricordi dei defunti. Se non prendiamo le dovute precauzioni avvicinandoci, avvertiremmo mal di testa e vertigini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Con el tiempo, perderíamos el conocimiento y nos desmayaríamos. Eso es lo que ocurre en una zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Eventually, you'll lose consciousness and collapse. That's the kind of place a manabound area is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Prima o poi, perderemmo i sensi e sveniremmo. E' questo che accade in una zona legata al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Por eso nuestra investigación de Aladiss estuvo estancada durante unos años, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: That is the major reason why our investigation of Aladiss was stalled for many years, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: E' per questo che la nostra indagine su Aladiss e' rimasta in stallo per diversi anni, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Sí, pero ante nosotros tenemos a alguien que podría salvar ese escollo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Yes. But the one who can solve that problem stands before us now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Si', ma davanti a noi c'e' qualcuno che potrebbe superare quell'ostacolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Es cierto, con este Núcleo de energía, no me pasaría nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: It's true. As long as I have this Energy Core, I'll be okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: E' vero, con questo Nucleo di Energia, non mi succederebbe nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Es un contenedor de energía, el maná en su forma líquida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: This is a container for energy, the liquefied form of mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: E' un contenitore di energia, il mana nella sua forma liquida.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Si lo uso para cubrirnos de energía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: If I take this and coat energy over us ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Se lo uso per avvolgerci di energia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Nos protegerá de los efectos de la concentración de maná en el organismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: It can protect against the effects of highly concentrated mana on the body.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Ci proteggera' dagli effetti della concentrazione di mana sull'organismo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: ¿En serio? ¡Entonces podríamos explorar las zonas de vínculo de maná!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Wow! That means we can even explore inside manabound areas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Davvero? Allora potremmo esplorare le zone legate al mana!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Un momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Hold on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Un momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Entonces, sin esa herramienta, sería inútil profundizar en esas zonas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: That also means that if we don't have her tool, we can't do anything in those manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Quindi, senza quello strumento, sarebbe inutile addentrarsi in quelle zone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Como nosotros la acompañamos... estaríamos dejando nuestra vida en sus manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Which means that for those of us accompanying her, our lives are in her hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Dato che noi la accompagniamo... staremmo mettendo la nostra vita nelle sue mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Cierto, pero no creo que a Yumia se le ocurra cometer ninguna locura. La encarcelaríamos por toda la eternidad. Sería su fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: That's true, but if Yumia were to do anything foolish, she would be imprisoned and her life would be over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Vero, ma non credo che a Yumia verrebbe in mente di commettere qualche follia. La chiuderemmo in carcere per tutta l'eternita'. Sarebbe la sua fine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Aunque lo único que puedo pediros es que confiéis en ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: All I can really do is ask for you to trust her, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Pero' l'unica cosa che posso chiedervi e' che vi fidiate di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: En pocas palabras: quiero que entréis en la zona de vínculo de maná... y lleguéis hasta el Faro Dux.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Anyhow, the first task for you all is to go into the manabound area ... Head to the Dux Lighthouse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: In poche parole: voglio che entriate nella zona legata al mana... e che arriviate fino al Faro Dux.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: ¿Por qué? ¿Qué hay allí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Is there something over there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Perche'? Che cosa c'e' la'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Antes de conoceros, cuando di con mi Atelier...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Before I met you two, when I found the atelier ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Prima di conoscervi, quando ho trovato il mio Atelier...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Descubrí que hay una ruta de maná enorme que conecta con el faro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: I discovered that there's a large mana pathway connecting it to the lighthouse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Ho scoperto che c'e' un enorme percorso di mana che collega al faro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: ¿Una ruta de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: A mana pathway?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Un percorso di mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: El maná que no puede seguir estas rutas, acaba acumulándose en la superficie, en estas zonas de maná condensado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Mana that can't properly flow through the pathways ends up collecting above ground in Aladiss's manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Il mana che non riesce a seguire questi percorsi finisce per accumularsi in superficie, in queste zone di mana condensato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Es lo que ha ocurrido en el faro. La afluencia de maná se sale de lo normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: It's the same around the lighthouse as well. It's like that because the flow of mana isn't normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: E' quello che e' accaduto al faro. Il flusso di mana e' fuori dal normale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Según nuestra evaluación preliminar, Aladiss contaba con unos dispositivos de circulación de maná en rutas como estas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: According to our preliminary research, Aladiss had major pathways like these fitted with mana circulators.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Secondo la nostra valutazione preliminare, Aladiss disponeva di dispositivi di circolazione del mana su percorsi come questi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Allí podría manipular el maná para restaurar la afluencia... O eso creo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: If I can go there, I think I could manipulate the mana to restore the proper flow ... Probably.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Li' potrei manipolare il mana per ripristinare il flusso... O almeno credo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: (Si sigo los pasos de mi madre...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: (If I can do what Mom did ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: (Se seguo i passi di mia madre...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: O eso crees, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: "Probably," huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: O questo credi, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Lo siento, no podría asegurarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: I'm sorry. I can't say for certain yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Mi dispiace, non posso ancora assicurarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: En teoría, deberíamos tener éxito, pero todo está en manos de Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: In theory, we have a chance of success. The rest is up to Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: In teoria, dovremmo avere successo, ma tutto e' nelle mani di Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: En mis manos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Up to me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Nelle mie mani...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Todo lo que hice... formar parte del equipo de investigación, involucrarme en artes prohibidas por mi cuenta, venir aquí... todo fue por este fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: The reason I got involved with the forbidden at my own risk and came here on the Research Team is all for this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Tutto cio' che ho fatto... entrare a far parte della Squadra di Ricerca, occuparmi di arti proibite di mia iniziativa, venire qui... e' stato tutto per questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Quiero usar mi poder para ayudar a los demás y dedicarme a completar encargos que nadie más puede aceptar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: If I can use this power to help everyone here, then I want to do the things only I can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Voglio usare il mio potere per aiutare gli altri e dedicarmi a portare a termine incarichi che nessun altro puo' accettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Ya lo habéis oído.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: And there you have it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: L'avete sentito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Cumpliremos con la tarea que nos asignen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: We will simply fulfill the duty we were assigned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Adempiremo al compito che ci verra' assegnato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: Os lo agradezco. Cuento con todos vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Thank you kindly. Well then, I'm counting on you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Ve ne ringrazio. Conto su tutti voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..src: ¡Sí, señor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..ref: Understood!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_101..dst: Si', signore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..src: (No puedo fallar... debo esforzarme por cumplir con la misión.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: (I can't fail this mission ... I've got to do everything I can.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..dst: (Non posso fallire... devo fare del mio meglio per portare a termine la missione.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..src: Perdón, pero antes de ir al faro, necesito preparar el equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: Sorry, but before we go to the lighthouse, I need some time to prepare my equipment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..dst: Scusate, ma prima di andare al faro ho bisogno di preparare l'attrezzatura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..src: Me alegro de que te lo tomes tan en serio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: It's good that you're taking this seriously from the beginning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..dst: Mi fa piacere che tu la prenda cosi' sul serio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: What equipment do you need to prepare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..src: Bueno... me gustaría estar preparada para cualquier acontecimiento, por eso quisiera tener varias cosas a mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: Well ... In order to be ready for whatever might happen out there, I'd like to have a variety of things at the ready.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..dst: Beh... vorrei essere pronta a ogni evenienza, per questo vorrei avere diverse cose a portata di mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..ref: Maybe I'll try making a new tool.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_102..dst: Forse provero' a creare un nuovo strumento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: ¡Lo he encontrado! Un géiser de maná. Debería ser capaz de aprovechar su energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: Found it! A mana geyser. We should be able to use this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: L'ho trovato! Un geyser di mana. Dovrei riuscire a sfruttarne l'energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: ¿Qué te pasa, Yumia? ¿Hay algo especial aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: What is it, Yumia? Is there something special here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: Che c'e', Yumia? C'e' qualcosa di speciale qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: El maná fluye desde la tierra en este punto. Y yo puedo aprovechar ese maná para la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: There's mana flowing out from the earth here. I can use it for alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: In questo punto il mana sgorga dalla terra. E io posso sfruttare quel mana per l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: Es cierto que intuyo cierta energía a mi alrededor. ¿Dices que puedes usarla para tu alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: We can only vaguely feel something here, yet you can make use of it for alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: E' vero, riesco a percepire una certa energia intorno a me. Dici che puoi usarla per la tua alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: Sí. La necesito para crear nuevas recetas de síntesis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: Yes. I need it to make new synthesis recipes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: Si'. Mi serve per creare nuove ricette di sintesi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: Los recuerdos grabados en el maná me sirven de guía para fabricar herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: The memories engraved into the mana serve as a kind of guide for making tools.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: I ricordi impressi nel mana mi guidano nella creazione degli strumenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: A medida que exploremos las distintas regiones, encontraremos más recuerdos y ampliaré mi repertorio de recetas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: As we continue exploring, we'll come into contact with more memories, which will let me make more things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: Man mano che esploreremo le varie regioni, troveremo altri ricordi ed espandero' il mio repertorio di ricette.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: ¿Nos puedes enseñar qué tenías pensado crear?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..dst: Ci mostri cosa avevi in mente di creare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..ref: Can you show us what you're thinking of making?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_103..src: ¡Bueno! Al fin y al cabo, debemos vigilar tus movimientos.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..ref: These are called particles. Hmm, how to explain ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..src: Básicamente, son fragmentos de recuerdos que se infiltran en el maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..ref: To put it simply, they are the remnants of memories that were engraved in mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..dst: In pratica, sono frammenti di ricordi che si infiltrano nel mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..src: Con las partículas, puedo crear una receta y fabricar nuevas herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..ref: By gathering particles, one can form a recipe for creating a new tool.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..dst: Con le particelle, posso creare una ricetta e fabbricare nuovi strumenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..src: Una receta de algo tan brillante... Qué guay...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..ref: Wow, a recipe from this shiny stuff ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..dst: Una ricetta da una cosa cosi' brillante... Che figata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_110..ref: Please wait for a moment, you two.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..src: (Si practico la alquimia, seré capaz de fabricar aún más cosas.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..ref: (The more things I can make, the more I'll be capable of doing.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..dst: (Se mi esercito con l'alchimia, saro' capace di fabbricare ancora piu' cose.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..src: (Y, cuanta más experiencia consiga, más probabilidades habrá de que sea útil para el equipo de investigación.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..ref: (And the more I'm capable of doing, the more opportunities I'll have to be useful to the Research Team.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..dst: (E, piu' esperienza acquisiro', piu' possibilita' ci saranno che io sia utile alla Squadra di Ricerca.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..src: (¡Estoy haciendo progresos para descubrir todo mi potencial!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..ref: (This is definitely a step toward unlocking my potential!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_111..dst: (Sto facendo progressi per scoprire tutto il mio potenziale!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..src: He encontrado esta gema oculta... ¿Será algún tipo de ingrediente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..ref: I found this pretty gem tucked away ... Is it an ingredient of some kind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..dst: Ho trovato questa gemma nascosta... Sara' qualche tipo di ingrediente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..src: Me pregunto si el anterior dueño dejaría algo por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..ref: I wonder if it's something left behind by this place's previous owner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..dst: Mi chiedo se il precedente proprietario avra' lasciato qualcosa qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..src: Noto cómo brillan todo tipo de recuerdos, como si un montón de maná se hubiera condensado para darle forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..ref: I can feel the shimmering of all kinds of memories, as if a bunch of mana was condensed into one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..dst: Sento brillare ogni tipo di ricordi, come se un mucchio di mana si fosse condensato per dargli forma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..src: Ese cristal es un cúmulo de maná. Percibo ondulaciones únicas en su interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..ref: The crystal is a cluster of mana. Distinctive undulations are detected inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..dst: Quel cristallo e' un aggregato di mana. Percepisco ondulazioni uniche al suo interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_112..ref: Really? Maybe I can use this for something.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: ¿Esta «receta» es de lo que hablabas antes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: This is the recipe that you mentioned earlier?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: Questa e' la "ricetta" di cui parlavi prima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: Sí, se llama Vial de recuerdos. La inspiración para esta receta está contenida en su interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: It's called a Memory Vial. The inspiration for the recipe is inside it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: Si', si chiama Fiala della Memoria. L'ispirazione per questa ricetta e' contenuta al suo interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: En un Vial de recuerdos se pueden almacenar todo tipo de cosas. Conocimiento, información, recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: With a Memory Vial, you can store all sorts of things. Knowledge and information, even people's memories ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: In una Fiala della Memoria si puo' conservare ogni tipo di cosa. Conoscenza, informazioni, ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: ¿Dices que hay información en este vial? ¡Suena a magia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: There's information inside this vial? I can't even begin to wrap my head around it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: Stai dicendo che ci sono informazioni in questa fiala? Sembra magia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: Otro ejemplo de las grandes hazañas de Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: So this is another example of what Aladiss managed to accomplish, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: Un altro esempio delle grandi gesta di Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: En este momento, solo me dice cómo hacer herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: All I can do with it at this point is record how to make tools, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: Per ora, posso usarlo solo per registrare come si creano gli strumenti, pero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: (Todavía me quedan muchas cosas por aprender, pero ya iré ganando experiencia...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: (There are a lot of things I don't know yet, but with more experience, surely ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: (Ci sono ancora tante cose che non so, ma con un po' di esperienza...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..src: (Tengo que aprovechar al máximo el tiempo que pase aquí.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..ref: (I have to make the most of my time here.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_120..dst: (Devo sfruttare al massimo il tempo che passero' qui.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..src: No se mueve. Con tanto óxido no se puede abrir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: Looks like it won't budge. The rust has fused it shut.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..dst: Non si muove. Con cosi' tanta ruggine non si puo' aprire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..src: Nadie ha estado por aquí desde hace tiempo, tiene sentido, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: No one has come through here for quite a long time, so I guess it makes sense, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..dst: Nessuno passa di qui da parecchio tempo, quindi e' comprensibile, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..src: Oye, esta es la única entrada, ¿no? ¡Hay que dar con el modo de abrirla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: Wait, this is the only entrance, right? We've gotta find a way to open it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..dst: Ehi, questo e' l'unico ingresso, no? Dobbiamo trovare il modo di aprirla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..src: Llegados a este punto, podría intentar arreglarla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: In that case, I could try to fix it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..dst: A questo punto, potrei provare a ripararla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: Huh? You can fix it, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..src: Eso creo. A ver, para la puerta necesito...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..ref: Probably. Let's see, for this door, I'd need ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_130..dst: Penso di si'. Vediamo, per la porta mi serve...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..src: Así que estas son las cosas que consigue la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..ref: So an alchemist can even do things like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..dst: Quindi queste sono le cose che riesce a fare l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..src: Yo no lo llamaría alquimia... Es más un apaño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..ref: I wouldn't call this alchemy, more like regular repair work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..dst: Io non lo chiamerei alchimia... E' piu' un rattoppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..src: Es que a Viktor no se le dan muy bien esas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..ref: Viktor's no good at stuff like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_140..dst: E' che a Viktor non riescono molto bene quelle cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..src: Noto cómo brillan todo tipo de recuerdos, como si un montón de maná se hubiera condensado para darle forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..ref: I can feel the shimmering of all kinds of memories, as if a bunch of mana was condensed into one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..dst: Sento brillare ogni tipo di ricordi, come se un mucchio di mana si fosse condensato per dargli forma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..src: Ese cristal es un cúmulo de maná. Percibo ondulaciones únicas en su interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..ref: That crystal is a cluster of mana. Distinctive undulations can be detected inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..dst: Quel cristallo e' un aggregato di mana. Percepisco ondulazioni uniche al suo interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_150..ref: Really? Maybe I can use this for something.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: ¿Será este pedestal el dispositivo de circulación de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: Could this pedestal be the mana circulator?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Sara' questo piedistallo il dispositivo di circolazione del mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: No. Solo los restos de uno. Se debió de romper durante el desastre y ahora solo nos queda el pedestal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: No. This is what remains of one. It was likely broken during the disaster, leaving only the pedestal behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: No. Sono solo i resti di uno. Si e' sicuramente rotto durante il disastro e ora e' rimasto solo il piedistallo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: ¿Por eso el maná se ha concentrado por aquí? ¿Porque se rompió?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: So the mana is pooling around here because it broke?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Ecco perche' il mana si e' concentrato qui intorno? Perche' si e' rotto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: Afirmativo. Aunque no existe necesidad para el dispositivo, el maná puede circular de manera natural por todo el planeta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: Yeah. Though there shouldn't be a need for the device, since mana should naturally circulate through the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Affermativo. Anche se il dispositivo non e' necessario, il mana puo' circolare naturalmente in tutto il pianeta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: Otra herida provocada por el Gran Desastre... Yumia, ¿sabías algo del pedestal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: Another scar of the Great Disaster ... Yumia, did you know about the pedestal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Un'altra ferita causata dal Grande Disastro... Yumia, sapevi qualcosa del piedistallo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: No sé si mis conocimientos se podrían aplicar a la tecnología aladissiana, pero ahora que lo tengo delante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: I wasn't sure if my knowledge would be applicable to Aladissian technology, but looking at this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Non sapevo se le mie conoscenze potessero essere applicate alla tecnologia aladissiana, ma ora che ce l'ho davanti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: That explains all the mumbling about how it'll "probably" work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Ora capisco il perche' dei "penso di si'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: En fin. ¿Despejará el maná de todos modos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: Anyway, will this really clear out the mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: Sí. Aunque sería la primera vez que lo intento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: Yes. Though I've never tried it for real before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Si'. Anche se sarebbe la prima volta che ci provo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: Allí había otro pedestal... Si repito lo que pasó...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: The pedestal was there too ... If I just do it like back then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Anche li' c'era un piedistallo... Se faccio come allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..src: Sí... Eso fue lo que hizo Irene.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..ref: ... Yes. That is what Irene did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_160..dst: Si'... Fu quello che fece Irene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Yumia, lo has logrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: You pulled it off, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ce l'hai fatta, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Menudo alivio. Todo ha salido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: That's a relief. Everything went well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Che sollievo. E' andato tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¡Eres genial, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Wow, you're amazing, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Sei fantastica, Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: La zona de vínculo de maná... Ya no está...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: The manabound area is cleared up ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: La zona legata al mana... Non c'e' piu'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Siendo así, seguro que podemos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: If this is possible, then we can surely ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Se e' cosi', di sicuro possiamo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¡Vaaaya! ¡Tampoco queda por allí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Oooh! It's cleared up over here too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ooooh! Neanche laggiu' ne e' rimasto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Buen trabajo, muchachos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Good job, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Buon lavoro, ragazzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¡Jefe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Chief!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Capo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Justo como esperaba de vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: It's just as I had hoped.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Proprio come mi aspettavo da voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Once when we had tried to investigate in the past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Cuando lo intentamos en el pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: The manabound area prevented us from getting near the lighthouse, even though it was right in front of us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Quando ci abbiamo provato in passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: La zona de vínculo de maná nos impidió alcanzar el faro, aunque lo teníamos a pocos pasos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: But now we can. The mana is gone, and we have a path forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: La zona legata al mana ci impedi' di raggiungere il faro, anche se lo avevamo a pochi passi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Pero ahora ya podemos ir. El maná ha desaparecido y el camino está despejado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Thank you. This is without a doubt a massive step forward for the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ma ora possiamo andarci. Il mana e' scomparso e la strada e' libera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Y todo gracias a ti. Significa mucho para el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: I should be the one thanking you for entrusting me with this. I'm so glad I could be helpful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: E lo dobbiamo tutto a te. Significa molto per la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Soy yo quien debe darte las gracias por confiar en mí para esta tarea. Me alegra haber servido de algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: It was certainly the right call to leave it to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Sono io a doverti ringraziare per avermi affidato questo compito. Sono contenta di essere stata utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Es innegable que eras la más indicada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: There's no need to thank me. This is my duty, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: E' innegabile che fossi la piu' adatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: No hace falta que me lo agradezcas. Solo cumplo con mi deber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Good attitude. I'll be counting on you to keep it up from here on out as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Non c'e' bisogno di ringraziarmi. Faccio solo il mio dovere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¡Esa es la actitud! Espero que mantengas ese nivel de entrega de aquí en adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Is it really all gone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Questo e' l'atteggiamento! Spero che tu mantenga questo impegno d'ora in poi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¿De verdad ha desaparecido por completo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Isn't there a chance it'll go back to how it was? If that happens when we aren't ready ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: E' davvero scomparso del tutto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¿No cabe la posibilidad de que regrese a su estado anterior? Y si no estamos preparados para cuando eso ocurra...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Exactly. Should we really believe what an alchemist has to say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Non c'e' la possibilita' che torni al suo stato precedente? E se non fossimo pronti quando accadra'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Exacto. ¿Deberíamos creer lo que nos cuente esa alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Hey, Yumia, what did you do exactly? Tell us!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Esatto. Dovremmo fidarci di quello che dice quell'alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿qué hiciste exactamente? ¡Cuenta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Uhh ... So, mana pooled in Aladiss because the device was broken ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ehi, Yumia, cosa hai fatto esattamente? Racconta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Esto... Como el dispositivo se rompió, el maná se estancó en Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: So as a substitute for that device, I used my own power to correctly adjust the flow of the pooled mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ehm... Siccome il dispositivo si e' rotto, il mana si e' accumulato in Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Sustituí el dispositivo con mi propio poder y corregí la afluencia del maná estancado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ho sostituito il dispositivo con il mio potere e ho corretto il flusso del mana accumulato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: En pocas palabras, solucioné lo que impedía que el maná estancado fluyera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: To sum it up, I made everything good so that the stagnant mana will flow properly again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: In poche parole, ho risolto cio' che impediva al mana stagnante di fluire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: ¡Ahhh! ¡Muy bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Ohhh, nice job!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ah! Ottimo lavoro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Es uno de los usos de la habilidad de una alquimista para controlar el maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: So that's an application of an alchemist's ability to control mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: E' uno degli usi dell'abilita' di un'alchimista per controllare il mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Sois buenos alumnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: You two understand well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Siete bravi allievi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Ya sea para desvelar lo que desencadenó la caída del Imperio aladissiano o para ser los primeros en explorar el continente...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Whether it's to uncover the truth behind the Aladissian Empire's collapse or to pioneer an uncharted continent ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Che sia per svelare cosa ha causato la cadutta dell'Impero Aladissiano o per esplorare per primi il continente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Mientras tengamos a Yumia con nosotros, podemos conseguir los dos objetivos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: As long as we have Yumia's power, we should be able to achieve both ends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Finche' avremo Yumia con noi, potremo raggiungere entrambi gli obiettivi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Son sueños que van a dejar de serlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Those goals are no longer simply dreams.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Sono sogni che smetteranno di esserlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Con mi poder...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: With my power ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Con il mio potere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Reconozco que tu destreza es esencial para el equipo de investigación. Y cumpliste con tu trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: I recognize that your powers are vital to the Research Team. You accomplished the job you needed to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Riconosco che la tua abilita' e' essenziale per la Squadra di Ricerca. E hai svolto il tuo compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Sigue usando ese poder por el bien de todos, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Please continue to use that power correctly for the good of us all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Continua a usare quel potere per il bene di tutti, per favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Eso haré. Muchas gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: Yes, I will. Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Lo faro'. Grazie mille.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Ahora que nos hemos abierto paso, deberíamos seguir adelante para llevar a buen término nuestra investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: All right, now that the land has been cleared, we should put it to good use for the sake of our future investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Ora che ci siamo aperti la strada, dovremmo andare avanti per portare a buon fine la nostra ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Todavía te quedan cosas por hacer, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: I still have plenty of work for you to do, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Hai ancora molte cose da fare, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..src: Haré todo lo que esté en mi mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..ref: I will do whatever I can to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_170..dst: Faro' tutto cio' che e' in mio potere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Creo que podríamos establecer aquí la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: I think we could use this place as a base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Penso che potremmo stabilire qui la base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Tener diferentes bases es fundamental para el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: Agreed. Increasing our number of bases is a vital part of the Research Team's efforts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Sono d'accordo. Avere basi diverse e' fondamentale per la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Despejaremos las zonas de vínculo de maná, aseguraremos los alrededores y construiremos nuevas bases para seguir explorando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: Clear up manabound areas, secure safe land, build new bases, and branch out from there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Libereremo le zone di collegamento del mana, metteremo in sicurezza i dintorni e costruiremo nuove basi per continuare a esplorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Haremos esto todas las veces que sea necesario y, con el tiempo, seremos capaces de abarcar toda Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: We repeat this again and again, and eventually, the scope of our investigation will span the whole of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Lo faremo tutte le volte che sara' necessario e, col tempo, riusciremo a coprire tutta Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Cuanto mayores sean las bases, ¡más personas podrán venir a trabajar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: And the bigger and better our bases are, the easier the investigation will go!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Piu' grandi saranno le basi, piu' persone potranno venire a lavorare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Yumia, todo el equipo se está esforzando por recorrer las sendas que les has abierto. En todos los sentidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Yumia, tutta la squadra si sta impegnando per percorrere i sentieri che hai aperto per loro. In tutti i sensi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Al construir bases en nuevos horizontes, harás que el resto del equipo lo tenga mucho más fácil para seguir investigando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: Yumia, the team is working hard to follow the paths you've laid out for them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Costruendo basi verso nuovi orizzonti, renderai molto piu' facile al resto della squadra continuare le ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Yo me encargo, jefe. Construir y fabricar son las cosas que se me dan bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: If you set up bases while you're on the front line, it will be a great aid to the rest of us who go there afterwards.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Me ne occupo io, capo. Costruire e fabbricare sono le cose che so fare meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..src: Excelente. Tengo muchas ganas de ver los resultados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..ref: Making things is what I do best. Just leave the bases to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_171..dst: Eccellente. Non vedo l'ora di vedere i risultati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: All right, this should be good.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Has construido una base en un abrir y cerrar de ojos... Ya veo. Puede servir de apoyo para la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: You built a base in such a short time ... I see. This will serve as a good foothold for the investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Hai costruito una base in un batter d'occhio... Capisco. Puo' servire da appoggio per le indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Volvamos a la base. Tenemos que preguntar qué deberíamos hacer ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: Let's head back to base. We need to ask about what our next steps are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Torniamo alla base. Dobbiamo chiedere cosa dovremmo fare ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Vale, sobre vuestros próximos pasos... Creo que, antes de seguir avanzando la investigación, deberíamos afianzar las bases de lo que ya tenemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: All right, as for what comes next ... I'd like to solidify our footing before we expand the scope of the investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Va bene, riguardo ai vostri prossimi passi... Penso che, prima di far avanzare le indagini, dovremmo consolidare le basi di cio' che abbiamo gia'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Quiero que os ocupéis de uno de los principales objetivos del equipo de investigación: las labores de exploración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: I want you to take on one of the major objectives of the Research Team—the pioneering effort.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Voglio che vi occupiate di uno dei principali obiettivi della Squadra di Ricerca: le attivita' di esplorazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: Pioneering ... What exactly will we need to do?
The details are all listed in here.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: «Planes de exploración»... Entonces ¿tenemos que ir progresando con las tareas que se detallan aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: "Pioneering plans" ... So we just need to make progress on the tasks listed in here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: "Piani di esplorazione"... Quindi dobbiamo progredire nei compiti descritti qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Hay varias tareas que completar. Si queréis, podéis empezar por la que os parezca más sencilla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: There are multiple tasks to be performed. Feel free to start with whichever seems easiest to achieve.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Ci sono diversi compiti da completare. Se volete, potete iniziare da quello che vi sembra piu' semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Conforme vayáis avanzando con las tareas, quizá recibáis nueva información o se os asignen misiones adicionales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: While you progress through the tasks, you may receive new information or be given additional requests.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: Man mano che avanzerete con i compiti, potrebbe capitarvi di ricevere nuove informazioni o vi verranno assegnate missioni aggiuntive.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Y, cuando llegue ese momento, contaré con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: When that time comes, I'll be counting on you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..dst: E, quando arrivera' quel momento, contero' su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..src: Lo pillo... Haremos lo que podamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_172..ref: ... Understood. We'll see what we can do.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Con vuestra ayuda, hemos completado la iniciativa de exploración en los alrededores y hemos creado buenos cimientos para la labor del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: With your help, we have completed the pioneering effort in the surrounding area and created a solid footing for the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Grazie al vostro aiuto, abbiamo completato l'iniziativa di esplorazione dei dintorni e creato buone fondamenta per il lavoro della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Pero vuestro trabajo aquí no ha terminado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: However, that doesn't mean our work is done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Ma il vostro lavoro qui non e' finito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Vamos a ampliar el alcance de la investigación y a explorar las zonas seleccionadas. De ahora en adelante, tendremos que ocuparnos de ambas tareas a la vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: We'll expand the range of our investigation and pioneer those areas. We must do both in tandem moving forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Amplieremo il raggio delle indagini ed esploreremo le zone selezionate. D'ora in poi dovremo occuparci di entrambi i compiti contemporaneamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Por eso debemos despejar las zonas de vínculo de maná una a una, tal y como Yumia nos ha enseñado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: To do this, it is necessary that we clear the manabound areas one by one, as Yumia showed us earlier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Ecco perche' dobbiamo liberare le zone di legame del mana una a una, proprio come Yumia ci ha mostrato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Según Flammi, la ayudante que me dejó mi madre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: According to Flammi, who was left to me by my mother ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Secondo Flammi, l'assistente che mi ha lasciato mia madre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Parece haber dispositivos de circulación en las grandes rutas de maná, como el que vimos en el faro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: There appear to be circulators situated above large mana pathways, just like the one in the lighthouse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Sembra che ci siano dispositivi di circolazione sulle grandi vie del mana, come quello che abbiamo visto al faro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Existen registros que indican que servían para controlar la afluencia del maná en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: There are records that indicate they were used to regulate the flow of mana in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Esistono registri che indicano che servivano a controllare il flusso di Mana ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Dicho de otro modo, siempre veremos esos pedestales al final de las rutas de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: So, to put it another way, that means that those pedestals will always be located on top of mana pathways.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: In altre parole, vedremo sempre quei piedistalli alla fine delle vie del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Hasta donde yo sé, la ruta de maná que pasa por debajo del faro continúa hacia el norte y hacia el este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: That's correct.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Per quanto ne so, la via del mana che passa sotto il faro continua verso nord e verso est.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Ah, vale, entonces se trata de seguir la ruta y despejar las zonas de vínculo de maná que nos encontremos por el camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: As far as I could tell, the mana pathway under the lighthouse continues to the north and to the east.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Ah, va bene, quindi si tratta di seguire la via e liberare le zone di legame del mana che incontriamo lungo la strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Y, al final, dejará de haber zonas de vínculo de maná en el continente. ¿Ese es el plan?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Oh, okay. Then we should just follow the pathway and clear out the manabound areas along the way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: E alla fine, sul continente non ci saranno piu' zone di legame del mana. E' questo il piano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Justo ese.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Ultimately, we'll have cleared all of the manabound areas across the continent. I'm assuming that's the plan?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Proprio quello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Norte y este... ¿Qué camino tomamos primero?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: That's right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Nord e est... Quale strada prendiamo per prima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: El norte comprende los Bosques de Margo. Es una zona extensa, incluso para la región de Lignumbria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: North or east ... Which way first?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Il nord comprende i Boschi di Margo. E' una zona immensa, persino per la regione di Lignumbria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Creo que lo más productivo sería dirigirse hacia el norte. Pero, si queréis investigar a fondo, lo mejor será dirigirse al este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: The area to the north containing the Margo Woodlands is particularly large, even for the Ligneus region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Penso che la cosa piu' produttiva sia dirigersi verso nord. Ma, se volete indagare a fondo, conviene andare verso est.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Os dejaré a vosotros los detalles de la investigación. Aseguraos de traerme únicamente las buenas noticias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: The most efficient path would be to head north. If you wish to investigate thoroughly, heading east may be best.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Vi lascio i dettagli dell'indagine. Assicuratevi di portarmi solo buone notizie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Bueno, ya sabemos todo lo que ha dicho el jefe, pero ¿qué vamos a hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: I'll leave the detailed investigation plans to you. I'm looking forward to hearing good things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Beh, ormai sappiamo tutto quello che ha detto il capo, ma cosa facciamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Dijo que la investigación sería más productiva si fuéramos hacia el norte. Yo diría que lo mejor sería dirigirnos al bosque.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Chief said all that, but what are we gonna do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Ha detto che l'indagine sarebbe piu' produttiva se andassimo verso nord. Direi che la cosa migliore sia dirigerci verso il bosco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Un momento, si estamos investigando, lo mejor sería mirar en todos los rincones, ¿no? Yo creo que lo mejor es empezar por el este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: He said if we want to investigate efficiently, starting from the north is best. I suggest we head to the woodlands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Un momento, se stiamo indagando, bisognerebbe guardare in ogni angolo, no? Secondo me conviene iniziare da est.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Vaya dos... Nunca coincidís en nada, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: But hold on, if we're investigating, shouldn't we search everywhere? I think going east first is a good idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Che due... Non siete mai d'accordo su niente, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Pues ahora que lo dices... Aunque por lo menos no nos peleamos. Solo discutimos un poco de vez en cuando, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: You two ... don't often think alike, do you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Ora che lo dici... Per lo meno non litighiamo. Discutiamo solo un po' di tanto in tanto, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Pues sí. Que yo recuerde, Isla y yo nunca nos hemos peleado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Now that you mention it ... But we don't fight or anything. Ah, but maybe we quarrel a bit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Gia'. Che io ricordi, io e Isla non ci siamo mai litigati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: ¿En serio? Me alegro de que tengáis una relación como esa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Right. As far as I can remember, Isla and I have never fought.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Davvero? Mi fa piacere che abbiate un rapporto cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Me esforzaré por ganarme vuestra confianza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Really? That's nice, having a relationship like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Mi impegnero' per guadagnarmi la vostra fiducia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Tendrás que ganártela con tus actos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: I'll try hard to earn your trust too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Dovrai guadagnartela con i fatti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Tú eres la que tiene la capacidad de despejar las zonas de vínculo de maná, así que deberías decidir si vamos al norte o el este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: What we think will all depend on your actions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Sei tu quella con la capacita' di liberare le zone di legame di mana, quindi dovresti decidere se andare a nord o a est.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: No hay respuesta incorrecta, podemos elegir el camino que os parezca mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: You're the one with the power to clear manabound areas, so we'll let you decide whether we go north or east.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Non esiste una risposta sbagliata, potete scegliere la strada che vi sembra migliore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Vale, lo pillo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: There's no wrong answer, so choose whatever you think is the best path.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: Va bene, ho capito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: Está bien esto de sentarnos alrededor de una hoguera y contarnos lo que pensamos. Deberíamos hacerlo de vez en cuando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Okay, understood.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: E' piacevole sedersi cosi' attorno a un falo' e raccontarci i nostri pensieri. Dovremmo farlo di tanto in tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: (Ayer Viktor dijo que no había respuesta incorrecta, pero...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: Sitting around a bonfire and sharing our thoughts like this might be nice to do every once in a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: (Ieri Viktor ha detto che non c'e' una risposta sbagliata, ma...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..src: (¿Norte o este?... ¿Qué camino debería elegir?).
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..ref: (Viktor said there was no wrong choice yesterday, but ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_190..dst: (Nord o est?... Quale strada dovrei scegliere?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: ¡Vaaaya! Me pregunto para qué usarían un sitio así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: Whoa! I wonder what this place was used for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Caspita! Mi chiedo a cosa servisse un posto del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: En los libros de historia lo llamaban el Jardín botánico Arbor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: Historical texts call it the Arbor Botanical Garden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Nei libri di storia lo chiamavano il Giardino Botanico Arbor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: Aunque es demasiado grande para ser un jardín botánico...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: Though it's pretty big for a botanical garden ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Anche se e' troppo grande per essere un giardino botanico...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: Yumia, ¿crees que habrá uno de esos pedestales por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: Yumia, do you think there's one of those pedestals here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Yumia, credi che ci sia uno di quei piedistalli da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: Seguro. A juzgar por la afluencia de maná, supongo que habrá uno por alguna parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: Yeah. Judging from the flow of mana, assuming there is one, it should be somewhere around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Certo. A giudicare dal flusso di mana, suppongo ce ne sia uno da qualche parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.src: Espero que no esté demasiado escondido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.ref: I hope it's easy to find ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200a.dst: Spero che non sia troppo nascosto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.src: Hay ruinas por todas partes... Seguro que hay algo para nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: There are ruins all over ... Seems like we'll be able to find something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Ci sono rovine ovunque... Di sicuro troveremo qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.src: Cierto, es la primera vez que veo tantas ruinas en Lignumbria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: True, this is my first time seeing so many ruins in the Ligneus region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Vero, e' la prima volta che vedo cosi' tante rovine a Lignumbria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: Maybe it used to be some kind of big facility or something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Forse un tempo era una grande struttura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.src: Entonces, debería contener registros que hablen de la caída del imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: Which would mean that there might be records relating to the empire's collapse left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Il che vuol dire che dovrebbe contenere registri sulla caduta dell'impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.src: Sería impresionante si encontrásemos algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: It might be a huge achievement if we find something like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Sarebbe impressionante se trovassimo una cosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.src: Ya. Mantened los ojos bien abiertos mientras buscamos el pedestal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.ref: Yeah. Let's keep an eye out while we look for the pedestal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_200b.dst: Gia'. Tenete gli occhi ben aperti mentre cerchiamo il piedistallo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.dst: Ben fatto! Un altro fantastico successo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.src: Me alegro de que haya salido bien. Ahora los demás también podrán acudir a este lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.ref: Yeah, I'm glad it went smoothly. Now everyone else should be able to come here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.dst: Mi fa piacere che sia andata senza intoppi. Ora anche gli altri potranno venire in questo luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.src: Yumia, la afluencia de maná que proviene del faro continúa hacia el norte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.ref: Yumia. It seems that the flow of mana from the lighthouse continues north from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.dst: Yumia, il flusso di mana che proviene dal faro continua verso nord.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.src: Hicimos bien en explorar esta zona. Sigamos la investigación en esta dir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.ref: So exploring here was the right decision. Let's continue investigating in this direct—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.dst: Abbiamo fatto bene a esplorare questa zona. Continuiamo le indagini in questa direz...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.src: Son muchos... ¡Nos enfrentaremos a ellos antes de que nos rodeen!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.ref: There's a lot of them ... We'd better take them out before we're surrounded!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210a.dst: Sono molti... Affrontiamoli prima che ci circondino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Sí, eso creo. Vamos a ver la afluencia de maná...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: Yeah, somehow. Now to check the flow of mana from here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Si', credo. Andiamo a controllare il flusso di mana da qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: La afluencia de maná que proviene del faro se detiene aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: The flow of mana from the lighthouse appears to stop here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Il flusso di mana che proviene dal faro si ferma qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Así que la ruta de maná termina en el norte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: So the mana pathway is only connected to the north.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Quindi il percorso del mana e' collegato solo a nord.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Supongo que la ruta de maná termina en el norte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: I guess the mana pathway must only connect up to the north.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Immagino che il percorso del mana arrivi solo fino a nord.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Lo siento, Viktor, os he hecho perder el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: I'm sorry, Viktor. It seems I've wasted everyone's time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Mi dispiace, Viktor, vi ho fatto perdere tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: No digas eso. No nos vamos de vacío, por lo menos, hemos despejado esta zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: It wasn't a waste. Even just clearing out a manabound area means we aren't leaving empty-handed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Non dire cosi'. Non ci andiamo a mani vuote: almeno abbiamo liberato quest'area dal vincolo di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Es verdad. ¡No le des más vueltas, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: He's right. Don't worry about it, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: E' vero. Non pensarci troppo, Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Además, hablando de no irnos de vacío, he visto algo interesante antes. Seguidme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: Besides, if we're talking about not leaving empty-handed, I saw something earlier. Follow me, you two.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: E poi, visto che si parla di non andare via a mani vuote, prima ho visto qualcosa di interessante. Seguitemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: See? There's definitely something inside, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Vedete? Qui deve esserci qualcosa, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Sí. Puede ser que aquí almacenaran los materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: You're right. This might be where they stored materials in this facility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Gia'. Qui potrebbero aver conservato i materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.src: Pero no parece que se vaya a abrir por las buenas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: But it doesn't look like we can just open it normally.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.dst: Pero' non sembra che si possa aprire cosi' normalmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_210b.ref: That means it's time for me to work my magic.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_211a.ref: Yumia. It seems that the flow of mana from the lighthouse continues north from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_211a.dst: Yumia, il flusso di mana che proviene dal faro continua verso nord.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_211b.ref: That means it's time for me to work my magic.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: That scared me! What was that all about, all of a sudden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: Che spavento! Ma com'e' saltato fuori, tutto d'un tratto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.src: Estaban muy nerviosos... ¿Hemos penetrado en su territorio sin darnos cuenta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: They seemed oddly agitated ... Did we enter their territory without realizing it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: Erano molto nervosi... Sara' che siamo entrati nel loro territorio senza accorgercene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.src: Ahora que lo pienso... Me suena haber oído algo así antes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: Come to think of it, I feel like I've heard something like this before ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: A pensarci bene... Mi sembra di aver sentito qualcosa del genere prima...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: Is something happening in this forest?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: Sara' che sta succedendo qualcosa in questa foresta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.src: Nuestro deber es investigar, tanto si hay algo como si no. En cualquier caso, debemos confirmar que la zona es segura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: If there's something here, it's our job to investigate, and if there isn't, then we'll have confirmed the area is safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: Il nostro compito e' indagare, che ci sia qualcosa o meno. In ogni caso, dobbiamo confermare che la zona e' sicura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.src: Seamos cautelosos mientras aseguramos el perímetro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.ref: Let's keep our guard up as we take a look around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_215a.dst: Restiamo in guardia mentre mettiamo in sicurezza il perimetro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Ese monstruo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: That monster ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Quel mostro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¿Eh? ¿Es... una herramienta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Huh? Is that ... some kind of tool ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Eh? E'... uno strumento?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¡Ah!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Ah!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¡Era el mismo! ¿Verdad que sí, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: That was definitely it! Right, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Era proprio lui! Vero, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¡Eh, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Hey, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ehi, Viktor!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Eh... ¡Sí! Perdón...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Oh, yeah! Sorry ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Eh... Si'! Scusa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¡Venga, vamos tras él!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: C'mon you two, after it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Dai, inseguamolo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¿Qu-qué está pasando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: ... Right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ch-che sta succedendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Nada, lo hemos perdido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Wh-what? What's going on?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Niente, l'abbiamo perso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Un callejón sin salida... ¡Maldita sea! ¿Por qué me quedé bloqueado justo en ese momento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: It's no good, we've lost track of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Un vicolo cieco... Dannazione! Perche' mi sono bloccato proprio in quel momento?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¡Es-esperad! ¿Por qué estáis tan nerviosos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: So this is as far as we get ... Darn it! Why did I freeze up at such a crucial moment?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Fe-fermi! Perche' siete cosi' nervosi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: También vienes de Duerer, debiste de estar presente cuando sucedió todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: H-hold on! What's gotten you so worked up?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Anche tu vieni da Duerer, devi essere stato presente quando e' successo tutto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Ha llegado el momento de contarle lo que vimos aquel día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: That's because ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: E' arrivato il momento di raccontarle quello che abbiamo visto quel giorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Sí, en efecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: ... You're also from Duerer, so you must have been there when it happened too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Si', esatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Ese monstruo es el motivo por el que nos alistamos al equipo de investigación. Hemos jurado acabar con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: It's time we tell her what we saw that day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Quel mostro e' il motivo per cui ci siamo arruolati nella Squadra di Ricerca. Abbiamo giurato di finirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¿Podéis ser más concretos...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Yes, it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Potreste essere piu' precisi...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Fue hace tres años, seguro que ya lo sabes, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: That monster is the reason we joined the Research Team. It is our mortal enemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: E' stato tre anni fa, sicuramente lo sai gia', ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Hubo una enorme explosión de maná en la zona de Duerer de la República de Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: ... Would you mind telling me more?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ci fu un'enorme esplosione di mana nella zona di Duerer della Repubblica di Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Las explosiones sucesivas tomaron a mucha gente desprevenida y muchos perdieron la vida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: It was three years ago. I'm sure you already know, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Le esplosioni successive colsero molte persone alla sprovvista e molti persero la vita...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Isla y yo nos vimos envueltos en todo ese caos.
