eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Gia' avere accesso a questo posto e' una fortuna; io direi di lasciare stare quella porta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: ¿Ese es el Vial de recuerdos de antes? ¿Qué vas a hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Is that the Memory Vial from earlier? What are you doing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Quella e' la Fiala della Memoria di prima? Cosa hai intenzione di fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: La verdad es que Flammi no está reparada del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Truth is, Flammi isn't completely fixed yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: A dire la verita', Flammi non e' ancora del tutto riparata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Cuando vivía con mi madre, hacía un montón de cosas más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: When my mother was around, it was able to do a bunch of other things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Quando vivevo con mia madre, ne faceva molte di piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Se me ha ocurrido que, con lo que saquemos de aquí, podría hacerle unos retoques, así que estaba probando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: I thought maybe with what I've learned here I'd be able to fix it somehow, so I was doing some trial and error.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Mi e' venuto in mente che, con quello che troveremo qui, potrei apportarle qualche ritocco, cosi' stavo provando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Lo entiendo, es un recuerdo de tu madre. Bueno, ¿y cómo vas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Right, it's a memento from your mother. How's it coming along?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Capisco, e' un ricordo di tua madre. Comunque, come stai procedendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Por ahora parece que no funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: It does not appear feasible at this time.
But there's one bit of information in here ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Un capítulo que hablaba sobre «cómo dar nuevos poderes a los objetos sintetizados» y estoy investigando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: A section on "Creating New Powers for Synthesized Items" that I think I can use, so I'm testing things out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Un capitolo su "Come conferire nuovi poteri agli oggetti sintetizzati" che credo possa tornarmi utile. Sto facendo qualche prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Qué interesante. Es verdad que dijiste que te uniste al equipo de investigación para saber más sobre la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Interesting. You did say that you joined the Research Team to learn more about alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Che interessante. E' vero che hai detto di esserti unita alla Squadra di Ricerca per saperne di piu' sull'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Sí, pero esto es más un proyecto personal, te prometo que no me obsesionaré demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: That's right. But this really is just a personal project, so I'll make sure not to get too carried away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Si', ma questo e' piu' che altro un progetto personale, ti prometto che non mi ossessionero' troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: De hecho, debería trabajar en el arma de Rutger cuanto antes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: I need to get back to making Rutger's weapon soon ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Anzi, dovrei occuparmi dell'arma di Rutger al piu' presto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Tu ama sabe mantener la cabeza bien puesta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Your master sure has her head on straight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: La tua padrona sa tenere la testa sulle spalle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..src: Yumia duerme hecha un ovillo todas las noches. Para Flammi, eso no es estar muy «bien puesta».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..ref: Yumia curls up into an "S" shape when she sleeps. Flammi does not consider that to be very "straight."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_075..dst: Yumia dorme raggomitolata tutte le notti. Per Flammi, questa non e' una testa molto "ben messa".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Vaya, vaya. Tenía dudas sobre el resultado, pero no está nada mal. Serías una gran armera, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Well, well. I was wonderin' how it would turn out, but this ain't bad. You could be a weapon maker, Alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Beh, beh. Avevo dei dubbi sul risultato, ma non e' affatto male. Saresti una grande armaiola, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Me alegro, pero no tenía pensado dedicarme exclusivamente a las armas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: I'm pleased to hear it, but I don't plan on becoming a weapons specialist any time soon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Mi fa piacere, ma non avevo intenzione di dedicarmi esclusivamente alle armi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: ¿Soy yo o Rutger «déjame solo» se está abriendo más al grupo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Is it just me or has the famously standoffish Rutger become a little more cooperative?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Sono io o Rutger "lasciatemi in pace" si sta aprendo di piu' al gruppo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Como si tuviera elección... Qué menos que ser agradable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: ... If I have to do it, I might as well put in the bare minimum effort.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Come se avessi scelta... E' il minimo essere gentile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Bueno, ¿y ahora qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: So, where to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Bene, e adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Tras discutirlo con el jefe Erhard, creo que nuestra mejor opción es ir al norte, al Jardín botánico Arbor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: After talking with Chief Erhard, I think going to the north of the Arbor Botanical Garden would be best.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Dopo averne discusso con il capo Erhard, penso che la nostra opzione migliore sia andare a nord, al Giardino Botanico Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Dices... seguir la ruta de maná y estudiar la zona en la que desapareció ese ser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: So where the mana pathway leads ... And where that thing disappeared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Vuoi dire... seguire il percorso del mana e studiare la zona in cui e' scomparso quell'essere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: ¿Qué «ser»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: "That thing"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Quale "essere"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Está en el informe de la misión. Léelo tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: It's in the investigation report. Read it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: E' nel rapporto della missione. Leggilo tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Vale, pues vamos allá, utilizaremos ese árbol enorme como punto de referencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Well then, let's make our way forward while using that big tree as a landmark.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Va bene, allora andiamo, useremo quell'albero enorme come punto di riferimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: ¡Vale! Seguiremos la afluencia de maná y daremos con algo tarde o temprano, ¿a que sí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Agreed! As long as we follow the flow of mana, we're sure to find something, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Si'! Seguiremo il flusso di mana e prima o poi troveremo qualcosa, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Jamás llegaremos al árbol.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: There's no way we can get to that tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Non riusciremo mai a raggiungere quell'albero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: ¿Y eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Is that so?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Come mai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Ya he estado allí y no hay forma de acercarse. Lo que sí hay son raíces enormes y murallas que lo rodean, entre otras muchas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: I've looked, and there's just no angle to approach it from. Overgrown roots, rock walls, you name it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Sono gia' stato li' e non c'e' modo di avvicinarsi. Ci sono pero' radici enormi e mura che lo circondano, tra le tante altre cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: ¿Y qué hacemos? Si hay un pedestal allí, tenemos un problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Then what should we do? If the pedestal is over there, we'll have a problem ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: E ora che facciamo? Se li' c'e' un piedistallo, abbiamo un problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Creo que hay una aldea Alber en el bosque del norte. Podríamos preguntarles si acaso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: There's an Alber settlement up in the northern forest, apparently. We should ask around there just in case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Penso che ci sia un villaggio Alber nella foresta a nord. Potremmo chiedere a loro, giusto in caso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Bueno, ¿qué? Decid algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: ... What now? Say somethin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Allora, che dite? Dite qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Perdón, ha sido sin querer. Es que me ha sorprendido escuchar una idea tan buena salir de tu boca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Sorry, it's nothing ... Honestly, I'm just surprised to hear a proper idea out of you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Scusa, non volevo. E' solo che mi ha sorpreso sentir uscire dalla tua bocca un'idea cosi' sensata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Sí, es como si fueras otra persona... Aunque tal vez sea sensación mía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Yeah, I think I can see you in a new light now ... Well, maybe that's an overreaction ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Si', e' come se fossi un'altra persona... Anche se forse e' una mia impressione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: No esperaba menos de un aventurero tan bueno, Rutger. Aunque estés aquí a la fuerza, siempre das buenos consejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: As expected of a seasoned adventurer, Rutger. Even though you act annoyed, you still give us good advice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Non mi aspettavo meno da un avventuriero cosi' bravo, Rutger. Anche se sei qui contro la tua volonta', dai sempre buoni consigli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Suscribo sus palabras. Ahora entiendo por qué el jefe te tiene en tan alta estima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: Yes, I misjudged you. Now I understand why the chief thinks so highly of you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Concordo con le sue parole. Ora capisco perche' il capo ti ha in cosi' alta considerazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Lo que digáis... Si estáis de acuerdo con mi plan, ya vamos tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: *Sigh* ... Well, whatever. If that's our plan, let's get ready and go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Come volete... Se siete d'accordo con il mio piano, siamo gia' in ritardo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Sabe sacarse los uni del fuego, eso se lo concedo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: ... So he'll get the job done when he needs to. I like that attitude, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Sa tirare fuori i uni dal fuoco, questo glielo concedo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Solo quiere «ser agradable», ¿eh? Eso no lo diría alguien que estuviera tan cerrado a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: It's the "bare minimum," huh? Well, I guess he's not such a terrible guy after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Vuole solo "essere gentile", eh? Questo non lo direbbe qualcuno cosi' chiuso con gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: Pues si lo que quiere es ayudar, podría dejar de ser tan quejica y ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: If he wants to be helpful, he could cut out the complaining and just help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Se vuole aiutare, allora potrebbe smettere di lamentarsi cosi' tanto e aiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: No estaría mal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..ref: That'd be nice ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: Non sarebbe male...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..src: <SEL_MM02_080_1_B><CR>No esperaba menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_080..dst: <SEL_MM02_080_1_B><CR>Non mi aspettavo meno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¿Cómo? ¡Atención, han llegado altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Oh, what's this? Some Tall Ones have arrived!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Come? Attenzione, sono arrivati gli altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Es cierto, es cierto! ¡Hola, altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Wow, it's true! Tall Ones, welcome!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: E' vero, e' vero! Ciao, altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Y no son los primeros altus! ¡Qué bien! ¡Bienvenidos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: There's been a lot lately! Welcome!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: E non sono i primi altus! Che bene! Benvenuti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Qué... ¡MONOS! ¡Cuántos Alber!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: So ... So cute! There are so many Alber!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Che... CARINI! Quanti Alber!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Isla, tranquila.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Calm down a bit, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Isla, stai tranquilla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¿Siempre habéis vivido aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Have you all always lived here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Avete sempre vissuto qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Sí, sí! Desde hace muuuuucho, pero muuuuucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: That's right! We've been here since long, long, looong ago!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Si', si'! Da taaaanto, ma taaaanto tempo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: (¿Tanto? Entonces no les afectan las zonas de vínculo de maná.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: (Since long ago ... That must mean they aren't affected by the manabound areas.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: (Tanto? Quindi le zone di legame del mana non li toccano.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: (Hace mucho que no ven «altus» como nosotros, ¿estarán hablando de antes de la caída del Imperio aladissiano?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: (If it's been a while since they've seen us "Tall Ones," could they be talking about before the Aladissian Empire fell?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: (E' da tanto che non vedono "altus" come noi, staranno parlando di prima della caduta dell'Impero Aladissiano?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Esto... Veníamos a una cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Ahem. Uh, getting straight to the point ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Ehm... Siamo venuti per una cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Queremos llegar a ese árbol gigante, ¿sabéis algún camino?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: We want to go to that giant tree. Do you know a way there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Vogliamo arrivare a quell'albero gigante, conoscete qualche strada?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Claro que sí! ¡El camino secreto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Of course! There's a secret path!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Certo che si'! Il sentiero segreto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Corta el rollo, enséñanos dónde está y ya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Whatever, just show us the path.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Suvvia, smettila di tirarla in lungo, mostraci dov'e' e basta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Bueno, vale, pero es muy peligroso. ¡Hay un monstruo que...! ¡Ay, que da mucho miedo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Hmm, okay. But it's very dangerous. There's a strong-looking monster! So scaaary!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Va bene, ok, ma e' molto pericoloso. C'e' un mostro che...! Ah, che fa tanta paura!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Sí, va muy rápido y brilla mucho. Ni se me ocurriría acercarme a él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Yeah, the shiny whooshy. I'm too scared to even get close ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Si', va molto veloce e luccica un sacco. Non mi sognerei mai di avvicinarmici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¿Rápido y brilla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: What's a shiny whooshy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Veloce e che luccica?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Un momento, ¿brillante y rápido? ¿Un monstruo con alas que anda sobre dos patas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Wait, does the shiny whooshy look like a winged monster that walks on two legs?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Un momento, luccicante e veloce? Un mostro alato che cammina su due zampe?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Ese! ¡Entonces es amigo de los altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: It does! Oh, so you Tall Ones are friends with it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Quello! Allora e' amico degli altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Bueno, tanto como amigo... Solo nos lo hemos cruzado antes una vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Er, well, something like that ... Though we've only seen it once.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Beh, amico amico... L'abbiamo incrociato solo una volta prima d'ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: No me entero de nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: You're just spoutin' nonsense ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Non ci capisco nulla...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: No somos amigos de ningún monstruo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Of course we're not friends with a monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Non siamo amici di nessun mostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Exacto, pero por cosas de la vida, parece que estamos destinados a encontrarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: ... Yeah. But there might be some kind of fate tying us together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Esatto, ma per gioco del destino sembra che siamo destinati a incontrarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Razón de más para ir al árbol si lo han visto por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: If that thing is around, then all the more reason to go to that massive tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Un motivo in piu' per andare a quell'albero se lo hanno visto da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Sentimos las molestias, pero os agradeceríamos que nos llevarais hasta ese camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Sorry for the trouble, but please show us the way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Ci dispiace per il disturbo, ma vi saremmo grati se ci portaste fino a quel sentiero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Vale, vale! ¡Un momentín! Es que nos gustaría pediros algo a cambio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Okay! Ah, but hold on a teensy moment! There's one thing we'd like to ask for in exchange.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Va bene, va bene! Un attimino! E' che vorremmo chiedervi qualcosa in cambio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¿El qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: One thing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Che cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: Se ha roto la vallita que protege nuestra aldea y estamos muy tristes. ¿Nos ayudáis, altus?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: The fence to our settlement is broken! It's a real letdown. Tall Ones, help us fix it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: La staccionata che protegge il nostro villaggio si e' rotta e siamo molto tristi. Ci aiutate, altus?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: ¡Claro que sí! No será ningún problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: Of course, that should be no problem!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: Certo che si'! Non sara' nessun problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..src: <SEL_MM02_090_1_B><CR>Claro que no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..ref: <SEL_MM02_090_1_B><CR>Of course not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_090..dst: <SEL_MM02_090_1_B><CR>Certo che no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: ... Whew, that ought to do it.
You sure can make a whole bunch of different things, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Sai fare davvero di tutto, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..src: Bueno, me crie en un taller después de todo, estas cosas estaban a la orden del día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: I grew up in a tool shop, after all. We offered all kinds of stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Beh, dopotutto sono cresciuta in un'officina, erano cose all'ordine del giorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..src: Ja, ja, ja, no es para tanto, pero me alegro de que os guste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: Haha, it's not much, but I'm glad you like it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Ah ah ah, non e' niente di che, ma mi fa piacere che vi piaccia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: She seems like she's having fun.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..src: Sí, estamos viendo a la auténtica Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Si', stiamo vedendo la vera Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..src: Se nos echa el tiempo encima. Sobre ese camino secreto, ¿nos lleváis a él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: Now's not the time for that. We have to get to that secret path. Can you lead us there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Il tempo stringe. Per quel sentiero segreto, potete portarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..src: ¡Claro, clarinete! Hicimos una promesa. Seguidme, altus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..ref: Okie-dokie, a promise is a promise. Follow me, Tall Ones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_100..dst: Certo, certissimo! Abbiamo fatto una promessa. Seguitemi, altus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Cuántas raíces... No se puede pasar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: That's a lot of roots ... It's pretty blocked off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Quante radici... Non si puo' passare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Ah, claro, los altus no cabéis por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: ... Oh, that's right. Tall Ones can't fit through this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Ah, vero, voi altus non riuscite a passare di qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Me estás diciendo que hemos venido aquí para nada?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: What? You mean we came all the way out here for nothin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Come? Mi stai dicendo che siamo venuti fin qui per niente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Rutger, ¿podrías cortarlas con tu guadaña o algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Rutger, can't you cut them with your scythe or something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Rutger, non potresti tagliarle con la tua falce o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: ¿Cómo quieres que corte estas raíces tan gruesas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: How am I supposed to cut through wood this thick?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Come vuoi che tagli radici cosi' spesse?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: ¿Y dónde queda eso de «abrirse paso a patadas a la desesperada»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Then how about breaking them with one of those kicks you're so proud of?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: E che ne e' stato del "farsi strada a calci nella disperazione"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Isla, no le pidas peras al olmo. Ningún humano tiene tanta fuerza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Isla, don't ask him to do the impossible. Humans can only be so strong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Isla, non chiedergli l'impossibile. Nessun essere umano e' cosi' forte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Are you on my side or not?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: E tu di che parte stai?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Esperad... Quizás yo pueda hacer algo para atravesarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Wait, hold on ... If this is all it is, then there might be something I can do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Aspettate... Forse io posso fare qualcosa per attraversarle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Sí, no os preocupéis. Gracias por acompañarnos hasta aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Yeah, leave the rest to us. Thanks for bringing us here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Si', non vi preoccupate. Grazie per averci accompagnato fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Necesitamos abrirnos un hueco para pasar. Entonces, si levantamos las raíces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: If all we need is a space big enough to pass through, then if we somehow lift the roots ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Ci serve un varco per poter passare. Quindi, se solleviamo le radici...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..src: Flammi, ¿podríamos sintetizar algo así? Por ejemplo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..ref: Flammi, would it be possible to synthesize something like this? For example …
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_110..dst: Flammi, potremmo sintetizzare qualcosa del genere? Per esempio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: What're you plannin' on doin' with that seed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..dst: Cosa intendi fare con quel seme?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..src: Ojo por ojo, diente por diente. Y en este caso: raíz por raíz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth. And in this case, a root for a root.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..dst: Occhio per occhio, dente per dente. E in questo caso: radice per radice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: ... Okay, let's give it a try.
Aaand ... we wait for a day.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..src: ¿Estás de broma? ¿En serio sabes de estas cosas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: ... Are you serious? You can even do stuff like this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..dst: Stai scherzando? Sai davvero fare queste cose?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..src: Lo conseguí, pero me las he visto y deseado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: I managed to do it, but it relied on some pretty heavy work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..dst: Ce l'ho fatta, ma non e' stato per niente facile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..src: Adelante, Yumia. El Gran Árbol de Latere nos espera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..ref: Let's keep moving, Yumia. The Great Tree of Latere lies ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_120..dst: Andiamo, Yumia. Il Grande Albero di Latere ci aspetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..src: ¡Anda! ¿Es el Gran Árbol de Latere? Es mucho más grande de lo que esperaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..ref: Whoa, so this is the Great Tree of Latere. It's way bigger than I imagined up close.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..dst: Oh! E' il Grande Albero di Latere? E' molto piu' grande di quanto pensassi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..src: Percibo algo. Abrid bien los ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..ref: Somethin' feels strange. Be on guard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..dst: Sento qualcosa. Tenete gli occhi ben aperti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..src: ¿Es tu alma de aventurero la que habla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..dst: E' il tuo animo avventuroso che parla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..ref: Let's keep moving. We'll find out what's waiting up ahead.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..src: Sigamos adelante. Averiguaremos de qué se trata.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_130..dst: Proseguiamo. Scopriremo di cosa si tratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: Oh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Oh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: That's—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Quello e'...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: It's you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Sei tu!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: No doubt about it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Non c'e' alcun dubbio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: Well, well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Oh, oh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: What are people doing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Che ci fate qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: Not only can it use tools, but this thing can speak as well?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Oltre a usare degli attrezzi, sa anche parlare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: That thing is—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Quella cosa e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: Nos entiende, eso nos simplifica las cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: Viktor ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Ci capisce, questo ci semplifica le cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: ¡Soy Viktor von Duerer, de la Orden de Eustella!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: If it can understand me, that makes things even simpler.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Sono Viktor von Duerer, dell'Ordine di Eustella!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: ¡Tú atacaste y provocaste el desastre de maná en mi hogar! ¡Identifícate!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: I am Viktor von Duerer, of the Order of Eustella!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Hai attaccato e causato la catastrofe del mana nella mia terra! Presentati!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: Un soldadito que juega a la guerra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: You attacked and caused the mana disaster in my domain! Identify yourself!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Un soldatino che gioca alla guerra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: Soy Vésper. Y como tú, soy un patriota.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: Ah, a modern soldier who knows nothing of war.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Sono Ve'sper. E come te, sono un patriota.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: ¡Vengaremos a todos los fallecidos acabando contigo! ¡Hemos venido hasta aquí por ti!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: ... I am Vesper. I too have dedicated my life for my country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Vendicheremo tutti i nostri caduti abbattendoti! Siamo arrivati fin qui proprio per te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: No hago leña del árbol caído...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: We will avenge everyone we lost by striking you down! We've come this far just for this one purpose!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Non e' che mi piaccia far legna dall'albero caduto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: ... pero no dudaré en partiros como ramitas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: I don't particularly enjoy tormenting the weak ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: ... ma non esitero' a spezzarvi come rametti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: El ejército del Imperio aladissiano no necesita debiluchos como tú entre sus huestes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: But I won't hesitate to cut you down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: L'esercito dell'Impero Aladissiano non ha bisogno di deborini come te tra le sue file.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: The military rule of the Aladissian Empire has no need for filth such as you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Eh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: This is gettin' interestin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Ora si fa interessante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..src: Por tu culpa... Todo lo que sucedió fue fruto de tus acciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: If it wasn't for you, that disaster would have never happened ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Per colpa tua... Tutto cio' che e' successo e' frutto delle tue azioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..ref: I'll never forgive you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_140..dst: Non ti perdonero' mai!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..src: Aun así, una alquimista llegada de fuera de Aladiss... Tenía entendido que se habían extinguido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..dst: Eppure, un'alchimista venuta da fuori Aladiss... Credevo che si fossero estinte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..ref: Still, to think that an alchemist would come from the outside. I was so sure they'd all been wiped out ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..dst: Ti restava ancora tanta vita da vivere...
Salve, alchimista e compagnia, come state?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..src: No... Una nueva hormiguita que pisar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..ref: Hello, alchemist and friends. Are you all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..dst: No... Una nuova formichina da schiacciare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..ref: ... No. The number of prey has simply increased by one.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..src: ¡Tranquilo! No somos rivales para él. Por lo menos, ahora no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_150..dst: Tranquillo! Non siamo in grado di affrontarlo. Per lo meno, non per ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Gracias, Rutger. Casi pierdo los estribos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: ... Thank you, Rutger. I lost my head for a moment there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Grazie, Rutger. Ho quasi perso le staffe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Si quieres darle las gracias a alguien, está por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: If you're gonna thank someone, direct it that way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Se vuoi ringraziare qualcuno, e' quello laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Imagino que serás del equipo de investigación. Te agradezco que hayas intervenido, casi no lo contamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: I suppose you must be another member of the Research Team. You have my thanks, we barely made it out alive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Immagino che tu sia della Squadra di Ricerca. Ti ringrazio per l'intervento, ce l'abbiamo fatta per un pelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: De nada. Me alegro de haber llegado a tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: You're welcome. I'm just glad that I made it in time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Di niente. Sono contenta di essere arrivata in tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Me llamo Nina y, como has dicho, soy del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: I'm Nina. As you guessed, I'm part of the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Mi chiamo Nina e, come hai detto, sono della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: No esperaba ver ningún monstruo como ese aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: It was quite a surprise to see a monster like that, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Non mi aspettavo di vedere un mostro del genere qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Ni siquiera se lo estaba tomando en serio.
A lo mejor la fuerza de los monstruos es mayor cuanto más nos acercamos al árbol.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: Maybe there are a bunch more monsters like that one beyond the tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Forse piu' ci avviciniamo all'albero, piu' i mostri diventano forti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..src: Deberíamos hacer algo con la zona de vínculo de maná antes de pararnos a charlar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: I would prefer we do something about the manabound area before we take a break.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..dst: Dovremmo occuparci della zona legata al mana prima di fermarci a chiacchierare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_151..ref: That's right. We need to take care of that first.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: La verdad, no salgo de mi asombro. ¿Es normal que los monstruos de Aladiss sepan hablar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: I still can't believe that thing. Was it normal in Aladiss for monsters to talk?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: A dire la verita', non ci credo ancora. E' normale che i mostri di Aladiss sappiano parlare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: No sabemos qué es ni lo que anda buscando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: We don't know what he is, or what he wants.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Non sappiamo cosa sia ne' cosa stia cercando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: There's no way he's an alchemist too, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Non puo' essere anche lui un alchimista, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: No lo descartaría, lo añadiré a la lista de cosas por investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: It's not out of the question. We have a lot to investigate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Non lo escluderei, lo aggiungo alla lista delle cose da investigare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Al menos, me conformo con saber que tiene alguna conexión con la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: At the very least, I believe he is connected to alchemy somehow ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Almeno, mi accontento di sapere che ha una qualche connessione con l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Un monstruo alquimista... Ni en mis peores pesadillas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: A monster alchemist ... I would have never imagined it in my wildest dreams.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Un mostro alchimista... Neanche nei miei peggiori incubi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Lo sé. Por su forma de hablar, no puedo evitar pensar que algo lo vincula con la alquimia de un modo u otro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: I know. But judging by the way he talked, I don't think there's no connection.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Lo so. Dal suo modo di parlare, non posso fare a meno di pensare che qualcosa lo leghi all'alchimia in un modo o nell'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Y eso sin mencionar la herramienta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: Not to mention that tool he used ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Era como un Núcleo de energía... ¿Lo habrá usado como nosotros en la zona de vínculo de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: It was like an Energy Core ... Was he using it in the same way as us in the manabound area?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Era come un Nucleo di Energia... Lo avra' usato come noi nella zona legata al mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: No creo que vaya a volver. Daos prisa, no hay tiempo que perder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: I don't think he's comin' back. Look alive, break time's over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Non credo che tornera'. Fate in fretta, non c'e' tempo da perdere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..src: Miremos por aquí, quizás encontremos alguna pista sobre quién es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..ref: Let's look around this area. We might find some clues about him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_160..dst: Guardiamo da questa parte, magari troviamo qualche indizio su chi sia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Esto es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: This is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Questo e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿Otro Vial de recuerdos? Dile a la lamparita que le eche un ojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: A Memory Vial, right? Use your lamp-thing to check it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Ancora una Fiala della Memoria? Di' alla lamparina di darle un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Flammi no es una «lamparita», es una asistente autóm...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Flammi is not a "lamp-thing." Flammi is a super-high-spec independent—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Flammi non e' una "lamparina", e' un'assistente autonoma supersof...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Sí, sí, ilumínanos y ya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Yeah, yeah, just hurry up already.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Si', si', illuminaci e basta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: El estado es deplorable, pero se puede extraer algo de información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: The condition is quite poor, but some of the information is able to be extracted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Le condizioni sono pessime, ma si puo' estrarre un po' di informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ... En el este... gran agitación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: ... The east ... great turmoil ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: ... A est... grande agitazione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: La tierra... a este ritmo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: This land is also ... at this rate ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: La terra... a questo ritmo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Debemos... avanzar en la alquimia... es un error...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: We ... to have advanced alchemy ... such a mistake ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Dobbiamo... avanzare con l'alchimia... e' un errore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Se corta. ¿Se trata del recuerdo de otra alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: It's all chopped up. Is this another memory from an alchemist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Si interrompe di continuo. E' il ricordo di un'altra alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Han hablado de una agitación en el este. ¿Tendrá relación con lo que oímos en aquel centro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: They said the east was in turmoil. Could it be related to the voice we heard at that facility?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Hanno parlato di un'agitazione a est. Avra' a che fare con quella voce che abbiamo sentito in quella struttura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Aunque no sé qué ha pasado en el este, tened por seguro que estamos de vuestro lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Though I'm not sure what happened in the east, know that we are on your side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Anche se non so cosa sia successo a est, siate certi che siamo dalla vostra parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: La capital de Aladiss está al este...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Aladiss's capital is to the east ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: La capitale di Aladiss si trova a est...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: («Alquimia»... «Error»...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: ("Alchemy" ... "Mistake" ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: ("Alchimia"... "Errore"...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: (¿Qué pasaría en Aladiss? ¿En qué medida fue responsable la alquimia?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: (Just what happened in Aladiss? Just what did alchemy bring about?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: (Cosa sara' successo ad Aladiss? In che misura fu responsabile l'alchimia?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: No importa, ahora debemos regresar e informar de nuestros progresos. Quiero contarle al jefe lo del monstruo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Regardless, it's best to go back and report our findings for now. I want to tell the chief more about that monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Non importa, per ora dobbiamo tornare a riferire cio' che abbiamo scoperto. Voglio raccontare al capo la storia di quel mostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Es verdad. ¿Vuelves con nosotros, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: That's true. You should come back with us, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: E' vero. Torni con noi, Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: En realidad, pensaba quedarme por aquí un poco más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Actually, I think that I want to poke around here a little while longer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: In realta', pensavo di restare ancora un po' qui in giro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿Estarás bien sola?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Huh, will you be okay by yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Starai bene da sola?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: El jefe me ha encomendado una misión especial. Además, antes era mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: I'm on a special mission from the chief to investigate. And besides, I used to be quite the mercenary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Il capo mi ha affidato una missione speciale. Inoltre, in passato ero una mercenaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Era evidente por su actitud que no era una persona como tú y como yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: It's obvious from the way she carries herself that she's not just any ordinary person ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Dal suo atteggiamento era evidente che non era una persona come noi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿Eh? ¿Y esto os parece justo? ¡De mí no os despegáis ni a sol ni a sombra!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Huh? Doesn't this seem unfair to any of you? I was told I couldn't go out on my own.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Eh? E questo vi sembra giusto? Voi non mi lasciate mai andare da sola!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿No es solo cuestión de confianza?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Isn't it just a difference in trustworthiness?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Non e' solo questione di fiducia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿Perdona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Say that again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Come hai detto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Si así lo prefieres, nos adelantaremos, pero ten mucho cuidado, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Well, if that's the case, we'll go on ahead. Please be careful, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Se preferisci cosi', andremo avanti, ma stai molto attenta, Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Claro, lo mismo digo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: Of course. You take care as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Certo, altrettanto a voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: ¿Estará bien...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: ... Will she really be all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Stara' davvero bene...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Solo tiene que ser consciente de dónde se mete, no es para tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: It's a matter of takin' responsibility for your own safety.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Deve solo fare attenzione a dove si mette, non e' cosi' grave.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..src: Aun así, hablando de golpes de suerte, tropezarnos con ella...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..ref: ... But still, talk about a lucky break, bumpin' into her ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_170..dst: Pero', a proposito di colpi di fortuna, imbatterci in lei cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Vesper, huh? I can't say I'm familiar with the name ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Ve'sper? Quel nome non mi dice niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Me encargaré de decírselo a todos los miembros del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: I'll be sure to share this report with all of the Research Team members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Mi occupero' di dirlo a tutti i membri della squadra di ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: No es una simple cuestión de venganza. De amenazas así hay que encargarse más pronto que tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: This isn't just a matter of revenge. A threat like this needs to be taken care of sooner or later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Non e' solo una questione di vendetta. Una minaccia del genere va affrontata prima o poi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Espero que Nina no tenga problemas para regresar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: I hope Nina makes it back safely ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Spero che Nina non abbia problemi a tornare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: ¿Eh? No te preocupes por ella. Es la más capacitada de todo el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Hm? No need to worry about her. She's the most capable member of the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Eh? Non preoccuparti per lei. E' la piu' capace di tutta la squadra di ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Ahora que sacas el tema, ¿la enviaste tú a ayudarnos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Speaking of, was it you who sent her to come help us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Visto che ne parli, l'hai mandata tu ad aiutarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: No, no tuve nada que ver. Le asigné una misión especial que solo ella podía llevar a cabo por sus habilidades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: No, I didn't do anything. I just put her on a special assignment due to her exceptional skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: No, non c'entro niente. Le ho assegnato una missione speciale che solo lei poteva portare a termine, grazie alle sue capacita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Ha sido simple cuestión de suerte que tropezarais con ella. O tal vez fue su intuición de mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: It must've been sheer luck that you bumped into her. Or maybe it was her intuition as a former mercenary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: E' stata pura fortuna se l'avete incontrata. O forse e' stato l'intuito da mercenaria di lei.
(Da quando Nina si era accorta della nostra presenza...?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Os pido disculpas, debí acompañaros en persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Sorry, perhaps I should have accompanied you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Vi chiedo scusa, avrei dovuto accompagnarvi di persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Olvídalo, jefe. Nos ha servido para abrir los ojos sobre nuestro nivel de fuerza actual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Not at all, Chief. This simply means that we need to become stronger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Lascia stare, capo. Ci ha aperto gli occhi sul nostro attuale livello di forza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Ja, ja, ja, qué responsable has salido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Haha, you're quite the dependable one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Ah, ah, ah, guarda che persona responsabile che sei diventata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Me plantearé hacer cambios en el grupo, pero agradezco vuestra aportación. Ya habéis despejado casi todas las zonas de vínculo de maná principales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: I'll look into rearranging personnel. But still, good work. You've all done well clearing the major manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Valutero' di apportare modifiche al gruppo, ma vi ringrazio per il contributo. Avete gia' liberato quasi tutte le zone di legame di mana principali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Sí, ahora podremos abarcar más terreno sin preocuparnos por ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Now everyone should be able to continue forward safely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Si', ora potremo coprire piu' terreno senza preoccuparci di loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Exacto. Y eso coloca nuestro objetivo al este: en la capital de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: That's right. Our goal now lies further to the east—the capital of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: Esatto. E questo pone il nostro obiettivo a est: nella capitale di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..src: Queda algo lejos, pero vuestras incursiones por toda Lignumbria son un buen punto de partida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: It's still somewhat out of reach, but your travels through the Ligneus region are a big first step.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..dst: E' ancora un po' lontano, ma le vostre incursioni in tutta Lignumbria sono un buon punto di partenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_180..ref: Keep up the good work, everyone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: ¿Cómo va todo? ¿Sientes ya que estás marcando la diferencia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Come va? Senti gia' di fare la differenza?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: How's it been going so far? Feel like you're making an impact?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: He visto que soy capaz de controlar las zonas de vínculo de maná y eso me ha dado fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Ho visto che sono capace di controllare le zone di legame di mana e questo mi ha dato forza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Pero me queda mucho por aprender. También soy consciente de mis límites y todavía debo ganarme la confianza de los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: I've realized that I can take care of manabound areas on my own, which is reassuring.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Ma mi resta ancora molto da imparare. Sono anche consapevole dei miei limiti e devo ancora guadagnarmi la fiducia degli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Quiero... hacer grandes descubrimientos. Hallar la verdad que revolucionará el mundo y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: But I still have a long way to go. There's still only so much I can do, and I haven't earned any trust yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Voglio... fare grandi scoperte. Trovare la verita' che rivoluzionera' il mondo e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: I want to make huge discoveries, uncover shocking truths, and—

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Te adelantas a los acontecimientos, Yumia. Acabamos de empezar a explorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Stai bruciando le tappe, Yumia. Abbiamo appena iniziato a esplorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Descansa por hoy. Mañana espera una nueva región.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Riposa per oggi. Domani ci attende una nuova regione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: ¿Por qué se habrá reído de mí?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: You're in too much of a hurry. We've only just started this survey.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Perche' si sara' messa a ridere di me?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Le habrá hecho gracia la mezcla de idealismo y la falta absoluta de estrategia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Deve aver trovato divertente quella miscela di idealismo e totale mancanza di strategia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: Just take it easy for today. Tomorrow, you'll be setting out for the next region.
He didn't have to laugh at me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Scusate se vi ho fatto aspettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..src: Por fin ha llegado el día. Según los documentos, la siguiente región se conoce como Syvashi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..ref: He likely found the combination of your lofty aspirations and lack of a concrete strategy humorous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_181..dst: Il giorno e' finalmente arrivato. Secondo i documenti, la prossima regione e' conosciuta come Syvashi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..ref: Take that big one over there.
Hey! Could someone give me a hand here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Ehi! Qualcuno mi da' una mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..src: Vaya. A este ritmo, las ruinas serán un recuerdo del pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..ref: Wow, at this rate, the rubble will be gone before we know it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Caspita. A questo ritmo, le macerie saranno solo un ricordo del passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..src: ¡Hasta las gentes Alber están arrimando el hombro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Persino gli Alber stanno dando una mano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..src: Sí. Ahora todo el mundo puede ir y venir sin problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..ref: Yeah. It's easier for everyone to come and go now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Si'. Ora tutti possono andare e venire senza problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..src: Gracias, chicos. Ahora que no hay zona de vínculo de maná, podemos trabajar desde aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..ref: Thanks to you guys clearing out the manabound area, we're able to come here and do our work too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Grazie, ragazzi. Adesso che la zona legata al mana non c'e' piu', possiamo venire a lavorare anche qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..src: Aunque me temo que necesitaremos vuestra ayuda de nuevo en el futuro. Cada uno de nosotros cumple una función en el equipo. ¡Ánimo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..ref: We'll be relying on you again after this, though ... Well, we all have our own roles. Keep up the good work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_182..dst: Anche se temo che ci servira' di nuovo il vostro aiuto in futuro. Ognuno di noi ha un proprio ruolo nel gruppo. Continuate cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Si incorporamos este estilo de lucha, seremos más eficientes al...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: By adopting this fighting style, we can more efficiently ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Se adottiamo questo stile di lotta, saremo piu' efficienti nel...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: ¿De qué habláis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: What are you two discussing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Di cosa state parlando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Ah, Yumia. Estábamos hablando de cómo podemos aprovechar al máximo las herramientas que nos has dado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Ah, Yumia. We were just talking about how to make the most of the new tools you gave us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Ah, Yumia. Stavamo parlando di come sfruttare al meglio gli strumenti che ci hai dato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Decía que, si atacamos todos a la vez justo nada más romper las defensas del enemigo, los resultados podrían ser mejores que nunca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: I was saying that if we can attack all at once right after breaking through the enemy's defenses, it could work better than ever before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Dicevo che, se attacchiamo tutti insieme subito dopo aver sfondato le difese del nemico, i risultati potrebbero essere migliori che mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: No sabes cuánto tiempo llevo escuchándolo divagar sobre el asunto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: And I've been listening to him talk about it for who knows how long.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Non immagini da quanto tempo lo ascolto divagare sulla questione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Pues sí que te lo estás tomando en serio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: You sure take things like this seriously.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Davvero ti prendi sul serio queste cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Si no te importa, me encantaría que me hablaras más sobre esa idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: If you don't mind, could you tell me more about your idea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Se non ti dispiace, mi piacerebbe molto che mi parlassi ancora di quell'idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Aunar fuerzas para hacer un ataque coordinado... Interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Working together to perform a coordinated attack ... Interesting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Unire le forze per effettuare un attacco coordinato... Interessante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Si nos sincronizamos bien, creo que los efectos de las herramientas podrían combinarse a la perfección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: If we can get the timing right, I think the effects of our tools could synergize well!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Se riusciamo a sincronizzare bene i tempi, credo che gli effetti dei nostri strumenti potrebbero fondersi alla perfezione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: ¿Lo dices en serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Oh, really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Dici sul serio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Claro, si coordinamos tipos de maná parecidos, podríamos generar un poder aún más grande. O eso creo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Yeah, overlapping similar kinds of mana should yield greater power ... I think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Certo, sovrapponendo tipi di mana simili dovremmo ottenere un potere ancora maggiore... O almeno credo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: El quid de la cuestión es si seremos capaces de sincronizarnos como debemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: The question is if we can properly match the timing or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: La vera questione e' se saremo capaci di sincronizzarci come si deve.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Vamos a tomárnoslo como un entrenamiento. Pongamos a prueba la fuerza de algunos monstruos cercanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Let's just think of it as practice at first. We should go try it out on some nearby monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Per cominciare, consideriamolo un allenamento. Proviamolo con qualche mostro nei dintorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Creo que podemos con este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: I think we could handle this one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Credo che possiamo affrontarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Para empezar, tenemos que minar las defensas del enemigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: First, please break though the enemy's defenses.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Per prima cosa, dobbiamo abbattere le difese del nemico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: ¡Muy bien, así debería bastar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: All right, this should work!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Benissimo, dovrebbe bastare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Usa una herramienta que pueda dar justo en el punto débil del enemigo. ¡Tú decides cuándo atacar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Please use a tool that can hit the enemy's vulnerability! I'll leave the timing to you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Usa uno strumento che colpisca il punto debole del nemico. Decidi tu quando attaccare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: ¡Pues ya estaría! Al atacar juntos, hemos combinado nuestras fuerzas a la perfección... Parece que ha hecho efecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: That settles it! Attacking together to reach perfect synergy ... It really seemed to have an effect.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Ecco fatto! Attaccando insieme, abbiamo unito le forze alla perfezione... Sembra proprio che abbia funzionato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..src: Lo malo es que, al usar ese cúmulo de poder tan grande, hemos gastado la potencia de las armas de una sola vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..ref: Though in exchange for that massive burst of power, it seems our tools are exhausted in one go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_183..dst: Peccato che, sprigionando tutta quella potenza, abbiamo esaurito gli strumenti in un colpo solo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..src: Pero ¡yo diría que ha sido un éxito!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..dst: Ma direi che e' stato un successo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..src: Sin duda, ha superado nuestras expectativas. Creo que nos será de utilidad en el futuro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..ref: For sure, even better than I had hoped. I think we'll be able to use this in the future.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..dst: Senza dubbio, ha superato le nostre aspettative. Credo che ci sara' utile in futuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..src: Es que he verificado mi hipótesis. No puedo negar que me ha subido la moral.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..ref: Well I was able to prove that I was onto something earlier. I can't say I'm not pleased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..dst: E' che ho verificato la mia ipotesi. Non posso negare che mi ha alzato il morale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..src: ¡La próxima vez tienes que coordinar el ataque conmigo, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..ref: Oh, you should coordinate an attack with me next time, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..dst: La prossima volta devi coordinare l'attacco con me, Viktor!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..src: Humm, claro, ¿por qué no? Deberíamos adoptarlo como medida preventiva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..ref: Hm? Oh, of course. We should be proactive in adopting—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_184..dst: Hmm, certo, perche' no? Dovremmo adottarlo come misura preventiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: A mí me vale con que se me vea elegante al luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: I just want to look as stylish as possible when I'm fighting out there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: A me basta apparire elegante mentre combatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¿Ocurre algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Is something the matter?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Succede qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Hola, Yumia. Estábamos hablando de las tácticas de combate...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Hey, Yumia. We were just talking about our battle tactics ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Ciao, Yumia. Stavamo parlando delle tattiche di combattimento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Yumia, ¿no te gustaría luchar con más estilo y elegancia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Yumia, don't you want to fight with even more style and elegance?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Yumia, non ti piacerebbe combattere con piu' stile ed eleganza?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Vaya, me ha pillado por sorpresa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: This is kind of sudden ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Dai, mi ha colto di sorpresa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Sí, ha sido muy repentino... Pero, ahora que lo dice, no es mala idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: It's very sudden, yes ... But after hearing her out, she does seem to be onto something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Si', e' stato molto improvviso... Ma ora che lo dice, non e' una cattiva idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Podéis ser más concretos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Really? Would you mind telling me more?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Ah, si'? Potete essere piu' precisi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¡Muy bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: All right!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Molto bene!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¿Quieres que nos coordinemos para contraatacar?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Coordinating together to counterattack ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Vuoi che ci coordiniamo per contrattaccare?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¡Sí! A veces, un enemigo va a por ti y no puedes evitar centrarte en la defensa. Al menos, a mí me pasa mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Yup! It happens a lot in my case, but there are times when an enemy has their sights set on you and you're stuck on defense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Si'! A volte un nemico ti prende di mira e non puoi fare a meno di concentrarti sulla difesa. Almeno, a me capita spesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: En casos como ese, podríamos establecer una señal y cambiarnos con estilo con un compañero para contraatacar de repente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: For times like those, if we set up a signal, we can stylishly switch out with a partner and strike back with a counter!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: In casi come quello, potremmo stabilire un segnale e scambiarci con stile con un compagno per contrattaccare all'improvviso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: A Isla solo le importa luchar con estilo, pero creo que lo de cubrirnos unos a otros es buena idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Isla claims she just wants to fight with style, but I think covering for each other is a good idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: A Isla interessa solo combattere con stile, ma credo che coprirsi a vicenda sia una buona idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Yo creo que merece la pena hacer la prueba. ¿Qué te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: This is worth testing in my opinion. What do you think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Io credo che valga la pena fare la prova. Che ne pensi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¡No tengo pegas! Vamos a probarlo con algún monstruo que haya por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: No objections from me! Let's go test it out on a nearby monster!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Non ho nulla in contrario! Andiamo a provarlo con qualche mostro qui intorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Pero, Isla... ¿Cómo se te ha ocurrido esto de repente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: ... But Isla, why did you come up with this all of a sudden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Pero', Isla... Come ti e' venuta in mente questa cosa all'improvviso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Al parecer, otro miembro del equipo ha dicho que es «peligrosa». Creo que está intentando demostrarle que se equivoca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: It seems that another team member called her "dangerous." She's probably trying to prove them wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Sembra che un altro membro della squadra l'abbia definita "pericolosa". Credo che stia cercando di dimostrarle che si sbaglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Si hay que luchar, lo haré con mucho estilo. Nada me borrará la sonrisa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: If I'm going to fight, I wanna look gorgeous doing it is all! I'm not upset about anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Se c'e' da combattere, lo faro' con grande stile. Niente mi togliera' il sorriso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Bueno, ¿qué? ¿Lo intentamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Well then, let's give it a try!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Allora, che ne dici? Ci proviamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: Primero, tenemos que buscar el momento perfecto para cambiarnos. Intenta esquivar el ataque enemigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: First, we need to find the right time to switch out. Try evading the enemy attack.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Per prima cosa, dobbiamo trovare il momento giusto per darci il cambio. Prova a schivare l'attacco nemico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¡Perfecto! ¡Ahora cámbiate conmigo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: Perfect! Now swap with me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: Perfetto! Ora dammi il cambio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..src: ¡Buen momento para entrar! Je, je, ha molado el cambio, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..ref: There's an opening! Hehe, that was a pretty cool switch just now, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_185..dst: E' il momento giusto! Eh eh, bel cambio, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..src: ¡Fiu, no ha estado mal para ser la primera vez!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..ref: Whew, that was pretty good for our first time trying it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..dst: Fiu, non era affatto male per essere la prima volta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..src: ¡Así se hace! Si seguimos perfeccionando la técnica, nadie volverá a criticarme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..ref: You said it! If we keep on perfecting this technique, no one will be able to complain about me ever again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..dst: Questo e'! Se continuiamo a perfezionare la tecnica, nessuno potra' piu' criticarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..src: ¡Lo sabía! Todo tenía que ver con lo que le había dicho ese miembro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..ref: ... So it WAS about what that member said.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_186..dst: Lo sapevo! Aveva tutto a che fare con quello che mi aveva detto quel membro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: ¡¿Sois... humanos?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: You ... Are you humans?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Siete... umani?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: No puede ser. Esas orejas, esas colas... ¿Es posible que sean Welleks?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: You're ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Non puo' essere. Quelle orecchie, quelle code... E' possibile che siano Wellek?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Sí. Puedes encontrarlos en escasas ocasiones, incluso en Eustella... Pero ¡¿sigue viviendo gente aquí?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: No way. Those ears and tails ... Could they be Welleks?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Si'. Si possono incontrare raramente, persino a Eustella... Ma qui vive ancora gente?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: ¿Qué hacen aquí esos humanos? Pensaba que habían muerto todos hace tiempo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Yes. You see them on rare occasions even in Eustella ... But there are still people living here?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Cosa ci fanno quegli umani qui? Pensavo fossero morti tutti tanto tempo fa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: ¿Cómo han llegado hasta aquí?
