eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: What are humans doing here? I thought they died out long ago ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Come sono arrivati fin qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: ¿Qué narices estáis mirando, eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Just how did they get here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Che diavolo state a guardare, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Espera, Rutger. Ninguno de nosotros entiende muy bien de qué va todo esto. Será mejor que no los provoquemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: What're you all gawkin' at, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Aspetta, Rutger. Nessuno di noi capisce bene cosa stia succedendo. Sara' meglio non provochiarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Sentimos haberos asustado. Somos humanos de la República de Eustella, una tierra que se encuentra al otro lado del mar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Wait, Rutger. None of us have a good grasp of the situation right now. Don't go riling them up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Scusateci per avervi spaventati. Siamo umani della Repubblica di Eustella, una terra che si trova al di la' del mare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Para investigar el Imperio aladissiano caído, hemos venido hasta aquí y por el camino hemos ido limpiando las zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Tch ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Per indagare sull'Impero Aladissiano caduto, siamo venuti fin qui e lungo la strada abbiamo ripulito le zone di legame di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: ¿Zonas de vínculo de maná?... ¿Os referís a las tierras prohibidas? ¿Estáis diciendo que podéis eliminarlas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Sorry to frighten you. We're humans from the Eustellan Republic, a land across the sea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Zone di legame di mana?... Vi riferite alle terre proibite? State dicendo che potete eliminarle?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Exacto. Estamos intentando llegar a la capital de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: In order to investigate the fallen Aladissian Empire, we've made our way here while clearing manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Esatto. Stiamo cercando di raggiungere la capitale di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Para llegar allí, tenemos que pasar por la Región de Syvashi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Manabound areas ... Do you mean the forbidden lands? You mean to say you can erase them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Per arrivarci, dobbiamo passare per la Regione di Syvashi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: No podemos permitirlo. Nuestra aldea se encuentra por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: That's right. We're trying to reach the capital of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Non possiamo permetterlo. Il nostro villaggio si trova qui nei paraggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Ningún forastero puede pasar sin permiso de Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: So we need to pass through the Sivash region to get there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Nessuno straniero puo' passare senza il permesso di Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: En ese caso, nos gustaría reunirnos con esa tal Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: We cannot permit that. Our settlement lies this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: In tal caso, vorremmo incontrare quella tale Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Pero no iréis a...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: No unknown outsiders may pass through without Cledia's permission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Ma voi non andrete a...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: No queremos hacer ningún daño a los Welleks. Os rogamos que nos deis una oportunidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: In that case, we'd like to meet with this Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Non vogliamo fare alcun male ai Wellek. Vi preghiamo di darci una possibilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Informaremos de vuestra solicitud... Pero, en cualquier caso, será Cledia quien decida si os atiende o no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: But you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Referiremo la vostra richiesta... Ma in ogni caso sara' Cledia a decidere se ricevervi o no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Como deis un paso en falso, no vamos a dudar en trataros como enemigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: We mean no harm to the Welleks. Please, just give us a chance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Se farete un passo falso, non esiteremo a trattarvi come nemici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Nos parece justo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: ... I will pass on your request. Whether Cledia will meet with you or not is her decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Ci sembra giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..src: Por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..ref: Do anything strange and we will not hesitate to treat you as an enemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_010..dst: Da questa parte...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: El paisaje ha vuelto a cambiar por completo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: The scenery has completely changed again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Il paesaggio e' cambiato di nuovo completamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Es verdad. ¿Qué pasaría aquí exactamente?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: It really has. Just what exactly happened here ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: E' vero. Cosa sara' successo qui esattamente?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Es cosa mía o hay muchísima humedad? Ahhh, se me está encrespando todo el pelo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Is it just me, or is it really humid? Aah, my hair's going to get all frizzy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Sara' impressione mia o c'e' tantissima umidita'? Ahhh, mi si sta arricciando tutto il pelo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿A quién le importa eso ahora mismo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Who cares about that right now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: A chi importa adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Hemos llegado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: We've arrived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Siamo arrivati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Esperad aquí. Os lo repito, no hagáis nada raro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Wait here. I'll warn you again: Don't do anything strange.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Aspettate qui. Lo ripeto, non fate nulla di strano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Humanos?... ¿Quiénes son?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Humans ...? Who are they?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Umani?... Chi sono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Ha venido gente de fuera... ¿Qué va a pasar a continuación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: People have come from the outside ... Just what will happen now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: E' venuta gente da fuori... Cosa succedera' adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Nos están tratando como si fuéramos un espectáculo. Menuda bienvenida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: We're bein' treated like quite the spectacle. What a fine welcome.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ci trattano come se fossimo uno spettacolo. Che benvenuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: No podemos hacer nada al respecto. Habrá que aguantarse hasta que la cosa se calme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: There's nothing we can do about it. Just bear with it until things settle down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Non possiamo farci niente. Dovremo sopportare la situazione finche' non si calmeranno le acque.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Por qué narices necesitamos «permiso»? ¡Ni que hubiéramos venido a saquear la zona!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Why the hell do we need "permission" anyway? It's not like we're here to ransack the place!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Perche' diamine ci serve un "permesso"? Mica siamo venuti a saccheggiare la zona!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Será mejor que evitemos hacer enemigos. Si queremos que la investigación vaya bien, es crucial que cooperemos con los pueblos autóctonos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: We need to avoid making enemies. The cooperation of the local people is essential for a smooth investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Sara' meglio evitare di farci nemici. Se vogliamo che l'indagine vada bene, e' fondamentale collaborare con i popoli indigeni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Jamás me habría imaginado que seguiría viviendo gente en este sitio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I never would have imagined that there would still be people living here, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Non avrei mai immaginato che qui ci fosse ancora qualcuno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Oye, no hace falta empujar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Hey, there's no need to pull.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ehi, non serve spingere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: He encontrado a otra humana husmeando. Es amiga vuestra, ¿no? Quedaos donde pueda veros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I found another human sneaking around. This one's a friend of yours, right? Stay where we can see you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ho trovato un'altra umana che frugava in giro. E' un'amica vostra, vero? Restate dove possa vedervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Esperad aquí. Y calladitos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Wait here. Quietly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Aspettate qui. E state zitti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Eso ha sido bastante desagradable por su parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Well, that was rude.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Quello e' stato piuttosto sgradevole da parte sua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¡Hola! Volvemos a vernos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Hello! So we meet again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ciao! Ci rincontriamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Sí, ha sido rápido... ¡Un momento, no! ¿Qué estás haciendo aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Yeah, that was quick ... Wait, no! What are you doing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Si', e' stato veloce... Un attimo, no! Che ci fai qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿A qué te refieres? Lo único que he hecho es seguir viajando desde que desapareció la zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: What do you mean? All I did was travel a little further since it looked like the manabound area had cleared up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: In che senso? L'unica cosa che ho fatto e' continuare a viaggiare da quando e' scomparsa la zona di legame del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Pues sí que viajas rápido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: You sure travel fast ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Beh, si' che viaggi veloce...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Más allá de eso, parece que la situación se ha puesto un poco peliaguda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Putting that aside, this seems like a rather tricky situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: A parte questo, sembra che la situazione si sia fatta un po' spinosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Sí. Parece que sigue viviendo gente en Aladiss. Estamos esperando para hablar con su líder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Yes. It seems there are still people living in Aladiss, and we're currently waiting to talk to their leader.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Si'. Sembra che ci siano ancora persone che vivono ad Aladiss. Stiamo aspettando di parlare con la loro leader.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Ya veo. Estoy de acuerdo: comportarse de forma imprudente no sería muy buena idea ahora mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I see. I do agree that acting recklessly wouldn't be the best choice here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Capisco. Sono d'accordo: comportarsi in modo imprudente non sarebbe una buona idea al momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Supongo que tendré que esperar aquí con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I suppose I'll sit here and wait with you then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Immagino che dovro' aspettare qui con voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: No parece que te preocupe mucho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: You don't seem very worried ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Non sembra che ti preoccupi molto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Conque vosotros sois los que queríais hablar conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: So you're the ones who say you wish to speak with me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Quindi siete voi che volevate parlarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Eres Cledia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Are you Cledia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Sei Cledia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Correcto. Soy Cledia, líder de los Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: That's right. I am Cledia, leader of the Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Esatto. Sono Cledia, leader dei Silva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Me han hablado de ti. Dicen que has eliminado las tierras prohibidas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I was told about you. The one who cleared the forbidden lands ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Mi hanno parlato di te. Dicono che hai eliminato le terre proibite...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Has sido tú, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Was you, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Sei stata tu, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: S-sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Did we say it was her?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: S-si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Les habíamos dicho que ha sido ella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Yumia was the one who talked about the manabound areas earlier. Maybe they figured it out ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Avevamo detto loro che e' stata lei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Yumia fue quien les habló antes de las zonas de vínculo de maná. A lo mejor se lo han imaginado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I-is something the matter?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: E' stata Yumia a parlare loro delle zone di legame del mana. Forse l'hanno dedotto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿P-pasa algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: You ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: C-c'e' qualcosa che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Tú...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Cledia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Tu...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Cledia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Tell me what your business here is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Cledia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿Qué os trae por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: We are heading for the capital where the Great Disaster originated, in order to uncover the secrets of this land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Cosa vi porta da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Nos dirigimos a la capital, donde se originó el Gran Desastre, para desentrañar los secretos de esta tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Finding out the cause of the collapse, which has been lost to time ... That is our—the Research Team's—goal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ci dirigiamo verso la capitale, dove ha avuto origine il Grande Disastro, per svelare i segreti di questa terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Queremos descubrir cuál fue la causa del colapso, que acabó perdiéndose en el tiempo... Ese es el objetivo de nuestro equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: ... And for that reason, you desire passage through this area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Vogliamo scoprire quale fu la causa del collasso, finito per svanire nel tempo... Questo e' l'obiettivo della nostra Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Y, para lograrlo, deseáis atravesar esta zona...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: It appears you have indeed cleared the mana in Ligneus before coming here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: E, per riuscirci, volete attraversare questa zona...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Parece que es cierto que has eliminado el maná de Lignumbria antes de llegar aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: However, how do you clear the forbidden lands? I cannot grant permission without knowing the technique you use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Sembra sia vero che hai eliminato il mana di Lignumbria prima di arrivare qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Pero ¿cómo eliminas las tierras prohibidas? No puedo daros permiso sin conocer la técnica que empleáis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: I wish to observe your power with my own eyes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Ma come fate a eliminare le terre proibite? Non posso darvi il permesso senza sapere che tecnica usate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Me gustaría observar tu poder con mis propios ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Thinking about where the mana pathway leads ... we should be able to clear the mana over there next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Vorrei osservare il tuo potere con i miei occhi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Veamos, si seguimos la ruta de maná... creo que podemos despejar esa zona a continuación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: "Over there"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Vediamo, se seguiamo il percorso del mana... credo che possiamo liberare quella zona dopo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿«Esa zona»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: That's the direction of the cathedral, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: "Quella zona"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: En esa dirección se encuentra la catedral, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: They know a technique for entering the forbidden lands as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: In quella direzione si trova la cattedrale, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: ¿También conocen una técnica para adentrarse en las tierras prohibidas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..ref: Understood. Then let us head there at once.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Conoscono anche una tecnica per addentrarsi nelle terre proibite?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..src: Está bien. Pues dirígenos hacia allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_020..dst: Va bene. Allora guidateci fino a li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: La técnica no solo les permite adentrarse en las tierras prohibidas, sino incluso purificarlas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: A technique to not just enter the forbidden lands, but even purify them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Quella tecnica non solo permette di addentrarsi nelle terre proibite, ma addirittura di purificarle...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: ¿Eso significa que hemos recuperado la catedral?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Does this mean that we've reclaimed the cathedral?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Questo significa che abbiamo recuperato la cattedrale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Ese poder...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: That power ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Qual potere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: (¿Habré hecho algo mal?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: (Did I do something wrong?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: (Avro' fatto qualcosa di sbagliato?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: De momento, me estás demostrando que lo que dices es cierto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: ... For the time being, I've seen with my own eyes that what you say is no lie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Per ora, mi stai dimostrando che cio' che dici e' vero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Pero no tengo suficiente información para llegar a una conclusión. ¿Eres la líder del equipo de investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: However, I do not have enough information to draw a conclusion yet. Are you the leader of the Research Team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Ma non ho abbastanza informazioni per trarre una conclusione. Sei tu la leader della Squadra di Ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: No, el jefe es otra persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: No, our chief is someone else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: No, il capo e' un'altra persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: En ese caso, ¿podrías traerme a vuestro jefe? Me gustaría comentarle lo que podemos hacer a continuación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: In that case, can you bring your chief here? I wish to discuss where to take things from here with your leader.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: In tal caso, potresti portarmi il vostro capo? Vorrei parlargli di quello che possiamo fare dopo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Por supuesto. Se lo haremos saber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Understood. We'll call him over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Certo. Glielo faremo sapere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Me llamo Erhard Boleman.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: My name is Erhard Boleman.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Mi chiamo Erhard Boleman.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Me han puesto al día mientras venía hasta aquí. Siento habernos entrometido en vuestras tierras de repente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: I've heard the details on my way here. I apologize for our sudden intrusion on your land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Mi hanno messo al corrente mentre venivo fin qui. Mi dispiace per essere irrotti all'improvviso nelle vostre terre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Ya está perdonado. He de admitir que tampoco os hemos recibido de la forma más elegante. A lo que íbamos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: It is forgiven. I will concede that we also did not respond in the most elegant of ways. Now then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: E' gia' perdonato. Devo ammettere che nemmeno noi vi abbiamo ricevuto nel modo piu' elegante. Vado al punto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Será mejor que hablemos en otro sitio. ¿Te importaría acompañarme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: This isn't the best place to talk. Would you mind coming with me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Sarebbe meglio parlare in un altro posto. Ti dispiacerebbe accompagnarmi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Claro, espero que tengamos una charla productiva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Of course, let's have a productive conversation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Certo, spero che avremo una conversazione produttiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Mientras, me gustaría pediros algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: I have something to ask of you all in the meantime.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Nel frattempo, vorrei chiedervi una cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: ¿Cómo? Un momento, ¿vas a ir tú solo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Huh? Wait, you're going to go by yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Come? Un momento, ci andrai da solo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Si somos muchos, entorpeceremos el diálogo. Pero he solicitado la presencia de otra persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: A big group would just get in the way of talks. There's someone else who I've called instead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Se siamo in tanti, ostacoleremo il dialogo. Ma ho richiesto la presenza di un'altra persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: ¿De otra persona? ¿Quién?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Someone else? Who?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Di un'altra persona? Chi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Alguien perfecto para mediar en toda esta situación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Someone that'll make for the perfect mediator in this situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Qualcuno di perfetto per fare da mediatore in tutta questa situazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Ya le he dicho dónde encontrarnos. Quiero que vayáis allí y os reunáis con ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: I told her where to meet us. I'd like you all to go there and meet up with her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Le ho gia' detto dove trovarci. Voglio che andiate li' e la incontriate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: ¿Te parece bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Is that all right with you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Ti sembra che vada bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Sí. Mientras permanezcas con nosotros, no creo que ninguno de los miembros de tu equipo vaya a hacer nada inapropiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Yes. As long as you remain with us, I doubt any of your team's members will decide to do anything untoward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Si'. Finche' resterai con noi, non credo che nessun membro della tua squadra fara' nulla di inappropriato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: Entonces, cuento con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: I'm counting on you all, then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: Allora, conto su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..src: De acuerdo, pues nos vamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..ref: Understood ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_030..dst: D'accordo, allora andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..ref: Oh, looks like she's here ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..dst: Caspita, sembra che sia qui... Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..src: ¡Ahora nos vamos a ver arrastrados a esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..ref: Hey, now we're gonna get dragged into this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..dst: Adesso verremo trascinati in questa faccenda!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..src: La aldea está cerca. ¡Deberíamos ocuparnos de ellos aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..ref: The settlement is close, we should take them out here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_041..dst: Il villaggio e' vicino. Dovremmo occuparcene qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: ¡L-lo siento mucho! Me perdí por el camino y acabé en el nido de un monstruo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: I-I'm so sorrrryyyyy! I got lost partway and ended up in a monster's nest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: M-mi dispiace tanto! Ho perso la strada e sono finita nel nido di un mostro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: No te preocupes. Lo importante es que estás bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: Don't worry. The important thing is that you're all right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Non ti preoccupare. L'importante e' che tu stia bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: Sí, exacto, me alegro de que estés sana y salva. Me imagino que eres la mediadora a la que ha llamado el cabecilla, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: Yeah, yeah, glad you're safe and all that. I take it you're the mediator the old man called?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Si', esatto, mi fa piacere che tu sia sana e salva. Immagino che tu sia la mediatrice chiamata dal capo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: S-soy Lenja... Me ha llamado el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: I-I'm Lenja ... The chief called me here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: S-sono Lenja... Mi ha chiamato il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: Ya, me sonaba que había una Welleks en el equipo de investigación. ¡Eres la persona perfecta para ocuparte de esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: Yeah, I thought that I remembered there being a Welleks on the Research Team! What a perfect person for the job!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Gia', mi sembrava che ci fosse una Welleks nella Squadra di Ricerca. Sei la persona perfetta per occuparti di questa faccenda!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: Yo soy Yumia. Perdona que te hayamos metido en esta situación tan peliaguda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: I'm Yumia. Sorry, you've been brought into a bit of a tricky situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Io sono Yumia. Scusa se ti abbiamo messo in una situazione cosi' delicata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: Ah, ya me han puesto al día... Sé cómo os llamáis y todo lo que está pasando...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: Oh, uh. I've heard about it ... Including your names, and what's going on ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Ah, mi hanno gia' messo al corrente... So come vi chiamate e tutto quello che sta succedendo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: En ese caso, podemos ir tirando. La aldea está por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: In that case, get goin' already. The settlement is that way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: In tal caso, possiamo andare. Il villaggio e' da quelle parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: ¿Creéis que esto va a salir bien si se ocupa una persona tan tímida y asustadiza?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: Is it really gonna be all right makin' someone so meek and shaky do this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Pensate che andra' bene affidarlo a una persona cosi' timida e pavida?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: El equipo de investigación trae a gente de lo más interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: The Research Team brings in all sorts of interesting people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: La Squadra di Ricerca attira persone davvero interessanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..src: Ya le hemos enseñado el camino, como nos han pedido. ¿Por qué no volvemos también?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..ref: We showed her the way like we were asked to, so why don't we head back as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_042..dst: Le abbiamo gia' indicato la strada, come ci e' stato chiesto. Perche' non torniamo anche noi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Parece que van a tardar un buen rato...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... It seems like it will be a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Sembra che ci metteranno parecchio tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Viktor, ¿crees que conseguiremos encontrar a Vésper en esta región?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Viktor, do you think that we'll be able to find Vesper in this region?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Viktor, pensi che riusciremo a trovare Ve'sper in questa regione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Me pregunto lo mismo. Se diría que no le preocupamos mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I wonder. He didn't seem to care about us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Me lo chiedo anch'io. A quanto pare, non gli importiamo granche'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Seguramente no nos considere una amenaza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: He probably doesn't consider us a threat at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Probabilmente non ci considera affatto una minaccia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Además, no sabemos qué objetivos tiene. Nos faltan pistas para localizarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Plus, seeing as we don't know his goals, we're lacking enough clues to track him down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Inoltre, non sappiamo quali siano i suoi obiettivi. Ci mancano indizi per localizzarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Hay que tener paciencia. Como ha dicho el jefe...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: So we must be patient. Just like the chief said ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Serve pazienza. Come ha detto il capo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Siento haberos hecho esperar. Creo que la reunión ha ido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Sorry to keep you waiting. I think the talks went well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Mi dispiace di avervi fatto aspettare. Credo che la riunione sia andata bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Anda, ¿ya está todo resuelto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Ooh, so is everything settled?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Oh, tutto e' gia' risolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Todavía no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Not yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Non ancora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Yumia, por aquí, por favor. Tengo que hablar contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Yumia, this way please. I need to speak with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Yumia, vieni qui, per favore. Devo parlarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿Eh? Mmm, vale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Huh? Uh, okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Eh? Mmm, va bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿De qué querías hablar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Um, what did you want to talk about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Di cosa volevi parlare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Le he preguntado a Erhard por ti. ¿De verdad eres alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I asked Erhard about you. So, you really are an alchemist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ho chiesto a Erhard di te. Sei davvero un'alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: S-sí. Pero ¿cómo lo has...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Y-yes. But how did you ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: S-si'. Ma come fai a...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Los alquimistas tienen la habilidad de manipular el maná. Tú tienes ese poder, así que pensé que sería una posibilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Alchemists are those with the ability to manipulate mana. You have that power, so I thought it was a possibility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Gli alchimisti hanno l'abilita' di manipolare il mana. Tu hai quel potere, cosi' ho pensato che fosse una possibilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: No tenía claro cómo sería la situación más allá de estas tierras, pero me daba la impresión de que la alquimia se había extinguido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I wasn't certain of the situation outside of these lands, but I was under the impression that alchemy had died out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Non sapevo bene come fosse la situazione al di la' di queste terre, ma avevo l'impressione che l'alchimia si fosse estinta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Por lo general, tampoco se utiliza en Eustella. Pero mi madre sabía alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: It's not generally used in Eustella either. However, my mom seemed to know alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Di norma, non viene usata nemmeno a Eustella. Ma mia madre conosceva l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Ya, me han hablado de la situación general. Tu familia podría tener vínculos con Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Yes, I heard the general situation earlier. Your family may have ties to Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Si', mi hanno parlato della situazione generale. La tua famiglia potrebbe avere legami con Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Mi familia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: My family ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: La mia famiglia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Quería hablar contigo para que supieras qué implicaciones tiene eso para los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: The reason I wanted to speak with you is because I want you to know what the situation is like for us Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Volevo parlarti perche' sapessi cosa comporta questo per i Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Presta atención.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Listen closely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Fai attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: En estas tierras, no pueden saber que eres alquimista bajo ningún concepto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: In these lands, you are under no circumstances to reveal yourself as an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: In queste terre, non devono in nessun caso scoprire che sei un'alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Le he pedido a Erhard que garantice que el equipo de investigación cumpla esta orden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I asked Erhard to instruct the entire Research Team to comply with this demand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ho chiesto a Erhard di garantire che la squadra di ricerca rispetti quest'ordine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿Q-qué quieres decir? Entiendo que puede considerarse un tabú, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Wh-what do you mean? I understand that it may be a taboo, but—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: C-cosa vuoi dire? Capisco che possa essere considerato un tabu', ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Los Welleks rechazan rotundamente la alquimia. No es solo un tabú, sino un código de nuestro pueblo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Welleks reject alchemy in the strongest terms. Not just as a taboo, but as a code of our people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: I Wellek rifiutano categoricamente l'alchimia. Non e' solo un tabu', e' il codice del nostro popolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Un código...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Code ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Un codice...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: No entrar en contacto con la alquimia es parte de nuestro código desde hace mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: It has long been part of our code to never come into contact with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Da molto tempo, il nostro codice prevede di non entrare in contatto con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Si se enteran de que eres alquimista... los miembros de la aldea podrían ponerse en tu contra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: If it is revealed that you are an alchemist ... It would lead to very fierce opposition among those of the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Se scoprissero che sei un'alchimista... gli abitanti del villaggio potrebbero rivoltarsi contro di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Incluso podría desatarse una disputa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... Potentially, fighting may even break out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Potrebbe persino scoppiare una disputa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¡¿T-tan seria es la cosa?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Th-that bad?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: C-cosi' grave?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Pero, al mismo tiempo..., tu poder es nuestra única esperanza para lograr que las tierras prohibidas se desvanezcan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: However, at the same time ... your power is our only hope to dispel the forbidden lands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ma allo stesso tempo... il tuo potere e' la nostra unica speranza per far svanire le terre proibite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: En los últimos años se han expandido y están adentrándose poco a poco en nuestra aldea. Hemos tomado medidas, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: They have expanded in recent years, slowly encroaching on our settlement. We have taken countermeasures ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Negli ultimi anni si sono estese e si stanno avvicinando sempre piu' al nostro villaggio. Abbiamo preso provvedimenti, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Si conseguimos acabar con la raíz del problema, nuestro futuro pintará mucho mejor. Como líder, te propongo lo siguiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: But if the root of the problem can be solved, our future will become much brighter. This is my wager as leader.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Se riuscissimo a eliminare il problema alla radice, il nostro futuro sarebbe molto piu' roseo. Da leader, ti propongo questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: No le digas a nadie que eres alquimista. Si no pronuncias esa palabra, no habrá ningún problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Do not tell anyone that you are an alchemist. If the words do not escape your lips, there will be no problems.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Non dire a nessuno che sei un'alchimista. Se non pronunci quella parola, non ci saranno problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Por suerte, nadie sospecha de ti en la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Luckily, there is no one in the settlement who suspects you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Per fortuna, nessuno al villaggio sospetta di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Pero, si sale a la luz, lo más probable es que me destituyan por incumplir el código.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: But if this matter comes to light, I would likely be removed from power for breaking the code.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ma se venisse a galla, con ogni probabilita' mi destituirebbero per aver violato il codice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿Que te destituyan? Gracias... No se lo diré a nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Removed? I ... Thank you. I won't tell anyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ti destituirebbero? Grazie... Non lo diro' a nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Creo que no lo estás entendiendo bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... It seems you are misunderstanding.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Mi sa che non hai capito bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Este asunto es muy serio para las dos. Si yo misma contase la verdad, vuestra investigación acabaría abruptamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: This is a serious matter for both of us. If I were to spread the truth myself, your investigation would abruptly end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: E' una questione molto seria per entrambe. Se fossi io stessa a dire la verita', la vostra ricerca finirebbe bruscamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Para que las dos nos beneficiemos de esto todo lo posible, entiendes lo que tenemos que hacer, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: In order for both of us to benefit as much as possible, you understand what we must do, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Per trarne entrambe il massimo vantaggio, sai cosa dobbiamo fare, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... Yes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: (Como alguno de nosotros haya dicho la palabra «alquimia» de pasada...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: (If one of us has already said the word "alchemy" in passing, then ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: (Se solo una di noi avesse pronunciato per caso la parola "alchimia"...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Sin embargo, eso no cambia el hecho de que nos inquiete que se haya presentado un grupo de desconocidos de forma repentina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: However, this doesn't change the fact that we are uneasy about a group of strangers suddenly showing up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Tuttavia, resta il fatto che ci inquieta l'arrivo improvviso di un gruppo di sconosciuti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Aun así, me ocuparé de decirles a todos que os traten como iguales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I'll be sure to promptly tell everyone to treat you all as equals, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Comunque, mi assicurero' che tutti vi trattino da pari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Vamos a trabajar juntas, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Let's work together, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Lavoriamo insieme, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... Yes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Eso es todo. Para cualquier otra cosa, deberías hablar con Erhard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: That's all I had to say. For any other matters, you should talk to Erhard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: E' tutto. Per qualsiasi altra cosa, dovresti parlare con Erhard.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Si forma parte de su código, debe de haber sucedido algo en el pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... It being in their code means that something must have happened in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Se fa parte del loro codice, dev'essere successo qualcosa in passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Si saber lo que soy puede hacer que estalle un enfrentamiento, ¿qué pudo ser...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: And if learning about me is enough to cause fighting to break out, then what exactly ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Se sapere cosa sono puo' scatenare uno scontro, cosa sara' successo...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Según Flammi tiene entendido, investigar lo ocurrido es precisamente el objetivo del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: In Flammi's understanding, investigating what it was is the objective of the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: A quanto ha capito Flammi, indagare su cio' che e' accaduto e' proprio l'obiettivo della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Tienes razón...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: That's true ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Hai ragione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Pero ¿tan mala es la alquimia? Mamá usaba su poder para salvar a la gente, ¿no?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: But is alchemy really that awful? Didn't Mom use this power to save people ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Ma l'alchimia e' davvero cosi' negativa? La mamma usava i suoi poteri per salvare la gente, no?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Quizá, después de todo, lo que estoy haciendo es algo malo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: I might be doing something bad after all ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Forse, dopotutto, quello che sto facendo e' sbagliato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Flammi no posee la capacidad de juzgar el bien y el mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: Flammi does not possess the function to judge what is right or wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Flammi non e' in grado di giudicare cosa sia giusto o sbagliato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Sin embargo, es evidente que los poderes de Yumia son necesarios para que la investigación siga su curso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: However, it is clear that Yumia's power is necessary for the investigation's continued progress.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Tuttavia, e' chiaro che i poteri di Yumia sono necessari per portare avanti l'indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: ¿Estás intentando hacer que me sienta mejor?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... Are you trying to make me feel better?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: Stai cercando di tirarmi su?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: No. Flammi solo expone los hechos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: No. Flammi is simply stating the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: No. Flammi si limita a esporre i fatti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..ref: ... I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_043..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¿Te has enterado?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: ... Did you hear?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Lo hai saputo?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Más o menos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: ... More or less.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Piu' o meno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Has vuelto. Muy bien, vamos a hablar del procedimiento a seguir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: You're back. Now then, let's talk about our course of action.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Sei tornata. Bene, parliamo di come procedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: La situación es la que es. Para que la investigación continúe, tenemos que andarnos con cuidado para no disgustar a los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: The situation is what it is. In order to continue our investigation, we must take care not to upset the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: La situazione e' questa. Per proseguire con l'indagine, dobbiamo fare attenzione a non irritare i Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Además de eso, Cledia nos ha pedido que echemos una mano para mejorar la calidad de vida alrededor de la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: In addition to that, we have been asked by Cledia to assist in improving the quality of life around the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Inoltre, Cledia ci ha chiesto di dare una mano a migliorare la qualita' della vita nei dintorni del villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: De momento, Lenja hará de mediadora entre el equipo de investigación y los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: For the time being, Lenja here will act as mediator between the Research Team and the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Per il momento, Lenja fara' da mediatrice tra la Squadra di Ricerca e i Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¡S-sí! ¡Lo haré lo mejor que pueda...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Y-yes! I will do my best ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: S-si'! Faro' del mio meglio...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¿Mejorar su calidad de vida? ¿Qué quieren, que les hagamos las tareas del hogar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Improvin' the quality of life? Like what, doin' chores and stuff for them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Migliorare la qualita' della loro vita? Cosa vogliono, che sbrighiamo le faccende di casa per loro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Si hacemos todo lo que nos pidan, no nos quedará tiempo para investigar. ¿Por qué tenemos que pringarnos las manos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: If we follow their every demand, we won't have time to investigate! Why do we gotta bow our heads in the dirt?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Se facciamo tutto quello che ci chiedono, non ci restera' tempo per indagare. Perche' dobbiamo sporcarci le mani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: No digas eso. Si nos ganamos la confianza de los habitantes de este lugar, todo será más fácil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Don't say that. If we can gain the trust of the local people, everything will be easier later on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Non dire cosi'. Se ci guadagniamo la fiducia degli abitanti del posto, poi sara' tutto piu' facile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Mmm... ¿Qué opinas de todo esto, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Hmm ... What do you think about all this, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Mmm... Tu che ne pensi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Quiero saber más sobre ellos. Quiero conocer más cosas además de su código...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Voglio saperne di piu' su di loro. Voglio conoscerli meglio, non solo sapere qual e' il loro codice...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Pero también sobre su historia en estas tierras, en las que se pensaba que no habitaba nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: I want to know more about them. I want to learn about not only their code ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Ma anche scoprire la loro storia in queste terre, che credevamo disabitate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Primero tenemos que dejar claros nuestros intereses, igual que ha hecho Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: But also about the history they've had living in this land that was said to be devoid of people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Prima dobbiamo chiarire quali sono i nostri interessi, proprio come ha fatto Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: La situación es complicada, pero, si no pasamos por el aro, no podremos perseguir nuestros objetivos. Tendremos que darles una vuelta a nuestras prioridades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: We must put our own interests first, just like Cledia did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: La situazione e' complicata, ma se non scendiamo a compromessi non potremo perseguire i nostri obiettivi. Dovremo rivedere le nostre priorita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: De ahora en adelante, tú serás quien tenga contacto directo con los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: The situation is difficult, but if not doing so would stall our goals, then we'd be getting our priorities backwards.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: D'ora in poi, sarai tu a occuparti dei rapporti diretti con i Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Tú decides en qué medida, siempre que no te olvides de la «regla» más importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: From here on out, you will be the ones in direct contact with the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Decidi tu fino a che punto, purche' non dimentichi la "regola" piu' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Tendremos mucho cuidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: To what extent you do so is up to you, as long as you do not forget the most important "rule."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Faremo molta attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Por último, Cledia nos ha dado permiso para crear una base de primera línea en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: We'll be very careful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Infine, Cledia ci ha dato il permesso di creare una base in prima linea in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Vamos a ponernos con los preparativos, así que venid a vernos más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Lastly, Cledia gave us permission to create a frontline base in this area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Stiamo per occuparci dei preparativi, quindi venite a trovarci piu' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Perdona, ¿tienes un segundo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: We will make preparations at once, so come visit later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Scusa, hai un secondo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Me gustaría trabajar con Yumia y los demás. ¿Qué te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Sorry, do you have a moment?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Mi piacerebbe lavorare con Yumia e gli altri. Che ne pensi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Creo que, tal y como están las cosas, mis habilidades podrían ser útiles si estoy cerca de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: I'd also like to work together with Yumia and the others. What do you say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Visto come stanno le cose, credo che le mie abilita' potrebbero tornare utili se le restassi vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Puede que tengas razón... Es verdad que parece que hay algo que os mantiene unidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Given how things are, I think my skills could prove beneficial if I stick around her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Forse hai ragione... In effetti, sembra che ci sia qualcosa che vi lega.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¿Te parece bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: You may be right ... There does seem to be something pulling you all together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Ti sembra che vada bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¡Por supuesto! ¡Está claro que se puede confiar en Nina!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Is that all right with you all?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Certo! E' chiaro che ci si puo' fidare di Nina!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: ¿Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Of course! Nina is super reliable!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Haced lo que os dé la gana...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Fate come vi pare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Entonces ya está decidido. Cuento con todos vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: ... Do whatever you want.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Allora e' deciso. Conto su tutti voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Que den comienzo nuestras labores de exploración e investigación a gran escala. Estos son los planes de exploración. Que os vaya bien por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Then it's decided. I'm counting on you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Comincino le nostre attivita' di esplorazione e ricerca su vasta scala. Ecco i piani di esplorazione. Buona fortuna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..src: Nina se ha unido al grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..ref: Our full-scale investigation and pioneering efforts begin now. Here are the pioneering plans. Good luck out there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_044..dst: Nina si e' unita al gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Bring the boxes with weapons over here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Portate le casse di armamento qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: ¡Las raciones de comida, por aquí! ¡Con cuidado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Food supplies over here! No need to rush!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Le razioni di cibo, da queste parti! Con attenzione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: ¡Vaya!... ¿Cómo han preparado todo esto en tan poco tiempo? ¡Creía que nos acababan de dar el visto bueno para construir la base!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Whoa ... How did things get set up so quickly?! Didn't we just get the OK to build a base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Caspita!... Come avete preparato tutto questo in cosi' poco tempo? Credevo ci avessero appena dato il via libera per costruire la base!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: Quizá empezaron con los preparativos antes de recibir el permiso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Maybe preparations were already underway even before we got permission?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Forse avevano gia' iniziato i preparativi prima di ricevere il permesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡correcto! El equipo de investigación tiene que adelantarse a los acontecimientos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Hahaha, precisely. The Research Team needs to be prepared for anything, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Ha, ha, ha, esatto! La Squadra di Ricerca deve saper anticipare gli eventi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: Controlaremos la exploración de la región de Syvashi desde aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: We'll be running our exploration of the Sivash region from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Gestiremo l'esplorazione della regione di Syvashi da qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: No lo habríamos conseguido sin la alquimia de Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: Yumia's ability as an alchemist will be pivotal in achieving results here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Non ce l'avremmo fatta senza l'alchimia di Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..src: Pero todos sois igual de importantes para nuestro cometido. ¡Os deseo mucha suerte!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..ref: And the rest of you are just as important to our success. Best of luck.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_045..dst: Ma siete tutti importanti quanto lei per il nostro compito. Vi auguro tanta fortuna!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Hola, ¿van a algún sitio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: Hello, are you all headed somewhere?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Ciao, state andando da qualche parte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: H-humanos... ¿Qué queréis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: H-humans ... What do you want?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: U-umani... Che cosa volete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Pensaba que a lo mejor podíamos ayudaros con algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: I thought maybe there was something we could help you with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Pensavamo di potervi dare una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: No necesitamos vuestra ayuda...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: We don't need help from you lot ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Non abbiamo bisogno del vostro aiuto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Ji, ji, parece que nos aborrecen por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: *Chuckle* Looks like we're pretty hated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Eheh, qui sembra che non ci sopportino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: No me sorprende. Hemos aparecido de la nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: It's not unexpected. We did just wander in out of nowhere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Non mi stupisce. Siamo spuntati dal nulla...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Los miembros del clan Silva hemos de que derrotar a los monstruos del interior del santuario de la catedral para recuperarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: We of the Silva clan shall reclaim the cathedral's inner sanctuary by eradicating the monsters inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Noi del clan Silva dobbiamo sconfiggere i mostri all'interno del santuario della cattedrale per riprendercela.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Creo que esa es la zona de vínculo de maná que eliminamos antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: That's the manabound area we cleared earlier, I think.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Credo che quella sia la zona di connessione del mana che abbiamo eliminato prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Nos encantaría ayudaros con eso, si os parece bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: We would like to help you with that if we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Saremmo felici di aiutarvi, se per voi va bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: No es necesario. No se permite el acceso de forasteros al santuario de la catedral.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: That is unnecessary. Outsiders are not permitted inside the cathedral's inner sanctuary regardless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Non e' necessario. Agli stranieri non e' comunque consentito accedere al santuario interno della cattedrale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: No son muy acogedores, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: ... They're rather unapproachable, huh.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Non sono molto cordiali, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Que va.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: (But we can't give up now.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Macche'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: (Pero no podemos rendirnos ahora.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: (I want them to realize that we aren't enemies ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: (Ma non possiamo arrenderci proprio adesso.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: (Quiero que se den cuenta de que no somos enemigos...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: (Helping them out with this may make things easier for us later on.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: (Voglio che capiscano che non siamo nemici...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: (Quizá, si los ayudamos con esto, las cosas nos resulten más fáciles en adelante.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: ... Understood. We won't go inside the inner sanctuary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: (Forse, se li aiutiamo, le cose ci saranno piu' facili in futuro.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Entendido... No nos colaremos en el santuario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: But can you allow us to assist you outside of it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Capito... Non entreremo nel santuario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Pero ¿nos dejáis ayudaros desde fuera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: I don't understand. Why do you wish to help us so badly?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Ma ci lasciate aiutare da fuori?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: No lo entiendo. ¿Por qué tenéis tantas ganas de ayudarnos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: Well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Non capisco. Perche' ci tenete tanto ad aiutarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Solo quiero que veáis cómo somos... Para que os quede claro que no hay motivos para sospechar de nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: I want everyone to get to know us ... That way you can see that we're not anyone suspicious.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Voglio solo che vediate come siamo... Cosi' vi sara' chiaro che non avete motivo di sospettare di noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Espero que podamos entablar una relación de cooperación entre el equipo de investigación y los Welleks del lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: I hope to build a cooperative relationship between the Research Team and the resident Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Spero che la Squadra di Ricerca e i Wellek del posto possano instaurare un rapporto di collaborazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Además, hay muchas cosas que me gustaría preguntaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: There are lots of things I want to ask you about as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Inoltre, ci sono tante cose che vorrei chiedervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: En ese caso..., podéis ocuparos de despejar el camino que dirige a la catedral. Venid con nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: ... In that case, you all can take care of clearing out the road leading up to the cathedral. Follow us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: In tal caso..., potreste occuparvi di liberare la strada che porta alla cattedrale. Venite con noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Mmm. Supongo que esto significa que nos hemos librado del primer obstáculo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: Umm. I guess that means we've cleared the first obstacle?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Mmm. Immagino che questo significhi che abbiamo superato il primo ostacolo, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.src: Eso parece. Hora de exterminar monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.ref: Seems like it. Let's get to monster exterminating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_050a.dst: Sembra di si'. E' ora di sterminare qualche mostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Va bene, sembra che abbiamo finito...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Hemos venido hasta Aladiss para acabar haciendo obras de caridad... Arg, no lo soporto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: We came all the way to Aladiss just to do charity work ... Aah, I can't stand this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Siamo venuti fin qui ad Aladiss per finire a fare opere di beneficenza... Uff, non lo sopporto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: No digas eso, Rutger. Además, sienta bien ayudar a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: Don't say that, Rutger. Besides, it feels good to be helpful to others.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Non dire cosi', Rutger. E poi, aiutare gli altri da' una bella sensazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Ja, gracias por iluminarme con tu altruismo. A ver si te enteras, la verdadera emoción de la aventura reside en...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: Hah, spare me the lecture, noble boy. Listen here, the true thrill of the adventure is about ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Ah, grazie per avermi illuminato con il tuo altruismo. Senti un po', il vero brivido dell'avventura sta nel...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Ya estamos con lo mismo de siempre.
Bueno, por mucho que se queje, Rutger siempre acaba echando una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: But for all his complaints, Rutger does always end up lending a hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Beh, per quanto si lamenti, Rutger finisce sempre per dare una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Es verdad. Es incapaz de mostrar que lo hace de corazón...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: True. He can never just be straightforward ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: E' vero. Non riesce proprio a far vedere che lo fa col cuore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Pero es una de las cosas que lo hacen adorable, ¿no creéis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: Isn't that one of his cute points, though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Ma e' una delle cose che lo rendono adorabile, non credete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: «Rutger es adorable». Flammi ha dejado registro de esta información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: "Rutger is cute." Flammi has recorded this information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: "Rutger e' adorabile". Flammi ha registrato questa informazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Es la gente del clan Silva. ¡Hay que darse prisa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: It's the people from the Silva clan. We have to hurry!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Sono quelli del clan Silva. Sbrighiamoci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Y pensar que todos estos estaban acechando por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: To think that this many were lurking here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: E pensare che tutti questi ci stavano tendendo un'imboscata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.src: Retiraos, por favor. Nosotros nos ocupamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: Please stand back. We'll take care of them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.dst: Ritiratevi, per favore. Ci pensiamo noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060a.ref: Wow. They certainly do look tough.
Be careful, everyone! Here they come!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: There's been a small problem. Could you help us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: C'e' stato un piccolo problema. Potreste aiutarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: En primer lugar, ponednos al día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: First of all, please tell us the details.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Prima di tutto, raccontateci i dettagli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Junto a nuestra aldea viven unas gentes llamadas Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: There is a race of people called the Neru who live near our settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Vicino al nostro insediamento vive un popolo chiamato Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Son monstruos, pero tienen el don de la palabra y viven en comunidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: They are monsters, but they are capable of speech and live together as a community.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Sono mostri, ma sanno parlare e vivono in comunita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: El conflicto entre los Silva y las Neru lleva mucho tiempo activo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: There has long been conflict between the Silva and the Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Da molto tempo c'e' un conflitto tra i Silva e i Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Casi siempre estamos peleando por algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: We are at each other's throat almost constantly.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: En nuestro último enfrentamiento, varias de las armas que llevábamos usando mucho tiempo acabaron destrozadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: In our most recent confrontation, a number of the weapons we have relied on for a long time finally broke.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Nel nostro ultimo scontro, diverse armi che usavamo da molto tempo si sono infine distrutte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Pero nuestro artesano se está haciendo mayor, ¿sabéis? No sabemos a quién pedirle que nos las arregle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: But the craftsman is getting old, you see. We are trying to figure out who we can ask to fix them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Ma il nostro artigiano sta invecchiando, capite? Non sappiamo a chi chiedere di ripararle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: ¿Y si recurrimos a la alc... al equipo de investigación? Seguro que podemos reparar las armas rotas en un pispás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: Could alc—the Research Team help with that? I'm sure we could fix up those broken weapons right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: E se chiedessimo all'alch... alla Squadra di Ricerca? Sono sicura che potremmo riparare quelle armi rotte in un attimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: ¿Los humanos son capaces de hacer lo que necesitamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: Can humans really make what we need?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Gli esseri umani sono davvero capaci di creare cio' che ci serve?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Tengo bastante maña con las manos. Lo haré lo mejor que pueda para que queden como esperáis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: I'm pretty good with my hands. I'll do my best to meet your expectations.
