eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Really? Those two that were talking about forbidden arts or whatever before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Davvero? Quei due che parlavano delle arti proibite e tutta quella roba?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Sí. Me sorprende que hayan cambiado tanto de parecer. No sé si debería alegrarme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Yeah, I was surprised to hear they changed their minds ... I wonder if that's really a good thing, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Si'. Mi sorprende che siano cambiati cosi' tanto d'idea. Non so se dovrei rallegrarmene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Me gusta que me acepten como una más del equipo, pero ya hemos visto que la alquimia tiene su lado peligroso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: It's great to be accepted as a team member, but there are still undoubtedly dangerous aspects to alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Mi piace che mi accettino come una del gruppo, ma abbiamo gia' visto che l'alchimia ha il suo lato pericoloso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Aunque la alquimia se haya usado en esta tierra para unos fines cuanto menos dudosos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Even if the history of alchemy in this land is cloaked by a dark legacy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Anche se l'alchimia e' stata usata in questa terra per scopi quantomeno dubbi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: No deberías ignorar las cosas buenas que has hecho para ayudar a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: The things you have done to help everyone won't change.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Non dovresti ignorare tutte le buone cose che hai fatto per aiutare gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Por lo menos, yo me alegro de tenerte como compañera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: At the very least, I'm glad to have you as a member of our team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Almeno io sono contenta di averti come compagna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: No esperaba que dijeras eso, Nina...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: ... I didn't think you'd be the one to say that, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Non mi aspettavo che lo dicessi, Nina...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Ya. Supongo que no soy la típica persona que dice esas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: You're right. I normally don't get to be the one to say things like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Gia'. Immagino di non essere il tipo di persona che dice certe cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Como mercenaria, suelo mantener las distancias con los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Being a mercenary, I rarely stay in one place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Da mercenaria, tendo a mantenere le distanze dagli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Pero ya llevamos un tiempo trabajando juntos y creo que os he cogido cierto cariño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: We've investigated together for only a short while, but I feel like I've grown quite close to you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Ma ormai lavoriamo insieme da un po' e credo che vi siano affezionata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Disfruto mucho de vuestra compañía. Y espero que sigamos viajando juntos mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: I really enjoy being here. I hope we can continue traveling together like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Mi trovo bene in vostra compagnia. E spero che continueremo a viaggiare insieme ancora a lungo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¡Vas a hacer que se me salte una lagrimilla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Y-you're making me blush!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Mi farai venire una lagrimucca!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Y tú, Isla? ¿Qué piensas de Yumia, de mí y de los demás?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: What about you, Isla? What do you think about Yumia, me, and the others?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: E tu, Isla? Cosa pensi di Yumia, di me e degli altri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Yo? Pues...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Oh, me? Well, I ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Io? Beh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Nunca he tenido amigos por la posición social de mi familia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: I never had many friends because of my family background.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Non ho mai avuto amici, per via della posizione sociale della mia famiglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¡Y me lo paso en grande hablando contigo, con Yumia y con Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Being able to chat with you, Yumia, and Lenja has been so much fun!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: E mi diverto un sacco a parlare con te, Yumia e Lenja!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Y con Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: And Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: E con Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Qué pasa con Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: What about Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Che c'entra Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¡Rutger no ha hecho más que fastidiarme desde el día en que lo conocimos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Rutger has annoyed me ever since the day we met him!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Rutger non ha fatto altro che darmi fastidio dal giorno in cui l'abbiamo conosciuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Sí, lo hemos notado... Pero ¿por qué te molesta tanto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: It certainly does seem that way ... But why exactly?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Si', ce ne siamo accorti... Ma perche' ti da' fastidio cosi' tanto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¡Porque es un vago y un caradura!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Because I know he's constantly slacking off!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Perche' e' un fannullone e uno sfacciato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Se esfuerza lo mínimo para acatar las órdenes sin que nadie le eche una reprimenda y siempre va con esa sonrisilla absurda. ¡Uf!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: He always toes the line where people can't get mad and he's not breaking orders with a smug look on his face!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Si impegna il minimo indispensabile per eseguire gli ordini senza che nessuno lo rimproveri, e gira sempre con quel sorrisetto assurdo. Uffa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Bueno, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Oh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Beh, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: También cumple con su palabra y hace lo que dicen. No sin quejarse, claro. Podría decirse que tiene principios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: But, well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Mantiene anche la parola data e fa quello che gli dicono. Non senza lamentarsi, naturalmente. Si potrebbe dire che ha dei principi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Pero ¡precisamente por eso me irrita más todavía! Si tantos principios tiene, ¡podría ser más estricta con él!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: He keeps his word and does what he's told, even if he complains. I guess he does have his own principles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Ma e' proprio per questo che mi irrita ancora di piu'! Se ha cosi' tanti principi, potrebbe essere piu' severa con lui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Me parece que alguien ha pensado mucho en Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Mi pare che qualcuno abbia pensato molto a Rutger...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿Qué? ¡No! ¡Tú me has preguntado y yo te he dicho lo que pienso de él!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Though knowing he does have some principles makes me angry at myself for not being stricter with him!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Cosa? No! Tu mi hai chiesto e io ti ho detto cosa ne penso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Pero no has hablado así de nadie, señorita Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Sounds like you've been paying a lot of attention to him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Ma non hai parlato cosi' di nessuno, signorina Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¡Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Huh? No! I was just letting you know what I thought since you asked!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Vaya con el jefe. Nos dice que nos tomemos un descanso y él no para de dar órdenes a todo el que pilla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Look at him. Tells us to take a break but there he is givin' orders to team members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Che capo, davvero. Ci dice di prenderci una pausa e lui non smette di dare ordini a chiunque capita a tiro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Es que nunca se cansa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Does he just never run out of energy or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Non si stanchera' mai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Estará bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I wonder if he'll be all right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Sara' a posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: No es estúpido. Conoce sus limitaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Well, he's not stupid. He knows his own limits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Non e' stupido. Conosce i suoi limiti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Y tú, Rutger? ¿Cómo estás?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: What about you, Rutger? How are you feeling?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: E tu, Rutger? Come stai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Eh? Pues... como siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Huh? Same old, same old.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Eh? Be'... come al solito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: En otras palabras, no has mejorado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: In other words, it's not getting any better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: In altre parole, non sei migliorato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Lo siento. Ojalá pudiera hacer algo para curarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I'm sorry. I wish I could make some kind of miracle cure for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Mi dispiace. Se solo potessi fare qualcosa per curarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Ya te lo he dicho antes. No es tu problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Like I said before, this doesn't involve you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Te l'ho gia' detto prima. Non e' un tuo problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Pero viniste aquí porque creías que encontrarías una solución, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: But didn't you come here thinking you might find a solution to your problem?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Ma sei venuto qui perche' credevi di trovare una soluzione, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Vine aquí porque me lo ordenó el viejo. Y porque creía que ganaría algo de pasta. Eso es todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I came here 'cause the old man ordered me to, and because I thought I could make some cash. That's it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Sono venuto qui perche' me l'ha ordinato il vecchio. E perche' credevo di guadagnare qualche soldo. Tutto qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: U-um! I also know a bit about brewing medicine! Maybe I coul—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡E-ejem! Yo sé un poco sobre medicina natural. Quizá podría...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: This ain't some stomachache. I don't need you to look after me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: E-ehm! Io me ne intendo un po' di medicina naturale. Forse potrei...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: No me duele el estómago ni necesito que os preocupéis por mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Oh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Non ho mal di stomaco e non ho bisogno che vi preoccupiate per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Por qué os molesta tanto mi situación? No necesito que me compadezcan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Gimme a break. Why're you tryin' to get involved? Just leave me alone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Perche' la mia situazione vi turba cosi' tanto? Non ho bisogno della vostra pieta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡No nos compadecemos! Eres parte del equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: We can't just leave you alone! You're a part of our team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Non ce ne compiangiamo! Sei parte della squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Sé que no soy tan buena como mi madre. Y puede que tardemos un poco en hallar una solución...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I know I don't have my mom's skills. And I know that finding a solution right away might be tough ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: So di non essere brava come mia madre. E forse ci vorra' un po' prima di trovare una soluzione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Pero quiero ayudarte. ¿Tan malo es querer ayudar a un amigo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: But all I know is that I want to help you. Is it wrong to want to help a friend?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Ma voglio aiutarti. C'e' di cosi' male nel voler aiutare un amico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡Y-yo también!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: M-me too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: An-anche io!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Al principio me dabas miedo, pero ¡ahora sé que es solo una fachada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I thought you were scary at first, but now I know that's not true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: All'inizio mi facevi paura, ma ora so che e' solo una facciata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Cuando nos atacó Lili Borea, me consolaste y me dijiste que no había sido culpa mía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: When we were attacked by Lili Borea, you told me it wasn't my fault ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Quando ci ha attaccati Lili Borea, mi hai consolato e mi hai detto che non era stata colpa mia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Quiero devolverte el favor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: That's why I want to do something for you too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Voglio ripagarti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Sigues con eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: You still remembered that little thing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Ci stai ancora con quella storia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Así que «amigos», ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: "Friends." "Friends," huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Quindi "amici", eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: ... *Sigh*
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: ... Sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Perdonad. Me he pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Scusate. Ho esagerato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¿Rutger? ¿T-te estás disculpando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I'm sorry. I went too far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Rutger? T-stai scusando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡Jamás pensé que viviría este día!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: R-Rutger just apologized?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Non avrei mai pensato di vedere questo giorno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Pero ¿por quién me tomáis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: I didn't think it was possible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Ma per chi mi prendete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: Venga, va, Rutger, ¿lo dices otra vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Just what do you guys take me for, huh?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Dai, su, Rutger, lo ridici un'altra volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡Ni de coña!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Rutger, say it one more time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: Nemmeno per sogno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..src: ¡Primera y última vez que me escucharéis decir algo así!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..ref: Like hell I will!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_083..dst: E' la prima e ultima volta che mi sentite dire una cosa del genere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: (Ahora que caigo... ¿No dijo Cledia que mi familia podría tener algún tipo de vínculo con Aladiss?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: (Now that I think about it, didn't Cledia mention that my family might have ties to Aladiss?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: (Ora che ci penso... Cledia non ha detto che la mia famiglia potrebbe avere una sorta di legame con Aladiss?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: (De ser así, mis antepasados huirían de Aladiss durante el gran desastre.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: (If that's true, maybe my ancestors fled from Aladiss during the Great Disaster.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: (In tal caso, i miei antenati sarebbero fuggiti da Aladiss durante il grande disastro.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: (Y siguieron practicando la alquimia en secreto en Eustella... Se convirtió en un arte que pasó de generación en generación.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: (They quietly continued practicing alchemy in Eustella ... They went that far to pass it down to future generations.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: (E hanno continuato a praticare l'alchimia in segreto a Eustella... E' diventata un'arte tramandata di generazione in generazione.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: (Me pregunto qué pensaría mi madre de todo esto...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: (I wonder what Mom thought about all this ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: (Mi chiedo cosa ne penserebbe mia madre di tutto questo...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Mamá, ¿hay algo que no sepas hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Mom, is there anything you can't make?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Mamma, c'e' qualcosa che non sai fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Eh? ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Hmm? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Eh? Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Pues... a que todo el mundo acude a ti cuando necesita algo. ¡Y nunca defraudas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: You know, when someone wants something, you can almost always make it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Be'... che tutti vengono da te quando hanno bisogno di qualcosa. E non deludi mai!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Por eso quiero saber qué no sabes hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: So I was wondering if there was anything you can't make.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Per questo voglio sapere cosa non sai fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Muchísimas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Of course. There are lots of things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Tantissime cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Simplemente, se me da bien mi trabajo. Por eso soy capaz de hacer la mayoría de las cosas que la gente pide.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: But I'm pretty good at what I do, so I guess I can make most things that people can imagine?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Semplicemente, sono brava nel mio lavoro. Per questo riesco a fare la maggior parte delle cose che la gente chiede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¡Yo quiero volar! ¡Hazme algo para poder surcar el cielo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Oh, then I wanna fly! I want something for flying through the sky!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Io voglio volare! Fammi qualcosa per poter solcare il cielo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Volar?... Hmmm... Supongo que... Ah, no, pero entonces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: The sky ...? The sky, huh? I guess if I—Ah, but then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Volare?... Hmm... Suppongo che... Ah, no, ma allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Mamá?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Mom?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Mamma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Perdona, cariño, estaba pensando en voz alta. Creo que volar es demasiado para mis habilidades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Oh, sorry. Just thinking out loud. I think something for flying in the sky is a bit too hard for me, sweetie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Scusami, tesoro, stavo pensando ad alta voce. Credo che volare sia troppo per le mie capacita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Y si a cambio te regalo este pajarito de peluche?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Aww ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: E se in cambio ti regalo questo uccellino di peluche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¡Ay! ¡Qué bonito! ¿Qué clase de pájaro es?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Hmm. How about I give you this stuffed birdie instead?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Oh! Che carino! Che tipo di uccello e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Uno que vive en los países del norte. ¿Te gusta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Oh! It's so cute! What kind of bird is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Uno che vive nei paesi del nord. Ti piace?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: No puedo darte alas para volar, pero esto sí. Quizá algún día puedas hacerte tus propias alas, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: This is a bird that lives in the northern countries. I thought you'd like it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non posso darti delle ali per volare, ma questo si'. Chissa', forse un giorno ti farai le ali tue, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¡Qué bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: I can't make you wings to fly, so take this instead. But maybe you'll make your own wings one day, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Che bello!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Ah, buenos días.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: I will!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Ah, buongiorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Buenos días...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Hey, good morning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Buongiorno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Te has despertado muy sobresaltada. ¿Una pesadilla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: ... Good morning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Ti sei svegliata molto di soprassalto. Un incubo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: No, estaba soñando con volar. Espera, no, era otra cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: You woke with quite a start. Bad dream?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: No, stavo sognando di volare. Aspetta, no, era un'altra cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿No lo recuerdas? A veces, a mí también me pasa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: No, I think I was dreaming about flying. Wait, no, what was it again ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non te lo ricordi? A volte capita anche a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Bueno, es hora de retomar la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Can't remember what you dreamed about? Happens to me too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Bene, e' ora di riprendere la ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Aunque... no tenemos ninguna pista decisiva sobre Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Now then, it's time to resume our investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Pero'... non abbiamo nessun indizio decisivo su Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Pues elegiremos un sitio al azar para explorar y punto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: That said, we still haven't found any decisive leads regarding Corleonis ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Allora sceglieremo un posto a caso da esplorare e basta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Exacto. Por eso quería preguntaros a todos: ¿a alguien se le ocurre por dónde deberíamos retomar la investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: We'll just have to decide on a location and start searching.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Esatto. Per questo volevo chiedere a tutti voi: a qualcuno viene in mente dove dovremmo riprendere la ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¡Yo lo sé! ¿Y si vamos por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Exactly. That's why I want everyone's input. Does anyone have any idea where we should resume the investigation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Lo so io! E se andiamo di qua?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Y eso para qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: I know! How about we try heading here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: E per far cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Eh? No lo sabremos hasta que no estemos allí. Además, no he oído que tengas una idea mejor, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: How is that gonna get us anywhere?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Eh? Non lo sapremo finche' non ci arriviamo. E poi non ho sentito da te un'idea migliore, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: El árbol en el centro, el Pergrinosequé ese. ¿Se puede trepar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Huh? We won't know unless we go. I don't see you adding any ideas, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: L'albero al centro, quel Perguin-sei-che'. Ci si puo' arrampicare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Turm Pérgrica... El nombre que le puso el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Hmm, let's see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Turm Pe'rgrica... Il nome che gli ha dato il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Treparlo? Conmigo no cuentes, os espero abajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: That tree at the center, the Pergri—whatever it's called—can we climb it somehow?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Arrampicarsi? Non contate su di me, vi aspetto giu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Hay algo que me escama.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Pergrica Turm, as named by the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: C'e' una cosa che mi insospettisce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Es sobre la tierra de las bendiciones... Sabemos que Corleonis pasará por allí tarde o temprano, ¿no podemos vigilarlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Climb it? Count me out, you can do that alone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Riguarda la terra delle benedizioni... Sappiamo che Corleonis prima o poi passera' di li', non possiamo tenerlo d'occhio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: No sé si una persona tan astuta caerá en una emboscada tan fácilmente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: There's something about it that's bothering me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non so se una persona cosi' astuta cadra' in un'imboscata cosi' facilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Además, los Geni dijeron que apenas lo ven.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: The Blessed Land, was it? We know he's bound to go there eventually, so can't we just stake it out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: E poi, i Geni hanno detto che lo vedono a malapena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Es verdad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: I wonder if we can actually outsmart someone so elusive with an ambush ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: E' vero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Y si lo llamamos a gritos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: The Geni also said that they rarely actually see him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: E se lo chiamiamo a gran voce?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Menuda idea. «¡Eh, Corleonis! ¡Ven, porfa!». ¿Te has dado un golpe en la cabeza?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Oh, right. They did say that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Bell'idea. "Ehi, Corleonis! Vieni, ti prego!". Ti sei data una batosta in testa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Lo has hecho tan bien que creía que iba a aparecer aquí mismo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Maybe we should just shout his name really loudly?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: L'hai fatto cosi' bene che credevo stesse per comparire proprio qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Eh... Y-yo tengo una idea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: That's a great idea. "Hey, Corleonis! Come out here, pretty please!" ... Are you stupid or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Ehm... I-io ho un'idea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: No estaría mal ir aquí, al sur, al horno de transposición de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: I was half-expecting him to show up after you said that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non sarebbe male andare qui, a sud, al forno di trasposizione del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿Por algún motivo en especial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Per qualche motivo in particolare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Sí, b-bueno, porque... el nombre me suena a que tiene a-algo que ver con la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: U-um ... If it's okay, I also have an idea ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Si', b-be', perche'... il nome mi fa pensare che a-abbia qualcosa a che fare con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Tampoco tenemos una pista mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Go ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non abbiamo nemmeno un indizio migliore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Cierto. Vamos a echar un vistazo por si acaso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: This place to the south, the Mana Transposing Furnace. I think it might be a good idea to go there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Giusto. Andiamo a darci un'occhiata per sicurezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: ¿En serio? ¿Os ha parecido un buen motivo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Any specific reason why?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Davvero? Vi sembra un buon motivo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Si nadie se opone, yo creo que merece la pena intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Uh, um, well, just because ... the name sounds like it has something to do with alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Se nessuno si oppone, io direi che vale la pena provarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: No se nos ha ocurrido nada mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: Well, it's not like we have any other leads.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Non ci e' venuto in mente niente di meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..src: Vale, andando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..ref: True. Let's go check it out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_084..dst: Va bene, andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¿Esto es el horno de transposición de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: So, this is the Mana Transposing Furnace?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Questo e' il forno di trasposizione del mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Eso creo. Vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: I believe so. Let's investigate around here a bit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Penso di si'. Andiamo a darci un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Mirad. Seguro que esto esconde algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Look at this. It's just screamin' that it's hidin' somethin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Guardate. Di sicuro qui si nasconde qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Estoy contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: But it seems to be locked. Did you try kicking it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Sono con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Está bloqueado. ¿Ya le has dado tu patada milagrosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: What're you talkin' about? That's obviously not gonna work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: E' bloccato. Gli hai gia' dato il tuo calcio miracoloso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¿Qué dices? No funcionaría aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Maybe it's like that drawbridge from before, and the power to the door is cut off?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Cosa dici? Qui non funzionerebbe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Tal vez le haya pasado como al puente levadizo y no le llegue corriente a la puerta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: If it's the same, it'll be a quick fix, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Forse e' successo come con il ponte levatoio e alla porta non arriva corrente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Podría ser. La otra vez lo arreglaste en un segundo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Not sure. If the machinery is still intact, then it might be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Puo' darsi. L'altra volta l'hai aggiustato in un attimo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Yo no cantaría victoria tan rápido. Si la maquinaria sigue intacta, no tardaré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: It seems like this whole area was powered by this, and yet ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Io non canterei vittoria cosi' in fretta. Se il meccanismo e' intatto, non ci vorra' molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Pero es como si toda la zona recibiera la corriente de aquí y, sin embargo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Exterior walls: Severely damaged.<CR>Furnace core: Malfunctioning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Ma e' come se tutta la zona ricevesse corrente da qui e, eppure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Muros exteriores: Daños severos.<CR>Núcleo del horno: Error de funcionamiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Flammi believes that without major repairs, it will be difficult to restart the furnace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Mura esterne: Danni gravi.<CR>Nucleo del forno: Malfunzionamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Flammi considera que no será fácil reiniciar el horno sin una reparación a fondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: What's the plan, Yumia? If you can fix it, go ahead. If not, we'll have to end our investigation here for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Flammi ritiene che non sara' facile riavviare il forno senza una riparazione accurata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¿Qué dices, Yumia? Si puedes arreglarlo, todo tuyo. Pero si no, podemos dejarlo para otro momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Yeah, just leave it to me. I should be able to figure something out with the skills I've acquired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Che ne dici, Yumia? Se riesci a sistemarlo, e' tutto tuo. Ma se no, possiamo lasciarlo per un'altra volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Sí, dejádmelo a mí. Después de todo lo que he aprendido, creo que no se me resistirá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Oh, reliable as ever! That's our Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Si', lasciatelo a me. Dopo tutto quello che ho imparato, credo che non mi resistera'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¡Esa es nuestra Yumia! Tan segura como siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: Um ... I can probably fix it? If I apply the skills I've learned so far, I should be able to figure something out ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: E' la nostra Yumia! Sicura come sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: No sé, quizá no sea tan complicado. Después de todo lo que he aprendido, a lo mejor se me ocurre algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: What's with the sudden lack of confidence?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Non so, forse non e' cosi' complicato. Dopo tutto quello che ho imparato, magari mi viene in mente qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¿Eso es lo que confías en ti misma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: D-don't be mean! Fixing such a large device isn't easy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: E questo e' avere fiducia in te stessa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: ¡N-no seas duro con ella! Arreglar un aparato tan grande no es sencillo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: There's no need to worry, Yumia. Do what you can, and we'll consider ourselves lucky if it works out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: N-non essere duro con lei! Sistemare un congegno cosi' grande non e' semplice...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: No te preocupes, Yumia. Haz lo que puedas. Sin ti estaríamos mucho más perdidos de todos modos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: ... Right. Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Non preoccuparti, Yumia. Fai quello che puoi. Senza di te saremmo comunque molto piu' persi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: Claro... Gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: (Both the actual furnace and the surrounding equipment all need repairs. There's quite a lot to get through.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: Certo... Grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: (Tanto el horno como el resto de las maquinarias necesitan algunas reparaciones. Son muchas cosas.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: (No need to rush. Let's fix them up one by one.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: (Sia il forno che il resto dei macchinari necessitano di qualche riparazione. Sono davvero tante cose.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: (Aunque no tenemos prisa. Iremos paso a paso.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..ref: <SEL_MM05_090_1_B><CR>I can probably fix it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: (Pero' non abbiamo fretta. Andremo un passo alla volta.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..src: <SEL_MM05_090_1_B><CR>A lo mejor se me ocurre algo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_090..dst: <SEL_MM05_090_1_B><CR>Magari mi viene in mente qualcosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: Miss Yumia. H-how did it look?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: Tal y como dijo Flammi, el núcleo del horno está roto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: Just like Flammi predicted, it looks like the core of the furnace is broken ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Proprio come aveva previsto Flammi, il nucleo del forno e' rotto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: Aunque creo que el daño se debe simplemente al paso del tiempo. Si mejoro el estado de las partes por separado, funcionará sin problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: However, the damage is limited to wear over time. If the parts can be repaired, it should function without issue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Pero' credo che il danno sia dovuto semplicemente al passare del tempo. Se miglioro lo stato dei componenti singolarmente, funzionera' senza problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: Pero no sé siquiera por dónde empezar. ¿Sabes el orden de montaje?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: But I don't even know where to start with these parts. Do you understand how they're put together?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Ma non so nemmeno da dove cominciare. Sai in che ordine vanno assemblati?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: Negativo. Flammi no tiene datos sobre las piezas que necesitas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: Negative. Flammi does not have any information on the specified parts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Negativo. Flammi non ha dati sui componenti di cui hai bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: Parecen ser específicas de este horno de transposición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: They are likely highly specific parts used only in this transposing furnace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Sembra siano componenti specifici, usati solo in questo forno di trasposizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..src: En fin. Echemos un vistazo. Quizá haya por aquí alguna pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..ref: Oh well, let's take a look around here. There might be some sort of clue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_100..dst: Va beh. Diamoci un'occhiata. Forse qui in giro c'e' qualche indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Equipo, esperad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Everyone. Wait one moment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Squadra, aspettate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¿Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Flammi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¿Qué hay en ese montón de trastos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Is there somethin' in that pile of junk?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Che c'e' in quel mucchio di cianfrusaglie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Escaneo finalizado. Veo un Vial de recuerdos sepultado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Scan complete. There seems to be a Memory Vial buried inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Scansione completata. Sembra esserci una Fiala della Memoria sepolta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¡Vaya, qué guay! Qué buena vista tienes, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Wow, that's amazing! Good job noticing that, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Wow, fantastico! Che occhio che hai, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Es verdad, hay uno... Flammi, ¿lo puedes examinar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: There really was one ... Flammi, can you take a look?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: E' vero, ce n'e' una... Flammi, puoi esaminarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Recibido. Reproduciendo grabación de audio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Understood. Playing audio recording now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Ricevuto. Riproduzione della registrazione audio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Señor, el Gobierno nos ha enviado otro plano de construcción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Sir, the state has sent another construction plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Signore, il Governo ci ha inviato un altro piano di costruzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¿Qué? ¿Cuántas modificaciones van a pedir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: What? How many additions is that now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Cosa? Quante altre modifiche vogliono chiedere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Lo sé, señor, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: I know, sir, but—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Lo so, signore, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¡Bah! ¡Ya lo sé, ya lo sé! Si los peces gordos nos ordenan algo, acatamos sin rechistar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Bah! I know, I know! If the higher-ups give the order, we have no choice but to follow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Bah! Lo so, lo so! Se i pezzi grossi ci ordinano qualcosa, obbediamo senza lamentarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¡Estirium! ¡Necesitamos más estirium! No me importa quien lo encuentre, pero ¡excavad hasta que se os caigan las manos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Stirium! We need more Stirium! I don't care who does it, but someone dig more up! We don't have nearly enough!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Estirium! Abbiamo bisogno di piu' estirium! Non mi importa chi lo trovi, ma scavate finche' non vi si stancano le braccia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¡Sí, señor! ¡Enseguida!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Yes, sir! Right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Si', signore! Subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Fin de la reproducción. Se trata de una reunión que tuvo lugar en el pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: The audio ends here. It seems to have been a recording of a meeting that took place in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Fine della riproduzione. Si tratta di una riunione avvenuta in passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¿Qué es el estirium?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: What is Stirium?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Che cos'e' lo stirium?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Es el nombre que recibe un mineral especial que se extrae en este territorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Stirium is the name of a rare mineral that is mined in this vicinity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: E' il nome di un minerale speciale che viene estratto in questo territorio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Seguramente el horno de transposición servía para fabricar dispositivos que funcionaban con maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: The transposing furnace likely used it to manufacture various mana-related devices.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Sicuramente il forno di trasposizione serviva a fabbricare dispositivi che funzionavano a mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Entiendo. Y ese mineral sería el ingrediente esencial. Me encantaría echarle el guante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: I see, so this mineral is the key ingredient. If we can get our hands on it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Capisco. E quel minerale sarebbe l'ingrediente essenziale. Mi piacerebbe molto metterci le mani...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Se podría usar para la reparación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: It could potentially be used for repairs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Potrebbe essere usato per la riparazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: ¿Alguna idea de dónde se extraía?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: Any idea where it was mined?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Avete un'idea di dove veniva estratto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: El yacimiento minero principal se encuentra al oeste, en la zona que rodea la Gran Caverna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: The area around the Grand Cavern to the west of here was the primary mining site.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Il giacimento minerario principale si trova a ovest, nella zona che circonda la Grande Caverna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..src: Nada nos dice que seguirá habiendo estirium allí, pero no perdemos nada por comprobarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..ref: There's no telling if there's any left, but it's worth a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_110..dst: Nulla ci dice che li' ci sara' ancora stirium, ma non perdiamo nulla a controllare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¡Lo hemos encontrado! Así que esto es estirium...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: We found some! So this is Stirium ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: L'abbiamo trovato! Quindi questo e' stirium...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Menos mal que Flammi acertó. ¿Y esto?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: I'm glad Flammi's records were right. ... Hm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Meno male che Flammi aveva ragione. ... Oh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Esta piedra... es extraña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: This stone ... seems strange.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Questa pietra... e' strana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¿Extraña por qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Strange?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Strana in che senso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: El flujo de maná que rodea la piedra se mueve de una forma poco natural a su alrededor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: It's like the flow of mana around the stone is twisting around unnaturally.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Il flusso di mana che circonda la pietra si muove in modo poco naturale attorno ad essa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Yo también lo noto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: I was thinking the same thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Lo noto anch'io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¡Jo...! ¡Yo quiero ver lo que veis vosotras!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Aww, I wanna see what you two can see!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Uffa...! Voglio vedere anch'io quello che vedete voi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Con total probabilidad, este fenómeno se debe a una propiedad del estirium que distorsiona el flujo de maná concentrándolo o dispersándolo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: This is likely due to a property of Stirium distorting the flow of mana by either concentrating or dispersing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Con ogni probabilita', questo fenomeno e' dovuto a una proprieta' dello stirium che distorce il flusso di mana concentrandolo o disperdendolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¿En serio? Qué interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Oh? That's an interesting property.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Davvero? Che interessante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Hay registros que describen el estirium como un metal peculiar que se usaba en muchas piezas y dispositivos de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: There are records of Stirium being a rare metal that is used in many mana-related devices and components.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Ci sono documenti che descrivono lo stirium come un metallo peculiare usato in molte parti e dispositivi a mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Claro. Se podría usar para controlar el maná en grandes cantidades y emplearlo como fuente de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Oh, I get it. This can be used to control huge amounts of mana and turn it into a power source.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Certo. Potrebbe essere usato per controllare grandi quantita' di mana e impiegarlo come fonte di energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Y ¿s-sabrías cómo usarlo con esa información?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Y-you figured out how to use it just from that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: E s-sapresti come usarlo con queste informazioni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Me temo que no. Pero creo que me servirá para restaurar algunas funciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Not exactly, but at the very least I should be able to restore some functionality.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Temo di no. Ma credo che mi servira' per ripristinare alcune funzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¡G-guay! ¡E-eres una caja de s-sorpresas, señorita Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Wow! As usual, you never cease to amaze, Miss Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: C-che f-figo! S-sei una scatola di s-sorprese, Signorina Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¡No es para tanto! Además, esto es trabajo en equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Oh stop, it's nothing. It's not just me, anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Non e' niente di speciale! E poi e' un lavoro di squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Hay que reconocer que la asistencia de Flammi ha sido clave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: It could be said that Flammi's contribution was quite significant in this matter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: C'e' da riconoscere che l'assistenza di Flammi e' stata fondamentale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¡No deberías echarte flores así, Flammi!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: You aren't supposed to compliment yourself like that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Non dovresti farti i complimenti da sola cosi', Flammi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¿Por qué no? Flammi solo constataba un hecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Why is that? Flammi was merely stating a fact.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Perche' no? Flammi stava solo constatando un fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Creo que no estaría de más revisarte un poco las piezas a ti. Ya sabes, desarmarte para perfeccionar tu funcionamiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: Once we get home maybe I should take you apart. I think I can make you even more "perfect."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Secondo me non sarebbe male controllare un po' i tuoi pezzi. Vedi un po', smontarti per perfezionare il tuo funzionamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: No es recomendable. Con tus habilidades actuales, existe el riesgo de que Flammi dejara de funcionar por completo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: That is not recommended. At your current skill level, there is a risk that you will render Flammi inoperable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Non e' consigliabile. Con le tue abilita' attuali, c'e' il rischio che Flammi smetta completamente di funzionare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: ¿Tan malo sería?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: I wonder about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Sara' cosi' grave?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Además, ¡Flammi ya es perfecta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: In addition, Flammi is already perfect as is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Inoltre, Flammi e' gia' perfetta cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..src: Tengo mis dudas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..ref: I wonder about that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_120..dst: Ho i miei dubbi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Cuando quieras, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Whenever you're ready, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Quando vuoi, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Vale!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: ... Okay!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Va bene!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Vaaaya... Es increíble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Wow, incredible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Caspita... E' incredibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Estup-pendo, señorita Yumia! ¡Lo has conseguido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Amazing! You did it, Miss Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Fanta-stico, signorina Yumia! Ce l'hai fatta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Sí. No me creo que haya funcionado de verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Yeah. I can't believe it worked!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Si'. Non posso credere che abbia davvero funzionato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Ya llega la corriente. Voy a abrir la puerta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: All right, the power is back. I'm going to open the door ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: La corrente e' arrivata. Vado ad aprire la porta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Qué caballerosa! Nos está invitando a pasar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: How considerate. Looks like it wants us to come in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Che cavalleresca! Sembra volerci far entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Adentro pues!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Then I guess we don't need to hesitate!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Dai, allora entriamo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¿Qué clase de habitación es esta? ¿Han abandonado todo esto aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: What kind of room is this? It seems like a whole lot of things have been left behind ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Che tipo di stanza e' questa? Sembra che abbiano lasciato qui tantissime cose...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¿Y sabes lo que eso significa? ¡Que hay mucho por descubrir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: A whole lot of things just means there's a whole lot of new discoveries to be made!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: E sai cosa significa? Che c'e' tantissimo da scoprire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Lenja, tu idea ha sido fabulosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Lenja, looks like your idea is going to pay off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Lenja, sembra che la tua idea stia dando i suoi frutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¿L-lo dices en serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: R-really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: D-dici sul serio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Claro que sí. Tuviste muy buen ojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Indeed. I think it was an excellent hunch.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Davvero. E' stata un'intuizione eccellente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Yupi!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Yay!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Evviva!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Esta habitación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: This room ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Questa stanza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¿Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¡Oh, lo siento! Es que... tengo un poco de hambre y me he distraído.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Oh, I'm sorry ... I'm a little hungry, so I spaced out for a bit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Oh, scusami... E' che ho un po' di fame e mi sono distratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: ¿Tienes... hambre?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: You're ... hungry?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Hai... fame?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Venga, no es momento de perder la concentración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Come now, you can't lose your focus at a time like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Dai, non e' il momento di perdere la concentrazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: No seas así, Viktor. Nina, si quieres picar algo, dímelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Now, now. Nina, if you want snacks, I've got some. Just let me know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Dai, dai, Viktor. Nina, se vuoi uno spuntino, dimmelo pure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..src: Gracias. Te lo recordaré cuando acabemos de revisar esta sala.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..ref: Thanks. Maybe I'll have some after we search this room.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_130..dst: Grazie. Ne approfittero' dopo aver esaminato questa stanza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..src: ¿Cuándo se usó este sitio por última vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..ref: Just how long ago was this place last used?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..dst: Quando e' stato usato questo posto per l'ultima volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..ref: A photo? Is this one of the people who used this facility?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..src: ¿Una foto? ¿Sería de alguien que trabajaba aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_131..dst: Una foto? Era di qualcuno che lavorava qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..src: ¿Q-qué son estos huecos? Hay por todas partes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..ref: Wh-what are these? It looks like there are quite a lot of them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..dst: C-cosa sono questi buchi? Ce ne sono ovunque...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..src: Ahí dentro cabe una persona tumbada. Por su ubicación, debían de servir para algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..ref: They seem just big enough for a person to lie down in. Being lined up like this, they had to be for something ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..dst: Dentro ci sta una persona sdraiata. Dalla loro posizione, dovevano servire a qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..src: Aunque... es la primera vez que veo algo así. No se me ocurre para qué los usarían.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..ref: But with only this to go off of, it's hard to say what their purpose was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..dst: Pero'... e' la prima volta che vedo una cosa simile. Non mi viene in mente a cosa potessero servire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..src: Ni siquiera Flammi conoce su finalidad con la información actual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..ref: Even Flammi is unable to determine their purpose based on the current information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_132..dst: Nemmeno Flammi ne conosce lo scopo con le informazioni attuali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: Yumia, ¿esto es un Vial de recuerdos de la civilización pasada?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: Yumia, isn't this a Memory Vial from the past civilization?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Yumia, e' una Fiala della Memoria della civilta' passata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: Eso parece. Flammi, ¿lo escaneas, por favor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: Looks like it. Flammi, please scan it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Sembra di si'. Flammi, la scansioni, per favore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: Scan complete. Reading it aloud now.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: «El proyecto Crisálida de recuerdos progresa según lo previsto.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: "The Recollection Cocoon project is progressing according to plan."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: "Il progetto Crisalide dei Ricordi procede come previsto."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: «Se les ha dado vida a estos seres artificiales, los homúnculos. La segunda generación no es más que una imitación, pero ya se aprecian algunos resultados.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: "Vessels brought to life—homunculi. The second generation is nothing more than an imitation, yet we are starting to see results."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: "Abbiamo dato vita a questi esseri artificiali: gli omuncoli. La seconda generazione non e' che un'imitazione, ma stiamo iniziando a vedere dei risultati."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: «Con la información obtenida en este experimento, podemos plantearnos una tercera generación que cuente con una personalidad única.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: "With the information gathered from this experiment, a third generation imbued with its own unique personality is now within the realm of possibility."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: "Con le informazioni ottenute da questo esperimento, possiamo prefigurarci una terza generazione dotata di una personalita' unica."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: «No debemos fracasar. Jamás aceptaré una derrota. Aunque tarde una eternidad, llegaré hasta el final.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: "Failure is not an option. I will never accept defeat. Even if it takes an eternity, I will see this through to the end."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: "Non dobbiamo fallire. Non accettero' mai una sconfitta. Anche se dovesse volerci un'eternita', portero' tutto fino alla fine."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: «Dedicaré todos mis conocimientos a las ambiciones ardientes del emperador Basilius. ¡Gloria al Imperio aladissiano!»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: "I shall devote all of my wisdom to the ardent ambitions of Emperor Basilius. Glory to the Aladissian Empire."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: "Dedichero' tutte le mie conoscenze alle ardenti ambizioni dell'imperatore Basilius. Gloria all'Impero Aladissiano!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: Esa es toda la información que Flammi ha conseguido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: ... That is all of the information that was able to be retrieved.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Questa e' tutta l'informazione che Flammi e' riuscita a recuperare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: ¿Basilius no fue el nombre que mencionó Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: Basilius? Isn't that the name Lili Borea mentioned?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Basilius non era il nome menzionato da Lili Borea?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: Sí. Fue el último emperador de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: Yes, it is. The name of the last emperor of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Si'. Fu l'ultimo imperatore di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: ¿Y en qué consiste ese proyecto «Crisálida de recuerdos»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: But what exactly is this Recollection Cocoon project?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: E in cosa consiste quel progetto "Crisalide dei ricordi"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: El término «homúnculo» se refiere a un tipo de ser vivo artificial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: The term "homunculus" appears to refer to a type of artificial life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Il termine "homunculus" si riferisce a un tipo di essere vivente artificiale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: Flammi no puede obtener más información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: No further information was able to be obtained.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Flammi non e' in grado di ottenere altre informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: ¿Como los mutantes? ¿Y qué hacían con ellos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: I wonder what that's all about. I guess it could be like the mutants?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: Come i mutanti? E cosa ne facevano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..src: (¿Eso es para lo que Basilius necesita el poder de la alquimia?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..ref: (Just what was Basilius trying to achieve with the power of alchemy?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_133..dst: (E' per questo che Basilius ha bisogno del potere dell'alchimia?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Creo que ya hemos mirado todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: I think we've pretty much checked everything now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Credo che abbiamo gia' visto tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Y seguimos sin saber n-nada de este sitio. Estoy m-muy confundida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: And we still don't know what this place is. Everything here is just so confusing ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: E continuiamo a non sapere n-niente di questo posto. Sono m-molto confusa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Eh, mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Hey, Mercenary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Ehi, mercenaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Qué pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: What is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Che c'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: No te hagas la tonta. ¿Qué nos ocultas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Don't play dumb. You're hidin' somethin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Smettila di fare la scema. Che ci stai nascondendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Por qué...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: What are you—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Perche'...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Basta, Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Hey now, Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Basta, Rutger...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: No me lo digas a mí, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Don't stop me, Alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Non dirmelo a me, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Ha sido evidente desde que llegamos aquí, hasta tú te habrás dado cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: It's been clear as day since we got here, but even before that you must've felt something was off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: E' stato evidente da quando siamo arrivati qui, persino tu te ne sarai accorta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Bueno... yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Well, I ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: (¿Cuándo notaría Nina nuestra presencia...?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: (When exactly did Nina find us ...?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: (Da quando Nina si era accorta della nostra presenza...?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Yumia, Rutger y Nina me dais una impresión distinta que el resto del grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Yumia, Rutger, Nina. The three of you in particular strike me as different from the other members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Yumia, Rutger e Nina mi trasmettete un'impressione diversa dal resto del gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Responde, mercenaria. ¿Qué nos ocultas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Answer me, Mercenary. What're you hidin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Rispondi, mercenaria. Che ci nascondi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Estás con el enemigo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Are you our enemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Sei dalla parte del nemico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Yo... Yo no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Io... Io no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Deben de haber pasado años desde la última vez que hubo tanta vida aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: It must have been hundreds of years since someone last visited this place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Devono essere passati anni dall'ultima volta che qui c'era cosi' tanta vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Esa voz...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: That voice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Quella voce...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Corleonis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Corleonis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Corleonis!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Cómo entiendo vuestra infinita curiosidad! Pero me temo que no puedo permitiros saquear mi antigua guarida a vuestro antojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: I fully understand your endless curiosity, but I'm afraid I cannot allow you to just ravage my old lair as you please.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Come comprendo la vostra infinita curiosita'! Ma temo di non potervi permettere di saccheggiare il mio antico covo a vostro piacimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Guarida?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Old lair?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Covo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Te sorprende? Puede que sea cosa del destino, querida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Why yes. But perhaps this was some sort of fate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Te ne stupisci? Forse e' una cosa del destino, cara.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿A qué te refieres? Tú eres el que nos ha seguido. El destino no tiene nada que ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: What are you talking about? You just followed us here, this has nothing to do with fate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Cosa intendi? Sei tu che ci hai seguiti. Il destino non c'entra nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Cuando lo dices así suena tan siniestro... ¡Tómatelo como un halago! Lo hago para que nos conozcamos mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Saying I was following you makes it sound so sinister! It's reconnaissance! Reconnaissance to get to know you better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Detto cosi' suona tanto sinistro... Prendila come una lusinga! Lo faccio per farci conoscere meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Suena igual de siniestro, bicho raro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Huh? There's no difference, you bastard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Suona altrettanto sinistro, strano esemplare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Oh! Y pensar que otra alma se ha dejado cautivar por la verdad de la alquimia como yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Ah, but to think there was another captivated by the truth of alchemy just like myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Oh! Pensare che un'altra anima si e' lasciata affascinare dalla verita' dell'alchimia proprio come me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Una nueva vida. Los mutantes y los homúnculos te interesan, ¿a que sí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: New life. Mutants. Homunculi. Such things attract you too, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Una nuova vita. I mutanti e gli homunculi ti interessano, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Que nos hayamos encontrado aquí, en esta tierra, solo puede ser cosa del destino!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: That we should meet here, in this land—it simply has to be called fate!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Se ci siamo incontrati qui, su questa terra, non puo' essere che opera del destino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Eh? ¿De qué estás hablando?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Huh ...? What are you even talking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Eh? Ma di che stai parlando?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Vaya, vaya. Quizá me haya equivocado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: ... Dear me. Perhaps I was mistaken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Oh oh. Forse mi sono sbagliato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Ese homúnculo, ¿no es creación tuya?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: That homunculus there, did you not create it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Quell'homunculus, non e' una tua creazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Eh?
