eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿Nina es... un h-homúnculo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Nina is ... a homunculus?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Nina e'... un o-omuncolo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡I-imposible! Miradla, ¡Nina es humana!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: N-no way! No matter how you look at her, Nina is human!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: I-impossibile! Guardatela, Nina e' umana!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Exacto. Ese es el aspecto de un homúnculo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Exactly. That's what homunculi are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Esatto. E' cosi' che appare un omuncolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡¿Nina es una humana creada mediante alquimia?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Then Nina is a human ... created through alchemy?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Nina e' un essere umano creato con l'alchimia?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Maldita sea. Eso lo explica todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Damn it. That explains it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Maledizione. Questo spiega tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Desde los primeros días y hasta hoy, el Imperio aladissiano ha supervisado la creación de cada espécimen a partir de la segunda generación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Dai primi giorni a oggi, l'Impero Aladissiano ha supervisionato la creazione di ogni esemplare a partire dalla seconda generazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Si ella no la ha creado, entonces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: From long ago until this very day, the Aladissian Empire has overseen every specimen since the second generation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Se non e' stata lei a crearla, allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Es el homúnculo de la primera generación robado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: But if that one was not created by her, then that can only mean ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: E' l'omuncolo di prima generazione che era stato rubato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Vaya! Qué giro de los acontecimientos. Menudo error por mi parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: It must be the stolen first generation homunculus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Ma guarda! Che colpo di scena. Ho proprio commesso un errore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Debo revisar el plan...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: My, what a turn of events. This is a serious miscalculation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Devo rivedere il piano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Espera! ¡Respóndenos antes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: I must hurry and revise the plan ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Aspetta! Prima rispondici!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Por desgracia, no puedo quedarme. Ya charlaremos en otro momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Wait! There's more to talk about ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Purtroppo non posso fermarmi. Parleremo un'altra volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: No me esperaba hacer un hallazgo tan descomunal. Me veo obligado a abandonaros por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Unfortunately, I am busy now. We can have a nice long talk another time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Non mi aspettavo di fare una scoperta cosi' enorme. Per ora sono costretto a lasciarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¡Rayos! ¡Espera!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: I have made a rather unexpected discovery today. With that, I must take my leave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Maledizione! Aspetta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: ¿De qué va ese tipo? ¡Agita el avispero y se marcha!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Damn it, wait!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Ma che gli prende? Getta il sasso nello stagno e poi se ne va!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Lo volveré a preguntar: vas a explicarnos quién eres, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: What's with that guy?! He just stirs things up and disappears!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Te lo chiedo di nuovo: ci spiegherai chi sei, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Sí. Os lo contaré todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: I'll ask again. You're gonna explain this yourself now, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Si'. Vi raccontero' tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..src: Pero antes, regresemos a la base. El jefe debería escucharlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..ref: Yes. I'll tell you everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_134..dst: Ma prima, torniamo alla base. Il capo dovrebbe sentirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Venga, empieza desde el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: All right then, time to spill it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Dai, inizia dall'inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Mercenaria, un consejo: yo que tú no me dejaría nada en el tintero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Mercenary. You better tell us everything you've been hiding.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Mercenaria, un consiglio: al posto tuo non tralascerei niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Ya lo sé. No hace falta ser tan borde. Tenía intención de contároslo todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I know. No need to be harsh, I intend to tell you everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Lo so. Non c'e' bisogno di risposte cosi' sgarbate. Avevo intenzione di raccontarvi tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Aunque no sé por dónde empezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: That said, I don't even know where to begin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Solo che non so da dove cominciare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Necesito que respondas a una cosa primero, ¿de verdad eres un homúnculo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Before anything else, please tell me. Are you really a homunculus?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Ho bisogno che tu risponda prima a una cosa: e' vero che sei un omuncolo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Sí, lo soy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: ... Yes, I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Si', lo sono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Soy un homúnculo. Me crearon en el Imperio aladissiano hace siglos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I am a homunculus. I was given life in the Aladissian Empire centuries ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Sono un omuncolo. Sono stata creata nell'Impero Aladissiano secoli fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Mi creadora fue una alquimista, Marina Friede.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Created at the hands of an alchemist, Marina Friede.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: La mia creatrice e' stata un'alchimista, Marina Friede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: ¿Marina? U-un momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Marina? Wait, that's—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Marina? U-un momento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: ¡Ese es el nombre del Observatorio Fatum Astrorum! Aparecía en uno de los documentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: The name from the Faltona Observatory! I remember reading it in the documents ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: E' il nome dell'Osservatorio Fatum Astrorum! Compariva in uno dei documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: «Nosotros somos diferentes. Seguimos a la doctora Marina y juramos por nuestro honor averiguar la verdad».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: "We are different. Under Doctor Marina's lead, we swear on our honor to seek out truth."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: "Noi siamo diversi. Seguiamo la dottoressa Marina e giuriamo sul nostro onore di scoprire la verita'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: «No importan el destino ni tampoco las circunstancias. Nuestra alma no flaqueará».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: "No matter where we go. No matter the circumstances. Our souls shall never waver."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: "Non contano il destino ne' le circostanze. La nostra anima non vacillera'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Sí. Me creó la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Yes. Doctor Marina is my creator.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Si'. Mi ha creata la dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Siento haberlo ocultado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I'm sorry for not saying anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Mi dispiace di averlo nascosto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Era cuestión de tiempo que la verdad saliera a la luz en el trascurso de la investigación, pero no sabía cómo sacar el tema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I knew it would come out eventually as our investigation continued, but I couldn't bring myself to say anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Era solo questione di tempo prima che la verita' venisse alla luce nel corso dell'indagine, ma non sapevo come introdurre l'argomento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Aunque sí diré esto: no me importa el uso que quieran darles a los homúnculos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: But believe me when I say that no matter how those mutants intend to use homunculi ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Pero' questo lo dico: non mi importa dell'uso che vorranno fare degli omuncoli...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Jamás he sido ni seré enemiga del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I have never, and will never, be an enemy to the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Non sono mai stata ne' saro' mai nemica della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: ¿Quieres que te creamos? Es mucho pedir, ¿no te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Nina ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Vuoi che ti crediamo? E' chiedere molto, non trovi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Nosotros decidiremos si volvemos a confiar en ti. ¿Entendido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Just believe you, huh? That's askin' a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Decideremo noi se fidarci di nuovo di te. Capito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Lo siento, pero estoy con Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: I think we'll decide for ourselves just how far our trust goes. Right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Mi dispiace, ma concordo con Rutger...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: ¿Por qué un homúnculo creado en Aladiss se uniría al equipo de investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: ... I agree with Rutger here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Perche' un omuncolo creato ad Aladiss si unirebbe alla Squadra di Ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: A menos que nos lo cuentes, no sé qué pensar de todo esto. Por favor, explícate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Why would you, a homunculus created in Aladiss, choose to join the Research Team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Se non ce lo racconti, non so cosa pensare di tutto questo. Ti prego, spiegati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Muy bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: Without knowing that, I can't decide what to think of you. So please, explain it to us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Va bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..src: Os contaré la vida que he llevado hasta ahora. Ha sido tan extensa como breve.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..ref: ... Very well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_140..dst: Vi raccontero' la vita che ho condotto finora. E' stata tanto lunga quanto breve.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Todo comenzó hace siglos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It all began centuries ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Tutto comincio' secoli fa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Se llevaron a cabo unos experimentos para crear humanos en secreto con la excusa de la «prosperidad» del Imperio aladissiano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Experiments to create humans were conducted in secret for the sake of the prosperity of the Aladissian Empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Furono condotti in segreto esperimenti per creare esseri umani, con la scusa della "prosperita'" dell'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: El primer logro de estos proyectos, el homúnculo de la primera generación, fui yo: Nina Friede.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: The very first success of these projects, the first generation homunculus, was me, Nina Friede.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Il primo risultato di questi progetti, l'omuncolo di prima generazione, sono stata io: Nina Friede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Aún recuerdo la sonrisa de la doctora. Cuando abrí los ojos, la vi allí aguantándose las ganas de llorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I still remember the doctor's smile. Her eyes brimming with tears when she first saw me open my eyes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ricordo ancora il sorriso della dottoressa. Quando aprii gli occhi, la vidi li' che tratteneva a fatica le lacrime.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Sin embargo, poco después de nacer, me separaron del lado de la doctora Marina y me sometieron a pruebas interminables.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: However, soon after being created, I was torn from Doctor Marina's side and forced to take part in unending experiments.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Tuttavia, poco dopo la nascita, mi separarono dalla dottoressa Marina e mi sottoposero a prove interminabili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Creí que jamás me dejarían marchar. No les importaba, al fin y al cabo, no era una persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: They truly never seemed to end. I wasn't a person after all, so it didn't matter to them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Pensavo che non mi avrebbero mai lasciata andare. Non gli importava; dopotutto, non ero una persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Eso es horrible...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: That's horrible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: E' orribile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Lo fue. La doctora no podía soportar la decisión del imperio y, un día, fue a buscarme y escapamos juntas del laboratorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It was. The doctor couldn't stand what the empire was doing either, so one day she took me and we escaped from the lab.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Lo fu. La dottoressa non riusciva ad accettare la decisione dell'impero e, un giorno, venne a cercarmi e fuggimmo insieme dal laboratorio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Nos acompañaron otros alquimistas que compartían nuestros valores e hicimos todo lo posible por pasar desapercibidos. Queríamos llegar al oeste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Together with other alchemists who shared our cause, we did whatever we could to stay hidden while heading west.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ci accompagnarono altri alchimisti che condividevano i nostri valori e facemmo del nostro meglio per passare inosservati. Volevamo arrivare a ovest.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Al final, llegamos a un laboratorio en Lignumbria donde vivir en paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Eventually, we reached a laboratory in the Ligneus region where we could finally live in peace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Alla fine, arrivammo a un laboratorio a Lignumbria dove vivere in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Pero esa paz no duró demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: But that peace was short-lived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ma quella pace non duro' a lungo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Años después de nuestra huida, el caos asoló Aladiss a causa del conflicto que mantenía con otras naciones y las reyertas internas por culpa de las investigaciones secretas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Some years after our escape, Aladiss was in disarray due to conflict with other nations and internal strife over the secret research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Anni dopo la nostra fuga, il caos devasto' Aladiss a causa del conflitto con altre nazioni e delle dispute interne provocate dalle ricerche segrete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: La agitación llegó a Lignumbria y coincidió con el gran desastre de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: That turmoil reached all the way to Ligneus, and it also coincided with a huge mana disaster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: L'agitazione giunse a Lignumbria e coincise con la grande calamita' del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Nuestro laboratorio sufrió los estragos del desastre y fue invadido por los árboles cuyo crecimiento se vio alterado por la presencia del maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Our laboratory was hit by the disaster and engulfed by trees that surged in growth due to the mana's influence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Il nostro laboratorio subi' le devastazioni della calamita' e fu invaso dagli alberi la cui crescita era stata alterata dalla presenza del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Recuerdo haber corrido para salvar a la doctora. Estaba a punto de quedar atrapada bajo un derrumbe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I remember going to save the doctor who was about to be caught in the building's collapse ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ricordo di essere corsa a salvare la dottoressa. Stava per rimanere intrappolata sotto un crollo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Mi memoria está en blanco después de ese momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: But after that, my memory is blank.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Dopo quel momento, la mia memoria si interrompe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Cuando volví a abrir los ojos, estaba en una orilla de la actual Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: The next time I woke up, I had been washed ashore in present-day Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Quando riaprii gli occhi, mi trovavo su una riva dell'attuale Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Cómo es posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Huh? But how?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Com'e' possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Posiblemente, fui gravemente herida en el derrumbe y, para salvarme, la doctora me metió en su prototipo de cápsula de recuperación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It seems that I had been gravely injured in the collapse, and so to save me the doctor placed me in a kind of<CR>treatment casket she was researching.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Probabilmente rimasi gravemente ferita nel crollo e, per salvarmi, la dottoressa mi mise nel suo prototipo di capsula di recupero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Es un dispositivo que manipula y regula el flujo de maná del cuerpo. Me salvó la vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It's a device that manipulates and regulates the mana flowing inside one's body. It saved me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: E' un dispositivo che manipola e regola il flusso di mana del corpo. Mi ha salvato la vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Estuve escondida en el fondo del océano cientos de años. Hasta hace poco...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I was hidden at the bottom of the ocean for centuries, all until recently ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Sono rimasta nascosta sul fondo dell'oceano per centinaia di anni. Fino a poco tempo fa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Cuando desperté y supe del estado actual del mundo, me quedé perpleja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: When I awoke and learned about the world's current state, I was certainly surprised.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Quando mi sono svegliata e ho saputo dello stato attuale del mondo, sono rimasta sgomenta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Aladiss había desaparecido hace siglos y la alquimia era un tabú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Aladiss had fallen centuries ago. Alchemy was deemed taboo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Aladiss era scomparsa da secoli e l'alchimia era un tabu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Con el fin de protegerme, decidí ocultar mi verdadera identidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: To protect myself, I decided I had to hide my true identity, yet ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Per proteggermi, decisi di nascondere la mia vera identita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Pero, desde que desperté, quise saber qué había pasado. No... Necesitaba saberlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Ever since I reawakened, I wanted to know what happened. No, I had to know what happened.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ma, da quando mi sono svegliata, ho voluto sapere cosa fosse successo. No... dovevo saperlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Por qué se destruyó Aladiss? ¿Por qué perdí mi hogar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Why was Aladiss destroyed? Why did I have to lose my homeland?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Perche' Aladiss e' stata distrutta? Perche' ho perso la mia casa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Qué les pasó a mis amigos del laboratorio? ¿Qué le pasó a la doctora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: What happened to my friends at the lab? What happened to the doctor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Che fine hanno fatto i miei amici del laboratorio? Che fine ha fatto la dottoressa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Busqué una manera de investigar Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I kept searching for a way to investigate Aladiss ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Cercavo un modo per indagare su Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Entonces, te topaste con el equipo de investigación y te uniste sin dudarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: And you stumbled onto the Research Team and decided to join.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Allora, ti sei imbattuta nella Squadra di Ricerca e ti sei unita senza esitare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: En cuanto a la segunda generación que mencionó Corleonis, os juro que no sé nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: As for the second generation that Corleonis mentioned, I'm afraid I don't know anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Per quanto riguarda la seconda generazione menzionata da Corleonis, vi giuro che non so niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Se basarían en la primera generación. La foto que vio Yumia será de esa segunda generación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It's likely based on the first generation. That photo Yumia found might be of the second generation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Si sarebbero basati sulla prima generazione. La foto che ha visto Yumia sara' di quella seconda generazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Él vio que yo era un homúnculo y por eso ha estado tan interesado en nuestro grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: He seemed to have realized that I was a homunculus, which may be why he had his eye on us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Lui ha capito che io sono un ominuncolo ed ecco perche' si e' tanto interessato al nostro gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Eso es todo lo que sé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: And that's about all I know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Questo e' tutto quello che so.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Pensabas que lo podrías ocultar para siempre?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Did you think you could keep hidin' it forever?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Pensavi di poterlo nascondere per sempre?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: No. Quería contarlo. Era cuestión de tiempo que lo averiguaseis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: ... I knew it would come out as the investigation progressed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: No. Volevo dirlo. Era solo questione di tempo che lo scopriste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Pero... No. Todo lo que diga ahora os sonará a excusa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: But, I—No. Anything I say now would just sound like an excuse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ma... No. Tutto cio' che diro' ora vi sembrera' una scusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: La realidad es que os mentí. Si creéis que no podéis volver a confiar en mí, abandonaré el equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: The fact is, I lied to you all. If you feel you can no longer trust me, I'll remove myself from the team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: La realta' e' che vi ho mentito. Se pensate che non possiate piu' fidarvi di me, lascero' la squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Me cuesta aceptar lo que acabo de oír. La verdad, estoy sorprendido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: It's difficult to digest this right after hearing it. I won't lie, I'm shocked too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Fatico ad accettare quello che ho appena sentito. A dire il vero, sono sorpreso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Necesitamos unos momentos para procesarlo. Debemos afrontar la verdad y ser honestos con nuestros sentimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I think we all need some time to think. Time to face this new truth and sort out our feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ci serve qualche momento per elaborarlo. Dobbiamo affrontare la verita' ed essere onesti con i nostri sentimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Cuando hayáis sopesado la situación, os corresponderá a vosotros decidir qué pasará con Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: After that, it'll be up to you all to decide what to do about Nina's situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Quando avrete valutato la situazione, spettera' a voi decidere cosa succedera' di Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Ahora iré a revisar vuestra información sobre el horno de transposición de maná por si acaso hubiera alguna nueva pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: For now, I'll check whether the information you found at the Mana Transposing Furnace gives us any other leads.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ora andro' a controllare le vostre informazioni sul forno di trasposizione del mana, nel caso ci fosse qualche nuovo indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Nina, quiero confirmar una cosa antes. No sabrás nada del proyecto «Crisálida de recuerdos», ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Nina, just to confirm, you don't know anything about the Recollection Cocoon project, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Nina, prima voglio confermare una cosa. Non sai niente del progetto "Crisalide dei ricordi", vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: No sé nada. La primera vez que oí hablar de él fue en el horno, como los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I don't. The first time I heard about it was at the Furnace, just like everyone else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Non so niente. La prima volta che ne ho sentito parlare e' stata al forno, come tutti gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Qué clase de proyecto necesita emplear homúnculos? Me despierta curiosidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I do wonder what kind of project would require the use of homunculi, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Che tipo di progetto ha bisogno di impiegare ominuncoli? Mi suscita curiosita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Lo que sí puedo hacer es sugerir un par de sitios donde hallar más datos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: That said, I can suggest some places that might provide more information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Quello che posso fare e' suggerirvi un paio di posti dove trovare altri dati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿De verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Sí. Ya he estado otras veces en la región de Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Yes. I visited the Auruma region several times in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Si'. Sono gia' stata altre volte nella regione di Auruma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Al este había un gran distrito comercial. Recuerdo que siempre estaba muy concurrido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: There was a large commercial district to the east. I remember that it was always bustling with people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: A est c'era un grande quartiere commerciale. Ricordo che era sempre molto affollato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Seguro que allí hay más información sobre la civilización pasada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I'm sure we could find more information about the past civilization there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Di sicuro li' ci sono piu' informazioni sulla civilta' passata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Un distrito comercial? Suena bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: A commercial district? That could be good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Un quartiere commerciale? Sembra un'ottima idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Eh, alquimista. No te creas todo lo que dice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Hey, Alchemist. Don't just blindly trust what she says.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Ehi, alchimista. Non credere a tutto quello che dice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Ahora no hay garantías de que sea verdad... No me fío de ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: There's zero guarantee she's not lyin'. ... I still don't trust you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Per ora non c'e' alcuna garanzia che sia vero... Non mi fido di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Entiendo cómo te sientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Capisco come ti senti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Os he mentido, a pesar de que siempre me habéis tratado como una amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I fully understand why you feel that way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Vi ho mentito, nonostante mi abbiate sempre trattata come un'amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Yumia, dejo la investigación del distrito comercial en tus manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: I've been lying to you all along, even though you treated me as a friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Yumia, lascio nelle tue mani l'indagine del quartiere commerciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Si crees que Nina merece tu confianza, id juntas a explorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Yumia. I'll leave the investigation of this commercial district to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Se pensi che Nina meriti la tua fiducia, esplorate insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Vale, reunión concluida. ¡Descansad, equipo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: If you still believe you can trust Nina's word, then go together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Bene, riunione conclusa. Riposatevi, squadra!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Descansar? ¿Yo también? ¿No vas a detenerme o algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: All right, then we're done here for now! You're all dismissed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Riposare? Anch'io? Non hai intenzione di fermarmi o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Si quisiera detenerte, ya lo habría hecho. Deben ser ellos quienes tengan la última palabra sobre ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Dismissed? Me too? You aren't going to detain me or anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Se avessi voluto fermarti, l'avrei gia' fatto. Devono essere loro ad avere l'ultima parola su di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: Aunque te pediría que no salieras de la base durante tu tiempo libre. Como miembro del equipo de investigación, debo hacerte algunas preguntas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: If I was going to detain you, I would have done so already. Your fate here depends on their decision now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Pero' ti chiederei di non uscire dalla base durante il tuo tempo libero. In qualita' di membro della squadra di ricerca, devo farti alcune domande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..src: ¿Alguien tiene algo que añadir? ¿No?<CR>Vale, pues ya hemos acabado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..ref: Ah, but please stay in the base during your free time. As a Research Team member, I have a ton of questions to ask.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_150..dst: Qualcuno ha qualcosa da aggiungere? No?<CR>Bene, allora abbiamo finito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Ah... Me imaginaba que sería algo así, pero no queda casi nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: ... Ah. I knew it would be something like this, but there's almost nothing left.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Ah... Immaginavo che fosse cosi', ma non e' rimasto quasi nulla.
Grazie per essere venuta con me, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Si no me falla la memoria, este sitio siempre estaba hasta arriba de gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Thank you, Yumia, for coming here with me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Se la memoria non mi inganna, questo posto era sempre pieno zeppo di gente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Por toda la zona, usaban una tecnología de maná mucho más avanzada de lo que podemos imaginar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: If memory serves, this place used to be bustling with people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: In tutta la zona usavano una tecnologia del mana molto piu' avanzata di quello che possiamo immaginare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Cada vez que veía la luz del maná, se me aceleraba el corazón de la emoción... Da igual lo lejos que estuviera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Mana technology far more advanced than anything we can imagine today was used all over the area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Ogni volta che vedevo la luce del mana, il mio cuore batteva forte dall'emozione... Non importava quanto fossi lontana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: ¿Lo lejos que estuvieras? ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Every time I saw the light of mana, my heart would flutter with excitement. ... No matter how far away I was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Quanto fossi lontana? Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Tanto la doctora como yo teníamos que pasar desapercibidas, así que nos manteníamos alejadas de los lugares concurridos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Far away? What do you mean by that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Sia la dottoressa che io dovevamo passare inosservate, cosi' restavamo lontane dai posti affollati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Por eso, solo podíamos mirar desde la distancia, pero esa luz tenía un brillo increíble hasta de lejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Both the doctor and I needed to keep a low profile, so we steered clear of any crowded places.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Per questo potevamo solo guardare da lontano, ma quella luce aveva uno splendore incredibile anche da lontano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Jamás habría imaginado que todo estaría destruido cuando tuviera la oportunidad de estar aquí de verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: That's why we could only ever look on from a distance. But even from afar, the light shone brilliantly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Non avrei mai immaginato che tutto sarebbe stato distrutto quando avrei avuto l'occasione di stare qui davvero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: Perdona que sea tan pesimista. ¿Empezamos a investigar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: I never thought that everything would be destroyed by the time I actually got to be here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Scusa se sono cosi' pessimista. Iniziamo a fare ricerche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..src: No puedo guiarte por aquí porque es la primera vez que vengo, pero tiene que quedar algún tipo de información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..ref: Sorry for the gloomy talk. Shall we start the investigation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_160..dst: Non posso guidarti da queste parti perche' e' la prima volta che vengo, ma deve essere rimasto qualche tipo di informazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: E' una Fiala della Memoria. Flammi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Parece un trozo de un informe de prensa de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: This appears to be a segment of an Aladissian press report.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Sembra un pezzo di un comunicato stampa di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: «Aumenta la preocupación por la creciente escasez de homúnculos».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: "Cresce la preoccupazione per la crescente scarsita' di omini".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: «En los últimos meses, se ha registrado una disminución del 20 % en los suministros de homúnculos del mercado».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: "In recent months, there has been a reported 20% decrease in the market supply of homunculi."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: "Negli ultimi mesi, e' stata registrata una diminuzione del 20% nelle forniture di omini sul mercato".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: «Según los altos funcionarios, se trata de una consecuencia temporal de la reasignación de recursos y se encuentra dentro de los efectos esperados».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: "Senior officials responded, 'This is a temporary effect of adjustments to resource allocation, and is within expected parameters.'"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: "Secondo gli alti funzionari, si tratta di una conseguenza temporanea della riassegnazione delle risorse e rientra negli effetti previsti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: «Declaran que los ciudadanos del Imperio aladissiano debemos tener fe en el gobierno del emperador y seguir sirviendo a nuestro país con devoción».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: "'As citizens of the Aladissian Empire, we must have faith in the emperor's leadership and devote ourselves to the service of our country.'"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: "Dichiarano che noi cittadini dell'Impero Aladissiano dobbiamo avere fede nel governo dell'imperatore e continuare a servire il nostro paese con devozione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: "'Glory to the Aladissian Empire.'"<CR>That is the end of the document.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Creo que la disminución en el suministro se debió a la huida de la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: I think the decrease in supply mentioned here was due to Doctor Marina's escape.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Penso che la diminuzione delle forniture sia dovuta alla fuga della Dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Cuando se fue, dejaron de funcionar varios proyectos relacionados. Pero parece que consiguieron ocultar la verdad bastante bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: After she left, related enterprises stopped functioning. It seems they did a great job covering up the truth, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Quando se ne e' andata, diversi progetti correlati hanno smesso di funzionare. Ma sembra che siano riusciti a nascondere la verita' piuttosto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Entonces, ¿los ciudadanos nunca se enteraron de lo de la doctora Marina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: So, the citizens were never informed about Doctor Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Quindi i cittadini non hanno mai saputo nulla della Dottoressa Marina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Desapareció de forma repentina una alquimista veterana que pertenecía a la institución de investigación más importante de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: It was the sudden disappearance of a senior alchemist belonging to the top research institution in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: E' scomparssa all'improvviso un'alchimista esperta che apparteneva alla piu' importante istituzione di ricerca di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Si le hubieran contado algo así a la población, la reputación del Imperio se habría visto gravemente perjudicada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: Revealing that to the public would have had huge effects on the empire's reputation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Se alla popolazione avessero raccontato una cosa del genere, la reputazione dell'Impero ne sarebbe stata gravemente danneggiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: No era consciente de que era una alquimista tan importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: I didn't realize she was such an important alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Non sapevo che fosse un'alchimista cosi' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Sí que lo era. Además de crear a los homúnculos, se ocupaba de muchos proyectos de investigación que el Imperio le encomendó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: Yes. Even apart from creating homunculi, the doctor was entrusted with many research projects by the empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Lo era eccome. Oltre a creare gli omini, si occupava di molti progetti di ricerca che l'Impero le aveva affidato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Por desgracia, ninguno de esos proyectos se centraba en las cosas que la doctora quería hacer de verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: Unfortunately, none of those projects were the kind she actually wanted to work on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Purtroppo nessuno di quei progetti era incentrato sulle cose che la dottoressa voleva davvero fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: No era en absoluto el entorno ideal para que se ocupara de sus investigaciones personales. No me extraña que escapase...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..ref: It was far from the ideal setting for pursuing her own research. It's no wonder she wanted to escape ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Non era affatto l'ambiente ideale perche' potesse dedicarsi alle sue ricerche personali. Non mi sorprende che sia fuggita...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..src: Bueno, vamos a seguir. Todavía queda mucho por ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_170..dst: Beh, andiamo avanti. C'e' ancora molto da vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Hala, qué de edificios altos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: Wow. There are so many tall buildings ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Caspita, quanti edifici alti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: No tiene nada que ver con el paisaje típico de Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: It's certainly not a sight that you can see in Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Non c'entra niente con il paesaggio tipico di Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Es imposible construir edificios como estos sin una alquimia de alto nivel y un montón de recursos humanos y materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: These buildings can't be made without both high-level alchemy and a wealth of human and material resources.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: E' impossibile costruire edifici come questi senza un'alchimia di alto livello e un sacco di risorse umane e materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: O eso me dijo la doctora en una ocasión...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: ... Or so the doctor once told me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: O cosi' mi disse la dottoressa una volta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Tenía razón. Aladiss tuvo que ser un lugar increíble en su época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: It's just as she said. I'm sure Aladiss was once an amazing place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Aveva ragione. Aladiss doveva essere un posto incredibile ai suoi tempi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: «La alquimia alberga infinitas posibilidades». Le encantaba decir esa frase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: "Alchemy holds infinite possibilities." She really liked saying that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: "L'alchimia racchiude infinite possibilita'". Le piaceva molto dire quella frase.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Supongo que estos edificios son el símbolo perfecto del infinito potencial de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: These buildings are a symbol of the infinite potential of alchemy, I suppose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Immagino che questi edifici siano il simbolo perfetto dell'infinito potenziale dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: ¿Cómo? ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: Huh? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Come? Cosa intendi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: El Imperio aladissiano dependía de la alquimia para crear la mayoría de sus recursos materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: The Aladissian Empire relied on alchemy for the majority of its material resources.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: L'Impero Aladissiano dipendeva dall'alchimia per creare la maggior parte delle sue risorse materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Es probable que la mayor parte de los materiales que se usaron en estos edificios se crearan así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: Most of the materials used in these buildings were likely made in the same way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: E' probabile che la maggior parte dei materiali usati per questi edifici sia stata creata cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Ya veo. Y los recursos humanos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: I see. And the human resources were ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Capisco. E le risorse umane...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Exacto... También se creaban con alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: ... Yes. They were also made through alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Esatto... Venivano create anche con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: El número de ciudadanos y la cantidad de mano de obra eran limitados, pero el emperador y los más altos funcionarios encontraron una solución.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: There was a limit to the number of citizens and the labor they could perform, but the emperor and other top officials figured out a way around that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Il numero di cittadini e la quantita' di manodopera erano limitati, ma l'imperatore e i piu' alti funzionari trovarono una soluzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Descubrieron que podían crear fácilmente mano de obra con alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: It turns out that they could just as easily "make" labor with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Scoprirono che potevano creare facilmente manodopera con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Homúnculos y mutantes, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: Homunculi and mutants, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Omuncoli e mutanti, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Sí, creados para obedecer las órdenes de su dueño sin cuestionarse nada. Era la opción más conveniente para el Imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: They were all created to obey their master's commands without question. It was most convenient for the empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Si', creati per obbedire agli ordini del padrone senza porsi domande. Era l'opzione piu' comoda per l'Impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Era una opción muy eficaz. Los homúnculos van acumulando recuerdos a lo largo de sus vidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: It was also very efficient. Homunculi accumulate memories throughout their lives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Era un'opzione molto efficace. Gli omuncoli accumulano ricordi nel corso delle loro vite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Cuando un homúnculo muere, esos recuerdos se pueden recopilar y volver a utilizar como maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: When a homunculus dies, those memories can simply be collected and reused as mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Quando un omuncolo muore, quei ricordi possono essere raccolti e riutilizzati come mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Yo no era más que un objeto de estudio, así que tampoco conozco los detalles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: I was always just a research subject however, so I don't know the specifics of any of that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Io non ero che un oggetto di studio, quindi non conosco nemmeno i dettagli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: No tenía ni idea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: I had no idea ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Non ne avevo la minima idea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: La verdad es que el Imperio aladissiano funcionaba muy bien con ese sistema. Los ciudadanos no sabían nada de la oscura realidad que hacía que todo se mantuviera en marcha y en paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: The Aladissian Empire actually functioned very well under this system. The citizens were kept in the dark about the grim reality that kept things going and enjoyed peace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: La verita' e' che l'Impero Aladissiano funzionava molto bene con quel sistema. I cittadini non sapevano nulla della cupa realta' che teneva tutto in moto e vivevano in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Pero, entonces, llegó la caída del Imperio. Recuerdo que, en aquella época, el resto de las naciones ejercía cada vez más presión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: But, the empire fell. I do remember there was increasing pressure from other nations at the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Ma poi giunse la caduta dell'Impero. Ricordo che, in quell'epoca, le altre nazioni esercitavano una pressione sempre maggiore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Sin embargo, Aladiss era lo bastante fuerte como para vencer si hubiera entrado en guerra con ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: Though Aladiss wasn't so weak that it would have lost to those nations had they gone to war.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Tuttavia, Aladiss era abbastanza forte da prevalere se fosse entrata in guerra con quelle nazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: Tuvo que producirse algún problema serio a nivel interno que lo cambió todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: There must have been some kind of major and decisive issue that occurred internally back then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Dev'essersi verificato un qualche problema serio a livello interno che ha cambiato tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..src: No solo he vuelto para saber qué les pasó a la doctora y a los demás, sino también para descubrir qué sucedió con el Imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..ref: I didn't just come back here to find out about the doctor and the others. I want to find out what happened to the empire too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_180..dst: Non sono tornata solo per scoprire cosa e' successo alla dottoressa e agli altri, ma anche per scoprire cosa e' successo all'Impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Supongo que eso es todo por ahora. ¿Has encontrado algo que merezca la pena desde que llegamos, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I suppose that's about everything for now. Did you find anything worthwhile from coming here, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Immagino sia tutto per ora. Hai trovato qualcosa che ne valga la pena da quando siamo arrivati, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Pues... creo que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: ... Yes, I think so.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Beh... credo di si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: De todas las ruinas que hemos investigado hasta ahora, esta es la que tenía una esencia de Aladiss más potente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Of all the ruins we've investigated so far, this one had the strongest essence of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Tra tutte le rovine che abbiamo esaminato finora, questa e' quella con l'essenza di Aladiss piu' potente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: «La alquimia alberga infinitas posibilidades». Creo que las palabras de la doctora Marina eran ciertas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: "Alchemy holds infinite possibilities." I think Doctor Marina's words are true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: "L'alchimia racchiude infinite possibilita'". Credo che le parole della Dottoressa Marina fossero vere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: No conseguiremos nada si no nos esforzamos por aprender. Pero, para entender bien las cosas, hay que ir más allá de los hechos más simples.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Nothing will happen if we don't try to learn. But to correctly understand things, you need to look beyond simple facts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Non otterremo nulla se non ci impegniamo a imparare. Ma, per capire bene le cose, bisogna andare oltre i fatti piu' semplici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Creo que eso es lo más importante que he aprendido en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I think that is the most important thing I learned here in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Credo che questa sia la cosa piu' importante che ho imparato in Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Como los alquimistas de la región de Lignumbria, que se dedicaban a ayudar a los residentes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Like the alchemist in the Ligneus region, who lived assisting the local residents ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Come gli alchimisti della regione di Lignumbria, che si dedicavano ad aiutare i residenti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Como los alquimistas del observatorio, que recalcaban lo importante que es tener en cuenta los recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Like the alchemist from the observatory, who insisted memories should never be disregarded ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Come gli alchimisti dell'osservatorio, che sottolineavano quanto sia importante tenere in considerazione i ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Entender sus motivos, sus contextos y otras cosas que van más allá de la superficie nos permite juzgar la verdad con precisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Understanding reasons, backgrounds, and other things beyond the surface allows us to correctly judge the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Capire i loro motivi, i loro contesti e altre cose che vanno oltre la superficie ci permette di giudicare la verita' con precisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Así es como me siento ahora mismo. Pero tampoco me siento muy confiada al respecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: That's how I feel now. I'm still not really confident about it, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: E' cosi' che mi sento in questo momento. Ma non mi sento nemmeno molto sicura al riguardo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Por eso, no creo que podamos poner fin a nuestra historia diciendo «Nina era un homúnculo» y ya está.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: But that's why I don't think we can just end your story with "Nina was a homunculus."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Per questo, non credo che possiamo chiudere la nostra storia dicendo "Nina era un omuncolo" e basta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Dame un poco más de tiempo para pensar en ello, en ti y en mis propios sentimientos, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Please give me a little more time to think. About you, and about my own feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Dammi un po' piu' di tempo per pensarci, su di te e sui miei stessi sentimenti, per favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: A pesar de todos los problemas que he causado, sigues esforzándote por verme como soy en realidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Nonostante tutti i problemi che ho causato, continui a sforzarti di vedermi come sono davvero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Lo siento... y gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Despite all the trouble I've caused, you're still willing to see me for who I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Mi dispiace... e grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Ahora que lo pienso, creo que a la doctora también le perturbaba algo. Igual que a ti ahora, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I'm sorry ... and thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Ora che ci penso, credo che anche la dottoressa fosse tormentata da qualcosa. Proprio come te ora, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Como por entonces yo no era más que un objeto de estudio, no era capaz de entender sus sentimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Thinking back on it, I think the doctor was also troubled by something. Similar to the way you are now, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Poiche' all'epoca io non ero che un oggetto di studio, non ero in grado di capire i suoi sentimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Solo quería ayudarla. Eso era todo lo que deseaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: As I was just someone being researched at the time, I never really understood her feelings back then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Volevo solo aiutarla. Era tutto cio' che desideravo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Significaba mucho para ti, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I just wanted to help her. That's all I ever wished for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Significava molto per te, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Sí... Lo era todo para mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: She really meant a lot to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Si'... Era tutto per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Tuvo la fuerza necesaria para escapar del Imperio y dedicarse a investigar lo que realmente le apasionaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Yes ... She meant the world to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Aveva la forza necessaria per sfuggire all'Impero e dedicarsi a ricercare cio' che la appassionava davvero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Pero, aun así, cuando hablaba de los resultados de sus experimentos, siempre tenía una sonrisa inocente en la cara.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: She was strong enough to escape the empire and pursue the research she truly wanted to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Ma, anche cosi', quando parlava dei risultati dei suoi esperimenti, aveva sempre un sorriso innocente sul viso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Me encantaba esa sonrisa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Yet when she spoke about the results of her experiments, it would always be with the smile of an innocent child.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Questo sorriso mi piaceva da morire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: He de admitir que no entendía ni un tercio de lo que decía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I loved that smile.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Devo ammettere che non capivo nemmeno un terzo di quello che diceva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Bueno, creo que ya es hora de volver a la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: I must admit, I never really understood a third of what she was saying, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Beh, credo che sia ora di tornare alla base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..src: Estaré esperando a que tomes una decisión, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..ref: Anyway, I think it's time we headed back to base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_190..dst: Attendero' che tu prendia una decisione, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Viktor, Isla, aquí estáis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Viktor, Isla, there you are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Viktor, Isla, eccovi qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Yumia, llegas justo a tiempo. ¿Podrías dedicarnos un momento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yumia, perfect timing. Could you lend us an ear for a bit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Yumia, arrivi proprio al momento giusto. Potresti dedicarci un momento?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Hmm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Ah, ya. Tenéis sentimientos encontrados sobre Nina, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I see. So you two are divided over how you feel about Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Ah, gia'. Avete sentimenti contrastanti riguardo a Nina, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Sí, y eso está haciendo que abordar toda esta situación sea todavía más difícil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yeah, and it's only made it harder to figure out how to approach the whole situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Si', e questo sta rendendo ancora piu' difficile affrontare tutta questa situazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Me alegro de que haya sido honesta con nosotros y ya no dudo de su lealtad, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I'm glad she was honest with us, and while I no longer question her loyalty, I just ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Mi fa piacere che sia stata onesta con noi e non dubito piu' della sua lealta', ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Me gustaría que nos lo hubiera contado antes. Podríamos haber avanzado mucho más en las investigaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I wish she had spoken up a bit sooner. We could have achieved so much more with our investigations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Mi sarebbe piaciuto che ce lo avesse detto prima. Avremmo potuto avanzare molto di piu' nelle ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: ¡Venga ya, deja de darle vueltas al mismo tema! No es tan sencillo como lo pintas, ¿sabes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Oh come on, stop dwelling on that! You know it's not that simple, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Dai, smettila di tornare sempre sullo stesso discorso! Non e' cosi' semplice come la dipingi tu, sai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: La propia Nina lo dijo. Si hubiera salido a la luz su verdadera identidad, habría estado en peligro, así que la ocultó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Nina said it herself. Her real identity being discovered would have put her in danger, so she kept it hidden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: L'ha detto Nina stessa. Se la sua vera identita' fosse venuta alla luce, sarebbe stata in pericolo, cosi' l'ha nascosta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Entiendo tu perspectiva, pero ¿no crees que deberíamos ponernos en el lugar de Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I understand your point of view, but don't you think we need to look at it from Nina's perspective?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Capisco il tuo punto di vista, ma non pensi che dovremmo metterci nei panni di Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: ¡Sí, sí! Si lo entiendo, pero es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yes, yes! I understand that, but I just ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Si', si'! Certo che lo capisco, ma e' che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Es... distinto. Me cuesta explicarlo con palabras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: This is ... different. It's difficult to put into words.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: E'... diverso. Faccio fatica a spiegarlo a parole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Me sabe mal que no tuviéramos la relación necesaria para que Nina tuviera la confianza de contárnoslo antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I just wish we could have built a relationship where Nina felt she could have shared this with us sooner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Mi dispiace che non avessimo un rapporto tale che Nina si fidasse a dircelo prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Vale, ya entiendo cómo te sientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Ah ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Va bene, ora capisco come ti senti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Sí, creo que ya lo pillo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: So that's how you feel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Si', credo di aver capito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Creo que tú también tienes razón. En realidad, no sabíamos nada sobre Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I think I get what you're trying to say.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Anche tu hai ragione, credo. In realta', non sapevamo niente di Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Ahora que lo pienso, ya le hicimos lo mismo a Yumia. Hemos vuelto a cometer el mismo error.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I think you're right, too. We really didn't know anything about Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Ora che ci penso, abbiamo fatto lo stesso con Yumia. Abbiamo commesso di nuovo lo stesso errore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Entonces, lo que queréis decir es que estáis de acuerdo en que Nina siga siendo parte del equipo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Thinking back on it, we did the same thing to Yumia. We've just repeated the same mistake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Quindi, quello che volete dire e' che siete d'accordo che Nina continui a far parte della squadra, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Sí, eso está claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: So, what you're saying is, you both agree that Nina is still part of the team, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Si', questo e' chiaro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Yumia, en una ocasión dijiste que los recuerdos de conflicto entre las Neru y los Silva no desaparecerán fácilmente, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yes. That much is certain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Yumia, una volta hai detto che i ricordi del conflitto tra i Neru e i Silva non scompariranno facilmente, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Así es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yumia, you once said that the memories of conflict between the Neru and Silva won't fade easily, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Esatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Creo que, si ese es el caso, los buenos recuerdos que tenemos de Nina tampoco lo harán.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Credo che, se e' cosi', nemmeno i bei ricordi che abbiamo di Nina lo faranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Da igual quién sea en realidad, el tiempo que hemos pasado juntos no va a desaparecer sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I believe that if that's the case, then the good memories—our memories with Nina—won't fade so easily either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Non importa chi sia in realta', il tempo che abbiamo passato insieme non sparira' cosi' per niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Tienes razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: No matter what her true identity may be, the time we've spent together won't disappear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Hai ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Sí, estoy segura de que Nina no pretendía engañarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: That's true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Si', sono sicura che Nina non intendesse ingannarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Y nunca olvidaré lo increíble que fue cuando nos rescató de Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: Yeah. I'm certain Nina was never trying to deceive us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: E non dimentichero' mai quanto e' stata incredibile quando ci ha salvato da Ve'sper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Os sentís igual al respecto, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: And I'll never forget how amazing she was when she saved us from Vesper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Anche voi la pensate allo stesso modo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: Creo que, si todos estamos de acuerdo en eso, ya sabemos suficiente. Al menos, por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: I'm sure you both feel the same, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Credo che, se tutti siamo d'accordo su questo, sappiamo gia' abbastanza. Almeno, per ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..src: No tenemos que imponerles nuestra opinión a los demás. Estoy segura de que todos pensamos lo mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..ref: If we all share that sentiment, then I think we know enough for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_200..dst: Non dobbiamo imporre la nostra opinione agli altri. Sono sicura che pensiamo tutti la stessa cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: ¿Qué estás haciendo, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: What are you doing, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Cosa stai facendo, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Anda, pero si es la alquimista. Llegas justo a tiempo, ¿me acompañas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: Oh, it's you, Alchemist. Good timin', you wanna come with me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Oh, ma e' l'alchimista! Arrivi proprio al momento giusto, vieni con me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: ¿Acompañarte a dónde?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: Come with you where?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Accompagnarti dove?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: A la región de Lignumbria. Quiero comprobar una cosa sobre la mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: The Ligneus region. I wanna check somethin' about that mercenary girl.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Nella regione di Lignumbria. Voglio verificare una cosa sulla mercenaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: No parece que te haya sorprendido mucho que Nina sea un homúnculo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: You don't seem all that surprised that Nina is a homunculus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Sembra che il fatto che Nina sia un omuncolo non ti abbia sorpreso piu' di tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: No es que no me haya sorprendido, es que me da bastante igual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: It's not that I'm not surprised. It just doesn't really matter to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Non e' che non mi abbia sorpreso, e' che non mi importa piu' di tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Lo que importa ahora es que resulte útil para los demás. ¿No crees?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: What's important now is whether she's gonna be useful to us or not. Am I wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Quello che conta ora e' che risulti utile per gli altri. Non credi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Eres muy práctico. A lo mejor debería aprender un poco de ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: You really are practical. Maybe I should take a leaf out of your book.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Sei molto pratico. Forse dovrei imparare qualcosa da te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Ni lo intentes... No lo llevas en la sangre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: ... I wouldn't try. It just ain't in your nature.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Non provarci nemmeno... Non ce l'hai nel sangue.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: No es fácil cambiar la forma en que has vivido la vida hasta ahora. Ni para mí ni para ti ni para nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: It ain't easy to change the way you've lived your life up till now. Not for me, not for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Non e' facile cambiare il modo in cui hai vissuto la vita finora. Ne' per me, ne' per te, ne' per nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: ... I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Ya, ya, déjate de lamentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: Yeah, yeah, cut the gloominess.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Va', va', niente lamenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Lo tuyo es hablar sobre la amistad, lo valiosos que son los vínculos y todo eso con cara seria. Eso es lo que llevas en la sangre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: You should just talk about friends and precious bonds and whatever with a straight face. That's your nature.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Tu puoi parlare di amicizia, di quanto i legami siano preziosi e tutto il resto con fare serio. E' quello che hai nel sangue.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Pero bueno, aunque no sea fácil cambiar, siempre podemos aprender cosas nuevas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: But you know, even if we can't change easily, we can always learn new things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Pero', vabbe', anche se non e' facile cambiare, possiamo sempre imparare cose nuove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Pfff, ¿quién sabe? Si tú crees que puedes, adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: Pfft, who knows. If you think you can, knock yourself out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Pfff, chi lo sa? Se credi di potercela fare, vai pure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Bueno, ¿a qué parte de Lignumbria vamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: So, where in Ligneus are we headed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Allora, in quale parte di Lignumbria andiamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Al Gran Árbol de Latere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: The Great Tree of Latere.
