eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Al Grande Albero di Latere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Nina fue la única que se quedó atrás después de nuestra pelea con el Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: After our fight with that Vesper guy, she was the only one who stayed behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Nina e' stata l'unica a restare sul posto dopo il nostro scontro con quel Vesper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Dijo que quería ir a echar un vistazo o algo así, pero sospecho que tramaba algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: Back then, she said somethin' about goin' to look around, but I suspect she might've been up to somethin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Ha detto che voleva dare un'occhiata o qualcosa del genere, ma sospetto che stesse tramando qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..src: Entiendo. Pues vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..ref: I see. All right, let's take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_210..dst: Capito. Allora andiamo a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..src: Creo que nos separamos de Nina más o menos a esta altura, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..ref: I think we parted ways with Nina around here, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..dst: Penso che ci siamo separati da Nina piu' o meno da queste parti, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..src: ¿Y este quién es? ¿Había un monstruo como este por aquí cuando vinimos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..ref: What's with this guy? Was there a monster like this around here before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..dst: E questo chi e'? C'era un mostro come questo da queste parti quando siamo venuti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..ref: No, I don't remember seein' it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..dst: No, non ricordo di averlo visto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..src: Vésper controlaba esta zona, así que a lo mejor se instaló aquí cuando él desapareció.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..ref: Vesper used to control this area, so it probably moved in after he disappeared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..dst: Vesper controllava questa zona, quindi magari si e' insediato qui quando e' sparito lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..src: Ya. ¡No te duermas en los laureles, alquimista!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_220..dst: Gia'. Non riposarti sugli allori, alchimista!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..src: A juzgar por el estado del suelo y las Alstahlias, se debe de haber construido hace muy poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..ref: Judging by the condition of the soil and Alstahlias, it was likely made quite recently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..dst: A giudicare dalle condizioni del terreno e delle Alstahlias, dev'essere stato costruito pochissimo tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..src: Dijo que había pasado mucho tiempo en el laboratorio de aquí con los investigadores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..ref: She did say she spent a lot of time with the researchers at the laboratory here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..dst: Ha detto che aveva passato molto tempo nel laboratorio di qui con i ricercatori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..ref: Wait. Are we done here, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..src: Ya tenemos lo que buscábamos. Me doy por satisfecho. No hay motivos para quedarse más tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..ref: We got what we came for. I'm satisfied. No reason to stay here any longer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..dst: Abbiamo gia' quello che cercavamo. Sono soddisfatto. Non c'e' motivo di restare ancora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..src: No está bien molestar a los que descansan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..ref: It's not right to disturb those at rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_230..dst: Non e' giusto disturbare chi riposa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Sí. Mmm... ¡Muchas gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Yes. Um ... thank you very much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Si'. Mmm... Grazie mille!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Vale, ahora tengo que buscar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Okay. Now I just need to find ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Va bene, adesso devo andare a cercare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Anda, hola, Lenja. ¿Estás de compras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Oh, hey, Lenja. Doing some shopping?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Oh, ciao, Lenja. Stai facendo compere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: ¡Señorita Yumia! Mmm, pues...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Miss Yumia! U-um, well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Signorina Yumia! Mmm, beh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Quería hacer un collar... Para dárselo a Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: ... I wanted to make a necklace. To give to Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Volevo fare una collana... Da dare a Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: ¿Un collar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: A necklace?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Una collana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Ya te he hablado de las costumbres de mi clan, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: I talked about my clan's custom before, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Ti ho gia' parlato delle usanze del mio clan, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Si no recuerdo mal, nos contaste que, cuando llegáis a la edad adulta, os embarcáis en un viaje de redención para ayudar a otra gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: If I remember correctly, once you become an adult you go on a journey of atonement to help people across the land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Se non ricordo male, ci hai raccontato che, quando raggiungete l'eta' adulta, intraprendete un viaggio di redenzione per aiutare altre persone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Cuando alguien vuelve de su viaje, recibe un collar hecho a mano por sus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Once someone returns after completing their journey, they receive a handmade necklace from their friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Quando qualcuno torna dal suo viaggio, riceve una collana fatta a mano dai suoi amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Este collar simboliza que hemos afrontado y aceptado nuestros pecados. Es un recuerdo de que hemos alcanzado la madurez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: It's a sign of having faced and accepted one's sins. A token of becoming a full-fledged adult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Questa collana simboleggia che abbiamo affrontato e accettato i nostri peccati. E' un ricordo del fatto che abbiamo raggiunto la maturita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Entiendo. ¿Y quieres darle ese mismo recuerdo a Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: I see. And you want to give that same token to Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Capisco. E vuoi dare a Nina quello stesso ricordo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: ¡N-no, no! Tampoco me gustaría darle tanto significado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: N-no, no! There's no big meaning like that behind it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: N-no, no! Non e' che voglia dargli un significato cosi' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Es solo que... la admiro mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: It's just that, I really admire her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: E' solo che... la ammiro molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Perdió a todos sus amigos de golpe y acabó arrastrada a un mundo donde nadie la conocía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: She suddenly lost all her friends and was thrown into a world where no one knew her ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Ha perso tutti i suoi amici di colpo e si e' ritrovata trascinata in un mondo dove nessuno la conosceva...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Debe de haber sido muy duro para ella. Creo que la mayoría de la gente sería incapaz de aceptar algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: That must've been hard on her. I think most people would simply be unable to accept it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Dev'essere stato durissimo per lei. Penso che la maggior parte delle persone sarebbe incapace di accettare una cosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Pero la señorita Nina afrontó la realidad y siguió adelante por su cuenta. Me parece increíble...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: But Miss Nina faced that reality and pushed through, all on her own. I think that's really incredible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Ma la signorina Nina ha affrontato la realta' ed e' andata avanti con le proprie forze. La trovo incredibile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Por eso... quería hacerle saber que ya no está sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: So that's why ... I wanted to let her know that she's not alone anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Per questo... volevo farle sapere che non e' piu' sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: No es fácil afrontar y aceptar algo que preferirías rechazar... Es un sentimiento con el que puedo empatizar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Lenja ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Non e' facile affrontare e accettare qualcosa che preferiresti rifiutare... E' un sentimento con cui riesco a empatizzare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: El camino que ha seguido la señorita Nina me recuerda un poco a mi propia experiencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: The hardship of facing and accepting something you'd much rather deny ... I understand a bit of how that feels.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Il percorso che ha seguito la signorina Nina mi ricorda un po' la mia stessa esperienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Nuestro viaje no ha terminado, pero quería darle un collar para que recuerde lo lejos que ha llegado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: The path that Miss Nina has taken feels a little like my own journey.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Il nostro viaggio non e' ancora finito, ma volevo darle una collana perche' si ricordi quanto lontano e' arrivata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Pero... no se me da muy bien hacerlos... Lo he intentado un montón de veces y no consigo que quede bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Our journey isn't over yet, but I wanted to give her a necklace to show her how far she's come.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Pero'... non sono molto brava a farli... Ho provato un sacco di volte, ma non riesco a farli venire bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Vale, ya lo entiendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: But, um ... I'm not very good at making them ... I've tried lots of times and just can't seem to put it together right ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Ok, ora ho capito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Gracias por contármelo. En ese caso, seguro que hay algún amigo cerca que te pueda ayudar, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: I see, now I get it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Grazie per avermelo detto. In tal caso, di sicuro c'e' qualche amico nei paraggi che possa aiutarti, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: Yo me ocupo. Vamos a hacer algo muy especial para dárselo a Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Thanks for telling me all this. But if that's the case, isn't there a friend nearby who you could rely on?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Me ne occupo io. Facciamo qualcosa di molto speciale da dare a Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..src: ¡Señorita Yumia! ¡Gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..ref: Let me help with the necklace. We'll make something really special and give it to Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_240..dst: Signorina Yumia! Grazie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: Disculpa la espera, Lenja. Aquí tienes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: Sorry for the wait, Lenja. Here you go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Scusa l'attesa, Lenja. Ecco a te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: ¡Hala, qué preciosidad! Es mucho más bonito que cualquier cosa que pudiera haber hecho yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: Wow, it's stunning! So much prettier than anything I could have made ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Caspita, che meraviglia! E' molto piu' bella di qualsiasi cosa avrei potuto fare io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: Me alegro de que te guste. Espero que a Nina también.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: I'm glad you like it. Now, the question is whether Nina will or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Mi fa piacere che ti piaccia. Spero che piaccia anche a Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: She definitely will! I guarantee it!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: Eso espero. Creo que deberías ser tú quien se lo dé, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: I hope so. I think you should be the one to give it to her, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Lo spero. Penso che dovresti essere tu a darlo, Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: ¿Cómo? Pero si lo has hecho tú...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: Huh? But you're the one who made it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Cosa? Ma se l'hai fatto tu...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: No lo habría hecho si no se te hubiera ocurrido, así que deberías dárselo tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: I never would've made it if it wasn't for your idea. So you should be the one to do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Non l'avrei fatto se non ci avessi pensato tu, quindi dovresti essere tu a darlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..src: Vale. Me ocuparé de transmitirle mis... ¡bueno, nuestros sentimientos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..ref: Okay. I'll make sure to get my ... no, our feelings across!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_250..dst: Va'. Mi occupero' di trasmettergli i miei... vabbe', i nostri sentimenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Aquí estás, Nina. Ya he hablado con los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: There you are, Nina. I've already spoken to everyone else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Eccoti qui, Nina. Ho gia' parlato con gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: I see ... How did it go?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Todo el mundo ha reflexionado mucho para entender cómo se sentía en relación contigo y lo que deberíamos hacer a continuación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: Everyone took a deep look into their hearts to figure out how they feel about you and what we should do next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Tutti hanno riflettuto a lungo per capire cosa provavano nei tuoi confronti e cosa dovremmo fare ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Lo siento... He causado muchos problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: ... My apologies. I've caused so much trouble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Mi dispiace... Ho causato molti problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: Trouble? No, none of us were thinking that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Problemi? No, nessuno di noi la pensa cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Es que todos somos conscientes de la importancia que tiene todo esto, así que queríamos meditarlo lo suficiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: Everyone understands the significance of this, so we're all giving it a lot of thought.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: E' che siamo tutti consapevoli di quanto sia importante tutto questo, quindi volevamo rifletterci a sufficienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Por eso quería saber más sobre ti, Nina: para aclarar mis propios sentimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Per questo volevo saperne di piu' su di te, Nina: per fare chiarezza sui miei stessi sentimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Bueno, ¿qué me dices, Nina? ¿Te apetece hablar conmigo un ratito?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: That's why I want to know more about you, Nina. To help sort out my own feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Allora, cosa mi dici, Nina? Ti va di chiacchierare un po' con me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Claro, te has esforzado mucho por venir a hablar conmigo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: So, what do you say, Nina? Are you willing to talk with me for a little while?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Certo, ti sei impegnata tanto per venire a parlare con me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..src: Vale. Pero aquí no, vamos a buscar otro sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..ref: I see. You went out of your way to reach out ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_260..dst: Va'. Ma non qui, cerchiamo un altro posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿cómo te sentiste cuando te enteraste de que era un homúnculo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Hey, Yumia. When you first heard that I was a homunculus, how did you feel?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ehi, Yumia, cosa hai provato quando hai scoperto che ero un omuncolo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pues, si te digo la verdad, creo que al principio no lo asimilé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Honestly, I don't think the truth really hit me at first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Beh, a dire la verita', credo che all'inizio non l'abbia assimilato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Por más que me fije, no pareces distinta a mí ni a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: No matter how you look at it, you don't look any different from me or the others.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Per quanto mi guardi, non sembri diversa ne' da me ne' dagli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Me lo imaginaba. La mayoría de la gente no es capaz de diferenciar a un humano de un homúnculo a simple vista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I suppose so. Not many people can tell the difference between humans and homunculi from the outside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Me lo aspettavo. La maggior parte delle persone non e' in grado di distinguere un umano da un omuncolo a occhio nudo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Por eso he podido ocultarlo durante tanto tiempo. Supongo que debería sentirme afortunada por que la doctora me creara con tanta precisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Which is why I've managed to keep it hidden for so long. I guess I should be grateful that I was made so intricately.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Per questo sono riuscita a nasconderlo per cosi' tanto tempo. Suppongo che dovrei sentirmi fortunata che la dottoressa mi abbia creata con tanta precisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Creo que tiene que ver con el verdadero motivo por el que me creó. Para recuperar a «su Nina».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I also think that's the reason the doctor made me. To bring back her "Nina."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Credo che abbia a che fare con il vero motivo per cui mi ha creata. Per riavere "la sua Nina".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: La doctora me creó por una razón. Esa es la parte de la historia que no te he contado todavía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: There was a reason the doctor created me. That's one part of the story I haven't told you yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: La dottoressa mi ha creata per un motivo. E' la parte della storia che non ti ho ancora raccontato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: ¿Cómo? ¿No fue porque el Imperio se lo ordenó?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Huh? Wasn't it because the empire ordered her to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Cosa? Non e' stato perche' l'Impero gliel'ha ordinato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: No. La doctora Marina estaba investigando a los homúnculos y me creó...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: No. The reason Doctor Marina was researching homunculi and created me—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: No. La dottoressa Marina stava studiando gli omuncoli e mi ha creata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: ... porque quería resucitar a su hija, que murió cuando era una niña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: —was to resurrect her daughter, who died when she was just a child.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: ... perche' voleva resuscitare sua figlia, morta quando era ancora una bambina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: En realidad, «Nina» era el nombre de su hija. Me creó para llenar su hueco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: "Nina" was actually the name of her daughter. I was created to be her replacement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: In realta', "Nina" era il nome di sua figlia. Mi ha creata per riempire il suo vuoto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Incluso me trasplantaron los recuerdos de la Nina original, que la doctora almacenó justo antes de que muriera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I was even transplanted with the memories of the original Nina, which the doctor had collected just before she died.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Mi sono stati perfino trapiantati i ricordi della Nina originale, che la dottoressa aveva conservato giusto prima di morire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Cuando cierro los ojos, todavía me vienen recuerdos... Esos recuerdos tan bonitos de la doctora y de su pequeña Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: When I close my eyes, they still come to me. The beautiful memories of the doctor and her Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Quando chiudo gli occhi, mi vengono ancora alla mente ricordi... Quei ricordi cosi' belli della dottoressa e della sua piccola Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pero... no sé si los deseos de la doctora llegaron a hacerse realidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: But I ... I don't know if the doctor's wish ever really came true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ma... non so se i desideri della dottoressa si siano mai realizzati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: La Nina de mis recuerdos y la Nina en la que me he convertido... no son la misma persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: The Nina in my memories and the Nina that I've become ... they just aren't the same person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: La Nina dei miei ricordi e la Nina in cui mi sono trasformata... non sono la stessa persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Los recuerdos que tengo en el corazón y los que he experimentado yo misma siempre se han mantenido separados, sin llegar a fusionarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: The memories in my heart and the ones I've experienced myself always remained separate, never merging into one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: I ricordi che porto nel cuore e quelli che ho vissuto in prima persona sono sempre rimasti separati, senza mai fondersi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pero ¿qué Nina es la verdadera? En cuanto empiezo a pensar en ello, me pierdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: But which Nina is the real Nina? As soon as I start to think about that, I just get lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ma quale Nina e' quella vera? Appena comincio a pensarci, mi perdo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: A veces, me pregunto... si haberme creado llegó a hacerla feliz en algún momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I wonder ... I wonder if my creation ever really made the doctor happy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: A volte mi chiedo... se avermi creata l'abbia resa felice, almeno per un momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pues ya está. Ya te he contado todo lo que tenías que saber sobre mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Nina ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ecco fatto. Ti ho gia' raccontato tutto quello che dovevi sapere su di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Ahora me toca a mí preguntarte algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: That's it. Now I've truly told you everything there is to tell about me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ora tocca a me farti una domanda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Yumia, después de todo esto, ¿qué opinas de mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Now it's my turn to ask you something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Yumia, dopo tutto questo, che ne pensi di me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: ¿Crees que debería haberos contado antes mi secreto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Yumia. After hearing all this, what do you think about me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Pensi che avrei dovuto rivelarvi prima il mio segreto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Entiendo tu situación. Hay cosas de las que no siempre se puede hablar, ni siquiera con tus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Do you think that I should have revealed my secret sooner?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Capisco la tua situazione. Ci sono cose di cui non sempre si puo' parlare, nemmeno con i tuoi amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Si no me hubiera unido al equipo de investigación, puede que nunca le hubiera hablado a nadie de mi madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I think ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Se non fossi entrata nella squadra di ricerca, forse non avrei mai parlato di mia madre con nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pero Viktor, Isla y todos mis amigos me apoyaron a pesar de todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I understand your situation. There are some things you just can't talk about, even to your friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ma Viktor, Isla e tutti i miei amici mi hanno sostenuta nonostante tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Y eso me hizo muy feliz. Gracias a eso, me di cuenta de que no estaba sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: If I hadn't joined the Research Team, I might never have told anyone about my mother.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: E questo mi ha resa molto felice. Grazie a cio', ho capito di non essere sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Por eso, quiero ser un apoyo para ti, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Per questo voglio essere un sostegno per te, Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Si te digo la verdad, sí que me gustaría que nos lo hubieras contado antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: But Viktor, Isla ... all of my friends stood by me despite that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: A dirtela vera, si', mi sarebbe piaciuto che ce lo avessi raccontato prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pero no por el bien del equipo, sino por tu propio bienestar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I know how happy that made me feel. It made me realize I wasn't alone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ma non per il bene della squadra, bensi' per il tuo benessere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Conozco de primera mano lo duro que puede ser guardarse los secretos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: And that's why I want to stand by you now, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: So per esperienza diretta quanto puo' essere duro tenersi dentro i segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Podríamos haberte quitado de encima parte de ese peso entre todos..., aunque no te librases de él del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: To be honest, I do wish you had shared it with us sooner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Avremmo potuto toglierti di dosso parte di quel peso, tutti insieme..., anche se non te ne saresti liberata del tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Tienes razón, lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Not just for the sake of the team, but more importantly for your own state of mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Hai ragione, mi dispiace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: No, no tienes que pedir perdón, Nina. No te estoy echando la culpa de nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I understand the pain of keeping secrets to yourself all too well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: No, non devi chiedere scusa, Nina. Non ti sto incolpando di niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Solo estoy frustrada conmigo misma por no haber sido una persona en la que sintieras que podías confiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: We could have shared a bit of that burden ... even if not all of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Sono solo frustrata con me stessa per non essere stata una persona in cui ti fossi sentita di poter confidare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Después de llegar a Aladiss y de todo lo que pasó, estaba demasiado absorta en mis propios problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: You're right. I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Dopo l'arrivo ad Aladiss e tutto quello che e' successo, ero troppo presa dai miei problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Creo que lo que quiero decir con esto es que... la que debería disculparse soy yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: No, you don't need to be sorry, Nina. I'm not blaming you for anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Credo che quello che voglio dire sia che... quella che dovrebbe scusarsi sono io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: A partir de ahora, quiero que nuestra relación sea un espacio seguro para compartir cualquier cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I'm just frustrated with myself for not being someone you felt like you could safely rely on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: D'ora in poi, vorrei che la nostra relazione fosse uno spazio sicuro in cui condividere qualsiasi cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Gracias. Aprecio mucho tu sinceridad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: After arriving in Aladiss and everything that happened, I was too caught up in my own issues.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Grazie. Apprezzo molto la tua sincerita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: No es cuestión de sinceridad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I guess what I'm trying to say is ... I should be the one to apologize.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Non e' una questione di sincerita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Solo quería tomar por mí misma una decisión sobre lo que me parecía correcto y lo que quería hacer a continuación, para llegar a mis propias conclusiones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: From now on, I want us to build a relationship where we can feel comfortable sharing anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Volevo solo prendere da me una decisione su cio' che ritenevo giusto e su cosa fare dopo, per arrivare alle mie conclusioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Pero, después de todo lo que acabas de contarme, mis sentimientos hacia ti no han cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Thank you. You really are sincere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Ma dopo tutto quello che mi hai appena raccontato, i miei sentimenti verso di te non sono cambiati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Me da igual que seas una humana o un homúnculo. Para mí, sigues siendo Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: It's not a matter of being sincere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Non mi importa che tu sia un'umana o un omuncolo. Per me, tu rimani sempre Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Eres amable, eres un poco traviesa, te gustan las cosas adorables... y eres una buena amiga en la que siempre se puede confiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I just wanted to think for myself about what's right and what to do next, and come to my own answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Sei gentile, sei un po' monella, ti piacciono le cose adorabili... e sei una buona amica su cui si puo' sempre contare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Espero que podamos seguir siendo amigas, Nina. Estoy segura de que todo el mundo se siente igual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: But even after all you just said, my feelings towards you haven't changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Spero che possiamo continuare a essere amiche, Nina. Sono sicura che tutti la pensano allo stesso modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: ¿Y tú qué opinas, Nina? ¿Qué quieres hacer ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: It doesn't matter if you're a human or a homunculus. To me, you're still Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: E tu che ne pensi, Nina? Che cosa vuoi fare adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Eh... Pues yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: You're kind, a bit mischievous, you love cute things ... and you're a close friend who I can always rely on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Eh... Beh, io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Solo quiero que las cosas sigan como hasta ahora. Quiero quedarme contigo y los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Voglio solo che le cose continuino come finora. Voglio restare con te e con gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Perfecto. Eso es todo lo que necesitaba saber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: I hope we can continue being friends, Nina. And I'm sure everyone else feels the same.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Perfetto. Era tutto cio' che dovevo sapere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..src: Entonces, ¿a qué esperamos? Vamos a hablar con los demás para volver a ponerlo todo manos a la obra. Juntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..ref: What about you, Nina? What do you want to do now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_270..dst: Allora, che aspettiamo? Andiamo a parlare con gli altri per rimettere tutto in moto. Insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Gracias a todos por venir. Permitid que me disculpe una vez más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Thank you all for coming. First of all, I apologize once again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Grazie a tutti per essere venuti. Permettetemi di scusarmi ancora una volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Al ocultar mi secreto, traicioné vuestra confianza. No quería causar problemas, pero eso no excusa mi comportamiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: By hiding my secret, I betrayed everyone's trust. That I meant no harm does not excuse what I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Nascendo il mio segreto, ho tradito la vostra fiducia. Non volevo causare problemi, ma questo non scusa il mio comportamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Sé que no estoy en posición de exigiros un futuro en común.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: I know that I'm not in a position to think about a future with you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: So di non poter pretendere un futuro in comune con voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Pero... me encantaría seguir a vuestro lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: But I ... I still want to continue investigating together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Ma... mi piacerebbe tantissimo restare al vostro fianco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: A partir de ahora, os contaré todo lo que sé. Seguro que os servirá de ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: From here on, I'll share everything I know. I'm sure that my knowledge will be of great help to you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: D'ora in poi, vi raccontero' tutto quello che so. Sara' sicuramente d'aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Puedo hablaros de la doctora. Su historia es fundamental para conocer lo que sucedió en el centro de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Especially information about the doctor, who was deeply connected to everything that happened in central Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Posso parlarvi della dottoressa. La sua storia e' fondamentale per conoscere cio' che accadde nel centro di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Es por eso que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: So, that's why ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: E' per questo che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: No, no es verdad. Estoy basándome en falsos pretextos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: No, that's not it. I'm just making up a false pretense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: No, non e' vero. Sto nascondendomi dietro falsi pretesti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: No quiero... No, no puedo perder esto que hemos creado todos juntos. Un equipo con el que investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: I ... I just don't want to lose what I have here. Working together with everyone toward a common goal ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Non voglio... No, non posso perdere cio' che abbiamo creato tutti insieme. Una squadra con cui fare ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Es muy preciado para mí. De un valor incalculable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: It's just the most wonderful, irreplaceable thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: E' molto prezioso per me. Di un valore inestimabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Por eso, me encantaría contar con vuestra compañía. Sé que las cosas no serán como al principio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: That's why I want to stay with you all. I know not everything can be the same as before ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Per questo, mi piacerebbe tantissimo avere la vostra compagnia. So che le cose non saranno come all'inizio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Pero me da igual. Acepto las consecuencias de mis acciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: But that's fine. I'm prepared to accept whatever comes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Ma non m'importa. Accetto le conseguenze delle mie azioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Por favor, decidme qué pensáis de todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Please, let me hear your decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Vi prego, ditemi cosa pensate di tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¡Uf...! ¡Qué alegría! Es un alivio que pienses como nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Phew! I'm so glad you feel the same way we do!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Uff...! Che gioia! E' un sollievo che tu la pensi come noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Me había preparado mentalmente por si nos decías que preferías abandonar el equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Indeed. I was bracing myself in case you said you wanted to leave the team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Sono d'accordo. Mi ero preparata mentalmente nel caso ci dicessi che preferivi lasciare la squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¿Qué? ¿Aceptáis que me quede? ¿Después de todo lo que os he hecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: What? You're okay with me staying? After everything I've done?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Cosa? Accettate che resti? Dopo tutto quello che vi ho fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Si tanto te preocupa, podrías compensarnos enseñándonos un par de trucos. No se te da nada mal pelear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: If you're so worried about that, just get workin' to make up for it. Shouldn't take long with your skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Se ti preoccupa tanto, potresti sdebitarti insegnandoci qualche trucchetto. Te la cavi piuttosto bene a combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¡Ja! ¿A qué viene eso? ¿No puedes decir lo mucho que te alegras de su decisión, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Oh, someone's not being honest. Can't you just admit you're happy about this, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Ah! Ma che ti prende? Non riesci a dire quanto sei felice della sua decisione, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¿Lo ves? Ya te lo dije, Nina. Todos estamos muy contentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Shut it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Visto? Te l'avevo detto, Nina. Siamo tutti molto contenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: P-perdona, Nina, esto es para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: See, I told you, Nina. Everyone feels the same way we do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: M-mi dispiace, Nina, questo e' per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Es un obsequio de mi clan. Yumia y yo lo hemos fabricado juntas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: E' un dono del mio clan. Yumia e io l'abbiamo realizzato insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¿Para mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Um ... Nina, this is for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Este collar simboliza los retos superados. Es un recuerdo de que hemos alcanzado la madurez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: It's a necklace passed down in my clan. Yumia and I made it together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Questa collana simboleggia le sfide superate. E' il ricordo del fatto che siamo diventati adulti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Todavía nos quedan obstáculos por sortear, pero tú ya has dejado atrás muchas dificultades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: For me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Ci restano ancora ostacoli da superare, ma tu hai gia' affrontato tante difficolta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Quiero que te sirva para recordar lo lejos que has llegado y que siempre estaremos a tu lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: This is given as a sign of overcoming great challenges. A token of becoming a full-fledged adult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Voglio che ti ricordi quanta strada hai fatto e che saremo sempre al tuo fianco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Gracias... Es precioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: Our journey hasn't come to an end yet, but we know now that you've been through a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Grazie... E' bellissima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Pues ya está todo dicho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: I hope this reminds you of how far you've come, and that we'll always be there to help you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Bene, direi che e' tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Vale, volvamos a nuestra misión. Quiero hablaros de unas ideas que he estado pensando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: ... Thank you. I love it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Va bene, torniamo alla nostra missione. Vorrei parlarvi di alcune idee a cui stavo pensando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Como ya he dicho, pasé varios años con la doctora Marina en un laboratorio de Lignumbria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: I suppose this settles things then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Come ho gia' detto, ho passato diversi anni con la Dottoressa Marina in un laboratorio di Lignumbria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Cuando volví a Aladiss, estuve revisando toda la zona por mi cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: All right, getting back to our main mission, allow me to share some of the ideas I have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Quando sono tornata ad Aladiss, ho esplorato tutta la zona per conto mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Pero creo que quedan cosas ocultas. Tal vez los materiales que investigaba la doctora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: As I mentioned, I spent several years with Doctor Marina at a research lab in Ligneus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Ma credo che ci siano ancora cose nascoste. Forse i materiali che studiava la Dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: ¡Me encantaría ver algo así! ¡Salgamos cuanto antes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: After returning to Aladiss, I searched most of the place myself ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Mi piacerebbe tantissimo vedere una cosa del genere! Andiamo subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..src: Venga, en marcha. Las ruinas del laboratorio están ocultas en lo más profundo del bosque.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..ref: But I believe there's still something hidden there. Perhaps some research materials left by the doctor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_280..dst: Forza, in marcia. Le rovine del laboratorio sono nascoste nel profondo della foresta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: Sí. Aquí es donde vivía con la doctora Marina y los demás. Era mi hogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: Yes, it is. This is where I lived with Doctor Marina and the others. It was my home.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: Si'. Qui vivevo con la Dottoressa Marina e gli altri. Era casa mia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: Los árboles han invadido la zona. Ya no es el hogar que yo recuerdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: Though it's been completely engulfed by the trees now, so it doesn't feel that way anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: Gli alberi hanno invaso la zona. Ormai non sembra piu' casa mia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: Si os soy sincera... apenas lo reconozco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: A essere sincera... a malapena lo riconosco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: So, what're we doin' here, Alchemist?
Let's split up and investigate the area.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: (Si la doctora dejó alguna información, daremos con ella.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: (If any information was left behind by Doctor Marina, we have to find it.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: (Se la Dottoressa Marina ha lasciato qualche informazione, dobbiamo trovarla.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: Say, Yumia, do you think that you can fix this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: Ehi, Yumia. Credi di poter aggiustare questa porta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: Aquí detrás debería haber una habitación, pero no puedo pasar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: There should be a room past here, but I can't get in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: Qui dietro dovrebbe esserci una stanza, ma non riesco a entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..src: Creo que sí. He aprendido mucho desde que empezamos esta aventura, esto será pan comido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..ref: I think so. With everything I've learned, this shouldn't be too hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_290..dst: Credo di si'. Con tutto quello che ho imparato, non dovrebbe essere difficile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..src: Tan resolutiva como siempre. Me alegro de que estés de mi parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..ref: Impressive as always. I'm so glad you're here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..dst: Come sempre, sei incredibile. Mi fa piacere averti dalla mia parte.
Non e' stato niente di speciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..src: Entremos. Puede que ahí esté lo que andamos buscando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..ref: Let's head inside. There might be something left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_300..dst: Entriamo. Potrebbe esserci quello che cerchiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..src: La verdad es que pensaba que encontraríamos algo de utilidad, pero no vamos por buen camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: I was hoping that we might find something in here, but this isn't looking promising.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..dst: Speravo che qui dentro avremmo trovato qualcosa, ma non promette bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..src: Si alguien quisiera dejar información importante, lo haría de un modo que soportara el paso del tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: If it was important information, it would probably be stored in a way that would last a long time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..dst: Se fosse un'informazione importante, probabilmente sarebbe stata conservata in modo da durare a lungo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..src: Claro. Después de todo, el papel se deteriora si no se guarda con cuidado. Yo usaría un contenedor resistente, como un Vial de recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: After all, paper deteriorates if it's not looked after. I think it would be stored in something like a Memory Vial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..dst: Dopotutto, la carta si deteriora se non viene custodita con cura. Penso che la conserverebbero in qualcosa come una Fiala della Memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..src: Saquemos todo lo que parezca valioso. Quizás, una vez seco, podamos recuperar algo interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: Let's bring up anything that stands out for now. We may be able to recover something from inside once it's dry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..dst: Per ora portiamo via tutto cio' che sembra interessante. Una volta asciutto, forse riusciremo a recuperare qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..src: Eh, mercenaria. Es un buen momento para que arrimes el hombro, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: Hey, Mercenary. You should be workin' harder than anyone else here, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..dst: Ehi, mercenaria. Dovresti darti da fare piu' di chiunque altro qui, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_310..ref: You're right. Let's get to it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Nina, esto es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Nina, isn't this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Nina, questo e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Un Vial de recuerdos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: A Memory Vial!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Una Fiala della Memoria!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Se tomaron muchas molestias para esconderlo. Debe de ser importante. ¡Por fin una pista!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: It was stored in such a secure way, it has to be important. This must be it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Si sono dati un gran da fare per nasconderla. Dev'essere importante. Finalmente un indizio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Vaya, vaya. Creo que habéis dado en el clavo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Why, yes. I believe you are correct.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Ma guarda un po'. Direi che avete fatto centro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Fue la mismísima doctora Marina quien lo dejó!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: It was left behind by the genius Doctor Marina, after all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: E' stata la Dottoressa Marina in persona a lasciarla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: El equipo de investigación es espléndido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: The Research Team truly is splendid.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: La Squadra di Ricerca e' fantastica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Otra vez tú!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: You again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Ancora tu!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¿N-nos estás s-siguiendo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: D-did you follow us here again?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: C-ci stai s-seguendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Y tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Besides, this land belongs to our empire. You have no say in what we do or where we do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Certo che si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Además, esta tierra pertenece al Imperio. No sois nadie para decir qué podemos o no podemos hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: That doesn't give you the right to stalk us, you creep!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Inoltre, questa terra appartiene all'Impero. Non siete nessuno per dirci cosa possiamo o non possiamo fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Eso no te da derecho a espiarnos, bicho raro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Creep?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Questo non ti da' il diritto di spiarci, strambo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¿Bicho raro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Creep?! Me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Strambo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡¿Bicho raro?! ¿¡YO!?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Haha, hahaha ... HAHAHAHA!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Strambo?! Io?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Ja, ja, ja... Ja, ja, ja, ja, ja. ¡JA, JA, JA, JA!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: I am a seeker of truth! Perhaps I am a creep, but you know what? It matters not!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Ah, ah, ah... Ah, ah, ah, ah, ah. AH, AH, AH, AH!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Yo soy un buscador de la verdad! Puede que eso me convierta en un bicho raro, pero ¿sabéis qué? ¡No me importa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: No matter what you fools have to say ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Sono un cercatore di verita'! Forse questo mi rende uno strambo, ma sapete una cosa? Non me ne importa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Vuestra opinión me importa un comino...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Nothing shall cloud my way forward!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: La vostra opinione non mi importa un bel niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Nada me detendrá!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Ngh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Niente potra' fermarmi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Complacency is the enemy. You should always keep a firm grip on what matters most.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: El exceso de confianza es un grave defecto. Deberíais sujetar con mano firme vuestras posesiones más importantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: I must say, I never expected that woman to flee to such a remote area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: L'eccessiva sicurezza e' un grave difetto. Dovreste tenere ben stretti i vostri beni piu' preziosi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Debo decir que no esperaba que esa mujer huyera a un lugar tan recóndito...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: ... Damn you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Devo dire che non mi aspettavo che quella donna fuggisse in un luogo cosi' remoto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Maldito seas!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Give it back!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Maledetto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Devuélvenoslo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: We can't let you have that. Hand it over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Restituiscicelo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Eso no es tuyo. Devuélvelo. ¡Ahora!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: I'll take a closer look at this a little later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Non e' tuo. Restituiscilo. Subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Lo estudiaré con detenimiento más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: In this day and age where alchemy has all but perished, you have enough innate ability for it to be labeled heresy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: La esaminero' con attenzione piu' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: En estos días en los que la alquimia ha sido relegada al pasado, posees la habilidad suficiente para que te tachen de hereje.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: I ponder just how much you can really achieve.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: In questi tempi in cui l'alchimia e' stata relegata al passato, hai talento a sufficienza da farti bollare come eretica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: Me gustaría saber hasta dónde serás capaz de llegar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Well then, I must take my leave. We shall meet again soon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Vorrei sapere fin dove riuscirai ad arrivare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: En fin. Me marcho. Hasta que nos volvamos a ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Pergrica Turm, was it? Show me your true power atop that tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Comunque, me ne vado. Alla prossima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¿Turm Pérgrica era? Llega hasta la copa del árbol y muéstrame tu verdadero poder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: Damn him!!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Turm Pe'rgrica, era? Raggiungi la cima dell'albero e mostrami il tuo vero potere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¡Odio a ese tipo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: I never thought you would find information that even we had not yet come by.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Odio quel tipo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: ¿Quién habría dicho que daríais con algo que nosotros hemos pasado por alto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..ref: The modern day alchemist has been quite fascinating to watch.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Chi l'avrebbe mai detto che avreste trovato qualcosa che a noi era sfuggito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..src: No puedo apartar la vista de esta alquimista moderna. Es cautivadora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_320..dst: Non riesco a staccare gli occhi da questa alchimista moderna. E' affascinante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¡Maldición! ¿Quién se ha creído que es? ¡No deja de meter sus narices en nuestros asuntos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Dammit! Who the hell does he think he is? Always gettin' in our way!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Maledizione! Chi si crede di essere? Non smette mai di ficcare il naso nei nostri affari!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Q-qué pesado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: H-he's very persistent ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: C-che seccatore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Nos ha dejado explorar sin quitarnos el ojo de encima. Y sé por qué lo ha hecho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: He's been letting us run around while he monitored us. And his goal is likely ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Ci ha lasciati esplorare tenendoci d'occhio. E so perche' l'ha fatto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Para arrebatarnos nuestros descubrimientos y usarlos en ese plan suyo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: To piggyback on our investigation to further his "plan" or whatever, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Per rubare le nostre scoperte e usarle per quel suo piano, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Creo que iba tras el rastro de la doctora Marina desde un principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: ... I think he's been searching for clues about Doctor Marina from the start.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Credo che stesse seguendo le tracce della Dottoressa Marina fin dall'inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Habrá pensado que Nina o el equipo de investigación le harían todo el trabajo sucio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: He probably thought if he followed Nina—followed the Research Team—he'd find what he was looking for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Avra' pensato che Nina o la Squadra di Ricerca gli avrebbero fatto tutto il lavoro sporco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Y mostró interés en mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: He also seems interested in me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: E ha mostrato interesse per me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¿Y vamos a dejar que nos trate como idiotas? ¡No pienso quedarme de brazos cruzados!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: We just gonna keep lettin' ourselves get played like chumps? No way I'm standin' for this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: E dovremmo lasciare che ci tratti da idioti? Non ho nessuna intenzione di restare a guardare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Yo tampoco. Hay que recuperar el Vial de recuerdos de la doctora Marina. ¡No podemos renunciar a una pista tan importante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Agreed. We have to get the doctor's Memory Vial back. It's probably the biggest lead we've ever had!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Nemmeno io. Dobbiamo recuperare la Fiala della Memoria della Dottoressa Marina. Non possiamo rinunciare a un indizio cosi' importante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¡E-estoy contigo! ¿Qué di-dijo al final?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: I-I agree! But where did he say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: S-si', sono d'accordo! Ma cosa ha d-detto alla fine?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Algo de Turm Pérgrica. Pero, si nos ha dicho a dónde se dirige, solo puede significar que está preparando una trampa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Pergrica Turm? The fact that he gave us his location makes me think it might be a trap ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Turm Pe'rgrica o qualcosa del genere. Ma se ci ha detto dove sta andando, significa solo che sta preparando una trappola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Tienes razón. No me sorprendería que se haya aliado con otros mutantes y nos tiendan una emboscada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: ... That's true. I wouldn't be surprised if he's teamed up with other mutants, waiting to ambush us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Hai ragione. Non mi sorprenderebbe che si sia alleato con altri mutanti per tenderci un'imboscata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Puede que con Vésper y Lili Borea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Maybe even Vesper and Lili Borea ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Forse anche con Vesper e Lili Borea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Sí, pero es lo único que tenemos. No nos queda otra que apretar los dientes e ir a por todas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Yeah, but we've got nothin' else to go on. I don't see any option but to just brace ourselves and charge in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Si', ma e' tutto cio' che abbiamo. Non ci resta che stringere i denti e lanciarici a capofitto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Cierto. Dijo que nos estaría esperando... Quizás tengamos tiempo para prepararnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Yeah. He said he'd be waiting for us, so we should have time to prepare, but even so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Vero. Ha detto che ci avrebbe aspettato... Forse avremo tempo per prepararci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: En cualquier caso, no podemos quedarnos aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: In any case, we definitely can't just give up here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: In ogni caso, non possiamo mica arrenderci qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Hay que averiguar qué está tramando. Necesitamos conocer sus verdaderas intenciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: We need to figure out what he's plotting. What his true intentions are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Dobbiamo scoprire cosa sta tramando. Dobbiamo conoscere le sue vere intenzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Todos vinimos aquí en busca de la verdad. No tengo intención de huir con el rabo entre las piernas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: We came here to learn the truth, and I have no intention of running with my tail between my legs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Siamo venuti qui in cerca della verita'. Non ho intenzione di fuggire con la coda tra le gambe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Eso. Quedarnos de brazos cruzados está descartado, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Yeah. Nothing will happen if we don't try to learn, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Esatto. Restare con le mani in mano e' escluso, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: No podemos dejar que Corleonis se salga con la suya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: We can't just leave Corleonis to his own devices.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Non possiamo lasciare che Corleonis la faccia franca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Mientras siga en Aladiss, la verdad seguirá siendo un misterio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: As long as he's in Aladiss, we'll never be able to grasp the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Finche' restera' ad Aladiss, la verita' rimarra' un mistero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Ya, pienso lo mismo. Me niego a permitir que haga y deshaga a su antojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Yes, I feel the same way. I refuse to just let him have his way anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Si', la penso anch'io. Mi rifiuto di lasciare che faccia e disfaccia a suo piacimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¡Por fin vamos a bajarle los humos a ese payaso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: So we finally get to take that clown down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Finalmente metteremo a tacere quel pagliaccio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¡Sí! ¡Vamos a...! Un momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Yeah! Time to—Wait a second ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Si'! E' l'ora di...! Un attimo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Dijo algo de Turm no sé qué, ¿no? ¿Alguien sabe cómo llegar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: He said the top of Pergri—whatever it's called—right? How do we get there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Ha detto qualcosa di Turm non ricordo cosa, no? Qualcuno sa come arrivare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Bien pensado. Es imposible trepar a ese árbol gigantesco...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Good point. We don't have any way to climb that giant tree ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Ha ragione. Non abbiamo modo di arrampicarci su quell'albero gigantesco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Si dijo que nos vería allí, debe de haber alguna forma de subir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: He told us to meet him there, so that means there's some way to reach the top, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Se ha detto che ci avrebbe incontrati li', vuol dire che c'e' un modo per raggiungere la cima, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¿Qué dices tú, mercenaria?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: You know anythin', Mercenary?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Tu che ne dici, mercenaria?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Tal y como dijo Flammi, el árbol de metal no existía en aquellos tiempos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Just as Flammi said before, that metal tree never existed in the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Come ha detto Flammi, quell'albero di metallo non esisteva in passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: No recuerdo nada parecido en la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: I don't remember ever seeing anything like that in the area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Non ricordo niente del genere in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Ha pasado mucho tiempo. Es normal que el paisaje haya cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: A very long time has passed. It's only natural that things have changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: E' passato molto tempo. E' naturale che le cose siano cambiate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Así que... En otras palabras, no hay modo de subir a la copa, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: So, um ... In other words, we don't have a way to reach the top?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Quindi... In altre parole, non c'e' modo di raggiungere la cima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: No tiene por qué ser así. Es pronto para rendirse. No sin antes ir a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Not necessarily. It's too early to give up. We might find something if we look into it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Non e' detto. E' presto per arrendersi. Potremmo trovare qualcosa facendo qualche ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Puede que en la estación haya información sobre el terreno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: There might still be some information about the geography of the area at the station.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Alla stazione potrebbero esserci ancora informazioni sulla geografia della zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: ¿Dices en la estación Ramus Radix?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Ramus Radix Station, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Intendi la stazione Ramus Radix?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..src: Ese es nuestro destino por ahora. Seguro que encontramos algo útil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..ref: Let's head there for now. I'm sure we'll find something to work with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_330..dst: Per ora, andiamo li'. Sono sicura che troveremo qualcosa di utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Aquí está. Es lo que estaba buscando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: Here it is. This is what I was looking for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Eccolo. E' proprio quello che cercavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Está muy deteriorado... No sé si Flammi podrá sacar algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: It seems pretty worn down. I wonder if Flammi can make anything of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: E' molto rovinato... Chissa' se Flammi riuscira' a ricavarne qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: La información que contiene está estructurada de forma similar a un Vial de recuerdos. Flammi puede leerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: It appears to have an information structure similar to a Memory Vial. Flammi has the ability to read it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Sembra contenere informazioni strutturate in modo simile a una Fiala della Memoria. Flammi e' in grado di leggerle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Hubo un derrumbe subterráneo importante alrededor de Turm Pérgrica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: It appears there was a major underground collapse that occurred around Pergrica Turm.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: C'e' stato un grosso crollo sotterraneo nei pressi del Turm Pergrica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: El árbol quedó al descubierto, porque las instalaciones de alrededor se derrumbaron. Es lo que queda del pozo central que se usaba para un ascensor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: That tree was laid bare due to the collapse of the surrounding underground facilities. It's the remains of a central shaft meant for an elevator.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: L'albero e' rimasto allo scoperto perche' le strutture circostanti sono crollate. E' cio' che resta del pozzo centrale usato per l'ascensore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: En otras palabras, la zona que rodea Turm Pérgrica estaba bajo tierra y la copa del árbol, a nivel del suelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: In other words, the area around Pergrica Turm was originally underground, and the top of the tree was at ground level.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: In altre parole, la zona intorno al Turm Pergrica era sotterranea e la cima dell'albero si trovava al livello del suolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Y todo lo de alrededor se vino abajo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: E tutto cio' che gli stava intorno e' crollato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Por eso el paisaje es totalmente distinto a como yo lo recordaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: So that's why the terrain looked completely different from how I remembered.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Ecco perche' il paesaggio e' cosi' diverso da come lo ricordavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: W-wow! How did you manage to figure that out, Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: I-incredibile! Come hai fatto a capirlo, Flammi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Eso no es nada para una asistente autómata especializada en investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: This is nothing for a super-high-spec independent survey assistant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Per un'assistente autonoma per rilevamenti dalle specifiche elevatissime non e' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Si el árbol es el pozo de un ascensor, habrá un camino que nos conduzca hasta él, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: If that tree is the central shaft for an elevator, there must be a path leading to it, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Se l'albero e' il pozzo centrale di un ascensore, ci sara' un passaggio che porta fin li', no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Flammi, ¿detectas un camino que podamos seguir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: Flammi, can you find a path that still seems usable?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Flammi, riesci a individuare un passaggio ancora percorribile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: You really are a genius today, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Oggi sei proprio un genio, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..src: Te equivocas, Yumia. Mi talento no es inspiración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..ref: You made a mistake while saying, "Always a genius," Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_340..dst: Ti sbagli, Yumia. Il mio talento non dipende dall'ispirazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Bueno, hemos llegado. Pero me temo que no podemos sortear este obstáculo, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: Well, we're here, but I don't think we can get through this, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Be', siamo arrivati, ma non credo che riusciremo a passare, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Los cálculos de Flammi son correctos. Este camino está en mejores condiciones que los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: All other paths have completely collapsed. Flammi thinks that this path is in comparatively better condition.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: I calcoli di Flammi sono corretti. Questo passaggio e' in condizioni relativamente migliori degli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: ¿En serio? Pues si esto es lo mejor, hasta aquí hemos llegado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: Huh? If this is the best we've got, we ain't gettin' in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Davvero? Se questo e' il meglio che abbiamo, non passeremo mai.
