eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Bueno, es mejor que trepar al árbol. Vamos a intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: It's got to be easier than climbing the outside of the tree. Let's give it a try.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Be', e' meglio che arrampicarsi sull'albero. Proviamoci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: ¡Por fin! Desde aquí será un paseo llegar a nuestro destino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: There we go! Looks like we can make it through.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Ecco fatto! Sembra che riusciremo a passare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Nunca habría apostado a que lograríamos entrar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: Never thought we'd actually get inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Non avrei mai pensato che saremmo davvero riusciti a entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Sigamos adelante. El pozo y el ascensor no deben de estar muy lejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: Let's stick to the path. We should find the central shaft and the elevator somewhere ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Proseguiamo. Il pozzo e l'ascensore non dovrebbero essere molto lontani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..src: Ese ascensor fue construido por la civilización pasada, ¿no? ¿No os preocupa que haya dejado de funcionar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..ref: An elevator made by the past civilization, huh? Fingers crossed it still moves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_350..dst: Questo ascensore e' stato costruito dall'antica civilta', vero? Speriamo che funzioni ancora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: El que vimos en la región de Syvashi era enorme, pero esto es otro nivel...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: The elevator in the Sivash region was huge, but this is on a whole new level ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Quello che abbiamo visto nella regione di Syvashi era enorme, ma questo e' tutta un'altra cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: Con esto podemos llegar arriba del todo. Bueno, si funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: If we ride this, it should take us right to the top, assuming it still works.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Con questo dovremmo arrivare in cima. Sempre che funzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: ¿Acaso te has olvidado del puente levadizo de la Vía Idealis? Seguro que aquí también llega la corriente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: True, but remember the drawbridge at Via Idea. There's a good chance the power will be out here too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Ti sei dimenticata del ponte levatoio di Via Idealis? E' molto probabile che anche qui manchi la corrente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: Dadme un momento. Veré lo que puedo hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: Give me a second. I'll see what I can figure out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Aspettate un momento. Vedro' cosa riesco a capire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: ¡Hay energía! Y oigo algo que se mueve en el interior. Sin duda, funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: Looks like we still have power. I can hear something moving inside, so the device also seems to be working.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: C'e' corrente! E sento qualcosa muoversi all'interno. A quanto pare, funziona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: Eeeh? A-are you sure this is safe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Eh...? S-siete sicuri che sia sicuro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: Solo hay una forma de averiguarlo. Aunque, si tienes una idea mejor, te escucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: Only one way to find out. Not like we have other options.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: C'e' un solo modo per scoprirlo. Non e' che abbiamo altre opzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..src: No hacemos nada aquí paralizados por el miedo. ¿Dónde está vuestro espíritu aventurero?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..ref: Sitting here scared isn't going to get us any further. We have to just go for it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_360..dst: Restare qui paralizzati dalla paura non ci portera' da nessuna parte. Dobbiamo buttarci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..src: E-espero que la s-señorita Yumia esté bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..ref: Oh, I hope Miss Yumia is okay ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..dst: S-spero che la Signorina Yumia stia bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..src: Es verdad. Tiene que estar bien. Eso quiero pensar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..ref: Right. No matter what, she'll be okay. No matter what ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..dst: Gia'. Andra' tutto bene, qualunque cosa accada. Andra' tutto bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..src: Nuestra prioridad ahora es dar con ella lo antes posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..ref: Anyway, our top priority should be to find her as soon as possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..dst: Comunque, la nostra priorita' e' trovarla il prima possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..ref: Let's search for a way down.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..src: En estos ascensores siempre construían escaleras de mantenimiento y de emergencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..ref: Elevators like this often have maintenance ladders or emergency stairs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_370..dst: Ascensori come questo spesso hanno scale di manutenzione o scale di emergenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Ugh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Dove sono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Where is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Non vedo niente. Flammi, ci sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: It's so dark. Flammi, are you there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Dove sono gli altri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Where is everyone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Viktor! Isla! Rutger!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Viktor! Isla! Rutger!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Nina! Lenja! C'e' qualcuno che mi sente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Nina! Lenja! Anyone! Is anyone there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Dove... sono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Where am I?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: -ia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: ——ia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Chi sei? Dove ti trovi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Who's there?! Is someone here?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: --ia, star--- be ---.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: ¿Me está hablando a mí? Esa voz...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Stai parlando con me? Quella voce...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Is someone calling out to me? Whose voice is that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Giudi- - da te stessa - - - cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: ¡No te oigo! ¡No sé qué me quieres decir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Figure ———  ——self. ———?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Non ti sento! Non capisco cosa vuoi dirmi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: I don't understand! I don't know what you're saying!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: - piangere. Prometto - saro' sempr- al tuo fianco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: ———, ——— cry. ——— promise, ——— always ———.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: - dispiace. - ti vogli-, Yu-.
Chi sei? Fermatiii!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: What is this voice?! Stop it!!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Sono... nell'Atelier?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Buenos días, Yumia. Espero que hayas descansado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: The ... atelier?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Buongiorno, Yumia. Spero che tu abbia riposato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Good morning, Yumia. It's good that you seem to have had a good rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Flammi? Io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Flammi, I ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Mmss... Yumia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Nngh... Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Yumia!?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: ¡Por fin te has despertado! Estaba tan preocupada... ¡Chica, parecía que no te ibas a despertar nunca!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Yumia?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Ti sei finalmente svegliata! Ero cosi' preoccupata... Ragazza, sembrava che non ti saresti mai svegliata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Perdona, no es momento de llorar. ¡Voy a avisar a los demás!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: I'm so glad you're finally awake! I was so worried you were just going to lie there forever!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Scusa, non e' il momento di piangere. Vado ad avvisare gli altri!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Isla ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Signorina Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Lo siento. No quería preocuparos a todos. Estoy bien. No me duele nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Sorry, no time for tears. I'm gonna go get the others!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Mi dispiace. Non volevo farvi preoccupare. Sto bene. Non mi fa male niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: ¿Seguro? Te caíste del árbol y llevas una semana inconsciente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Miss Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Sicura? Sei caduta dall'albero e sei rimasta priva di sensi per una settimana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Sorry, I guess I worried you all. I'm fine now. Not even sore anywhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: U-una settimana? Ma e' tantissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Are you certain? You fell from the tree and have been out for seven days straight!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Cos'e' successo dopo la mia caduta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: (Por lo visto, cuando me caí, aquel tipo se echó las manos a la cabeza y desapareció.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: S-seven days?! That long?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: (A quanto pare, quando sono caduta, quel tipo si e' messo le mani nei capelli ed e' sparito.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: What happened after I fell?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: (Corleonis ha visto tutto e ha detto:)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: («Si la chica vive, decidle que regrese aquí».)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: (Apparently, after I fell, the thin man clutched his head and vanished.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: ("Se la ragazza e' viva, ditele di tornare qui".)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: (When Corleonis saw that, he stood down and said,)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: (E poi se n'e' andato anche lui.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Después de todo lo que había pasado, no sabíamos qué pensar. Volvimos rápidamente a bajar en el ascensor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: ("If the girl lives, have her return to this place.")
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Dopo tutto quello che era successo, non sapevamo cosa pensare. Siamo tornati giu' in fretta con l'ascensore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Y vimos a los Geni sacándote del lago. Ahí acaba la historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: (Then he too vanished into thin air.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: E abbiamo visto i Geni tirarti fuori dal lago. La storia finisce qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: After that, we didn't really know what was going on, but when we rushed back down with the elevator ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Come...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: No le des más vueltas por ahora. Estamos felices de que hayas regresado y eso es lo más importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: We found the Geni were already pulling you out of the lake, and that's where the story ends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Per ora non pensarci. Siamo felici che tu sia tornata, ed e' questo che conta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Me sorprende que no acabaras hecha papilla tras semejante caída. Qué cosas tiene la energía, ¿eh, alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: How did all that happen ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Mi sorprende che tu non sia diventata una poltiglia dopo una caduta del genere. L'energia e' proprio incredibile, eh, alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: (No lo recuerdo, pero tal vez actuara por instinto.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: You don't need to think about that for now. Let's just be glad you're all right, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: (Non ricordo, ma forse ho agito d'istinto.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: ¿Tanto te costaría decir «Yumia, me alegro de que estés bien» como una persona normal? ¡Sé que estabas preocupado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Still, hard to believe you're uninjured after fallin' from that height, even if it was into water. Energy really is ridiculous, ain't it, Alchemist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Ti costa tanto dire "Yumia, sono felice che tu stia bene" come farebbe una persona normale? So che eri preoccupato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: ( ... I don't remember much, but I guess I must have acted instinctively.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Cosa? Non volevo che l'indagine...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Ya, ya. Te tenemos calado, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Can't you just say, "I'm glad you're okay," like the rest of us? You were just as worried!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Si', si'. Ti conosciamo bene, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Dices que no sientes dolor, pero ¿notas algo diferente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Huh? I just didn't want our investigation to be interrup—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Dici che non senti dolore, ma noti qualcosa di diverso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: No, la verdad. Aunque, si tuviera que destacar algo, estoy un poco... confusa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Yeah, yeah, we all know exactly what kind of person you are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Non direi. Pero', se proprio devo dire qualcosa, mi sento un po'... confusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Es normal. Llevas una semana durmiendo y no has probado bocado. Es por eso, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: You said you're uninjured, but does anything else feel off?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: E' normale. Hai dormito per una settimana e non hai mangiato un boccone. Sara' per questo, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Hmm, not really. If I had to say something, I guess my mind's feeling a little bit hazy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: A dirla tutta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Ja, ja, ja, tu estómago ha respondido a la pregunta. Espera, te prepararé algo rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Of course it is. You've been sleeping for a whole week, and you haven't eaten anything the entire time ... right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Ah, ah, ah! Il tuo stomaco ha risposto alla domanda. Aspetta, ti preparo qualcosa al volo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Ah, now that you mention it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Ah! E dobbiamo avvisare il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Está en la base de Lignumbria, ¿no? Le avisaremos para que venga mientras Isla prepara la comida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Haha, your stomach just realized too. Hang on, I'll whip something up right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: E' alla base di Lignumbria, vero? Lo avvisiamo di venire mentre Isla prepara da mangiare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Oh, we need to inform the chief, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: (La base?...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: He's at the Ligneus survey base, right? We'll go call him while Isla is preparing the food.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Signorina Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Oh... perdón, no es nada. ¡Estoy bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: (Survey ...?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Oh... scusate, non e' niente. Sto bene!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..src: Si vais a la base, me gustaría acompañaros. Me vendría bien dar un paseo para comprobar que no me pasa nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..ref: Um, Miss Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_010..dst: Se andate alla base, vorrei venire con voi. Mi farebbe bene fare due passi e controllare che sia tutto a posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¡Te has despertado, Yumia! ¿Crees que ha sido buena idea venir hasta aquí andando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: You're awake, Yumia. Should you already be walking around like this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Ti sei svegliata, Yumia! Sei sicura che sia stata una buona idea venire fin qui a piedi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Sí, estoy bien. No sé cómo, pero me las apañé para salir ilesa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Yes, I think I'm good. I managed to come out of it without a scratch.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Si', sto bene. Non so come, ma sono riuscita a cavarmela senza ferite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Todos éramos conscientes de los peligros que entrañaba nuestra misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: We all knew these investigations would be fraught with danger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Eravamo tutti consapevoli dei pericoli della nostra missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: En otra situación, os diría «buen trabajo» y «descansar es también vuestra obligación».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I should probably be saying, "Well done," and, "Be sure to rest up more."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: In un'altra situazione, vi direi "bel lavoro" e "anche riposarsi e' un vostro dovere".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Pero, aunque me sabe muy mal, la verdad es que debo pediros un favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: But unfortunately, as cold as it may seem, there's one thing I need to ask you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Pero', anche se mi dispiace molto, devo chiedervi un favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¿Podéis reanudar la investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Can you return to the investigation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Potete riprendere le ricerche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: No sé si me he recuperado del todo, pero ahora eso no importa. Quiero retomar el trabajo. Aunque...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I may not be in perfect condition, but I think I'm well enough to continue. Probably ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Non so se mi sono ripresa del tutto, ma ora non importa. Voglio tornare al lavoro. Anche se...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: No has sonado muy convencida. ¿Dónde está la Yumia animada que conocíamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: That's not very convincing. Where's that spirit you had back when you started?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Non sembravi molto convinta. Dov'e' finita la Yumia piena di energia che conosciamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Lo siento, últimamente no me siento yo misma del todo. Será porque acabo de despertarme...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I'm sorry, I'm not quite feeling like my usual self yet. Maybe because I just woke up ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Mi dispiace, ultimamente non mi sento proprio me stessa. Sara' perche' mi sono appena svegliata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¡Señorita Yumia!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: U-um, Miss Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Signorina Yumia!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Hay una cosa q-que quería comentarte. ¿Puedo ver tu mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: There's something that's been bothering me. Could you let me see your hand?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: C'e' una cosa che v-volevo dirti. Posso vedere la tua mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¿Mi mano? Sí, claro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: My hand? Ah, sure ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: La mia mano? Si', certo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Algo no va bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: C'e' qualcosa che non va.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¿El qué? ¿Qué pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Something's wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Cosa? Che succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Tu maná es distinto. No sabría explicarlo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Wrong? What is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Il tuo mana e' diverso. Non saprei spiegarlo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Creo que esa es la causa de tu confusión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Your mana feels different. I can't really explain it, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Credo che sia questa la causa della tua confusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Lo siento, es todo lo que puedo decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Maybe it's related to why your mind is still hazy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Mi dispiace, e' tutto quello che so dirti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¿Ya está? Eso es como no decir nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I'm sorry, but that's all I can really say ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Tutto qui? E' come non aver detto niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¡L-lo siento! Es que... ¡Ah! ¡S-se me ha ocurrido algo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Huh? You basically said a whole bunch of nothin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: M-mi dispiace! E' che... Ah! M-mi e' venuta un'idea!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Podríamos preguntarle a Cledia. Sabe más que una Welleks común sobre estos temas y podrá decirte más que yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: I-I'm sorry. Oh, um ... I know!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Potremmo chiedere a Cledia. Su queste cose ne sa piu' di una Welleks comune e sapra' dirti piu' di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Pues dejémonos de chácharas y pongámonos en marcha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: If we ask a talented Welleks like Cledia, she might be able to tell you more!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Allora basta chiacchiere, mettiamoci in marcia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Estáis exagerando. Estoy bien, no tenéis que preocuparos tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Then let's stop beatin' around the bush and go do that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: State esagerando. Sto bene, non c'e' bisogno che vi preoccupiate cosi' tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: No, tienen razón. Voy a hacer uso de mi autoridad como jefe y os ordeno ir a ver a Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: You're overreacting. I feel fine, you don't need to worry about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: No, hanno ragione. In qualita' di capo, vi ordino di andare da Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Ah... Si insistís, iré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: No, I disagree. I'm going to use my authority as chief here. Go see Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Ah... Se insistete, andro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: Vale. Vamos a verla. Es verdad que noto algo... extraño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: *Sigh* I guess if you're that insistent, I'll go ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Va bene. Andiamo da lei. In effetti, sento qualcosa di... strano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: ¡Pues ya tenéis un destino! Dejad a un lado la investigación e id a ver a Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: ... Yeah, let's go see her. Something does feel off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Avete una meta, allora! Lasciate perdere le ricerche e andate da Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..src: En nuestro trabajo, siempre hay tiempo para el esfuerzo personal. Pero a veces lo mejor es ser paciente y resolver las preocupaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..ref: Sounds like a plan. Forget the investigation for a second and go see Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_020..dst: Nel nostro lavoro c'e' sempre tempo per impegnarsi a livello personale. Ma a volte la cosa migliore e' avere pazienza e risolvere le proprie preoccupazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Qué os trae por aquí? Y con unas miradas tan serias...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Oh, what brings you all here? You look unusually serious as well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Cosa vi porta qui? E perche' avete quelle facce cosi' serie...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Verás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Well, you see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Vedi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Ya veo. Sí, percibí que algo en ti había cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I see. I did think you felt a bit different from before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Capisco. Si', avevo notato che qualcosa in te era cambiato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Se pondrá bien la señorita Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Is Miss Yumia going to be okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: La Signorina Yumia si rimettera'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: No me aventuraré a decir nada sin examinarla. Yumia, ¿me dejas ver tu mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I can't say for certain without examining her. Yumia, could you hold out your hand?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Non mi sbilancio senza prima averla visitata. Yumia, posso vedere la tua mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Sí, claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Oh, this looks like ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Si', certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Yumia, I'm going to get straight to the point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Oh!... Ma questo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Yumia, no me voy a andar con rodeos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Since your fall, do you feel like you've forgotten something important?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Yumia, non girero' intorno alla questione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Desde tu caída, ¿has tenido la sensación de haber olvidado algo importante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Something important?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Da quando sei caduta, hai avuto la sensazione di aver dimenticato qualcosa di importante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Algo importante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Alchemy is the manipulation of mana. And mana is a force spun from life's memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Qualcosa di importante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: La alquimia consiste en la manipulación del maná. Y el maná es una fuerza que se extrae de los momentos vividos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: The more significant the memory is, the more mana it generates.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: L'alchimia consiste nel manipolare il mana. E il mana e' una forza che si ricava dai momenti vissuti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Cuanto más significativo es el recuerdo, más maná genera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I think in your panic as you fell, you may have tried to use more mana than your limits would normally allow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Piu' un ricordo e' significativo, piu' mana genera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Se me ocurre que, al caer, sentiste un pánico desbordante que te obligó a superar tus límites en el uso del maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: In doing so, you tried to forcibly pull out more mana from the environment than actually existed ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Immagino che, cadendo, tu abbia provato un panico cosi' intenso da spingerti a superare i tuoi limiti nell'uso del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Así, intentaste extraer más maná de la naturaleza del que era posible...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Causing you to pull from your own memories without realizing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Cosi' hai cercato di estrarre dalla natura piu' mana di quanto fosse possibile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Y eso te hizo sacar energía de tus propios recuerdos sin quererlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Is ... is that even possible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: E questo ti ha portata ad attingere inconsapevolmente energia dai tuoi stessi ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Eso... es posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: It's not a simple task. It's proof that the user is very adept at handling mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: E'... possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: No es fácil. Es una prueba más de que esta usuaria del maná es muy habilidosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: It appears that you are in a similar state to Rutger at the moment, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Non e' facile. E' un'ulteriore prova di quanto sia abile questa utilizzatrice di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Yumia, tu situación es muy parecida a la de Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I've forgotten something ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Yumia, la tua situazione e' molto simile a quella di Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿He olvidado recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: This is to be expected. It's difficult to recognize something that you've forgotten as being forgotten.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Ho dimenticato dei ricordi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Era de esperar. Cuesta mucho reconocer qué has olvidado si no lo recuerdas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Trace back your memories as far back as you can. Start from the oldest and recall everythin' you can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Era prevedibile. E' difficile capire cosa hai dimenticato se non te lo ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¡Oye!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: (My oldest memories ...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Ehi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Retrocede en tus recuerdos lo máximo que puedas. Empieza por el más antiguo que tengas y ve progresando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: (The tool shop ... Mom ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Ripercorri i tuoi ricordi piu' indietro che puoi. Inizia dal piu' antico e procedi in avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¡V-vale!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Mom ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: R-ricevuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: (Mi recuerdo más antiguo...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Miss Yumia, is something wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: (Il mio ricordo piu' antico...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: (El taller... Mamá...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I can't remember it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: (Il laboratorio... Mamma...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Mamá?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Mamma?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Señorita Yumia, ¿estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I can't remember my mom's face.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Signorina Yumia, sta bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: No la recuerdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Her face, the things we talked about, all our memories together, everything. It's like there's a big empty hole.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Non me la ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: That means those are the memories you used.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: No recuerdo la cara de mi madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I used the memories of my mom ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Non ricordo il volto di mia madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Su rostro, nuestras conversaciones, los días que pasamos juntas... Es como si un agujero negro los hubiera engullido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: No way! Yumia's mother is so important to her, there's no way sh—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Il suo volto, le nostre conversazioni, i giorni passati insieme... E' come se un buco nero li avesse inghiottiti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Entonces, usaste esos recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: It's most likely because she was so important to her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Allora hai usato quei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿Usé los recuerdos de mi madre?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I-isn't there anything we can do?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Ho usato i ricordi di mia madre?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¡Eso es imposible! Yumia quiere muchísimo a su madre, jamás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Once a memory has returned to the earth as mana, recovering it is ... impossible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: E' impossibile! Yumia vuole un bene immenso a sua madre, non lo farebbe mai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Precisamente, los usó porque eran importantes para ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: It would be like trying to retrieve a single drop of nectar that's fallen into the ocean.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: E' proprio perche' erano importanti per lei che li ha usati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: ¿No hay n-nada que podamos hacer para ayudarla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Oh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Non c'e' n-niente che possiamo fare per aiutarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Cuando un recuerdo regresa a la tierra en forma de maná, recuperarlo es... imposible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Quando un ricordo torna alla terra sotto forma di mana, recuperarlo e'... impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Sería como recuperar una gota de néctar que haya caído en el océano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to the atelier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Sarebbe come recuperare una goccia di nettare caduta nell'oceano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Yumia ... All right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Vale, eso es todo lo que queríamos saber. Regresemos al Atelier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..ref: Thank you for your help, Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Bene, ora sappiamo tutto quello che volevamo. Torniamo all'Atelier.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Yumia... Está bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Yumia... Va tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..src: Gracias por tu ayuda, Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_030..dst: Grazie per il tuo aiuto, Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Oye, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Hey, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Ehi, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Mamá te fabricó, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: You were made by Mom, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Ti ha costruito la mamma, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Correcto. La creadora de Flammi fue Irene Liessfeldt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Correct. Flammi's creator was Irene Liessfeldt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Esatto. La creatrice di Flammi era Irene Liessfeldt.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Y ¿cómo era ella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: What kind of person was she?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: E com'era?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Irene tenía una personalidad alegre, animada y optimista. Siempre tenía una sonrisa dibujada en la cara.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Irene's personality was cheerful, bright, and optimistic. She always wore a smile, no matter the situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Irene aveva un carattere allegro, vivace e ottimista. Aveva sempre un sorriso stampato in volto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Su afición favorita era crear todo tipo de cosas. Incluso durante los descansos del trabajo, se escabullía a fabricar cachivaches.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Her biggest hobby was making things. Even during spare moments at work, she often enjoyed crafting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Il suo passatempo preferito era creare ogni sorta di cose. Anche durante le pause dal lavoro, sgattaiolava via per fabbricare cianfrusaglie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Otro de sus pasatiempos favoritos era cocinar. Irónicamente, su familia no consideraba sus platos muy sabrosos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Another one of her hobbies was cooking, although her family did not rate the taste very highly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Un altro dei suoi passatempi preferiti era cucinare. Ironia della sorte, la sua famiglia non trovava molto gustosi i suoi piatti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Además, era alquimista. No obstante, debo mencionar que eso lo mantenía oculto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Also, she was an alchemist. However, this was something she kept hidden from those around her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Inoltre, era un'alchimista. Tuttavia, devo precisare che teneva nascosta questa cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Sí... Eso lo sé. Por eso vine aquí y me uní al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: ... Right. I learned that, and that's why I came here and joined the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Si'... Lo so. E' per questo che sono venuta qui e mi sono unita alla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Correcto. Además...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Correct. In addition to that—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Esatto. E inoltre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Creo que era una buena madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: I'm sure she was a great mother.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Credo che fosse una brava madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Yumia... Irene Liessfeldt sigue siendo tu madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: ... Yumia. Irene Liessfeldt is still your mother.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Yumia... Irene Liessfeldt e' ancora tua madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Lo sé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: I know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Lo so.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: De hecho, no lo sé...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: I know, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: A dire il vero, non lo so...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Flammi no puede procesar a qué te refieres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: I don't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Flammi non riesce a capire cosa intendi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Tal vez te falta información. Flammi dará más datos. La comida favorita de Irene era...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Flammi is unable to process what you mean.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Forse ti mancano delle informazioni. Flammi ti dara' qualche dettaglio in piu'. Il cibo preferito di Irene era...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Ya no importa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Perhaps you require additional information. Providing more now. Irene's favorite food was—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Non importa piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: No lo entendería aunque me lo cuentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: You can stop now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Non capirei, anche se me lo raccontassi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Tú has preguntado a Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Even if you tell me, I won't truly get it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Sei tu che hai fatto una domanda a Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Ya, lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: ... You are the one who asked, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Gia', mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Esto no tiene sentido. No consigo hacerme a la idea de lo que me está pasando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: ... Right, sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Non ha senso. Non riesco a capacitarmi di quello che mi sta succedendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Ojalá la alquimia pueda darme soluciones. Flammi, ¿me quieres ayudar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: This is hopeless. I just can't set my mind straight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Spero che l'alchimia possa darmi delle risposte. Flammi, mi vuoi aiutare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Muy bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Okay, let's see if alchemy can provide some solutions. Flammi, are you willing to help?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Va bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: ¿Algún avance?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: ... Very well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Qualche progresso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: No, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Any progress?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: No, a dire il vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Yumia, se está haciendo tarde...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Not really.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Yumia, si sta facendo tardi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Yumia. Escucha. Deberías descansar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Yumia, it's getting pretty late ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Yumia. Ascolta. Dovresti riposare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: No puedo relajarme sin tener la mente ocupada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Yumia. You should really get some rest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Non riesco a rilassarmi se non tengo la mente occupata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Siento... que lo he perdido todo. Mi motivo para estar aquí, todos mis intentos por ayudar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: If I don't occupy my mind with something, I can't calm down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Mi sembra... di aver perso tutto. Il motivo per cui sono qui, tutti i miei tentativi di aiutare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Me da miedo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: My reason for being here, what I've been trying to do, everything ... It feels like I'll lose all of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Ho paura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: ¿Qué debería hacer hoy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: It's terrifying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Cosa dovrei fare oggi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Yumia, el jefe quiere hablar contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: What should I do today?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Yumia, il capo vuole parlarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: ¿El jefe? Supongo que querrá que continuemos con la misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: Yumia, the chief is calling for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Il capo? Immagino voglia che continuiamo la missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..src: Puede ser. No lo sé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..ref: The chief? I wonder if he's going to say it's about time to continue our mission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_040..dst: Puo' darsi. Non lo so.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Voy a hablar sin tapujos. Puede que os sorprenda, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: I know this is sudden, but—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Parlero' senza mezzi termini. Forse vi sorprendera', ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: I've decided to put you all on break.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Ho deciso di concedervi una pausa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Y no uno breve. Habéis sufrido mucho últimamente: creo que debéis descansar al menos unos días.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: Not just a short break either. You've all been through a lot, so I feel that you should rest for at least a few days.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: E non sara' breve. Ultimamente avete passato momenti difficili: credo che dobbiate riposarvi almeno per qualche giorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: ¿Cómo? Espera, pero todavía hay muchas cosas que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: Huh? Wait, but ... there are still so many things that we need to—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Cosa? Aspetta, ma ci sono ancora tante cose da...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: ¡Qué bien, Yumia! Llevamos trabajando desde que llegamos, ya empezaba a notarme quemada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: Isn't this great, Yumia? We've been working ever since we arrived here, so I was getting worn out too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Che bello, Yumia! Lavoriamo da quando siamo arrivate, cominciavo a sentirmi esausta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: La investigación queda en pausa hasta nuevo aviso. Yo también necesito pensar en otras cosas. Os veo más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: And so, the investigation is on hold until further notice. I'm going to take it easy for a while too. See you later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Le ricerche sono sospese fino a nuovo avviso. Anch'io ho bisogno di pensare ad altro. Ci vediamo piu' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Venga, Yumia. ¡Vamos a divertirnos por ahí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: Come on, Yumia! Let's go out and enjoy ourselves somewhere!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Dai, Yumia. Andiamo a divertirci un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Nunca hemos salido juntas a hacer algo divertido. ¡Ahora es el momento perfecto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Non siamo mai uscite insieme a divertirci. Questa e' l'occasione perfetta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: He dormido como una marmota... ¿Eh? ¿Dónde están todos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: We've never just gone out together for fun, right? Now's our chance!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Ho dormito come un sasso... Eh? Dove sono tutti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Buenos días, Yumia. Han salido a dar un paseo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: I slept like a rock. ... Huh, where is everyone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..dst: Buongiorno, Yumia. Sono usciti a fare una passeggiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..src: Entonces, no deben de andar lejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_041..ref: Good morning, Yumia. They all went out for a walk.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: Considerin' how you'd bring up your mom at every chance, I'm surprised you're not bawlin' your eyes out.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: Con la de veces que nos has hablado de tu madre, me sorprende que no vayas llorando por las esquinas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: Even if I wanted to cry, I can't. I don't remember anything about her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Visto quante volte ci hai parlato di tua madre, mi sorprende che non te ne vada in giro a piangere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: Aunque quisiera, no me sale. No me acuerdo de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: I don't remember my parents at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Anche se volessi, non ci riuscirei. Non mi ricordo di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: So I don't have even the slightest clue about how much affection you had for your mom.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: Yo tampoco recuerdo a mis padres.
Así que no tengo ni la más remota idea de cuánto cariño le tenías a tu madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: Losin' your memories? I know how that feels better than anyone else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Quindi non ho la minima idea di quanto volessi bene a tua madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: De perder los recuerdos sí que sé un rato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Quanto a perdere i ricordi, me ne intendo parecchio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: No, what I'm tryin' to say is ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: No, lo que quiero decir es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: I think I said this before, but it ain't easy for people to change the way they live.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: No, quello che voglio dire e' che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: Creo que ya te lo he dicho antes, pero a la gente le cuesta adaptarse a los cambios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: Even without your memories, you're still you. Plus ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Credo di avertelo gia' detto, ma per le persone e' difficile adattarsi ai cambiamenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: A pesar de haber perdido tus recuerdos, sigues siendo tú. Además...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: "We can always learn new things." You're the one who said that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Anche se hai perso i tuoi ricordi, sei sempre tu. E poi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: Una vez dijiste «siempre podemos aprender nuevas cosas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: Everythin' ain't lost yet. At the very least, don't forget the words you spat out yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Una volta hai detto "possiamo sempre imparare cose nuove".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: No todo está perdido. Al menos, no olvides las palabras que tú nos has dicho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..dst: Non e' ancora tutto perduto. Almeno, non dimenticare le parole che tu stesso ci hai detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..src: No me las des a mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_042..ref: I'm not the one you should be thankin'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¡Uf!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Viktor, what are you doing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Ugh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿Qué estás haciendo, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Oh, Yumia. Just keeping myself fit with some running.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Che stai facendo, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Ah, Yumia. Nunca es un mal momento para hacer deporte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Even though we're on break. You never change.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Ah, Yumia. Non e' mai un brutto momento per fare sport.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿No se supone que estamos de descanso? Hay cosas que no cambian nunca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: It's simply become a habit now. What about you, Yumia? Did you get some rest?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Non dovremmo essere a riposo? Ci sono cose che non cambiano mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Para mí se ha convertido en un hábito. ¿Qué tal tú, Yumia? ¿Has descansado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Me? Yeah. More than enough, actually.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Per me e' diventata un'abitudine. E tu, Yumia? Ti sei riposata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿Yo? Sí. Más de lo que debería.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: ... I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Io? Si'. Piu' del dovuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Yumia, if you don't mind, there's something I'd like to ask.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Yumia, me gustaría preguntarte algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: How much of your memory is actually missing? You don't need to answer if you don't want to, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Yumia, vorrei chiederti una cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿Cuántos recuerdos has perdido? No tienes por qué responder si no te apetece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Hmm ... I don't remember any conversations I had with my mother as a child, or what she looked like, or her voice. Those kinds of details.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Quanti ricordi hai perso? Non devi rispondere se non te la senti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Mmm... No recuerdo las conversaciones que tenía con mi madre cuando era niña, su aspecto ni su voz. Ya sabes, esas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Including the things you told us before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Mmm... Non ricordo le conversazioni che avevo con mia madre da bambina, ne' il suo aspetto o la sua voce. Insomma, cose del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿Ni siquiera las historias que nos has contado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: I remember those. Though, I guess it's more like I just remember talking about them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Nemmeno le storie che ci hai raccontato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Eso sí. Pero solo recuerdo haberos hablado de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: It just doesn't feel like I directly experienced any of those things. Even though I was talking about my own past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Quelle si'. Pero' ricordo solo di avervi parlato di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: No tengo la sensación de haber vivido esas experiencias. Aunque estuviera hablando de mi propia vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: It's like I'm listening to someone else's memories. It's hard to explain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Non ho la sensazione di aver vissuto quelle esperienze, anche se parlavo della mia vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Es como escuchar los recuerdos de alguien ajeno a mí. No sé, no es fácil de explicar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Indeed, I can't pretend to understand what you are going through.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: E' come ascoltare i ricordi di qualcun altro. Non so, e' difficile da spiegare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Ya. Me cuesta seguir lo que me intentas decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: But as I said before, the time we've spent together won't disappear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Capisco. Faccio fatica a seguire quello che vuoi dire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Aunque, como ya te dije en su momento, el tiempo que hemos pasado juntos no va a desaparecer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: The conversations we've had, the things we've done, the experiences we've shared. We'll remember it all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Pero', come ti ho gia' detto, il tempo che abbiamo trascorso insieme non scomparira'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Siempre recordaremos las charlas que hemos mantenido, las cosas que hemos hecho juntos y las experiencias que hemos vivido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Those memories are etched into us too. So, if you ever lose your way, trust that we'll be here to guide you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Ricorderemo sempre le conversazioni che abbiamo avuto, le cose che abbiamo fatto insieme e le esperienze che abbiamo vissuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Esos recuerdos están forjados a fuego en nosotros. Si alguna vez te sientes perdida, puedes confiar en nosotros para guiarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: We've always relied on your strength up until now. Even in the battle the other day, we were powerless to assist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Quei ricordi sono impressi a fuoco dentro di noi. Se mai ti sentirai persa, puoi contare su di noi per guidarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Hasta ahora, nosotros hemos sido los que nos hemos dejado guiar por tu fuerza. Incluso en la batalla del otro día... Apenas pudimos intervenir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: However, I do hope you will allow us to assist you ... as friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Finora siamo stati noi a lasciarci guidare dalla tua forza. Anche durante la battaglia dell'altro giorno... siamo riusciti a malapena a intervenire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Sin embargo, espero que podamos ayudarte... siendo tus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Viktor ... Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Tuttavia, spero che potremo aiutarti... in qualita' di amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Viktor... gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: But you'll "remember it all," huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Viktor... grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Forjados a fuego, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: You really do say the most embarrassing things without a hint of embarrassment, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Forgiati nel fuoco, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: No sé cómo consigues decir cosas tan sensibleras sin pestañear, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Wha—!?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Non so come fai a dire cose cosi' sdolcinate senza battere ciglio, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: ¿Perdonaaa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..ref: Hehe. Haha. Ahaha!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Cosaaa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..src: Je, je, je. ¡Ja, ja, ja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_043..dst: Eh, eh, eh. Ah, ah, ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..src: Buenos días, Lenja. Nina. ¿Ibais a alguna parte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..ref: Morning, Lenja. And you too, Nina. Did you go somewhere?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..dst: Buongiorno, Lenja. Anche tu, Nina. Stavate andando da qualche parte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..src: A buscar suministros de la base. ¿Y tú, Yumia? ¿A qué has dedicado tu tiempo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..ref: We went to get some supplies from the base. How about you, Yumia? Have you been doing anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..dst: Siamo andate alla base a prendere dei rifornimenti. E tu, Yumia? Che hai fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..src: A nada en especial. He estado... ¡Ah! Por cierto, ¿está Isla con vosotras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..ref: Not really, I've just been ... Oh, that's right. Isn't Isla with you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..dst: Niente di che. Sono stata... Ah, giusto! Isla e' con voi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..src: Creo que se adelantó. Debe de estar en el Atelier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..ref: I think she went back to the atelier before us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..dst: Credo sia tornata all'atelier prima di noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..src: Nos hemos debido de cruzar en el camino... Gracias. Iré a buscarla allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..ref: We must have just missed each other ... Thanks. I'll head back there now!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_044..dst: Allora ci siamo incrociate per un soffio... Grazie. Torno subito li'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¡Isla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Isla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Isla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¡Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Ah, estás ahí. Bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Ah, there you are. Good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ah, eccoti. Bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¿Estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Is something wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: C'e' qualcosa che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Oye, ¿has hablado con Rutger y Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Hey, did you say something to Rutger and Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ehi, hai detto qualcosa a Rutger e Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Wh-what do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Bueno, he hablado con los dos y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Well, I was just talking to them, and—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Beh, stavo parlando con loro e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¡Vaya! Menudo piquito tienen esos dos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Wow, to think that those two would say stuff like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Wow, non avrei mai pensato che quei due dicessero cose del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Has hablado con ellos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: You definitely said something to them, didn't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Gli hai detto qualcosa tu, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¿Sí o no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Didn't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Non e' cosi'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Jo, me has pillado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Darn, I thought I could get away with it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Accidenti, pensavo di farla franca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Les dije que, cuando una chica está de bajón, no está de más que sean sus compañeros quienes la animen. ¡Pero eso fue todo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: I just said that when a girl is feeling down, it's a great time for a man to offer some uplifting words. That's all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ho solo detto che quando una ragazza e' giu', e' un'ottima occasione per un uomo per dirle qualcosa di incoraggiante. Tutto qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Así que por eso estaban tan charlatanes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: So that's what prompted those talks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ecco cos'ha dato il via a quei discorsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Sé que debería haber estado más encima de ti en lugar de mandarlos a ellos, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: I know I should've just come and talked to you directly ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: So che avrei dovuto venire a parlarti direttamente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Lo siento. Es que no sé si podía aguantarme las ganas de llorar, por eso, preferí evitarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: I'm sorry. I felt like I might end up crying myself instead, so I held back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Mi dispiace. Temevo che avrei finito per mettermi a piangere anch'io, cosi' mi sono trattenuta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¿de verdad fue por eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Haha. That's your reason?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ahaha. Era questo il motivo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¡No te rías! Solo quería ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Don't laugh! I just wanted to help ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Non ridere! Volevo solo aiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Perdón, perdón. Gracias por el gesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Sorry, sorry. Thanks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Scusa, scusa. Grazie per il pensiero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Pero, si tus sentimientos eran tan fuertes, me habría valido con un abrazo tuyo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: But you know, if you really felt so strongly, you could have just come and given me a big hug.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ma sai, se ci tenevi davvero cosi' tanto, potevi anche venire qui e darmi un bell'abbraccio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¿Eh? Ah...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Ah... Huh?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Eh? Ah...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Y... bueno. ¿Necesitas un abrazo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Ah, um ... You want a hug, then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: E... beh. Vuoi un abbraccio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Ya no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Not anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Non piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: ¡Venga ya!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Oh, come on!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Ma dai!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Los chicos me dijeron cosas muy bonitas. Consiguieron levantarme el ánimo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: I already got some uplifting words from the boys, so I'm all good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: I ragazzi mi hanno gia' tirato su il morale con parole gentili, quindi sto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Oye, tienes menos pelos en la lengua que cuando nos conocimos, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: You know, you've become even cheekier than when we first met.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Sai, sei diventata ancora piu' sfacciata da quando ci siamo conosciute.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Entonces no éramos las mismas personas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Our positions were very different back then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Allora eravamo persone diverse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Tienes razón. En fin... Me alegro de que te sientas mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Right. Well, anyway ... I'm glad you seem to be feeling better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Hai ragione. Comunque... mi fa piacere che tu stia meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Voy a ver al jefe. Quiero contarle todas las cosas que he estado pensando y cuál es mi plan de ahora en adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: I'm going to see the chief. I need to tell him what I'm thinking, and what I plan to do from here on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Vado a parlare con il capo. Voglio dirgli cosa penso e cosa intendo fare d'ora in poi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..src: Llamemos a los demás para ir juntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..ref: Let's call everyone and go together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_050..dst: Chiamiamo gli altri e andiamoci insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Gracias por el descanso, jefe. Me ha venido bien para darle vueltas a ciertos asuntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: ... Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Grazie per la pausa, capo. Mi e' servita per riflettere su alcune cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Creo que he hallado la respuesta a algo que me estaba pesando sobre los hombros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Thank you for the break. It gave me some time to think.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Credo di aver trovato la risposta a qualcosa che mi pesava sulle spalle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Cuéntame.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I feel like I've finally found the answer to what I've been struggling with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Raccontami.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Pues... Es sobre la alquimia. ¿Tomó mi madre la decisión correcta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Let's hear it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Dunque... riguarda l'alchimia. Mia madre fece la scelta giusta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Es una cuestión que siempre me ha rondado la mente. Por eso vine aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Just what is alchemy? Did my mother do the right thing back then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: E' una domanda che mi sono posta spesso. Per questo sono venuta qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Hasta ahora, siempre he querido pensar que la alquimia era algo bueno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: These are the questions I wanted answered, so I came here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Fino a oggi ho sempre voluto credere che l'alchimia fosse qualcosa di buono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Quería y necesitaba creerlo así. De lo contrario, estaría reconociendo que mi madre era una villana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Up until now, I've always wanted to believe that alchemy was a good thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Dovevo crederci. Altrimenti avrei dovuto ammettere che mia madre era una malvagia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Por eso no podía aceptar todo lo que había sufrido Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I had to. If I didn't, it felt like I was making my mother a villain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Per questo non riuscivo ad accettare tutto cio' che aveva sofferto Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Miré hacia otro lado. Intenté no ver los estragos que la alquimia había provocado en esta tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: That's exactly why I couldn't accept what happened with Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Ho distolto lo sguardo. Ho cercato di non vedere i danni che l'alchimia aveva causato in questa terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Perder los recuerdos de mi madre me ha permitido reflexionar y ser capaz de mirar a la verdad de frente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I averted my eyes. I tried to block out the truth about alchemy that lay hidden in this land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Aver perso i ricordi di mia madre mi ha permesso di riflettere e di guardare la verita' in faccia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Hablar con mis compañeros también me ha hecho abrir los ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Losing the memories of my mother allowed me to reflect on myself and finally see that truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Parlare con i miei compagni mi ha fatto aprire gli occhi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Me han hecho pensar en qué es lo yo quiero. Y así es como debo afrontar la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Since then, I've been speaking with the others, which made me think even more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Mi hanno fatto riflettere su cio' che voglio. Ed e' cosi' che devo affrontare l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: ¡Me encanta la alquimia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: It made me think about what I want to do now. How I should face alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Amo l'alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Incluso sin los recuerdos de mi madre, a pesar de haber olvidado su cara, este sentimiento sigue latiendo en mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I love alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Anche senza i ricordi di mia madre, pur avendo dimenticato il suo volto, questo sentimento continua a battere dentro di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: La primera vez que alguien me dio las gracias por haberle ayudado mediante la alquimia... casi di saltos de alegría.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Even without the memories of my mother—even if I can't recall her face—that feeling of mine won't change.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: La prima volta che qualcuno mi ha ringraziato per averlo aiutato con l'alchimia... ero cosi' felice che quasi saltavo di gioia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Y sé que es el mismo arte que ha causado tanto dolor a muchas otras personas. La alquimia no es buena o mala de por sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: The first time someone thanked me for helping them with alchemy ... I was so happy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: E so che e' la stessa arte che ha causato tanto dolore a molte altre persone. L'alchimia non e' buona o cattiva in se'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Todo depende de la persona que la utilice. En ambos casos, la alquimia es la misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: But that same technique could be used to cause someone sorrow. Alchemy itself is neither right nor wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Tutto dipende da chi la usa. In entrambi i casi, l'alchimia e' la stessa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Quiero descubrir qué más esconde este lugar. Y, para eso, debo aceptar los pecados y las tragedias que han llegado a ser una realidad por culpa de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Everything depends on how someone chooses to use it. Both sides are still alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Voglio scoprire cos'altro nasconde questo luogo. E per farlo, devo accettare i peccati e le tragedie diventati realta' a causa dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Los recuerdos no solo nos sirven para ver el pasado. También son los cimientos del futuro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I want to uncover the truth buried in this land, which also means accepting all the sinful memories and tragedies that have occurred because of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: I ricordi non servono solo a guardare al passato. Sono anche le fondamenta del futuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Quiero seguir adelante con nuestros planes. En gran medida, porque creo que los recuerdos son la base de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Memories are not just for reflecting on the past, but also for building towards a new future.
