eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Entiendo... así que os envía el jefe. Me alegro de recibir refuerzos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: ... I see, so the chief asked you. Frankly, I'm grateful for the help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Capisco... Quindi vi manda il capo. Sono contento di avere dei rinforzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: ¿Nos puedes resumir qué has descubierto hasta ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Can you give us an overview on the information you're working with right now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: puoi riassumerci cosa hai scoperto finora?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Claro. He estado hablando con la gente de por aquí y no dejan de mencionar algo que me tiene perplejo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Certainly. I've been interviewing people, and there's one term that keeps coming up that's caught my attention.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Certo. Ho parlato con la gente del posto e continuano a nominare qualcosa che mi lascia perplesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: The "Harvest Project." Have any of you heard of it before?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: No... ¿Tiene algo que ver con la deidad de la cosecha?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: I haven't. Does it have to do with the Harvest Deity?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: No, non ne ho mai sentito parlare. C'entra qualcosa con la divinita' del raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Puede, no lo sé. Creo que el resto de información se ha perdido con el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Maybe, I'm not sure yet. Any further details seem to be all but lost already.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Forse, non lo so. Credo che il resto delle informazioni sia andato perduto col tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Tal vez sea el nombre de alguna política nacional que se estableció para enriquecer todo Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: It might just be the name of some national policy that was being planned to enrich Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Potrebbe essere il nome di una politica nazionale pensata per arricchire tutta Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Es posible. En los países más privilegiados, los que manejan el dinero siempre piensan en enriquecerse de alguna manera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Sounds plausible to me. Rich people in rich countries always think about getting richer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: E' possibile. Nei paesi piu' privilegiati, chi gestisce il denaro pensa sempre a come arricchirsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Bueno. No es extraño toparse con datos o lugares de interés que acaban en un callejón sin salida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Well, sometimes you find information and places of interest, only for nothing to come of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Beh, non e' raro imbattersi in informazioni o luoghi interessanti che poi si rivelano un vicolo cieco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Habéis venido a ayudarme a recabar información, ¿verdad? Creo que, antes o después, os pasará lo mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: You guys came to help me gather information, right? You'll probably run into the same thing at some point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Siete venuti ad aiutarmi a raccogliere informazioni, vero? Credo che prima o poi capitera' anche a voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: En estos asuntos somos unos principiantes. ¿Tienes algún consejo para nosotros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: We're basically amateurs when it comes to this kind of thing. Do you have any advice?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: In queste cose siamo dei principianti. Hai qualche consiglio per noi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Lo más importante es aprovechar al máximo el tiempo que dedicáis a hablar con los lugareños.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: I think the most important thing is to make the most of the time you spend talking to the people who live here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: La cosa piu' importante e' sfruttare al massimo il tempo che dedicate a parlare con la gente del posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Aunque sea una charla trivial o una conversación de pasada, es preciso reconocer los detalles más interesantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Even if the conversation isn't riveting, you need to be able to pick out important details, even in small talk.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Che sia una chiacchierata banale o una conversazione di sfuggita, bisogna saper cogliere i dettagli piu' interessanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Detalles interesantes en charlas triviales... Vale. Lo tendremos en cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: Important details in small talk ... Okay. We'll keep that in mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Dettagli interessanti nelle chiacchiere banali... D'accordo. Lo terremo a mente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..src: Por mi parte, seguiré buscando pistas. Si descubrís algo, venid a verme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..ref: I'll keep gathering information on my end as well. If you find something, let me know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_020..dst: Io continuero' a cercare indizi. Se scoprite qualcosa, venite a trovarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: ¿El proyecto Cultivo? Hace tiempo que no oía hablar de él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: Harvest Project? That's quite a dated term.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: Il Progetto del Raccolto? E' da un po' che non sentivo questo nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Más allá de que se remonta a años atrás, no sabemos mucho más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: We don't know much about it, beyond that it's something from a long time ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: A parte il fatto che risale a molti anni fa, non ne sappiamo molto altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Ya veo... Entonces, ¿podrías indicarnos dónde podríamos obtener más información sobre el tema?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: I see ... In that case, do you know anywhere that might have some more information about it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: Capisco... In tal caso, sapresti indicarci dove potremmo trovare altre informazioni al riguardo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Pues... quizás encontréis algo en los antiguos edificios que hay cerca de la escuela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: Well ... There are a lot of old buildings near the school that might have something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: Beh... Potreste trovare qualcosa nei vecchi edifici vicino alla scuola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Con escuela... ¿te refieres a la Academia Hermética?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: The school ... As in Hermea Academy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: La scuola... Intendi l'Accademia di Hermea?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Es lógico. Al ser una academia, seguro que hay un montón de documentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: Since it's an academy, there's probably a bunch of information collected there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: Ha senso. Essendo un'accademia, di sicuro ci saranno un sacco di documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..src: Bien pensado. Puede que haya información de la época en que la escuela estaba activa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: Fair point. We might find some useful information from back when the school was active.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..dst: Hai ragione. Potremmo trovare informazioni utili risalenti a quando la scuola era ancora in attivita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_030..ref: Yeah. Thank you for the help.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..src: Una academia abandonada... ¿No os da repelús?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..ref: An abandoned academy ... It sure is eerie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..dst: Un'accademia abbandonata... Non mette i brividi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..src: Se supone que las ruinas deben de ser así. Bueno, ¿por dónde empezamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..ref: That's just how ruins are. So, where should we start our search?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_040..dst: Le rovine sono fatte cosi'. Allora, da dove cominciamo a cercare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..src: Hace más de seis meses que empecé a trabajar en esta academia. Para estar en Aladiss, el equipo no está mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..ref: It's been half a year since I started working at this academy. It's well-equipped, even for Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..dst: Lavoro in questa accademia da piu' di sei mesi. E' ben attrezzata, anche per essere ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..src: Se han destinado muchos recursos a la investigación del maná. Si fuera estudiante todavía, me encantaría matricularme aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..ref: A lot of resources are being put into mana-related research. If I were a student, I'd want to study here too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_050..dst: Per la ricerca sul mana vengono investite moltissime risorse. Se fossi ancora uno studente, mi piacerebbe iscrivermi qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..src: La academia valora por igual las Humanidades y las actividades físicas, aunque últimamente el interés por estas últimas está menguando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..ref: Our academy values both the liberal and martial arts, but recently there's been a declining interest in athletics.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..dst: L'accademia da' la stessa importanza alle discipline umanistiche e a quelle sportive, ma ultimamente l'interesse per lo sport sta calando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..src: Nunca veo a nadie usar el campo de atletismo en las horas libres. ¿Para qué pagamos todas esas tasas de mantenimiento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..ref: I never see anyone use the field outside of class time. What are we paying those ridiculous upkeep fees for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_060..dst: Non vedo mai nessuno usare il campo fuori dall'orario delle lezioni. Per cosa paghiamo tutte queste assurde spese di manutenzione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..src: Estuve una semana sin ir a clase por culpa de un resfriado. Cuando me recuperé, no me enteraba de nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..ref: After taking the week off with a cold, I couldn't believe how little I understood when I came back to school.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..dst: Sono rimasto a casa una settimana per un raffreddore. Quando sono tornato a lezione, non riuscivo a credere a quanto poco capissi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..src: Si mis clases de Tecnología con maná ya me parecían complicadas al principio, no quiero ni pensar lo que me va a costar ponerme al día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..ref: Especially my mana technologies class. It was hard to begin with, but I don't think I'll be able to catch up now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..dst: Soprattutto la lezione di tecnologie del mana. Era difficile gia' all'inizio, ma ormai non credo proprio di riuscire a rimettermi in pari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..src: He estado sopesando la idea de cambiarme de departamento, uno que no me exija inscribirme en Tecnología con maná. Hablaré con el profesor más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..ref: Maybe I should transfer to a department that doesn't require mana technologies. I'll talk to my professor later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_070..dst: Forse dovrei trasferirmi in un dipartimento che non richiede tecnologie del mana. Ne parlero' piu' tardi con il professore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..src: Las plantas que trajeron de Lignumbria para su estudio se han marchitado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..ref: The plants that were brought in from Ligneus for research have already wilted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..dst: Le piante portate da Lignumbria per la ricerca sono gia' appassite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..src: Por lo visto, esa especie no puede crecer en Syvashi por la calidad del suelo. Nuestro presupuesto es limitado, así que no nos queda otra: hay que poner en pausa la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..ref: It seems that variety can't grow in Sivash soil. We have a limited budget, so we'll have to put this research on hold.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_080..dst: A quanto pare, quella specie non riesce a crescere nel terreno di Syvashi. Abbiamo un budget limitato, quindi dovremo sospendere la ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..src: Hoy he escuchado a otra persona contar esa historia de la «muñeca vacía». No se habla de otra cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..ref: I heard yet another person talking about that "empty doll" story today. It sure has gotten a lot of attention lately.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..dst: Oggi ho sentito un'altra persona parlare della storia della "bambola vuota". Ultimamente sta facendo un gran parlare di se'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..src: Si se mezcla el néctar de la Alstahlia con agua pura, cobrará vida... No, no me lo creo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..ref: By mixing the nectar of Alstahlia with pure water, they spring to life ... No, there's no way that's true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..dst: Se si mescola il nettare dell'Alstahlia con acqua pura, prende vita... No, non puo' essere vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..src: Cuando lo intentamos, solo conseguimos que el néctar se disolviera en el agua. Es imposible crear una muñeca de este modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..ref: We all tried it together, but the nectar just dissolved into the water. There was no way it was going to create a doll.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..dst: Abbiamo provato tutti insieme, ma il nettare si e' solo sciolto nell'acqua. Era impossibile che riuscissimo a creare una bambola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..src: A este ritmo, la historia acabará derivando tanto que irá sobre un fantasma o algo por el estilo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..ref: At the rate things are going, the story might end up getting twisted and turn into a ghost story or something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_090..dst: Di questo passo, la storia finira' per essere stravolta e diventera' una storia di fantasmi o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..src: Mmm... Ninguna de estas pistas me dice nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..ref: Hmm, I'm not seeing anything relevant in any of the clues we've found so far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..dst: Mmm... Non riesco a trovare niente di pertinente in nessuno degli indizi raccolti finora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..src: Un chico preocupado por no dar la talla en clase, costes de mantenimiento para el campo de atletismo, historias de fantasmas... Poco más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..ref: Worries about falling behind in class, maintenance costs for the sports field, and ghost stories ... It's all very plain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..dst: Le preoccupazioni di un ragazzo per non riuscire a stare al passo con le lezioni, i costi di manutenzione del campo sportivo e storie di fantasmi... Tutto molto banale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..src: Menos mal que no me hice ilusiones. Y ahora, ¿qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..ref: I knew I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. So now what?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..dst: Sapevo che non avrei dovuto farmi illusioni. E adesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..src: No queda otra que dejarlo aquí, porque no hemos encontrado nada. ¿Y si dejamos la búsqueda de información por ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..ref: We haven't found any clues, so I guess we stop here. Let's hold off on information gathering for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_091..dst: Non abbiamo trovato indizi, quindi direi di fermarci qui. Per ora lasciamo perdere la raccolta di informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: Oh, you all showed up at just the right time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Siete arrivati proprio al momento giusto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Wilma tiene algo importante que decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: Listen to what Wilma has to say.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Ascoltate cosa ha da dire Wilma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Quiero visitar una aldea Alber para seguir investigando el proyecto Cultivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: There's an Alber settlement I want to visit in order to perform research for the Harvest Project investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: C'e' un insediamento Alber che vorrei visitare per fare ricerche nell'ambito dell'indagine sul Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: ¿Tú también has oído hablar de él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: You've heard about this Harvest Project stuff too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Avete sentito parlare anche voi del Progetto del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Sí, hace poco. Me preguntaron si el nombre me sonaba de algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: Only quite recently, but yes. I was asked if I recalled hearing the name anywhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Me ne hanno parlato solo di recente, ma si'. Mi hanno chiesto se mi ricordassi di aver gia' sentito quel nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Aunque era la primera vez que lo escuchaba, me dejó con la intriga y me uní a la investigación. Pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: While it was the first I'd heard of it, I was interested enough to join the investigation on it. However ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Era la prima volta che ne sentivo parlare, ma la cosa mi incuriosiva abbastanza da unirmi all'indagine. Tuttavia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Además del nombre, no se sabe mucho más. Por eso decidí buscar en otro sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: There was no information left besides the name itself, so I decided to try looking in a different location.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Non era rimasta alcuna informazione, a parte il nome, cosi' ho deciso di cercare in un altro luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Sí. Hay una aldea Alber en la orilla opuesta de los acantilados del noreste. Lleva allí desde la edad dorada de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: Yes. There's an Alber settlement on the opposite shore from the northeastern cliffs that's been around since the golden age of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Si'. Sulla sponda opposta rispetto alle scogliere nordorientali c'e' un insediamento Alber, che esiste fin dall'eta' d'oro di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: He pensado que sería un buen lugar para indagar un poco más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: I imagine it would be a great place to find out whether any pertinent information remains ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Immagino sia un ottimo posto per scoprire se e' rimasta qualche informazione utile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Pero no sé cómo funciona el mecanismo que me permitiría cruzar al otro lado, así que estoy bloqueada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: But I can't figure out how the mechanism to cross over to the other shore works. I'm completely stumped.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Ma non capisco come funziona il meccanismo per passare all'altra sponda, quindi sono bloccata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: Necesitas un guante especial para accionarlo. Déjamelo a mí. Te fabricaré uno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: You need a special kind of glove to use it. Leave it to me, I can make some for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Per usarlo serve un guanto speciale. Lascia fare a me. Te ne fabbrichero' uno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..src: ¡Muchas gracias! Te esperaré junto al mecanismo, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..ref: Oh, thank you! Well then, I'll go wait near it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_100..dst: Grazie mille! Ti aspettero' vicino al meccanismo, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_110..src: ¡Gracias! ¡Gracias! Por fin puedo continuar la investigación en la aldea Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_110..ref: Thank you so much! Now I can proceed with research at the Alber settlement!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_110..dst: Grazie! Grazie! Finalmente posso continuare la ricerca nel villaggio degli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_110..ref: (We might find something out if we go with her. Let's tag along.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_110..dst: (Forse li' troveremo degli indizi. Dovremmo accompagnarla.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Bien. Los Alber me han pedido ayuda con unas reparaciones, así que les estoy echando una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Fine. The Alber here are in need of a little help, so I'm just doing some repairs around the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Bene. Gli Alber mi hanno chiesto aiuto con alcune riparazioni, quindi gli sto dando una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: ¿Reparaciones? Pero, Wilma, ¿no habías venido a investigar el proyecto Cultivo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Repairs? But Wilma, didn't you come here to investigate the Harvest Project?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Riparazioni? Ma, Wilma, non eri venuta a indagare sul Progetto del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Sí, claro, y lo haré a su debido tiempo. No puedo ignorar a estos chiquitines.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: I will, in due time. But I can't just ignore these little ones in their time of need.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Si', certo, e lo faro' al momento opportuno. Non posso ignorare questi piccolini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Ganarse la simpatía de los lugareños es muy importante cuando se investigan cosas así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Building rapport with the locals is an important part of field research!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Conquistarsi la simpatia della gente del posto e' molto importante quando si indaga su queste cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Además, el estilo de vida de los Alber siempre me ha parecido muy misterioso. ¡Quién sabe si haré un gran hallazgo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Besides, the life and ways of the Alber are filled with mysteries we've yet to unravel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Inoltre, lo stile di vita degli Alber mi e' sempre sembrato molto misterioso. Chissa', magari faro' una grande scoperta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Esta clase de misterios forman parte de mis obligaciones de investigadora. No solo me dedico a estudiar a la deidad de la cosecha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Investigating those mysteries is another duty of mine. My work isn't restricted to matters related to the Harvest Deity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Anche questo tipo di misteri rientra nei miei doveri di ricercatrice. Non mi dedico solo a studiare la Divinita' del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Ya, supongo que es lo que te convierte en una profesional. Cubres varios flancos a la vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: I see. I guess that's why you're a pro. You're juggling a lot of stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Capisco, immagino sia questo a renderti una professionista. Copri tanti fronti insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Je, je, je, ¿qué puedo decir? Al equipo de investigación le faltan manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: Hehe, what can I say? The Research Team is shorthanded.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Eheh, che vuoi che ti dica? Alla Squadra di Ricerca mancano braccia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: Si piensas así, quizá podamos echarte una. Se me da bien reparar todo tipo de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: In that case, let us help you. I'm pretty good at repairing buildings and the like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Se la pensi cosi', magari possiamo darti una mano. Sono brava a riparare ogni genere di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..src: ¡Toda ayuda es siempre bien recibida! Acepto tu oferta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..ref: I'm always grateful for your help. I'll take you up on your offer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_120..dst: Ogni aiuto e' sempre benvenuto! Accetto la tua offerta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Hemos ido adelantando las reparaciones en las zonas más castigadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: We went ahead and repaired some of the most damaged areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Abbiamo intanto fatto avanzare le riparazioni nelle zone piu' danneggiate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Gracias, será un alivio para los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: Thank you, the Alber will surely be pleased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Grazie, sara' un grande sollievo per gli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Muy bien, ahora toca recabar información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: All right, let's start gathering information now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Molto bene, ora tocca raccogliere informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Yo también investigaré por mi cuenta sobre los Alber y sobre ese proyecto Cultivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I'll do some research on my end too. Both about the Alber and the Harvest Project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Anche io faro' ricerche per conto mio, sugli Alber e su quel Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Genial. Pero, si preguntamos sin ton ni son, nos llevará un buen rato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: Sounds good. Although, just randomly asking around might take a lot of time ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Ottimo. Ma se chiediamo in giro a casaccio, ci vorra' un bel po' di tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: No os preocupéis, tengo una lista de los Alber que parecen saber algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: Not to worry, I've already determined three Alber who I believe might know something useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Non preoccupatevi, ho gia' un elenco degli Alber che sembrano sapere qualcosa di utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: He anotado aquí sus rasgos más distintivos y por dónde suelen rondar. Echad un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I wrote down their identifying features and where they can be found. Please take a look at this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Ho annotato qui i loro tratti piu' distintivi e i posti in cui si trovano di solito. Dateci un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Ya os lo he dicho, es una currante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: Like I said, she's a hard worker.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Ve l'ho detto, e' una gran lavoratrice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: La palabra que buscas es erudita. Bueno, ¿con quién hablamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I guess that's a scholar for you. Now then, who should we talk to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: La parola che cerchi e' erudita. Allora, con chi parliamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Me imagino que lo mejor será preguntar al Alber más sabio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I think talking to the knowledgeable Alber would be the best call.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Immagino che la cosa migliore sia chiedere all'Alber piu' sapiente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: C-claro. Yo preguntaría primero al más experto en la materia, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: Y-yeah. If there's someone here who knows more than others, they would be who I'd want to ask!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: C-certo. Io chiederei prima al piu' esperto in materia, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Me llama la atención ese libro antiguo. Si se escribió hace mucho tiempo, merecerá la pena leerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I'm interested in that old book. If it was written back in the day, that alone would be a big deal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Mi incuriosisce quel libro antico. Se e' stato scritto tanto tempo fa, varra' la pena leggerlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: W-well then, let's go find that Alber!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: Supongo que, si lo más característico de este Alber es su curiosidad, no perdemos nada por preguntarle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: I feel like if she made a point to describe that Alber as "curious," they must be worth talking to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Immagino che, se il tratto piu' caratteristico di questo Alber e' la curiosita', non perdiamo nulla a chiederglielo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..src: A lo mejor hasta nos ayuda en la investigación. Vamos a buscarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: They might even help us with our search. Let's go find them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..dst: Chissa', magari ci aiuta pure nella ricerca. Andiamo a cercarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_130..ref: <SEL_RM02_190_1_B><CR>Let's find the Alber with the old book.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: No sé nada sobre el proyecto Cultivo. Pero ¡el nombre me encanta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: I don't know about any "Harvest Project." But I think it's a really happy-sounding name!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Non so niente del Progetto del Raccolto. Pero' il nome mi piace un sacco!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: Entiendo... ¿Te puedo preguntar cómo podéis los Alber entrar a las zonas de vínculo de maná sin sufrir efectos secundarios?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: I see. Then, can you tell me how Alber are able to go inside of manabound areas without any problems?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Capisco... Posso chiederti come fate, voi Alber, a entrare nelle zone legate al mana senza subire effetti collaterali?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: Mmm... Pues no lo tengo claro. Supongo que nuestra forma de percibir el maná es diferente a la de los altus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: Hmm, I'm not really sure ... Maybe we feel mana differently than you Tall Ones?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Mmm... Non saprei dire. Immagino che il nostro modo di percepire il mana sia diverso da quello degli altus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: Feel it differently? Can you elaborate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: Pues no sabría decirte... Además, ahora mismo tengo mil cosas que hacer. ¡Me faltan ingredientes para la cena!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: Hmm ... Not right now. I'm about to go gather ingredients for supper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Eh, non saprei dire... E poi adesso ho mille cose da fare. Mi mancano gli ingredienti per la cena!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: Como siempre digo: con el estómago vacío, no digo ni pío. Con hambre me pongo muy mustio. ¡Es horrible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: When my tummy is grumbly, my mood gets all crumbly. I can't even smile. It's terrible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Come dico sempre: a pancia vuota non dico ne' pio. Con la fame mi abbatto. E' orribile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: ¿Y si preparo un banquete solo para ti? Así podrías hablar sin que nada te detenga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: I'll make you something to eat. A whole feast, okay? Then can you tell me more?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: E se ti preparassi un banchetto tutto per te? Cosi' potresti parlare senza che nulla ti fermi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..src: ¿De verdad harías eso? ¡Qué bien! Solo de imaginarme lo rico que estará, se me hace la boca agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..ref: Really? Oh, wow! Okay, I'll be waiting to eat your yummy food!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_140..dst: Lo faresti davvero? Che bene! Solo a immaginare quanto sara' buono mi viene l'acquolina in bocca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: ¡Hala, hala, hala! ¡Pero si hay un montón de comida! Menos mal que hoy llevo los pantalones elásticos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: Wow wow wow, there's so much! I'll be stuffed!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Caspita, caspita, caspita! Ma e' un sacco di cibo! Meno male che oggi ho i pantaloni con l'elastico!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: ¡Qué bien! Vale, entonces os contaré un montón de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: Thank you! Okay then, I'll tell you lots of stuff!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Che bello! Va bene, allora vi raccontero' un sacco di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: ¿Sentís una enorme paz al entrar a las zonas de vínculo de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: You feel calm when you enter manabound areas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Sentite una grande pace quando entrate nelle zone legate al mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: Exacto. Es perfecta para echarse una siesta, además, ¡huele requetebién!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: That's right. Perfect for taking naps, and it smells good too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Esatto. E' perfetta per un pisolino, e poi profuma benissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: Y, a la vez, me noto menos cansado. Yo diría que nos da energías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: It makes me less tired too, so maybe it gives us energy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: E allo stesso tempo mi sento meno stanco. Direi che ci da' energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: Qué curioso... Eso significa que nuestros cuerpos funcionan de manera distinta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: Interesting ... Does that mean your bodies work differently than ours?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Interessante... Vuol dire che i vostri corpi funzionano diversamente dai nostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..src: Seguro que a Wilma le interesa esta información. ¡Gracias! ¡Has sido de gran ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..ref: This might be a good thing to tell Wilma about. Thanks! You were a big help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_150..dst: Potrebbe essere utile parlarne a Wilma. Grazie! Mi sei stato di grande aiuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..src: Sin problemas. Podéis hojear todo lo que queráis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..ref: No problem. You can look at it as much as you want.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..src: ¿De verdad no te importa que leamos ese libro tan valioso? Es todo un detalle por tu parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..ref: That's very kind of you. You really don't mind letting us see your precious book?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..dst: Non ti dispiace davvero se leggiamo quel libro cosi' prezioso? Sei davvero gentile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..src: Es un gran libro, pero no sé leer el idioma antiguo. Me alegra que haya alguien que pueda leerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..ref: I love the book, but I can't read the old writing. I think it would be happy if someone could read it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..dst: E' un bel libro, ma non so leggere la lingua antica. Mi fa piacere che ci sia qualcuno che sa leggerlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..src: Ya veo. Entonces, lo escanearé para echarle un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..ref: I see. Let's scan it and take a look then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_160..dst: Capisco. Allora lo scannerizzo per dargli un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: ¿En seeerio? ¿A los altus os da dolor de cabeza entrar en las zonas de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: Is that really true? Tall Ones get headaches when they go in the mana?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Davvero? Agli Alti viene mal di testa quando entrano nelle zone di mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: Sí, por eso queremos saber qué hacéis para caminar por ellas sin sufrir ningún efecto secundario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: Yup. That's why we want to know how you all can walk in it without any side effects.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Si', e' per questo che vogliamo capire come fate a camminarci senza effetti collaterali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: Pues... no sabría decirte. Yo creo que nuestra percepción es distinta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: I'm not sure why. Maybe because we feel it differently?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Non saprei... Credo che percepiamo le cose in modo diverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: Cualquier detalle podría servirnos. ¿A qué te refieres con eso de la percepción?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: Any information would help. Please, could you tell me what you mean by that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Qualsiasi dettaglio potrebbe aiutarci. Cosa intendi quando dici che le percepiamo in modo diverso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: Claro, veréis es que... primero me gustaría pediros un favor. Me encantaría probar la comida de los altus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: That's fine, but first I have a favor to ask. I want to eat what Tall Ones eat!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Certo, ecco... prima pero' vorrei chiedervi un favore. Mi piacerebbe assaggiare il cibo degli Alti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: ¿Nuestra comida? Podría prepararte algún plato sencillo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: Human food, you mean? I could make something simple for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Il nostro cibo? Potrei prepararti qualcosa di semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: No, no, nada de cocinarlo por mí. Quiero los ingredientes para hacer mi propia receta. ¡Me encanta cocinar y luego zampar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: No cooking. I want the stuff to make it myself. I like both making and eating food!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: No, non voglio che cucini tu! Voglio gli ingredienti per preparare qualcosa da sola. Adoro cucinare e poi mangiare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..src: Eres un Alber muy curioso, ¿eh? Vale, te traeré un puñado de ingredientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..ref: You really are a curious Alber. Okay, I'll get you a bunch of ingredients.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_180..dst: Sei proprio un Alber curioso, eh? Va bene, ti portero' un po' di ingredienti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: ¡Huaaala! ¡Es mucha comida! ¡Ahora podré preparar los platos de los altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: Wow! So much food! Now I can make the same things Tall Ones eat!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Wow! Quanta roba da mangiare! Ora potro' preparare gli stessi piatti che mangiano gli Alti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: Me alegro de que te guste. ¿Podríamos seguir la conversación donde la dejamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: I'm glad you like it. Now will you tell us more?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Sono contenta che ti piaccia. Allora, possiamo continuare da dove avevamo interrotto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: Ah, sí, lo de la percepción... Claro, claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: About feeling things differently, right? Sure, let's see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Giusto, parlavamo del percepire le cose in modo diverso, vero? Certo, vediamo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: ¿Sentís paz al entrar a las zonas de vínculo de maná? ¿Cómo es eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: You feel calm when you enter manabound areas? What does that mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Vi sentite in pace quando entrate nelle zone sature di mana? Che significa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: Pues justo como dices. Cuando estamos rodeados de maná, nos sentimos a gusto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: It's exactly what it sounds like. It feels good to be surrounded by lots of mana!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Proprio come hai detto. Ci sentiamo a nostro agio quando siamo circondati da tanto mana!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: Es una sensación agradable, muy acogedora. A mí me entra hasta un poco de sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: I feel nice and cozy, and I get all sleepy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: E' una sensazione piacevole, molto confortevole. A me viene perfino un po' sonno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: Todo lo contrario que a los humanos... ¡Gracias por tu ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: Wow, but the effects on humans are totally different ... Thank you for your help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: Tutto il contrario rispetto agli umani... Grazie per il tuo aiuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..src: ¡No, gracias a ti! Bueno, ¿y qué platito debería preparar ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..ref: No, thank YOU! What yummy food should I make?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_190..dst: No, grazie a te! Allora, che piattino dovrei preparare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Se sienten en paz en las zonas de vínculo de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: What? They feel calm in manabound areas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Come? Si sentono tranquilli nelle zone legate al mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Sí. Por lo visto, sienten una calma absoluta cuando entran en una.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Yes. It seems the Alber feel mysteriously calm when they enter a manabound area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Si'. A quanto pare, gli Alber provano una calma assoluta quando entrano in una di quelle zone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Pero no hemos podido corroborar estos datos, así que no podemos confirmar que sean fiables...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: However, we weren't able to verify this information ourselves, so it does lack credibility ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Pero' non siamo riusciti a verificare di persona queste informazioni, quindi non possiamo confermarne l'attendibilita'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Claro... Pueden ser habladurías, pero sigue siendo nueva información. Además, es posible que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: No, it may just be hearsay, but it's still new information. And in addition ... it's possible that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Gia'... Potrebbero essere solo voci, ma si tratta comunque di nuove informazioni. Inoltre, e' possibile che...
Ti e' venuto in mente qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Me llama la atención que su reacción a las zonas de vínculo de maná sea tan opuesta al cansancio mental que nosotros sufrimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: I'm just curious how their reaction to manabound areas is the complete opposite of the mental strain we experience.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Mi incuriosisce che la loro reazione alle zone legate al mana sia cosi' opposta alla stanchezza mentale che proviamo noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: La forma en que el maná se relaciona con nosotros sería diferente a nivel biológico.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: The way we take in mana may be different on a biological level.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Il modo in cui il mana interagisce con noi potrebbe essere diverso a livello biologico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: ¿Podría tratarse de una resistencia al maná? O incluso que sean capaces de convertir esa energía en nutrientes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Could it be high mana resistance? Or maybe they have some way of converting mana into nutrients ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Potrebbero avere un'elevata resistenza al mana? Oppure magari riescono a convertire quell'energia in sostanze nutritive...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Para empezar, las zonas de vínculo de maná son especiales de por sí, no hay nada que se les parezca...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: In the first place, manabound areas themselves are a special environment, with nothing else quite like them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Prima di tutto, le zone legate al mana sono di per se' ambienti speciali, senza nulla di simile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Sigo pensando que aquí queda mucho por averiguar. ¡Esta investigación irá sobre ruedas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: I feel like there's still plenty more information that can only be found here. My research should progress quickly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Continuo a pensare che qui ci sia ancora molto da scoprire. Questa ricerca procedera' a gonfie vele!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Hiciste bien en venir a este sitio, Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Coming here was a good call, Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Hai fatto bene a venire qui, Wilma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Je, je, eso parece. Me emociono con solo pensar todos los descubrimientos que llevarán nuestro nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Hehe, it seems so. I'm getting quite excited thinking about what we might discover next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Eheh, a quanto pare si'. Mi emoziona solo pensare a tutte le scoperte che potremmo fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: ¿Qué tal se te dio a ti? ¿Hallaste algo interesante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: And how are things on your end? Did you come across anything interesting?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: E tu, invece? Hai trovato qualcosa di interessante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Nada digno de mención... Aparte, claro, de que los Alber de cada región tienen un modo de vida diferente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Nothing of note, other than differences in the lives of the Alber in each region ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Niente di degno di nota... A parte, ovviamente, che gli Alber di ogni regione hanno uno stile di vita diverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Sí que encontré varios restos de objetos de fabricación humana, pero no saqué nada en claro sobre ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: I did find remnants of some man-made objects, but I wasn't able to gather any information from them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Si', ho trovato diversi resti di manufatti, ma non sono riuscito a ricavarne informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Si los humanos no saben recopilar información sobre esos objetos, Flammi se presenta voluntaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Even if humans are incapable of gathering information from them, Flammi should be able to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Se gli umani non riescono a ricavare informazioni da quegli oggetti, Flammi si offre volontaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Mira que eres creída... Aunque tiene razón, deberíamos comprobar si queda algo por averiguar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: You really are overconfident ... But it's true, we should go and see if we can figure anything out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Sei proprio una montata... Pero' ha ragione, dovremmo andare a vedere se c'e' ancora qualcosa da scoprire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: Siento no haber sido de mucha ayuda...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: I apologize for not being able to contribute ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: Mi dispiace di non essere stata di grande aiuto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..src: ¡Con tu experiencia nos vale! Puedes confiarnos este tipo de tareas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..ref: Your expertise is a huge help, so just leave this kind of investigating to us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_200..dst: La tua esperienza ci e' di grande aiuto, quindi lascia a noi questo genere di indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: Entiendo... Me alegro de saber al menos que el proyecto Cultivo era real.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: I see ... It's good to know that the Harvest Project was actually real ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: Capisco... Mi fa piacere sapere almeno che il Progetto del Raccolto fosse reale...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: Al fracasar, la gente involucrada presentó un montón de quejas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: But not only did it fail, there were that many complaints about those who were involved with it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: Non solo e' fallito, ma ci sono state anche un sacco di lamentele contro chi era coinvolto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: ¿Tanto le costaba a Aladiss cosechar algo de provecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: It sounds like it was hard for even Aladiss to have a good harvest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: Ma era cosi' difficile per Aladiss ottenere un buon raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: M-me pregunto si Aladiss seguiría en pie s-si esto les hubiera salido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: I-I wonder if Aladiss would be around and thriving today if it had gone better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: M-mi chiedo se Aladiss sarebbe ancora in piedi oggi, se fosse andata meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: Mi investigación sobre el proyecto Cultivo ha llegado a su fin. Después de todo, no está relacionado con la deidad de la cosecha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: For now, my investigation into the Harvest Project will end here. It's not related to the Harvest Deity, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: La mia indagine sul Progetto del Raccolto finisce qui per ora. In fondo, non c'entra con la Divinita' del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..src: Pondré mis notas en orden y le presentaré un informe al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..ref: After I sort out the information a little more, I'll go report back to the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_250..dst: Mettero' in ordine i miei appunti e presentero' un rapporto al capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: ¡Hola! Ya me preguntaba cuándo volveríamos a compartir información. ¿Habéis averiguado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Hello there. I was actually thinking we should exchange information soon. Anything on your end?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Ciao! Mi chiedevo proprio quando avremmo condiviso di nuovo le informazioni. Voi cosa avete scoperto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Así que el proyecto Cultivo fue un fracaso... Lamento haberos enviado a investigar algo en vano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: ... I see. So the Harvest Project was a failure. I'm sorry I sent you all off on a fruitless endeavor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Quindi il Progetto del Raccolto e' stato un fallimento... Mi dispiace di avervi mandato a indagare su una cosa inutile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Yo no diría en vano, al final pudimos confirmar su existencia. Dime, ¿cómo te fue a ti?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: We were able to confirm its existence, so I wouldn't call it fruitless. Anyway, how have things gone for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Non la direi inutile, alla fine abbiamo confermato la sua esistenza. E tu, com'e' andata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Pues... no tengo nada del otro mundo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Well, it's nothing particularly shocking, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Be'... non ho niente di particolarmente scioccante, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: ¿Sabíais que existe un centro de almacenamiento de agua cerca de aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Did you know that there's a water storage facility near here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Sapevate che qui vicino esiste un impianto di stoccaggio dell'acqua?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Yes, is there something wrong with it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Si', che c'e' che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Pues que no solo contiene agua. Ese centro se llegó a usar para realizar algún tipo de prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Apparently it's not just for water. The facility was also used as a testing site for something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Il fatto e' che non contiene solo acqua. Quell'impianto e' stato usato anche come sito di test per qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: ¿De qué clase de prueba estamos hablando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: What kind of something are we talking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Di che tipo di prova stiamo parlando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: No lo sé. Quería ir a investigarlo, pero el jefe me asignó otra misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: I'm not sure. I wanted to go investigate, but I was assigned a different mission by the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Non lo so. Volevo andare a indagare, ma il capo mi ha assegnato un'altra missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Os lo cuento porque creo que sería una pena que quedara en el olvido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: But I'm letting you all know because I think it would be a shame to ignore it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Ve lo dico perche' credo che sarebbe un peccato lasciarlo nel dimenticatoio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: Gracias por el chivatazo. Si se nos presenta la oportunidad, iremos a comprobarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: Thanks for sharing. If we have a chance, we'll go check it out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Grazie per la dritta. Se ne avremo l'occasione, andremo a controllare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..src: No hay de qué. Aunque después del proyecto Cultivo, no me echéis en cara si esto tampoco es relevante, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..ref: No problem. But after how the Harvest Project lead turned out, don't hold it against me if it's nothing again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_260..dst: Non c'e' di che. Ma dopo il Progetto del Raccolto, non me ne volete se anche stavolta non e' niente, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..src: Esto es una broma de mal gusto... Fijaos en esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..ref: Huh? You've gotta be kiddin' me. Come look at this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..dst: Ma vah, dev'essere uno scherzo... Venite a vedere questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..src: ¿Eh? Creo que he visto algo así en otra ruina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..ref: Hmm? I think I've seen this in other ruins before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..dst: Eh? Credo di aver visto una cosa simile in un'altra rovina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..src: Sí, pero esta vez hay algo distinto. Y está roto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..ref: Yeah, but this one looks a little different. And broken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..dst: Si', ma questa volta c'e' qualcosa di diverso. Ed e' rotto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..src: Tal vez saquemos alguna conclusión si lo escaneamos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..ref: We might learn somethin' if we scan it though, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..dst: Forse ricaviamo qualcosa se lo scansioniamo, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..src: Sí, pero primero hay que repararlo. No podemos escanearlo en estas condiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..ref: Maybe. But we have to repair it first. We can't scan it while it's like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_270..dst: Si', ma prima bisogna ripararlo. Non possiamo scansionarlo in queste condizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_280..src: Vale, ya está como nuevo. Voy a escanearlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_280..ref: All right, it seems fixed now. Time to scan it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_280..dst: Va bene, ora e' come nuovo. E' ora di scansionarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: «Producción de homúnculos en masa»... ¿A eso se referían con «cultivo»? Es una locura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: "Mass production of homunculi" ... That's what they meant by "harvest"? This is madness.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: "Produzione di omuncoli su larga scala"... E' questo che intendevano con "raccolto"? E' una follia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Es peor que una locura... Es aterrador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: E' peggio di una follia... E' terrificante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: ¿Cómo podían hacerle eso a un ser vivo? ¡A un alma!... ¿Por qué harían algo tan desagradable?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: How could they treat a living being, a soul, like this? Why do something so repulsive ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Come potevano fare una cosa del genere a un essere vivente? A un'anima!... Perche' fare qualcosa di cosi' ripugnante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Qué horror... No sé qué pensar de todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: It really is shocking. This is just ... awful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Che orrore... Non so proprio cosa pensare di tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Me dan ganas de vomitar. Un país como ese se merece caer en la ruina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: It's sick. A country like that deserves to be destroyed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Mi viene da vomitare. Un paese simile merita di cadere in rovina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos? No podemos dejar esto aquí, ¿verdad?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: ... So now what do we do? We can't just leave this here, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: E ora che facciamo? Non possiamo lasciare questa cosa qui, vero?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: No podemos permitir que un alquimista lo vea y quiera ponerlo a prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: If an alchemist like me finds it, they can't be allowed to use it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Non possiamo permettere che un alchimista lo trovi e voglia metterlo alla prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Sé que lo normal sería informar al jefe y preguntarle cómo proceder...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: I know we normally should report to the chief and ask for directions ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Lo so, normalmente dovremmo riferirlo al capo e chiedere come procedere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Pero así correríamos un gran riesgo. Se lo contaremos cuando hayamos acabado aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: But the risk is too great. We can properly report back after it's gone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Ma cosi' correremmo un rischio troppo grande. Glielo racconteremo quando avremo finito qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Registraremos todo lo que hayamos visto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: We'll record what we saw here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Registremo tutto cio' che abbiamo visto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..src: Vaya, vaya... Menuda sorpresa. El soldadito sabe saltarse las normas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..ref: Well, well ... I think I misjudged you. I thought you always did things by the book.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_290..dst: Vabbe', vabbe'... Che sorpresa. Il soldatino sa anche saltare le regole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Esta es la verdad sobre el proyecto Cultivo... Asumo la responsabilidad por haberlo destruido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: ... This is the truth of the Harvest Project. I take full responsibility for the decision to destroy it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Questa e' la verita' sul Progetto del Raccolto... Assumo ogni responsabilita' per la decisione di distruggerlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: No pasa nada. Respeto tu decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: It's okay. I respect the decision you all made.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Non fa niente. Rispetto la decisione che avete preso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Además, si la historia llegara a los oídos equivocados, alguien podría sentir la necesidad de recuperar esos horribles métodos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Besides, if the story had gotten around to the wrong people, the project's methods may have been sought out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Inoltre, se la storia arrivasse alle orecchie sbagliate, qualcuno potrebbe sentirsi in dovere di recuperare quegli orribili metodi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Gracias, jefe...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: ... Much obliged.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Grazie, capo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Pero seguimos teniendo un grave problema entre manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: However, the problem doesn't end here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Pero' il problema non finisce qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: ¿A qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Huh? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Hay compañeros que han oído hablar del proyecto Cultivo. Al parecer, los Welleks lo comentaron de pasada, al igual que pasó en mi caso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Word of the Harvest Project has spread to the members. It seems they heard about it from the Welleks like I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Ci sono colleghi che hanno sentito parlare del Progetto del Raccolto. Pare l'abbiano saputo dai Welleks, proprio come me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Es cierto. Y tan solo por el nombre ha llamado mucho la atención. Algunos han abierto su propia investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Right. And the name has caught the attention of many. Some are now conducting their own research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: E' vero. E il solo nome ha suscitato molta attenzione. Alcuni hanno avviato una propria indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Si no se nos ocurre una historia que los desanime a seguir investigando...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: If we don't come up with a story that convinces them that there's no need for further investigation ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Se non ci venisse in mente una storia che li convinca che non serve indagare oltre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Habrá gente que no se detenga hasta dar con toda la verdad sobre el proyecto Cultivo. De una forma u otra, darán con la clave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: There may be people who don't quit searching and find out the truth behind the Harvest Project some other way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Ci sara' gente che non si fermera' fino a scoprire la verita' sul Progetto del Raccolto. In un modo o nell'altro, la trovera'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Por ejemplo, yo misma. Si siguiera pensando que el proyecto estaba relacionado con la deidad de la cosecha, no lo habría abandonado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Take me, for example. If I believed the project was tied to the Harvest Deity, I would still be investigating it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Per esempio, io stessa. Se credessi che il progetto fosse legato alla Divinita' del Raccolto, continuerei a indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Debemos elaborar una historia convincente para mantener oculto el verdadero propósito del proyecto Cultivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: We'll need a convincing tale to keep the Harvest Project's dark secret buried.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Dobbiamo elaborare una storia convincente per tenere sepolto il oscuro segreto del Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: En otras palabras: necesitamos una tapadera. No me apasiona la idea de engañar al equipo, pero me temo que no hay alternativa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: To be clear, we need a cover-up. I don't feel good about deceiving the team, but I fear there's no better option.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: In altre parole: ci serve una copertura. Non mi piace l'idea di ingannare la squadra, ma temo non ci siano alternative.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Sin embargo, inventarnos una historia no va a ser tarea fácil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: However, coming up with a story that will convince everyone won't be easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Pero' inventarci una storia che convinca tutti non sara' per nulla facile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Una historia que resulte creíble...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Something that will convince everyone, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Una storia che convinca tutti, eh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: ¿Y si fuera un plan para repoblar de árboles y plantas el páramo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: What if it was about reforesting the wastelands? Going to plant trees and stuff?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: E se fosse un piano per riforestare le terre desolate? Andare a piantare alberi e simili?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Podría ser. Enriquecer el suelo sería algo positivo y encaja con la idea de «cultivar» nuevas especies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: That might work. Enriching the land would be a good thing, and befitting of the name "Harvest Project."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Potrebbe funzionare. Arricchire la terra sarebbe una cosa positiva, e adatta al nome "Progetto del Raccolto".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: ¿Y si fuera un plan para paliar el hambre que sufría la población? Un cultivo abundante de alimento que acabara con la inanición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: What if it was a plan to fight starvation? A bountiful harvest means no one goes hungry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: E se fosse un piano per alleviare la fame che soffriva la popolazione? Un raccolto abbondante che mettesse fine alla carestia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: El nombre se explicaría solo y eso hace que sea más creíble. Tampoco sería raro que un país tuviera un proyecto para tal fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: It's the most obvious explanation, but that would make it believable. You could find that policy in any country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: E' la spiegazione piu' ovvia, ma proprio per questo sarebbe credibile. Non sarebbe strano che un paese avesse un progetto del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: ¿Y si quisieran enriquecer la cultura del país? Suena a algo que promovería Aladiss, ¿verdad? Cultivar la sabiduría y el estudio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: What if it were about enriching the country with wisdom? That kind of thing sounds pretty Aladissian, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: E se volessero arricchire la cultura del paese? Sembra qualcosa che Aladiss promuoverebbe, vero? Coltivare la saggezza e lo studio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Tienes razón, Aladiss estaría dispuesta a algo así. Después de todo, hablamos de una nación que floreció gracias a la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: True, that wouldn't have been strange for Aladiss. It was a country that flourished thanks to alchemy, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Hai ragione, per Aladiss sarebbe stato plausibile. Dopotutto, parliamo di una nazione fiorita grazie all'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Para darle más credibilidad, podríamos comenzar a usar un proyecto con ese nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: To give it more credibility, we should start implementing it ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Per dargli piu' credibilita', potremmo cominciare a metterlo in pratica noi stessi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..src: Vale, pues manos a la obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..ref: Right. Let's get to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_300..dst: Va bene, allora mettiamoci al lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..src: Listo. Ahora podrán guardar suficientes alimentos durante mucho más tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..ref: All right, now they should be able to keep plenty of food here safely for long periods of time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..dst: Fatto. Ora potranno conservare cibo a sufficienza in sicurezza per molto tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..ref: Now all that's left is filling it up with food.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..dst: Si', ora non resta che riempirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..src: Eso es responsabilidad de los que viven aquí. Para conseguir una buena cosecha, todo el mundo debe esforzarse por igual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..ref: That's up to the efforts of those who live here. A good harvest involves everyone putting in work together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_310..dst: Quella e' responsabilita' di chi vive qui. Per ottenere un buon raccolto, tutti devono impegnarsi allo stesso modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..src: ¿Qué os parece? Me temo que no he podido insonorizarla ni decorarla como me gustaría...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..ref: How does this look? Unfortunately, I wasn't able to make it perfectly soundproof or anything fancy, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..dst: Che ve ne pare? Temo di non essere riuscita a insonorizzarla ne' ad abbellirla come avrei voluto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..src: No te preocupes. A los eruditos les encanta tener un lugar donde aprender, relajarse y centrarse en sus estudios. La decoración es lo de menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..ref: No problem. For those who are serious about learning, having a place to relax and focus on studying is enough.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..dst: Non preoccuparti. Per chi studia sul serio, avere un posto dove rilassarsi e concentrarsi sugli studi e' piu' che sufficiente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..src: Además, si fuera demasiado acogedora, ¡se quedarían dormidos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..ref: Not to mention, if it's too cozy, everyone might fall asleep!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..dst: Per non parlare del fatto che, se fosse troppo accogliente, tutti potrebbero addormentarsi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..src: C-claro... Bueno, ya está todo listo. Buen trabajo, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..ref: R-right ... Well, preparations are done now. Good work, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_320..dst: G-giusto... Beh, ora e' tutto pronto. Buon lavoro, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: Qué buena noticia. Ahora podéis tomaros un merecido descanso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: That's great news. We can rest easy for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Che bella notizia. Ora potete prendervi un meritato riposo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: He comunicado al resto de compañeros los detalles sobre el nuevo proyecto Cultivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: I've let the other team members know the details of the new Harvest Project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Ho comunicato al resto dei compagni i dettagli del nuovo Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: Como solo conocían el nombre, todos se han creído nuestra historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: Since all that was known was the name, everyone seems to be convinced.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Dato che conoscevano solo il nome, tutti ci hanno creduto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: Hemos conseguido que una tragedia sea una bendición. El equipo de investigación tomará las riendas del proyecto Cultivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: We've turned a tragedy into a blessing with this one. The Research Team will continue this Harvest Project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Siamo riusciti a trasformare una tragedia in una benedizione. La Squadra di Ricerca prendera' in mano il Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: La palabra «cultivo» tiene muchos significados. Si se os ocurre alguna idea que encaje, tenéis libertad para llevarla a cabo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: "Harvest" doesn't have to refer to just one thing. If you come up with anything else, go ahead and make it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: La parola "raccolto" ha molti significati. Se vi venisse in mente qualche altra idea adatta, siete liberi di realizzarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: Si seguimos así, el proyecto será cada vez más convincente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: If we continue to do that moving forward, the project will become more and more convincing, I imagine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Se continueremo cosi', il progetto diventera' sempre piu' convincente, immagino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..src: Entendido. Si vemos algo que podría mejorar y cultivarse, pondremos en marcha este proyecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..ref: Got it. If we find a place where something can be done or fixed up, we'll do it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_330..dst: Capito. Se troviamo qualcosa che si possa migliorare e coltivare, metteremo in pratica il progetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: Chief, how has the Harvest Project been going?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: Capo, come va il Progetto del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..src: Va bien. Todos están encantados con los preparativos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: It's been going well. Everyone seems to like the new Harvest Project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: Va bene. Tutti sembrano apprezzare il nuovo Progetto del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..src: Y no solo eso, hay compañeros que han querido poner su granito de arena. Te has ganado un buen número de admiradores, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: Not only that, but some people have been making things lately too. It seems they admire you, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: E non solo, alcuni compagni hanno voluto dare una mano. Pare che tu abbia accumulato molti ammiratori, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..src: Les has inspirado al verte enriquecer de esta manera sus vidas. Ahora todo el mundo quiere fabricar muebles y todo tipo de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: Seeing you make things to enrich our lives inspired them, so making furniture and the like has become popular.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: Li ha ispirati vederti creare cose per arricchire le nostre vite. Ora tutti vogliono fabbricare mobili e ogni tipo di cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..src: Incluso usan sus creaciones para intercambiar bienes. Si os llama la atención, id a verlo con vuestros propios ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: They also use their prized creations for bartering. If you're interested, why not take a look yourself?
