eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Ehi, Flammi. Quando dice che dobbiamo dimostrare di voler imparare, intende forse...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Entendido. No hay pruebas definitivas, pero Flammi opina que merece la pena intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Understood. There is no definite proof, but Flammi thinks that plan is worth trying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Ricevuto. Non ci sono prove certe, ma Flammi pensa che valga la pena provare quel piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Sin embargo, las funciones actuales de Flammi no son suficientes. Se requieren piezas adicionales especialmente optimizadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: However, Flammi's current output is not sufficient. Specially tuned additional parts are required.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Tuttavia, le funzioni attuali di Flammi non sono sufficienti. Servono componenti aggiuntivi appositamente ottimizzati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Vale... Bueno, vamos a intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: ... All right. Then let's give it a try.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Va bene... Allora proviamoci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_060..src: Yumia, apunta a la «ilusión» y dispara la munición de escaneo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_060..ref: Yumia, aim at the "illusion" and fire the Scan Ammo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_060..dst: Yumia, mira all'"illusione" e spara le munizioni di scansione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..src: Con la munición de escaneo, podremos lidiar fácilmente con cualquier ilusión que aparezca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..ref: By utilizing Scan Ammo, any other illusions that appear can easily be dealt with in the same way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..dst: Usando le munizioni di scansione, potremo affrontare facilmente allo stesso modo tutte le altre illusioni che dovessero apparire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..src: Bueno, la puerta ya está abierta. ¿Entramos o qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..ref: Anyway, the gate's open now. C'mon, let's get goin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_070..dst: Comunque, il cancello e' aperto. Forza, andiamo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_080..dst: Incredibile! Ci sono nuvole sotto i nostri piedi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_080..ref: Amazing! There are clouds at our feet!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_080..src: ¡Así que este es el Campo de entrenamiento de Idus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_080..dst: Quindi questo e' il Campo di addestramento di Idus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Oh, peregrinos que visitáis el campo de entrenamiento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: O pellegrini giunti a questo campo di addestramento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Me llamo Astasha y soy guía de Idus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: My name is Astasha, guide of Idus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Mi chiamo Astasha e sono la guida di Idus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: ¡Un guía! Eso significa que pertenece al clan Flumme...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: A guide! Then that means they're from the Flumme clan ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Una guida! Allora dev'essere del clan Flumme...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Si ansiáis descubrir los secretos de los Welleks, deberéis superar tres pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: Should you wish to obtain the secrets of the Welleks, you must pass three trials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Se desiderate ottenere i segreti dei Welleks, dovrete superare tre prove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Si lo lográis, vuestras almas se volverán nobles y dignas de dichos misterios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: In so doing, you shall prove your souls worthy of being conferred these secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Cosi' facendo, dimostrerete che le vostre anime sono degne di ricevere questi segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Parece que lo que queda de la voluntad de este guía nos considera peregrinos en entrenamiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: It seems that the lingering will of the guide sees us as pilgrims here for training.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Sembra che la volonta' residua della guida ci consideri pellegrini venuti qui per addestrarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Antes Flammi detectó una gran cantidad de maná más adelante. Es probable que fueran las pruebas que ha mencionado Astasha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: Earlier, Flammi detected a large amount of mana being activated ahead. That was likely the trials which Astasha mentioned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Poco fa, Flammi ha rilevato una grande quantita' di mana attivarsi piu' avanti. Probabilmente si trattava delle prove menzionate da Astasha.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Ya veo. Básicamente, tenemos que seguir su guía y superar las tres pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: I see. In other words, we have to follow the guidance and pass the three trials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Capisco. In altre parole, dobbiamo seguire le indicazioni e superare le tre prove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Las pruebas son de hace cientos de años, ¿no? Me sorprende que sigan funcionando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: The trials are from hundreds of years ago, right? It's surprising that they still work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Le prove risalgono a centinaia di anni fa, giusto? Mi sorprende che funzionino ancora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Conque los secretos de los Welleks, ¿eh? ¡La cosa se pone interesante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: The secrets of the Welleks, huh? Now this is gettin' good!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: I segreti dei Wellek, eh? Ora si' che si fa interessante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: No estamos aquí por el tesoro, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: We're not here for treasure, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Non siamo qui per il tesoro, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: No me ha quedado claro lo que ha querido decir con «pruebas» y «secretos de los Welleks».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: I'm not sure what he meant by the Welleks' secrets or trials ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Non mi e' chiaro cosa intendesse con "prove" e "segreti dei Wellek"...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Pero, si nos lleva a cualquier información que dejaran los antiguos Welleks, ¡nuestro deber como miembros del equipo de investigación es investigarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: But if it leads to important information left behind by ancient Welleks, it's our duty as members of the Research Team to look into it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Ma se ci portera' a scoprire informazioni importanti lasciate dagli antichi Wellek, e' nostro dovere, in quanto membri della Squadra di Ricerca, indagare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Sí, pero hay que tener cuidado. La palabra «prueba» implica que nos aguarda alguna amenaza desconocida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: Yes, but we must be careful. The word trial strongly implies that unknown threats await us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Si', ma dobbiamo fare attenzione. La parola "prova" lascia intendere che ci attenda una minaccia sconosciuta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..src: Para empezar, vamos a dirigirnos hacia la prueba que detectó Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..ref: First, let's head towards the trial that Flammi noticed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_090..dst: Per cominciare, dirigiamoci verso la prova che ha individuato Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..src: La primera prueba está justo en frente, ¿no? Pero desde aquí no podemos llegar a pie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: The first trial is just ahead, right? But we can't reach that foothold from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..dst: La prima prova e' proprio li' davanti, giusto? Ma da qui non possiamo raggiungere quel punto d'appoggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..src: Quizá haya otra forma de acceder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: Perhaps we should look around for a way across?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..dst: Forse dovremmo cercare un modo per arrivarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..src: Nunca había visto un vial de recuerdos con este diseño... Flammi, ¿puedes comprobar su contenido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: I haven't seen a Memory Vial with this design before ... Flammi, can you check its contents for us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..dst: Non avevo mai visto una Fiala della Memoria con questo design... Flammi, puoi controllarne il contenuto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: Understood. Scanning the Memory Vial now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..dst: Ricevuto. Scansione della Fiala della Memoria in corso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..src: Parece que no se trata de una simple grabación de recuerdos, sino la llave para activar una ilusión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: It appears that this isn't simply a memory recording, but a key to activating an illusion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..dst: Sembra che non sia una semplice registrazione di ricordi, ma una chiave per attivare un'illusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_100..ref: Yes. Try it for yourself, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..src: Ya veo, hay partes de la ilusión que deben activarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..ref: I see, so there are things that need to be activated within the illusion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..dst: Capisco, quindi ci sono parti dell'illusione che devono essere attivate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..src: Sí. Sin embargo, la llave se ha agotado. Hay que tener muy en cuenta dónde ha de utilizarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..ref: Yes. However, that key has been used up. Proper consideration about where to use them must be taken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..dst: Si'. Tuttavia, quella chiave si e' esaurita. Bisogna valutare attentamente dove usarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..src: Lo pillo. No la usaré de forma precipitada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..ref: Got it. I'll make sure not to use them recklessly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..dst: Capito. Faro' attenzione a non usarla con leggerezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..src: Bueno, los caminos ya están unidos. A por la primera prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..ref: Anyways, the paths are connected now. Let's go to the first trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_110..dst: Comunque, ora i sentieri sono collegati. Andiamo alla prima prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Peregrinos que os enfrentáis a esta prueba, usad el poder de la creatividad para abriros camino hacia los misterios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Pilgrims attempting this trial. Use your creative power to clear a path toward the secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Pellegrini che affrontate questa prova, usate il vostro potere creativo per aprirvi la strada verso i segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Depositad las herramientas adecuadas, bañadas en poder alquímico, como ofrendas en estos tres altares.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Make proper offerings of tools infused with alchemical power on these three altars.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Offrite gli strumenti giusti, intrisi di potere alchemico, su questi tre altari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Esa hazaña os abrirá las puertas del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Do so, and the path will open.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Fatelo e il cammino si aprira'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Así que esta es la primera prueba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: I see ... So this is the first trial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Capisco... Questa e' la prima prova?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Is that all the explanation we get?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: E' tutto qui quello che ci spiegano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: ¿Os acordáis de la puerta? Pensar por nosotros mismos es parte de la prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Remember the gate? Thinkin' for ourselves is part of the trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Ricordate il portale? Ragionare con la nostra testa fa parte della prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Hay que dejar las herramientas adecuadas, bañadas en poder alquímico, en los tres altares... ¿Qué querrá decir eso de «adecuadas»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Offer tools infused with alchemical power on three altars ... "Proper" may refer to specific conditions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Dobbiamo offrire strumenti intrisi di potere alchemico sui tre altari... "Giusti" potrebbe riferirsi a delle condizioni specifiche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..src: Ahora que lo dices, creo que he visto algo en el altar de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..ref: Now that you mention it, I believe I saw something like an altar back there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_120..dst: Ora che me lo dici, credo di aver visto qualcosa che somigliava a un altare laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: Así que esta es una de las pruebas... Parece que es aquí donde tenemos que dejar uno de los objetos como ofrenda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..ref: So this is one of the trials ... It seems this is where we offer one of the requested items.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Quindi questa e' una delle prove... A quanto pare, e' qui che dobbiamo lasciare uno degli oggetti come offerta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: No ha sido muy considerado que digamos darnos esa única pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..ref: It's quite unkind to only give us this as our sole hint.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Non e' stato molto gentile darci un solo indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: Si fuera una antorcha, no habría mencionado la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..ref: If it were a torch, then it wouldn't have mentioned alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Se fosse una torcia, non avrebbe parlato di alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: Pero tampoco tengo claro que sea un arma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..ref: I'm not sure that it's a weapon, either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Ma non sono nemmeno sicura che si tratti di un'arma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: ¡No pasa nada, Lenja! ¡Has hecho bien en dar tu opinión!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Non preoccuparti, Lenja! Hai fatto bene a dire la tua!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..ref: It's okay, Lenja! It's great that you shared your opinion!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: Mmm. Es como que entiendo una parte, pero otra no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Mmm. Mi sembra di aver capito una cosa, ma l'altra no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..src: ¡Hay que poner esas cabezas a funcionar! Al fin y al cabo, es una prueba. ¡Tenemos que trabajar en equipo para pasarla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_130..dst: Mettiamoci a ragionare! In fondo e' una prova. Dobbiamo collaborare per superarla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..src: Oh, peregrinos que visitáis el campo de entrenamiento, habéis encarnado el poder de la creatividad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..ref: Pilgrims to these training grounds. You have demonstrated your creative power.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..dst: Oh, pellegrini giunti in questo campo di addestramento, avete dimostrato il vostro potere creativo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..src: Os concederé la oportunidad de enfrentaros a la siguiente prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..ref: I grant you the right to attempt the next trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..dst: Vi concedo il diritto di affrontare la prossima prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..src: El circulador es viejo, pero todavía funciona. Podemos usarlo para despejar la zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..ref: This circulator is old, but it is still operational. It can be used to clear the manabound area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..dst: Questo circolatore e' vecchio, ma funziona ancora. Possiamo usarlo per liberare l'area satura di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..src: ¿Será una recompensa por haber superado la primera prueba? Vamos a activarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..ref: Maybe it's a reward for clearing the first trial? Let's activate it now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_140..dst: Sara' una ricompensa per aver superato la prima prova? Attiviamolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..src: Parece que se ha abierto el camino a una nueva zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..ref: It appears that a path to a new area has opened.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..dst: Sembra che si sia aperto il passaggio verso una nuova zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..src: Bueno, vamos a ver qué prueba nos aguarda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..ref: Now then, let's see what trial awaits us next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..dst: Bene, vediamo quale prova ci attende.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..src: El objetivo de estas pruebas era evaluar el poder de los alquimistas. Será mejor que confiemos en las capacidades de Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..ref: These were originally trials to test an alchemist's power. We'll likely have to rely on Yumia to proceed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..dst: Queste prove servivano a mettere alla prova le capacita' degli alchimisti. Per proseguire, dovremo affidarci a Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..src: Pero todos tenemos que poner de nuestra parte y cooperar para avanzar con la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..ref: However, we should be able to help as well. Let's work together and continue investigating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_150..dst: Tuttavia, anche noi possiamo dare una mano. Collaboriamo e continuiamo le nostre ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: Peregrinos que afrontáis esta prueba, confiad en vuestras piernas y vuestros conocimientos para despejar el camino hacia los secretos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: Pilgrims attempting this trial. Rely on your legs and insight to clear a path toward the secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: Pellegrini che affrontate questa prova, affidatevi alle gambe e all'ingegno per aprire la via verso i segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: Viajad a los cuatro altares de la zona de la segunda prueba y que se haga en ellos la luz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: Journey to the four altars hidden within the second trial area and give them light.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: Raggiungete i quattro altari nascosti nell'area della seconda prova e fate risplendere la loro luce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: Esa hazaña os abrirá las puertas del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: Do so, and the path will open.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: Fatelo e il cammino si aprira'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: Mmm, está claro lo que tenemos que hacer: encontrar los altares e iluminarlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: Hm, it's clear what we need to do—simply find the altars and light them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: Mmh, e' chiaro cosa dobbiamo fare: trovare gli altari e illuminarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: Pero no tenemos pistas sobre su ubicación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: As for hints about where they are ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: Quanto a indizi sulla loro posizione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..src: (¿Serán esos fantasmas pistas para encontrar los altares? Tenemos que ir reuniendo información mientras los buscamos.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..ref: (Are those phantoms clues to finding the altars? Let's gather information as we look for them.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_160..dst: (Quei fantasmi saranno indizi per trovare gli altari? Raccogliamo informazioni mentre li cerchiamo.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..src: Peregrinos que os enfrentáis a esta prueba, vuestro disciplinado peregrinaje ha concluido. Os concedo la oportunidad de afrontar la siguiente prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..ref: Pilgrims attempting this trial. Your righteous pilgrimage is complete. I grant you the right to attempt the next trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..dst: Pellegrini che affrontate questa prova, il vostro devoto pellegrinaggio e' giunto al termine. Vi concedo il diritto di affrontare la prova successiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..src: Podéis avanzar a la tercera prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..ref: You may proceed to the third trial.
All right, we made it through.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..src: Vamos a activar el circulador y a pasar a la siguiente prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..ref: Let's activate the circulator and move on to the next trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_170..dst: Attiviamo il circolatore e passiamo alla prova successiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..src: Ya se puede acceder a la tercera zona de pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..ref: The third trial area can now be accessed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..dst: Ora e' possibile accedere all'area della terza prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..ref: Phew, we've finally made it this far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..dst: Uff, finalmente siamo arrivati fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..src: Si estáis cansados, podemos volver a por suministros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..ref: If you're tired, we can head back for supplies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..dst: Se siete stanchi, possiamo tornare a fare rifornimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..src: Sí. No sabemos en qué consistirá la tercera prueba. Hay que hacer bien los preparativos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..ref: Yes. We don't know what the third trial will require. Let's be sure to make careful preparations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_180..dst: Si'. Non sappiamo cosa ci riservera' la terza prova. Prepariamoci per bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..src: Peregrinos que afrontáis esta prueba, reunid vuestro coraje para abrir el camino de los secretos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..ref: Pilgrims attempting this trial. Gather your courage and open a path to the secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..dst: Pellegrini che affrontate questa prova, fatevi coraggio e aprite la via ai segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..src: Lograd que el poder de la alquimia acabe con los males que acechan estos altares.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..ref: Drive out the great fiends standing before the altars using the power of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..dst: Sconfiggete con il potere dell'alchimia i grandi demoni che si ergono davanti agli altari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..src: Esa hazaña os abrirá las puertas del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..ref: Do so, and the path will open.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..dst: Fatelo e il cammino si aprira'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..ref: Where did these all come from?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..dst: Ma da dove sono sbucati tutti?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..src: ¿Qué les pasa a estas criaturas? Parecen...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_190..ref: What's with these things? They look—
Get ready, everyone! Here they come!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Qué monstruos más extraños! ¡Nuestros ataques no funcionan!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: These monsters really are weird! Our attacks aren't working!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Questi mostri sono davvero strani! I nostri attacchi non funzionano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Tiene que haber algo que podamos hacer! ¡Chicos, fortaleced vuestras defensas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: There's got to be something we can do! Everyone, strengthen your defenses!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Ci deve essere qualcosa che possiamo fare! Tutti, rinforzate le difese!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡A-atrás!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: S-stay away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: S-stai lontano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Lenja!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Aggg!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Ngh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Agg!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Ja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Hah!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Eh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡Chicos! ¡Usad las herramientas que os fabriqué!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Everyone! Use the tools I made you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Ragazzi! Usate gli strumenti che vi ho preparato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Chist, ¿esto es lo que tenemos que hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Tch, that's what we gotta do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Tsk, quindi e' questo che dobbiamo fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Las armas normales no hacen efecto, ¿cómo puede ser?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: How could attacks using normal weapons not work?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Com'e' possibile che gli attacchi con armi normali non funzionino?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Parece que los monstruos de la tercera zona de pruebas están protegidos por un poder especial, pero no sé cómo funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: The monsters in the third trial area appear to be protected by a special power, though how it works is unknown.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: I mostri nella terza area di prova sembrano protetti da un potere speciale, ma non sappiamo come funzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Los ataques normales no tienen efecto. Solo pueden ser derrotados por las herramientas que ha creado Yumia con alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Normal attacks have no effect. Only tools created by Yumia's alchemy can defeat them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Gli attacchi normali non hanno effetto. Solo gli strumenti creati con l'alchimia di Yumia possono sconfiggerli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Así que esta es la tercera prueba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: So this is the third trial ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Quindi questa e' la terza prova...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¿Te has hecho daño, Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Are you hurt, Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Ti sei fatta male, Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: N-no, la señorita Yumia me ha protegido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: N-no. Miss Yumia protected me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: N-no, la Signorina Yumia mi ha protetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Pero no he sido de ayuda una vez más...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: But I wasn't any help again ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Ma non sono stata d'aiuto neanche stavolta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: ¡No digas eso, los monstruos han salido de la nada! ¡Le podría haber pasado a cualquiera!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Don't say that, those monsters came out of nowhere! It could happen to anyone!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Non dire cosi', quei mostri sono spuntati dal nulla! Sarebbe potuto succedere a chiunque!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Pero la situación se ha puesto peligrosa. Preparaos bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: But the situation's gotten dangerous. Everyone, be sure you're thoroughly prepared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Ma la situazione si e' fatta pericolosa. Preparatevi tutti per bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Sin las herramientas de Yumia, no habríamos podido protegernos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Without Yumia's tools, we'll have no means of protecting ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Senza gli strumenti di Yumia, non avremo modo di difenderci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Deberíamos planear una vía de escape, por si acaso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: We should also have an escape planned, just in case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Dovremmo anche pianificare una via di fuga, per ogni evenienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: (Tengo que garantizar que todo el mundo tenga herramientas y fabricar más si no son suficientes...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: (I need to make sure that everyone has tools, and make more if we don't have enough ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: (Devo assicurarmi che tutti abbiano degli strumenti e fabbricarne altri, se non ne abbiamo abbastanza...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..src: Bueno, ya sabemos de qué va esta prueba. Cuidado con los monstruos mientras buscamos el altar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..ref: Anyways, we know what this trial is about. Let's watch out for monsters as we search for the altar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_200..dst: Comunque, sappiamo gia' in cosa consiste questa prova. Facciamo attenzione ai mostri mentre cerchiamo l'altare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¿En qué estás pensando, Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: What are you thinking about, Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: A cosa stai pensando, Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Llevas un buen rato pensativa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I feel like you've been lost in thought for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: E' da un po' che sei pensierosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¡S-siento estar distraída!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I-I'm sorry for spacing out ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: S-scusa se mi sono distratta!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: No, no es una regañina. Solo quería que supieras que estoy aquí para escucharte, si necesitas hablar de cualquier cosa que te preocupe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: No, I'm not scolding you. I just thought that if there's something bothering you, I could maybe hear you out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: No, non ti sto rimproverando. Volevo solo dirti che sono qui per ascoltarti, se hai bisogno di parlare di qualcosa che ti preoccupa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Este lugar alberga elementos importantes de la historia de los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Um ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Questo luogo custodisce elementi importanti della storia dei Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¡Así que quiero sentir que he conseguido algo aquí! O eso pensaba al principio, porque no he tenido ninguna suerte...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: This place contains important history for the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Voglio riuscire a fare qualcosa qui! O almeno, e' quello che pensavo all'inizio, ma non ho avuto fortuna...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: No he servido de nada, ni siquiera durante las pruebas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: So, I want to accomplish something here! Or at least, that's what I thought, but I haven't had any luck ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Non sono stata di nessun aiuto, nemmeno durante le prove...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Creo que en parte eso se debe a que las pruebas se diseñaron para alquimistas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Even during the trials, I've been completely useless ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Credo che sia anche perche' le prove sono state pensate per gli alchimisti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Pero has servido de mucho. No podría haber superado las pruebas por mi cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I think part of it is that these trials were originally meant for alchemists ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Ma sei stata di grande aiuto. Non avrei potuto superare le prove da sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¿Lo dices en serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: But you haven't been useless at all. There's no way I could have overcome these trials on my own.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Dici sul serio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Siempre me pasa lo mismo. Cuanto más me esfuerzo, peor me salen las cosas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Is that really true?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Mi succede sempre. Piu' mi impegno, peggio mi vanno le cose...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Acabo dando vueltas en círculo. Nada me sale bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: This always happens. The harder I try, the more I fail ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Finisco per girare in tondo. Non me ne va bene una.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: No pretendo quitarle hierro al asunto y decirte que no te preocupes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I just end up going in circles. Nothing ever goes well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Non voglio sminuire la cosa e dirti di non preoccuparti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Pero a nadie le sale todo bien siempre. Yo incluida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: It isn't my place to say something lighthearted like, "Don't worry about it!" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Ma nessuno riesce sempre in tutto. Nemmeno io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Todo el mundo tiene que enfrentarse a fracasos en mayor o menor medida. Y mucha gente se desanima cuando eso ocurre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: But nobody succeeds all the time. Not me, not anyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Tutti devono affrontare dei fallimenti, chi piu' chi meno. E molti si scoraggiano quando succede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¿De verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Everyone experiences failure to some degree. And plenty of people get disheartened by it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Je, je, pues claro. Nadie es perfecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Eheh, certo. Nessuno e' perfetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Yo misma tengo la mala costumbre de darles demasiadas vueltas a las cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Hehe, it's true. Nobody's perfect.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Anch'io ho la cattiva abitudine di rimuginare troppo sulle cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Pero, cuando estoy en un aprieto, tengo la ayuda de mis amigos. Como debe ser, ¿no crees?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I have the bad habit of brooding over things on my own.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Ma quando mi trovo in difficolta', posso contare sull'aiuto dei miei amici. E' cosi' che dovrebbe essere, non credi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¿Q-qué pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: But when I'm in a pinch, my friends support me. That's the way it should be, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: C-che succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Estaba pensando en lo maravillosa que eres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Wow ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Stavo pensando a quanto sei meravigliosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: P-pero... Me he dado cuenta de que quizá no sea buena idea estar todo el tiempo admirándote.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: Wh-what's wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: M-ma... Mi sono resa conto che forse non e' una buona idea starti sempre ad ammirare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Eso es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: I was thinking about how amazing you are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Esatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: Ya nos acercamos al final de las pruebas. ¡Vamos a dar el último empujón!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: B-but ... I realize that constantly admiring you might not be the best thing to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Ormai siamo vicini alla fine delle prove. Diamoci dentro per l'ultimo tratto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..src: ¡Sí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..ref: That's good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_210..dst: Si'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..src: Oh, peregrinos que visitáis el campo de entrenamiento, habéis derrotado esos males con valentía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..ref: Pilgrims to these training grounds. You have shown bravery in defeating the fiends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..dst: Pellegrini giunti a questo campo di addestramento, avete dimostrato coraggio sconfiggendo quei demoni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..src: Os brindaré la oportunidad de acceder a los secretos de los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..ref: I shall grant you the right to reach the Welleks' secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..dst: Vi concedero' il diritto di accedere ai segreti dei Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..ref: Phew ... We've finally cleared all three trials!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_220..dst: Uf... Abbiamo superato tutte e tre le prove!
Ci abbiamo messo un bel po'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..src: Ese parece el destino definitivo de las pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..ref: That looks like the final destination of the trials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..dst: Quello sembra essere la destinazione finale delle prove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..src: Ya era hora. Estoy harto de esperar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..ref: About time. I'm sick of waitin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..dst: Finalmente. Mi sono stufato di aspettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..src: Bueno, vamos a ver qué nos aguarda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..ref: All right, let's go see what awaits us there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_230..dst: Bene, andiamo a vedere cosa ci aspetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..src: Hay un monstruo gigante atrapado... ¿Esto tiene que ver con las pruebas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..ref: A giant monster has been sealed away ... Is this related to the trials?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..dst: Un mostro gigante e' stato sigillato... Ha a che fare con le prove?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..src: ¡Eh, este no era el trato! El fantasma dijo que solo eran tres pruebas, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..ref: Hey, this wasn't the deal! Didn't that phantom say there were only three?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..dst: Ehi, non era questo l'accordo! Quel fantasma non aveva detto che le prove erano solo tre?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..src: P-puede que no sea un monstruo enemigo, sino una criatura relacionada con la historia de los Welleks...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..ref: I-it's possible that this isn't an enemy monster, but a creature related to the Welleks' history ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..dst: P-potrebbe non essere un mostro nemico, ma una creatura legata alla storia dei Wellek...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..src: No tiene pinta de venir en son de paz.
No, no parece pacífico en absoluto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..dst: Mh, di certo non sembra pacifico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..ref: At least try to sound worried, Nina!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..dst: Almeno fai finta di essere preoccupata, Nina!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_240..ref: Get ready, everyone! Here it comes!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Puf... Lo conseguimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Phew ... We did it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Uf... Ce l'abbiamo fatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¡Qué susto! ¿A qué ha venido eso? ¿Una prueba extra?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: That scared me! What was that, a bonus trial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Che spavento! Che cos'era, una prova extra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: No lo sé. Pero, sin duda, no era un monstruo normal y corriente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I don't know. But clearly, it was no normal monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Non lo so. Ma di certo non era un mostro comune.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¿Es... el fantasma de Astasha?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Is that ... Astasha's phantom?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: E'... il fantasma di Astasha?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Peregrinos que habéis superado las pruebas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Pilgrims who have cleared the trials ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Pellegrini che avete superato le prove...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Os debo mis más sinceros agradecimientos por haber detenido a El olvidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: You have my sincere thanks for quelling The Forgotten One.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Vi sono sinceramente grato per aver fermato il Dimenticato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Tras permanecer aquí tanto tiempo, al fin puedo volver a la tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I, who have lingered here for eons, may finally return to the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Io, che ho indugiato qui per eoni, posso finalmente tornare alla terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¿V-volver?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: R-return ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: T-tornare...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Esa bestia absorbió las inmensas cantidades de maná que quedaban en este lugar y adquirió unas dimensiones fuera de lo normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: That beast grew abnormally large by absorbing the vast quantities of mana that remained here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Quella bestia e' cresciuta a dismisura assorbendo le immense quantita' di mana rimaste qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Utilicé el poder que me quedaba para atraparlo. Si se hubiera roto, habría desatado un verdadero desastre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I used my remaining power to create a seal, but if it broke, a great disaster may have occurred.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ho usato il potere che mi restava per sigillarlo. Se il sigillo si fosse spezzato, avrebbe potuto scatenarsi un vero disastro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Ha sido una suerte que os hayáis encargado de él antes de que eso sucediera, pero siento haber empleado estas venerables pruebas con tal fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: That you were able to deal with it before that happened was fortunate, but I apologize for using the noble trials to that end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Siete stati fortunati a occuparvene prima che accadesse, ma mi dispiace aver usato queste venerabili prove a tale scopo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Esta es una de las últimas reliquias que quedan en el territorio. Como recompensa, tenéis mi bendición para llevárosla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: This is one of the land's remaining relics. As a reward, you may take it with my blessing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Questa e' una delle ultime reliquie rimaste in queste terre. Come ricompensa, vi concedo la mia benedizione: potete prenderla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Je, je... ¡Esto es lo que yo quería!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Heh heh ... This is what I've been waitin' for!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Eheh... E' proprio quello che aspettavo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: La historia de los Welleks está marcada por el fracaso. Tanto ahora como en el pasado, hemos cometido un error tras otro. Este es uno de ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: The history of the Welleks is one of failure. Then, as now, fault piled on top of fault. This is another such example.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: La storia dei Wellek e' segnata dai fallimenti. Tanto allora quanto oggi, a un errore se ne e' aggiunto un altro. Anche questo e' un esempio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Pero Idus tampoco era inalterable. Su estado estaba en constante cambio y las disputas entre clanes eran constantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Idus too is not a monolith. Its state ever shifted, and quarrels between the clans never ceased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Eppure neanche Idus era immutabile. La sua situazione cambiava continuamente e le dispute tra i clan non finivano mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Pero superamos muchos fracasos para construir nuestra civilización. Nuestras incontables cicatrices nos transformaron en vigorosos guerreros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: But we overcame many failures to build our civilization. Our countless scars transform us into stronger warriors.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ma abbiamo superato molti fallimenti per costruire la nostra civilta'. Le nostre innumerevoli cicatrici ci hanno resi guerrieri piu' forti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Nuestros defectos nos permiten alcanzar un futuro mejor, aprender de ellos y convertirlos en las lecciones del mañana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: All of our faults serve to better the future. Learn from them, and carry those lessons into tomorrow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Tutti i nostri errori contribuiscono a migliorare il futuro. Imparate da essi e portate con voi quelle lezioni nel domani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Oh, peregrinos. Os congratulo una vez más por superar las pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: O pilgrims. Once again, I congratulate you on clearing the trials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Oh, pellegrini. Mi congratulo ancora una volta con voi per aver superato le prove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Los Welleks que crearon la alquimia jamás imaginaron que esta sería capaz de destruir un país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: The Welleks who created alchemy never thought it would cause a country to be destroyed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: I Wellek che crearono l'alchimia non avrebbero mai immaginato che avrebbe potuto distruggere un paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Tendréis sentimientos encontrados al respecto, pero creo que ellos tampoco eran seres perfectos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: You're probably conflicted about this, but I don't think they were perfect either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Probabilmente avete sentimenti contrastanti al riguardo, ma non credo che fossero perfetti nemmeno loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Sin embargo... puede que por eso estemos hoy aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: However ... that might be why we're all here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Tuttavia... forse e' per questo che siamo tutti qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Siempre he pensado en cómo podía evitar el fracaso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I always thought about how I could keep myself from failing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ho sempre pensato a come evitare di fallire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Me daba miedo fracasar y provocar problemas... pero estaba equivocada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I was scared of failure and causing problems ... but I had it all wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Avevo paura di fallire e di creare problemi... ma mi sbagliavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Como miembro del clan Flumme, tengo que mantener la cabeza alta y contarle a todo el mundo lo que he aprendido aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I must hold my head high as a member of the Flumme clan, and tell everyone what I learned here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Come membro del clan Flumme, devo tenere alta la testa e raccontare a tutti cio' che ho imparato qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Lo que encontramos en los campos de entrenamiento, lo que nos enseñó Astasha... Quiero llevarlo todo a la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: What we found in the training grounds, what Astasha taught us ... I'll bring all of it back to the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Quello che abbiamo trovato nei campi di addestramento, quello che ci ha insegnato Astasha... Riportero' tutto all'insediamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Por el clan Flumme. No, por crear un futuro mejor para los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: For the Flumme clan's—no. For a brighter future for all Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Per il clan Flumme. No, per un futuro migliore per tutti i Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡Es mío!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Hahaha! It's all mine!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ahahah! E' tutto mio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¿Qué está haciendo?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: What is he doing ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Che cosa sta facendo...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: El fantasma de Astasha no va a volver. ¿Se ha desvanecido sin más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Astasha's phantom isn't coming back. Did he really vanish?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Il fantasma di Astasha non tornera'. E' davvero svanito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Sí. Puede que estuviera usando el poder que le quedaba para contener a esa extraña criatura. Ahora puede descansar en paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Yes. He might have used the last of his power to hold back that abnormal creature. Now he can rest in peace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Si'. Forse ha usato le ultime energie per trattenere quella creatura anomala. Ora puo' riposare in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Tienes motivos para estar orgullosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: You have something to boast about now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ora hai qualcosa di cui vantarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Bueno, has tenido contacto con un ancestro del clan Flumme. ¡Eso sí que es una historia impactante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I mean, hearing from an ancestor of the Flumme clan? Talk about a shocking travel story!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Voglio dire, aver parlato con un antenato del clan Flumme? Questa si' che e' una storia di viaggio sconvolgente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Je, je, puede que tengas razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: Hehe, you might be right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Eheh, forse hai ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Puede que solo haya oído hablar a Astasha un par de veces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I may have heard Astasha speak only a few times ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Forse ho sentito parlare Astasha solo poche volte...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Pero me alegro de haber venido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: But I'm glad I came here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ma sono contenta di essere venuta qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: No importa cuántos errores cometa, algún día esas experiencias me servirán de algo. En la vida todo tiene provecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: No matter what mistakes I make, someday the experience will come back to help me. Nothing in my life is useless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Non importa quanti errori commetta, un giorno l'esperienza mi sara' utile. Niente nella mia vita e' inutile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Pero eso no significa que pueda cambiar en un abrir y cerrar de ojos... Quiero ser más positiva y asumir más desafíos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: But that doesn't mean I can change right away ... I want to be more positive and take on more challenges.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Ma questo non significa che possa cambiare da un momento all'altro... Voglio essere piu' positiva e mettermi alla prova piu' spesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: Si podemos hacer algo para ayudarte, cuenta con nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: If we can do anything to help, let us know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Se possiamo fare qualcosa per aiutarti, faccelo sapere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..src: ¡Lo haré!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..ref: I will!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_250..dst: Lo faro'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: ¿Qué es esto...? ¿Qué está pasando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: What is this ...? Is something going on?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Che cos'e'...? Che cosa sta succedendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: ¿Ha pasado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Did something happen?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: E' successo qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: En buen momento llegas, humana. Lo que tiene que decir, escucha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Come at a good time you have, human. To what he has to say, please listen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Sei arrivata al momento giusto, umana. Ascolta cio' che ha da dire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Kuku Toh soy. Todo un placer conocerte es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Kuku Toh, I am. A pleasure to meet you it is, human.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Io essere Kuku Toh. Un piacere conoscerti e'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: ¡Un placer! Soy Yumia, formo parte del equipo de investigación de Aladiss, que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Nice to meet you! I'm Yumia. I'm with the Aladiss Research Team, which—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Piacere! Sono Yumia, della Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss, che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Explicar falta no hacer, alquimista humana. De ti haberme hablado mi pueblo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Need to explain you do not, human alchemist. Told me of you, my people have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Spiegazioni non servono, alchimista umana. Il mio popolo mi ha parlato di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Entonces, ¡tiempo que nos ahorramos! ¿Puedes explicarme la situación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: That saves us some time then. Can you fill me in on the situation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Allora ci siamo risparmiati un po' di tempo! Puoi spiegarmi la situazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Dos días hace, sí. Yo escapé, sí. De Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Two days ago, it was. Escaped, I did. From Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Due giorni fa, si'. Io sono fuggito, si'. Da Aladissia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: ¿De Aladissia...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Aladissia ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Di Aladissia...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: No tengo ni idea de qué se trata. Es un lugar, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: I haven't heard of it before. It's a place, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Non ho idea di cosa si tratti. E' un luogo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Exacto. Base de investigación del maestro Corleonis, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Correct. Master Corleonis's research base, it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Esatto. Una base di ricerca del maestro Corleonis, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: ¡¿De Corleonis?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Corleonis?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Di Corleonis?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Entonces, ¿todavía hay una base de la que no sabemos nada...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: So there was still a base we didn't know about ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Quindi c'e' ancora una base di cui non sappiamo nulla...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Tampoco nosotros de su existencia saber, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Know of its existence, we also did not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Neanche noi sapere della sua esistenza, no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Ni siquiera el equipo de investigación estaba al tanto de esto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Even the Research Team didn't have any intel on this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Nemmeno la Squadra di Ricerca ne era al corrente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Oye, ¿qué quieres decir con eso de que escapaste?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Hey, what exactly do you mean by "escaped"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Ehi, che intendi quando dici che sei scappato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Destinados estábamos a en ese lugar trabajar, sí. Pero luego un problema surgió. Durante mucho tiempo, desaparecido el maestro estuvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Bound by fate to work in that place, we were. But then arose, a problem did. Gone for too long, Master was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Destinati eravamo a lavorare in quel luogo, si'. Ma poi e' sorto un problema. Il maestro e' scomparso per molto tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Las instalaciones fallaron, sí. El maná sin control fluía, sí. Atrapados mis camaradas continúan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Malfunctioned, the facility did. A large overflow of mana, there was. Trapped, my comrades remain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Le strutture si sono guastate, si'. Il mana scorreva senza controllo, si'. I miei compagni sono ancora intrappolati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: A ver, quedaron atrapados compañeros tuyos y huiste de Aladissia para pedir ayuda, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: So you had comrades there, and you escaped from Aladissia to get help ... is that correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Aspetta, alcuni tuoi compagni sono rimasti intrappolati e tu sei fuggito da Aladissia per chiedere aiuto, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Lacking in strength, we are. Your help we seek, humans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Nos falta fuerza, sí. Vuestra ayuda necesitamos, humanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: I assume you're already aware of our relationship with Corleonis, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Forze ci mancano, si'. Il vostro aiuto ci serve, umani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Supongo que estás al tanto de la relación que tenemos con Corleonis, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Endured cruel toil and burden, we have. Blame you, we do not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Immagino tu sappia dei rapporti che abbiamo con Corleonis, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Una carga pesada nosotros haber tenido. No os culpamos, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: For now, safe my comrades are. A need to decide in haste, there is not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Un pesante fardello abbiamo sopportato, si'. Non vi biasimiamo, no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Por ahora, mis camaradas a salvo están. Necesidad de tomar una decisión rápida no hay, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: This isn't something that we can decide on our own. Let's report it to the chief and see what he thinks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Per ora, i miei compagni al sicuro sono. Non c'e' bisogno di decidere in fretta, no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: No lo podemos decidir nosotros. Toca informar al jefe, a ver qué piensa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: We'd like to take some time to discuss this. We'll be back as soon as we've settled on a course of action.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Non possiamo deciderlo noi. Dobbiamo parlarne con il capo e sentire cosa ne pensa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Necesitamos tiempo para pensarlo. Volveremos en cuanto hayamos decidido qué vamos a hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..ref: Hoping for your assistance, I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Abbiamo bisogno di tempo per pensarci. Torneremo non appena avremo deciso cosa fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..src: Tu ayuda espero, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_010..dst: Il tuo aiuto spero, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Pensábamos que ya habíamos explorado Aladiss por completo, pero parece que nos saltamos algún que otro lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Aladissia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Pensavamo di aver esplorato Aladissia da cima a fondo, ma a quanto pare ci e' sfuggito qualche luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: A mí también me ha sorprendido. Seguro que la base está escondida en un lugar que suele pasar desapercibido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: We thought our exploration of Aladiss was thorough, but I guess there were still places we missed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Ha sorpreso anche me. Scommetto che la base e' nascosta in un posto che passa spesso inosservato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Eh, no es más que una idea, pero ¿y si es una trampa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: I was surprised too. The base must be hidden somewhere that'd normally never be found ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Ehi, e' solo un'idea, ma... e se fosse una trappola?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: A-a mí no me lo ha parecido, la verdad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Hey, just throwin' this out there—isn't it possible this whole thing's a setup?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: A-a me non e' sembrato, a dire il vero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Pues claro que no, ¡así es cómo funcionan las trampas! Si quieres, da rienda suelta a tu lado caritativo, pero ¡luego no digas que no lo avisé!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: I-it didn't really seem that way to me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Ma certo che no! E' cosi' che funzionano le trappole! Se vuoi, puoi anche lasciarti guidare dal tuo lato caritatevole, ma poi non dire che non ti avevo avvertito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Ese Geni... Kuku Toh se llamaba, ¿no? A mí me ha parecido más listo que los demás, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Of course it didn't look like a trap—that's how traps work. Be nice if you want, but don't say I didn't warn you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Quel Geni... si chiamava Kuku Toh, vero? A me e' sembrato piu' sveglio degli altri, a dire il vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Entonces, ¿es posible que este rechazo a Corleonis sea fingido y que, en realidad, nos guarden rencor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: That Geni—Kuku Toh, was it? He did seem sharper than the others, I'll give him that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Quindi e' possibile che il loro rifiuto di Corleonis sia una finzione e che in realta' ci serbino rancore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: No podemos descartarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: So it's possible that their rejection of Corleonis is just talk, and they're holding a grudge against us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Non possiamo escluderlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Trampa o no, no podemos pasar por alto una posible amenaza al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: We can't rule out the possibility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Trappola o no, non possiamo ignorare una possibile minaccia alla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Hagamos lo que hagamos, necesitamos más información y averiguar cuáles son sus verdaderas intenciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Trap or not, we can't leave a potential threat to the Research Team unchecked.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Qualunque cosa facciamo, ci servono piu' informazioni e dobbiamo scoprire quali siano le loro vere intenzioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Exacto. Por ahora, vamos a tomárnoslo como si fuera una tarea oficial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: So either way, we need to hear more from them and figure out what their true intentions are, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Esatto. Per ora, consideriamolo un incarico ufficiale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Hay que cooperar con los Geni y comenzar a investigar. Si Aladissia es real, no podemos hacer oídos sordos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Exactly. Let's treat this as a formal assignment for the time being.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Dobbiamo collaborare con i Geni e avviare le indagini. Se Aladissia esiste davvero, non possiamo fare orecchie da mercante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Sin embargo, mucha atención a cualquier actividad sospechosa o posible trampa. Si algo os huele mal, tenéis permiso para detener la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Establish cooperation with the Geni and begin the investigation. If Aladissia is real, we can't afford to overlook it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Tuttavia, fate molta attenzione a ogni attivita' sospetta o possibile trappola. Se qualcosa vi puzza, siete autorizzati a interrompere le indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Dejo las decisiones más delicadas a vuestro juicio ahí fuera. Habéis llegado hasta aquí sin problemas, así que seguro que tomaréis la decisión acertada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: However, be on the lookout for any suspicious activity or traps. If anything feels off, you have full permission to stop.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Lascio a voi le decisioni piu' delicate la' fuori. Siete arrivati fin qui senza problemi, quindi sono certo che farete la scelta giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Puf. Por ahora, supongo que bastará con ir con cautela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: I'll leave the finer decisions to your judgment in the field. You've gotten this far, so I'm sure you'll make the right call.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Uff. Per ora, suppongo che bastera' procedere con cautela.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Uy, pensaba que lo habías dicho por fastidiar, pero sí que te estabas preocupando por todo el grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: ... Hmph. I guess just stayin' cautious is good enough for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Oh, pensavo lo dicessi solo per infastidirmi, invece eri davvero preoccupato per tutto il gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Eres de esas personas que caerían de cabeza en una trampa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Huh. I thought you were saying that stuff just to cause trouble again, but you actually were looking out for everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Sei il tipo di persona che finirebbe dritta in una trappola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: You're exactly the type to walk straight into a trap.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Si ese Geni nos ha dicho la verdad, tenemos que implicarnos en esto, nos guste o no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Come again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Se quel Geni ci ha detto la verita', dobbiamo occuparcene, che ci piaccia o no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Si podemos, a mí me gustaría ayudar. Vamos a volver a hablar con el Geni de inmediato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: Assuming what that Geni said is true, then we have a connection to this whether we like it or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Se possiamo, mi piacerebbe dare una mano. Torniamo subito a parlare con il Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..src: Eso, pero aseguraos de ir bien preparados. Me da la sensación de que no va a ser nada fácil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..ref: If we can, I want to help out. We'll head back to the Geni right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_020..dst: Esatto, ma assicuratevi di essere ben preparati. Ho la sensazione che non sara' affatto facile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..src: Kuku, ya hemos tomado una decisión; pongamos rumbo a Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..ref: Kuku, we've come to a decision. Let's head to Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..dst: Kuku, abbiamo preso una decisione. Mettiamoci in viaggio verso Aladissia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..ref: Oh! My thanks I give, human.
S-so, um ... where exactly is Aladissia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..src: Desde el exterior, verse no puede. Hasta allí os llevaré, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..ref: From the outside, it cannot be seen. Lead you there, I will.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_030..dst: Dall'esterno, vederla non si puo'. Fin li' vi condurro', si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_040..src: Así que por aquí se entra a Aladissia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_040..ref: This is the way into Aladissia, huh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_040..dst: Quindi e' da qui che si entra ad Aladissia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_040..ref: Can you lead the way for us?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_050..ref: Huh? The path cuts off here ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_050..src: Para mover el puente, usamos esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_050..ref: Use this to move the bridge, we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_050..dst: Per spostare il ponte, questo usiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_050..ref: Oh, I see! Let's give it a shot.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..ref: Cart rails for moving goods, they are.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..src: ¿Crees que podríamos usarlas para desplazarnos más rápido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..ref: Do you think we could use these to move around faster?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..dst: Credi che potremmo usarli per spostarci piu' in fretta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..src: Aunque pudiésemos, parece que nos falta lo más importante: el vagón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..ref: Even if we could, we're kinda missing the most important part—the cart itself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..dst: Anche se potessimo, ci manca proprio la cosa piu' importante: il carrello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..src: No te preocupes, se me ha ocurrido una cosita que podría venirnos de perlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..ref: Don't worry. I've got something in mind that might do the trick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_060..dst: Non preoccuparti. Mi e' venuta in mente una cosa che potrebbe fare al caso nostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Aladissia esto es, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Aladissia, this is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Questa e' Aladissia, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Una zona de investigación secreta del maestro Corleonis, sí. Para restablecer el Aladiss verdadero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: A secret research area run by Master Corleonis it is. Made to restore the true Aladiss, it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Un'area di ricerca segreta gestita dal maestro Corleonis, si'. Creata per ripristinare la vera Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: No me lo esperaba así... ¿Cómo iba a imaginar que se podría ocultar un lugar tan gigantesco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: I wasn't expecting this ... To think a place this huge was completely concealed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Non me l'aspettavo... Non avrei mai immaginato che si potesse nascondere un luogo cosi' enorme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Parece que Corleonis también tenía bases de investigación más allá de Auruma...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Looks like Corleonis had research bases outside Auruma, too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Sembra che Corleonis avesse basi di ricerca anche oltre Auruma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Exacto. Conociéndolo, seguro que trabajaba para crear de nuevo algo peligroso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Exactly. Knowing him, he might have been working on creating something dangerous again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Esatto. Conoscendolo, probabilmente stava lavorando per creare qualcos'altro di pericoloso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Si planeaba algo así, nuestra tarea es descubrir la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: If he was plotting something, it's our duty to uncover the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Se stava tramando qualcosa, e' nostro dovere scoprire la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: ¿Eh? Oye, ¿eso de ahí no es estirium?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Hm? Hey, isn't that Stirium over there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Eh? Ehi, quello laggiu' non e' Stirium?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Así es. Se supone que es un material poco común, pero aquí lo veo por todas partes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: You're right. It's supposed to be rare, but I'm seeing it everywhere here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Hai ragione. Dovrebbe essere raro, eppure qui lo vedo dappertutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Antes de llegar el maestro Corleonis, un yacimiento minero esto era, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Long before Master Corleonis arrived, a mining site this once was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Prima che arrivasse il maestro Corleonis, qui c'era una miniera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Anda. No me importaría llevarme alguna que otra cosilla de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Oh ...? Could be a nice little payday in this place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Oh...? Qui potrei fare un bel gruzzolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: No es momento, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Not the time, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Non e' il momento, Rutger.
