eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: En cualquier caso, el hecho de que el equipo de investigación no supiese de la existencia de este lugar, demuestra lo que se esforzaron por ocultarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Still, the fact that the Research Team didn't know this place existed ... They must've gone to great lengths to keep it concealed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Eppure, il fatto che la Squadra di Ricerca non sapesse dell'esistenza di questo posto... Devono aver fatto di tutto per tenerlo nascosto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Y no me sorprende, parece que es lo que les gusta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Wouldn't be surprisin'. They seem to like that kinda thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Non mi sorprende. A quanto pare, gli piace fare cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Si nadie nos hubiese hablado de este lugar, puede que nunca nos hubiésemos dado cuenta de que estaba aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: If no one had brought it up, we might never have realized it was here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Se nessuno ce ne avesse parlato, forse non ci saremmo mai accorti che esisteva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Parece que esta región también está repleta de zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Looks like this region is covered in manabound areas, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Sembra che anche questa regione sia piena di zone legate al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Un lugar único Aladissia es, sí. Aunque conectado a Aladiss, su maná no está.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: A unique place, Aladissia is. Connected to mainland Aladiss, its mana is not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Aladissia e' un luogo unico, si'. Collegata alla terraferma di Aladiss, ma il suo mana no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: E-espera, ¿qué quieres decir con qué no están conectados?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: W-wait, what do you mean there's no connection?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: A-aspetta, cosa intendi quando dici che non sono collegate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Aladissia imperturbable permanece. No importa el estado de Aladiss, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Unaffected, Aladissia remains. No matter the state of mainland Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Aladissia rimane intatta, si'. Qualunque sia lo stato della terraferma di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Aquí el maná no se ha dispersado..., al principio, al menos. Este lugar gestionado por el maestro Corleonis estaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Therefore, the mana did not overflow ... originally, at least. Personally managed by Master Corleonis, it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Percio' il mana non traboccava... almeno all'inizio. Era il maestro Corleonis a gestire personalmente questo luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Pero la situación cambió, sí. La gestión abandonada quedó, así que un accidente sucedió.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: But changed, the situation did. Complete, the management was not, and so occurred an accident did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Ma la situazione cambio', si'. La gestione non fu completata e cosi' si verifico' un incidente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Ya veo... Ahora entiendo cómo acabó así este lugar y por qué tus camaradas quedaron atrapados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: I see ... So that's how things ended up like this, and why your friends were stranded.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Vedo... Ora capisco come questo posto sia finito cosi' e perche' i tuoi compagni siano rimasti intrappolati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Aunque no fuese a propósito, puede que hayamos causado este problema de manera indirecta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: Even if it wasn't intentional, this could still be seen as a problem we indirectly caused.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Anche se non era intenzionale, potremmo comunque aver causato indirettamente questo problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Para arreglarlo, a la torre de control de Aladissia debemos ir, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: To fix this, to the Aladissia Control Tower we must first go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Per rimediare, dobbiamo prima andare alla Torre di Controllo di Aladissia, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: El núcleo de Aladissia, sí. Podríamos la fuga de maná detener.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: The core of Aladissia, it is. Stop the mana leak, we may be able to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Il nucleo di Aladissia, si'. Potremmo riuscire a fermare la perdita di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..src: Si queremos más información, creo que deberíamos ir a la torre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..ref: If we want more information, going to the tower is probably our best bet as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_070..dst: Se vogliamo saperne di piu', credo che la cosa migliore sia andare alla torre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..src: Está cerrada... Kuku, ¿hay alguna forma de abrirla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: It's locked ... Kuku, is there a way to open it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..dst: E' chiusa... Kuku, c'e' un modo per aprirla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..src: Sí. Si la terminal usas, puede abrirse. Aunque el método un tanto bruto es, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: Yes. If the terminal you use, opened it can be. Though, slightly forceful the method is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..dst: Si'. Se il terminale usi, aprirla si puo'. Anche se il metodo un po' brutale e', si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..src: Un dispositivo de seguridad es. En muchos lugares de Aladiss se encuentra, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: A security device, this is. Found in many places across Aladiss, they are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..dst: Un dispositivo di sicurezza e'. In molti luoghi di Aladissia si trova, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..src: Sigue los pasos que te indico y se abrirá. Pero antes a los monstruos guardianes derrotar debes, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: Follow the steps I now give, and open it will. But first, defeat the summoned guardian monsters you must.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..dst: Segui i passaggi che ora ti indico e si aprira'. Ma prima i mostri guardiani evocati sconfiggere devi, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: So that's what you meant by forceful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..dst: Ah! Ora capisco cosa intendevi con brutale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_071..ref: Correct. For now, give it a try you should.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Un momento, aquí hay algo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Wait, there's something there ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Aspetta un momento, qui c'e' qualcosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¡¿Un monstruo?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: A monster?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Un mostro?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: T-tú eres...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Y-you're ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: T-tu sei...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¡Habla! Y con ese aspecto... ¡¿Es un mutante?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: It talks, and that appearance ... Don't tell me it's a mutant?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Parla! E con quell'aspetto... Sei un mutante?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Entonces, ¿era una trampa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: So this was a trap after all?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Allora era una trappola?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¿Quién eres...? ¿Dónde estoy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Who are you ...? Where even am I?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Chi sei...? Dove mi trovo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Uf... Mi cuerpo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Ugh ... My body ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Uf... Il mio corpo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¿Qué es esto? Actúa de forma extraña...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: What is this? It's acting strange ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Che cos'e'? Si comporta in modo strano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¿Te importaría decirme qué está pasando...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Please, tell me. Do you know anything about what's going on ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Ti dispiacerebbe dirmi che cosa sta succedendo...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: ¿A-a qué te refieres...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Wh-what do you mean ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: A-a cosa ti riferisci...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Es de mala educación hacer preguntas sin presentarse primero. ¿Quién eres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: It's rude to ask questions without even introducin' yourself first. Who are you, anyway?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: E' maleducato fare domande senza prima presentarsi. Chi sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Soy Elnath. Solo recuerdo mi nombre. He perdido todos mis recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Sono Elnath. Ricordo solo il mio nome. Ho perso tutti i miei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: No me da la sensación de que mienta... ¿Qué te parece a ti, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Elnath. That name is the only thing I can still remember. Everything else is gone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Non mi sembra che stia mentendo... Che ne pensi, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: No podemos bajar la guardia solo por cruzar unas palabras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: I don't get the sense that he's lying ... What's your take, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Non possiamo abbassare la guardia solo perche' abbiamo scambiato qualche parola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Kuku, ¿sabes algo de él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: We can't let our guard down just because of a single statement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Kuku, sai qualcosa di lui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Yo no..., pero mis camaradas podrían, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Kuku, do you know anything about him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Io no..., ma forse i miei compagni si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Ahora mismo tampoco podemos hacer mucho más... Creo que lo más útil sería traer al jefe aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: I do not know ... But know, my comrades might.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Al momento non possiamo fare molto altro... Credo che la cosa piu' utile sia portare qui il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Por el momento, no parece hostil, así que..., creo que ese es el plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: There's not much we can do right now ... Bringing the chief here seems like the safest move.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Per ora non sembra ostile, quindi... credo che il piano sia questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Lo siento, pero todavía no sabemos si eres aliado o enemigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: He doesn't seem hostile right now, so ... Yeah, that sounds like a plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Mi dispiace, ma non sappiamo ancora se sei un alleato o un nemico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Vamos a llamar a alguien que pueda ayudarnos. Espera, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Sorry, but we can't tell if you're a friend or foe right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Chiameremo qualcuno che possa aiutarci. Aspetta, per favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Muy bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: So we're bringing in someone who can. Until then, we'll have to ask you to wait.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Va bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..src: Vamos a despejar las zonas de vínculo de maná cercanas mientras esperamos al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..ref: Very well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_080..dst: Ripuliamo le vicine zone di legame del mana mentre aspettiamo il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Algo me han contado durante el viaje, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I've been briefed during the trip, but—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Durante il viaggio mi hanno raccontato qualcosa, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Un mutante con amnesia? Uf, no va a ser nada fácil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: A mutant with amnesia ... This is certainly a tough one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Un mutante con amnesia? Uff, non sara' per niente facile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Y tú eres...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: You are ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: E tu chi sei...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Erhard, líder del equipo de investigación. Estoy al frente de este grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Erhard. I lead the Aladiss Research Team. I'm in charge of overseeing this crew.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Sono Erhard, il leader della Squadra di Ricerca. Sono a capo di questo gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Tú eras Elnath, ¿no es así? Por tus características, diría que eres mutante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Elnath, was it? You do seem to have the characteristics of a mutant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Tu sei Elnath, giusto? Dalle tue caratteristiche, direi che sei un mutante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Dicho esto, afirmas no tener ningún recuerdo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: That said, you claim to have no memory of anything, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Detto questo, sostieni di non ricordare nulla, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: E-exacto... Ni siquiera sé quién soy...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Y-yes ... I have no idea who I even am ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: E-esatto... Non so nemmeno chi sono...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Pero... me da la sensación de haber estado aquí antes... Aunque no sé explicar por qué.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: But ... I feel like I've seen this place before ... even if I can't explain why ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Pero'... ho la sensazione di essere gia' stato qui... Anche se non so spiegare perche'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Perdona, pero ¿qué es exactamente un mutante? Parece que hablabais de mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Sorry, but what exactly is a "mutant"? It sounded like it had something to do with me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Scusa, ma cos'e' esattamente un mutante? Sembrava steste parlando di me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: No podemos contarte todo lo que hemos descubierto, pero te haremos un resumen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: We won't share everything we've uncovered, but we'll give you the basics.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Non possiamo raccontarti tutto quello che abbiamo scoperto, ma ti faremo un riassunto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Así que son hostiles... Ahora entiendo por qué os andáis con tanto ojo conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: So they are hostile towards you ... I understand now why you're so cautious around me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Quindi sono ostili... Ora capisco perche' state cosi' attenti con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Creo que... antes era como vosotros. Aunque es un recuerdo borroso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I think ... I used to look like you. Though it's hazy, that memory remains ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Credo che... un tempo fossi come voi. Anche se il ricordo e' confuso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Olvidadlo por ahora. Lo que de verdad me gustaría saber es... ¿Qué va a ser de mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Forget it for now. What I really want to know is ... what's going to become of me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Lasciamo perdere per ora. Quello che vorrei davvero sapere e'... Che ne sara' di me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Me vais a abandonar...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Will you cut me down ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Mi abbandonerete...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Lo poco que tenemos claro es que no podemos dejarte aquí así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: We can't just leave you like this. That much is certain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: L'unica cosa che sappiamo per certo e' che non possiamo lasciarti qui cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Dicho esto, si sigues cooperando con nosotros, tampoco nos apresuraremos a tomar una decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: That said, if you continue to show you're willing to work with us, we won't rush to make a decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Detto questo, se continuerai a collaborare con noi, non ci affretteremo a prendere una decisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Como medida temporal, el equipo vigilará tus movimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: As a temporary measure, placing you under watch by the team seems like a reasonable compromise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Per il momento, la squadra terra' sotto controllo i tuoi movimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Y-ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I ... I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: C-capisco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Antes, Kuku, el Geni que colabora con nosotros, nos ha sugerido que sus compañeros podrían saber algo de Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Earlier, Kuku—the Geni who is working with us—suggested that his companions might know something about Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Poco fa Kuku, il Geni che collabora con noi, ci ha suggerito che i suoi compagni potrebbero sapere qualcosa su Elnath.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Y si empezamos rescatando a los Geni, como era el plan, y luego recopilamos información sobre él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: How about we begin by rescuing the Geni as planned, and then gather any information we can about him from there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Che ne dite di cominciare salvando i Geni, come previsto, e poi raccogliere informazioni su di lui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: A mí me parece la mejor opción. Yumia, ¿crees que podrás arreglar las cosas pronto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: That sounds like the best approach. Yumia, does it seem like you'll be able to settle things here soon?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Mi sembra l'opzione migliore. Yumia, pensi di riuscire a sistemare tutto presto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Lo dudo mucho... En las otras regiones aún quedan muchísimas zonas de vínculo de maná en las que tenemos que trabajar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I'm afraid not ... The other places still have manabound areas we need to deal with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ne dubito... Nelle altre regioni ci sono ancora moltissime zone di legame del mana su cui dobbiamo intervenire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Parece que la torre de control tiene un mecanismo para manejar el equipo de cada zona, pero ahora mismo no funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: The control tower appears to have a mechanism for operating the equipment in each area, but it is currently not functional.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Sembra che la torre di controllo abbia un meccanismo per gestire l'attrezzatura di ogni zona, ma al momento non funziona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: No tenemos más opción que desplazarnos a cada zona y rescatar a los Geni atrapados directamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: There is no choice but to travel to each area and rescue the stranded Geni directly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Non abbiamo altra scelta che raggiungere ogni zona e salvare direttamente i Geni intrappolati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Ya veo. Si no hay prisa alguna, aprovechad la oportunidad para explorar los alrededores con calma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I see. If there's no rush, approach it calmly and use the opportunity to explore the surroundings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Capisco. Se non c'e' fretta, approfittatene per esplorare con calma i dintorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Siento molestaros, pero... ¿podría acompañaros en esta investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Sorry to trouble you, but ... would it be possible for me to accompany you on this investigation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Mi dispiace disturbarvi, ma... potrei accompagnarvi in questa ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Teniendo en cuenta tus circunstancias, sabes que no es nada sencillo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Just to be clear: you're aware that, given your circumstances, that isn't a simple request, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Date le tue circostanze, sai che non e' affatto semplice, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Sé que os pido mucho, pero... me creo que podré recuperar la memoria viendo cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I know it's a lot to ask ... But I feel like if I see something, it might jog my memory!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: So che vi sto chiedendo molto, ma... credo di poter recuperare la memoria vedendo certe cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Solo quiero despejar esta niebla mental que me atormenta. No os daré problemas. ¡Dejad que os acompañe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: All I want is to clear the haze from my head. I swear, I won't cause any harm. Please ... let me join you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Voglio solo dissipare questa nebbia mentale che mi tormenta. Non vi daro' problemi. Lasciatemi venire con voi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Aun así, no es tan sencillo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Even so, it's not that simple ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Eppure, non e' cosi' semplice...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Creo que supondrá una mayor amenaza dejarlo aquí sin saber quién es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: It's possible that leaving him behind while we still don't know who he really is might be the larger threat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Credo che lasciarlo qui senza sapere chi sia rappresenti una minaccia maggiore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Me estás diciendo que te parece bien que le ayudemos a recuperar la memoria, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Meaning ... you're okay with him trying to regain his memories, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Mi stai dicendo che per te va bene aiutarlo a recuperare la memoria, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Em... ¿Qué os parece dejar que nos acompañe en la misión?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Umm ... Would you consider letting him join us on the mission?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ehm... Che ne dite di lasciarlo venire con noi in missione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Yumia, ¿lo dices en serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Yumia, are you serious?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Yumia, dici sul serio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Teniendo en cuenta lo que ha dicho, me da la sensación de que aún conserva recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Judging by what he's said, I get the sense that some fragments of his memory are still there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: A giudicare da cio' che ha detto, mi sembra che conservi ancora qualche ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: No como yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: ... Unlike me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Non come me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Lo que significa que, tal y como ha dicho, puede que algo le ayude a recuperar la memoria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Which means, just as he suggested, something might be able to help bring his memories back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Il che significa che, come ha detto lui, forse qualcosa puo' aiutarlo a recuperare la memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: En ese caso, nos podría dar información de lo más valiosa sobre Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: His memory returning could lead to valuable information about Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: In tal caso, potrebbe fornirci informazioni preziosissime su Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Con un mutante, podríamos conseguir una información que, de otra manera, sería imposible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: If we can work with a mutant, we might gain access to previously unobtainable information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Con un mutante potremmo ottenere informazioni altrimenti impossibili da reperire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿No sería eso de ayuda también para el equipo de investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Wouldn't that benefit the Research Team as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Non sarebbe utile anche per la Squadra di Ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Yo coincido con Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I agree with Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Sono d'accordo con Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: En mi opinión, si ocurre algo, creo que podríamos lidiar con ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Even if something were to happen, I believe we can handle it. That's how I see it, anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Secondo me, se dovesse succedere qualcosa, potremmo occuparcene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Muy bien. Podéis permitir que Elnath os acompañe en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: ... Very well. Take Elnath along with you on your investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Benissimo. Potete permettere a Elnath di accompagnarvi durante l'indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¿Seguro, jefe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Are you sure about this, Chief?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ne e' sicuro, capo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Teniendo en cuenta los conocimientos sobre maná y alquimia de Yumia, creo que lo más seguro es que no le quite ojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I figure that it might be safer to have him under Yumia's supervision, given her knowledge of mana and alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Considerando le conoscenze di Yumia in fatto di mana e alchimia, credo che la cosa piu' sicura sia tenerlo sempre d'occhio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Y eso que al principio vosotros me vigilabais a mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Though, I was the one under surveillance at first ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: E pensare che all'inizio eravate voi a tenere d'occhio me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Bueno, ¡eso demuestra lo mucho que te has ganado nuestra confianza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Well, I guess that just shows how much trust you've earned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Beh, questo dimostra quanto ti sei guadagnata la nostra fiducia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¡Gracias, señor Erhard! ¡Y gracias a ti también, señora Yumia...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Thank you, Sir Erhard ...! And you as well, Lady Yumia ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Grazie, signor Erhard! E grazie anche a te, signorina Yumia...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Si el jefe ha tomado esa decisión, haré lo que esté en mi mano para que todo salga bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: If that's the chief's decision, then I'll do everything I can to make sure nothing goes wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Se il capo ha preso questa decisione, faro' tutto il possibile perche' vada tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: ¡T-tengo muchas ganas de trabajar contigo, Elnath!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: L-looking forward to working with you, Mister Elnath ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: N-non vedo l'ora di lavorare con te, Elnath!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Oye, que no somos sus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Hey, we're not friends with him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ehi, non e' che siamo suoi amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Ah, eh, ya...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Oh, uh, right ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ah, eh, gia'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Sé que tengo que guardar las distancias, pero me alegro de acompañaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: I'm aware that I need to keep my distance. I'm just grateful to be allowed to come along.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: So che devo mantenere le distanze, ma sono felice di accompagnarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Dicho esto..., gracias por hablar conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: That said ... I'm grateful you spoke to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Detto questo... grazie per aver parlato con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Muy bien. Ahora que ya lo tenemos todo listo, ¡a ponerse en marcha!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: All right then, with that settled, it's time to get moving.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Benissimo. Ora che e' tutto pronto, mettiamoci in marcia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Hay tres lugares donde mis camaradas están. Id a ellos. El orden a vosotros dejo, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Three places where my companions remain, there are. Please go to them. The order, I leave up to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Ci sono tre luoghi in cui si trovano i miei compagni. Andate da loro. L'ordine lo lascio a voi, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Muy bien. Toca empezar a investigar. Elnath, quédate a la vista todo el rato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Got it. Time to get the investigation underway. Elnath, stay within our line of sight at all times.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Benissimo. E' ora di iniziare le indagini. Elnath, resta sempre in vista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Muy bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: Wait for my companions here, I will. When rescued they are, please tell them to gather here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Va bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: Yo a mis compañeros esperaré aquí. Cuando los hayáis rescatado, que vengan aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..ref: <SEL_RM07_090_1_B><CR>I want to help him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: Aspettero' qui i miei compagni. Quando li avrete salvati, fateli venire qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..src: <SEL_RM07_090_1_B><CR>Quiero ayudarle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_090..dst: <SEL_RM07_090_1_B><CR>Voglio aiutarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: Según la información que nos ha dado Kuku Toh, los Geni que trabajan aquí viven en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: From the information that Kuku Toh provided, this area serves as living quarters for the Geni who work here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: Secondo le informazioni che ci ha dato Kuku Toh, i Geni che lavorano qui vivono in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: Este es uno de los lugares donde los Geni han quedado atrapados, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: This is one of the places where the Geni are stranded, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: E' uno dei luoghi in cui i Geni sono rimasti intrappolati, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: Exacto. Puede que estén a salvo en una zona segura. Hay que hacer una investigación y una búsqueda en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: Correct. They are likely taking shelter in a secure location. An investigation and search of the area is necessary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: Esatto. Potrebbero essere al sicuro in una zona protetta. Dobbiamo esaminare e perlustrare quest'area.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: No... Esto en concreto no me dice gran cosa, pero me da la sensación de que he visto antes a los Geni...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: No... Questo, in particolare, non mi dice granche', ma ho come l'impressione di aver gia' visto i Geni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: ¿Me estás diciendo que podrías tener alguna relación con los Geni...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: No ... this scenery alone doesn't tell me much. But I feel like I've seen the Geni before, somewhere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: Vuoi dire che potresti avere qualche legame con i Geni...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: Eso creo..., aunque no recuerdo más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: So you're saying you might have had some connection with the Geni ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: Credo di si'..., anche se non ricordo altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..src: Entonces puede que los Geni que tenemos que rescatar te reconozcan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..ref: I think so ... though I can't recall the details.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_100..dst: Allora e' possibile che i Geni che dobbiamo salvare ti riconoscano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¿Humanos? ¿Quiénes sois?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Humans? Who are you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Umani? Chi siete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Kuku nos envía para ayudarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Kuku sent us. We're here to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Kuku ci manda. Siamo qui per aiutarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¡Un rescate! Mi agradecimiento tenéis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Rescue! My thanks I give you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Un salvataggio! La mia gratitudine vi porgo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Antes de poner rumbo a la torre de control, ¿nos podrías decir algo sobre él? Se llama Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Before we leave for the control tower, could you tell us if you know anything about him? His name's Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Prima di dirigerci alla torre di controllo, potresti dirci se sai qualcosa di lui? Si chiama Elnath.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Familiar me resulta, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Familiar, he is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Mi e' familiare, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¿E-en serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: R-really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: D-davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Hace mucho tiempo, sí. De las ruinas, el maestro Corleonis un cuerpo desenterró.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Long ago, it was. From ruins, a body Master Corleonis unearthed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: E' successo molto tempo fa. Il maestro Corleonis dissotterro' un corpo dalle rovine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¿Desenterró...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Unearthed ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Dissotterro'...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Un cuerpo de un experimento mutante, sí. Encontrado en condiciones impolutas. El maestro Corleonis lo recuperó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: A body from a mutant experiment, it was. Found in miraculous condition and retrieved by Master Corleonis, it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Era il corpo di un soggetto di un esperimento sui mutanti. Il maestro Corleonis lo trovo' in condizioni miracolose e lo recupero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Después el cuerpo restauró y rehabilitó una y otra vez, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Afterwards, repeatedly restored and rehabilitated the body, he did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: In seguito, restauro' e riabilito' quel corpo piu' volte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Más no sé. Continuó su investigación, supuse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: However, no more do I know. Assumed he continued his research, I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Tuttavia, non so altro. Supposi che avesse continuato le sue ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Investigaba cómo despertarme... Ya veo... Entonces, por eso yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: He was researching how to awaken me ... I see. So that's why I ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Stava studiando come risvegliarmi... Capisco. Ecco perche' io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¿Recuerdas algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Did you remember something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Ricordi qualcos'altro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: No, más bien voy entendiendo cómo estoy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: No, more like I understand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: No, e' piu' che altro che sto capendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Desde que me desperté, me siento aturdido, como si no pudiese mover mi cuerpo correctamente. Parece que aún necesitaba ajustes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Since waking, I've felt sluggish, like my body won't move properly. It seems I was still being calibrated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Da quando mi sono svegliato, mi sento intorpidito, come se non riuscissi a muovere il corpo correttamente. A quanto pare, dovevo ancora essere calibrato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Entonces, ¿el accidente de Aladissia te despertó antes de que el proceso hubiese terminado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: So the accident in Aladissia woke you before the process was finished?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Quindi l'incidente di Aladissia ti ha svegliato prima che il processo fosse terminato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Yes ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: De haber terminado el proceso, quizá te habrías enfrentado a nosotros, como los demás mutantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Had your calibration finished properly, you likely would have been opposing us like the other mutants.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Se la calibrazione fosse stata completata correttamente, probabilmente ti saresti schierato contro di noi, come gli altri mutanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: No puedo negar esa posibilidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: I can't deny that possibility ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Non posso negare questa possibilita'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Aun así, que tu cuerpo permaneciese intacto varios siglos... Parece que la tecnología de conservación de Aladiss es de lo más avanzada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Still, to be intact after hundreds of years ... Preservation technology in Aladiss must have been incredibly advanced.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Eppure, il fatto che il tuo corpo sia rimasto intatto per secoli... A quanto pare, la tecnologia di conservazione di Aladiss era incredibilmente avanzata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Visto lo visto, tampoco me sorprende.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: After what we've already seen, that doesn't come as much of a shock.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Dopo tutto quello che abbiamo gia' visto, non mi sorprende piu' di tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: ¿Qué habéis visto...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: What you've already seen ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Quello che avete gia' visto...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: Bastantes cosas, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: Yeah, there have been a lot of things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Si', ne sono successe parecchie, a dire il vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..src: No quiero inmiscuirme, pero es más que obvio que tenéis vuestros propios problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..ref: I won't ask for details, but it's clear you all have your own circumstances to deal with ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_110..dst: Non voglio intromettermi, ma e' chiaro che avete tutti i vostri problemi da affrontare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: El Geni dice que esta zona servía como almacén para guardar suministros y especímenes para la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: The Geni say this area serves as a warehouse for storing supplies and experimental specimens used in research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Il Geni dice che questa zona fungeva da magazzino per conservare provviste e campioni sperimentali usati per la ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Especímenes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Specimens ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Campioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¿Recuerdas este almacén?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Do you have any memories of this warehouse?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Ricordi questo magazzino?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Puede que no fuese este lugar en particular, pero me resulta familiar... Como si hubiera estado en uno similar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: It may not have been this place in particular, but something about it feels familiar. Like I've been somewhere like it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Forse non proprio questo posto, ma qualcosa mi sembra familiare... Come se fossi gia' stato in un posto simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¡Eso es! Yo era un sujeto de pruebas..., capturado por los investigadores y obligado a formar parte en sus experimentos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: That's it. I was a test subject ... I was captured by the researchers ... forced into their experiments ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: E' cosi'! Ero una cavia... I ricercatori mi avevano catturato... e costretto a prendere parte ai loro esperimenti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Oye, ¡¿estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Hey, are you okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Ehi, stai bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: S-sí, me han venido algunos recuerdos y me ha pillado por sorpresa, eso es todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Y-yes ... Some memories came rushing back to me and it threw me off, that's all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: S-si'... Mi sono tornati in mente alcuni ricordi e mi hanno colto alla sprovvista, tutto qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¿A ti también te convirtieron en mutante en contra de tu voluntad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Were you also turned into a mutant against your will?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Hanno trasformato anche te in un mutante contro la tua volonta'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Eso parece... Un momento, ¿cómo que «también»? ¿Hay otros como yo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: It seems so ... Wait, "also"? Are there others like me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Sembra di si'... Aspetta, "anche"? Ci sono altri come me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Sí. Que sepamos, una al menos. Una mutante que vivió algo parecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Yeah. There's at least one who we know of. A mutant who went through something very similar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Si'. Per quanto ne sappiamo, ce n'e' almeno una: una mutante che ha vissuto qualcosa di molto simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Lili Borea... No me suena su nombre, pero seguro que no es la única que ha pasado por esto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Lili Borea ... I don't recognize the name, but it's likely she's not the only other one who's gone through this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Lili Borea... Il nome non mi dice niente, ma probabilmente non e' l'unica ad aver passato tutto questo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Oye, Elnath, ¿puedo preguntarte algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Can I ask you something, Elnath?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Elnath, posso chiederti una cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¿No odias la alquimia por todo lo que te han hecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Don't you resent alchemy for what it's done to you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Non odi l'alchimia per quello che ti ha fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Sé que da igual lo que diga ahora mismo, porque podría tergiversarse, pero voy a hacerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: I know that no matter what I say right now, it may come off as self-serving, but please hear me out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: So che qualunque cosa dica adesso potrebbe sembrare una giustificazione per me, ma ti prego, ascoltami.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: No le guardo rencor a la alquimia. La culpa es de los investigadores que hicieron esos experimentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: I hold no grudge against alchemy. The ones at fault are the researchers who conducted those experiments.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Non porto rancore all'alchimia. La colpa e' dei ricercatori che hanno condotto quegli esperimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Pero no era eso lo que querías saber con tu pregunta, ¿no? Más bien si te guardo rencor a ti por ser alquimista, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: But that wasn't the true meaning of your question, was it? You're really asking if I resent you, as an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Ma non era questo che volevi sapere con la tua domanda, vero? In realta' vuoi sapere se ti porto rancore perche' sei un alchimista, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Culparte a ti o a la alquimia sería un error. Lo que ocurrió no fue culpa tuya, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: But blaming you—or alchemy itself—would be misplaced. You're not responsible for what happened, are you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Incolpare te o l'alchimia stessa sarebbe fuori luogo. Non sei responsabile di cio' che e' successo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Seguramente Lili Borea no tuvo más opción que atacar. Estaba furiosa y tenía que pagarlo con algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Lili Borea probably had no choice but to lash out. She was filled with anger and had to direct it at something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Probabilmente Lili Borea non aveva altra scelta che scagliarsi contro qualcuno. Era piena di rabbia e doveva sfogarla su qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Hala... Es increíble que puedas verlo de esta forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Wow ... It's amazing you're able to see things like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Wow... E' incredibile che tu riesca a vedere le cose in questo modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¿Ah, sí? Solo he dicho lo que pienso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Is it? I only spoke what felt true to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Davvero? Ho solo detto cio' che mi sembrava giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: Lo que piensas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: What felt true ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Cio' che ti sembrava giusto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: ¿Pasa algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: Is something wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: Succede qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..src: No, nada. Sigamos buscando a los Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..ref: No, it's nothing. Let's continue our search for the Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_120..dst: No, niente. Continuiamo a cercare i Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: ¡Te encontramos! Menos mal que estás a salvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: We found you! Thank goodness you're safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Ti abbiamo trovato! Meno male che sei al sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Que humanos me rescaten me sorprende, sí. La primera vez que veo humanos reales, así es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: That humans would be the ones to rescue me, I did not expect. My first time seeing real ones, it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Che degli umani mi abbiano salvato mi sorprende, si'. Umani veri, e' la prima volta che ne vedo, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Es un mutante, como Corleonis. ¿Lo conoces?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: E' un mutante, come Corleonis. Lo conosci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Lo siento, sí, porque no lo conozco, no. Sin embargo, una corazonada tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: He's a mutant, like Corleonis. Is there anything you know about him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Mi dispiace, si', ma non lo conosco, no. Tuttavia, un presentimento ho.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Apologize I do, but know him, I do not. However, an inkling I have.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Aquí Geni en masa el maestro Corleonis producía. Creo que un ejercito para la guerra formar pretendía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Qui, Geni in massa il maestro Corleonis produceva, si'. Credo che un esercito per la guerra volesse formare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Unirse a ese ejército seguramente el destino de Elnath fuese.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Mass-producing Geni here, Master Corleonis was. To form an army for war, presume I do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Unirsi a quell'esercito doveva essere il destino di Elnath.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: ¡¿U-un ejército?! ¡¿Eso es lo que intentaba hacer?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Likely meant to join that army, Elnath was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: U-un esercito?! Era questo che stava cercando di fare?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: No me sorprende. Aladiss siempre quería invadir otros países.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: A-an army?! That's what he was trying to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Non mi sorprende. Aladiss voleva sempre invadere gli altri paesi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: ¿Lo sabéis? Una reserva de agua hay en Aladissia, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: It's not very surprising. Aladiss was always willing to invade other countries.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Lo sapete? Ad Aladissia c'e' una riserva d'acqua, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Las tuberías por todo Aladissia maná líquido a la reserva llevaban, sí. Esa gran cantidad de maná para investigar se usaba, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Do you know? A reservoir there is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Le tubature in tutta Aladissia portavano mana liquido alla riserva, si'. Quella grande quantita' di mana veniva usata per le ricerche, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Una reserva... ¿Sería el centro de mando de Corleonis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Transported liquefied mana into the reservoir, the pipes across Aladissia did. Used for research, that large amount of mana was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Una riserva... Sara' stata il centro di comando di Corleonis?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Sí. Allí, el laboratorio de Corleonis está.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: A reservoir ... Could that have been Corleonis's headquarters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Si'. Li' si trova il laboratorio di Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Una investigación importante parecía llevar a cabo, pero no sabemos de qué se trataba, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Yes. There, Master Corleonis's laboratory is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Sembrava stesse conducendo una ricerca importante, ma non sappiamo di cosa si trattasse, no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Ya veo... Parece que podremos encontrar información de lo más valiosa en ese laboratorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Important research he seemed to have been conducting, but what it was we also do not know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Capisco... Sembra che in quel laboratorio potremo trovare informazioni davvero preziose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: I see ... From what it sounds like, that lab is very likely to hold some key information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: E' un indizio molto importante, grazie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Para llegar a la reserva, primero el puente debe bajarse, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: This is a big lead. Thank you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Per raggiungere la riserva, prima bisogna abbassare il ponte, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Ahora mismo no podemos controlar el puente desde la torre de control. Hay que buscar la forma de bajarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: In order to reach the reservoir, the bridge in front of it must first be lowered.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Al momento non possiamo azionare il ponte dalla torre di controllo. Dobbiamo trovare un modo per abbassarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..src: Vale. Cuando rescatemos a todos los Geni, vayamos a hablar con Kuku.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..ref: Currently, the bridge cannot be operated from the control tower. Another way to lower it will have to be found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_130..dst: Va bene. Quando avremo salvato tutti i Geni, andiamo a parlare con Kuku.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..src: Teniendo en cuenta la información que hemos descubierto, este es el conjunto de instalaciones de investigación más grande de todo Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..ref: Based on the information gathered, this is the largest cluster of research facilities in all of Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..dst: Considerando le informazioni raccolte, questo e' il piu' grande complesso di strutture di ricerca di tutta Aladissia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..src: Los experimentos se centraban en los recuerdos de seres vivos. Los Geni llevaban a cabo un trabajo agotador aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..ref: The experiments focused on the memories of living beings. The Geni were subjected to grueling work here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..dst: Gli esperimenti erano incentrati sui ricordi degli esseri viventi. Qui i Geni erano sottoposti a lavori estenuanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..src: Si la investigación estaba relacionada con recuerdos, puede que descubramos algo más sobre el pasado de Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..ref: If the research was related to memory, we might be able to uncover more about Elnath's past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_140..dst: Se la ricerca era legata ai ricordi, potremmo scoprire qualcosa in piu' sul passato di Elnath.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..ref: Look! Monsters are gathered over there!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..dst: Guardate! Ci sono un sacco di mostri laggiu'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..ref: Monsters! Out of control! Out of control!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..src: Creo que tenemos una emergencia entre manos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..ref: Sounds like we've got an emergency on our hands ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..dst: Sembra che abbiamo un'emergenza per le mani...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..src: No sé qué pasa, pero ¡debemos ayudar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..ref: I don't know what's going on, but we should step in and help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_150..dst: Non so cosa stia succedendo, ma dobbiamo intervenire e aiutare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¡Dicho y hecho!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Done and done!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Fatto e finito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¡Todo solucionado! Kuku nos ha contado lo que estaba pasando y hemos venido a ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: It's safe now! Kuku told us what was going on and we came to help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Ora e' tutto a posto! Kuku ci ha raccontato cosa stava succedendo e siamo venuti ad aiutarti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¡Un rescate! Mi agradecimiento tenéis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Rescue! My thanks I give you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Un salvataggio! La mia gratitudine vi porgo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Oye, ¿por qué te rodeaban todos esos monstruos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Why were all those monsters surrounding you, anyway?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Ora, perche' ti circondavano tutti quei mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: El motivo ahí está.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Over there, the reason is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: La ragione e' laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Crea monstruos artificiales ese dispositivo. Desarrollado por el maestro Corleonis, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Creates artificial monsters, that device does. Developed by Master Corleonis, it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Quel dispositivo crea mostri artificiali. Sviluppato dal maestro Corleonis, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¡¿Que crea monstruos artificiales?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: It creates artificial monsters?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Crea mostri artificiali?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Pero fuera de control estaba debido a los sucesos ocurridos en Aladissia, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: But out of control it became, due to the accidents occurring across Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Ma, a causa degli incidenti avvenuti in tutta Aladissia, e' finito fuori controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¿Así que Corleonis investigaba cómo crear monstruos artificiales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: So Corleonis was even researching how to create artificial monsters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Quindi Corleonis faceva ricerche anche su come creare mostri artificiali?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Con casos como el mío y el de otros mutantes como Elnath, tampoco me sorprende.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: With cases like me and mutants like Elnath around, it's not really all that surprising.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Con casi come il mio e mutanti come Elnath in giro, non e' poi cosi' sorprendente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Aún en fase experimental estaba. Un «producto secundario» el maestro Corleonis lo llamaba, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Still in the experimental phase, it was. A "byproduct," Master Corleonis called it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Era ancora in fase sperimentale. "Sottoprodotto" lo chiamava il maestro Corleonis, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¿Un producto secundario...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: A byproduct ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Un sottoprodotto...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Sus especificaciones desconozco, sí, pero libres de examinarlo sois.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Unknown to me, the specifics are. Feel free to examine it, if your interest it has caught.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: I dettagli mi sono sconosciuti, si'. Esaminatelo pure, se vi interessa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Para nosotros, ya no importa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: To us, it matters no more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Per noi, ormai non ha piu' importanza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Un producto secundario... Parece que su objetivo era otro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: A byproduct ... That means his real focus was something else ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Un effetto collaterale... A quanto pare, il suo vero obiettivo era un altro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¿Recuerdas algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Did you remember anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Ricordi qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Aún no, pero, teniendo en cuenta lo que se investigaba aquí, podría haber una relación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Nothing yet, but based on what was being researched, there may still be a link ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Non ancora, ma da cio' che si studiava qui potrebbe esserci un legame...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Es solo que... al ver todo esto, siento una enorme furia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: It's just ... seeing things like this, I can't help but feel a surge of anger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: E' solo che... vedere tutto questo mi fa provare una rabbia immensa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Tu rostro antes he visto, sí. En algún lugar de por aquí el registro debería estar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: Seen your face before, I have. Somewhere around here, records there should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Ho gia' visto la tua faccia. Da qualche parte qui intorno dovrebbe esserci un registro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: ¡¿E-en serio?! ¡Por favor, enséñamelo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: R-really? Please, show me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: D-davvero?! Ti prego, mostramelo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..src: Por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..ref: This way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_160..dst: Da questa parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: El Vial de recuerdos correcto debería este ser, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: The correct Memory Vial, this should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Questa dovrebbe essere la Fiala della Memoria giusta, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: M-mi pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: My ... my past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: I-il mio passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: El contenido del Vial de recuerdos contiene el pasado del mutante Elnath. Resumiendo el contenido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: The contents of the Memory Vial outline the past of the mutant "Elnath." Summarizing the data now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Il contenuto della Fiala della Memoria rivela il passato del mutante Elnath. Riassumo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: «Nombre del sujeto: Elnath. Profesión anterior: alquimista. Trabajaba gestionando los presupuestos de las labores de alquimia».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: "Subject name: Elnath. Previously an alchemist. An administrator who managed budgets for alchemical work."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: "Nome del soggetto: Elnath. Professione precedente: alchimista. Si occupava di gestire i bilanci delle attivita' alchemiche".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: «Demostró fuertes principios morales y una gran profesionalidad. No se observó ningún mal comportamiento al comienzo del experimento».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: "Demonstrated strong morals and a professional demeanor. No signs of misconduct were noted during his early tenure."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: "Ha dimostrato una forte integrita' morale e grande professionalita'. All'inizio dell'esperimento non si e' osservato alcun comportamento scorretto".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: «Sin embargo, con el paso del tiempo, aumentó su insubordinación. Supuesto motivo: rechazo de la investigación confidencial de...».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: "However, repeated insubordination was later recorded. Presumed reason: rejection of confidential research into—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: "Tuttavia, col passare del tempo, la sua insubordinazione e' aumentata. Probabile motivo: rifiuto di partecipare alla ricerca riservata su...".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: ¿Eh? ¿Una investigación de qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Huh? Research into what?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Eh? Una ricerca su cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Falta esa información en los datos. Seguramente se eliminó de forma intencionada. Continúa así:
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: There is a gap in the data. The missing part was likely intentionally erased. Continuing:
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Queste informazioni mancano dai dati. Probabilmente sono state rimosse di proposito. Continua cosi':

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: «El comportamiento disruptivo continuó. Ayudó a escapar a un criminal en busca y captura y entró en zonas de acceso restringido».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: "Disruptive behavior persisted. Aided the escape of a wanted criminal and trespassed into restricted areas."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: "Il comportamento sovversivo e' continuato. Ha aiutato un criminale ricercato a fuggire ed e' entrato in aree ad accesso limitato".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: ¿Ayudó a un fugitivo...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Aided an escape ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Ha aiutato un fuggitivo...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: «Se le encarceló por traición. El sujeto era un candidato a mutante viable, por lo que se procedió a su transferencia».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: "Imprisoned on charges of treason. Subject was found to be a viable mutant candidate and was transferred."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: "E' stato incarcerato per tradimento. Il soggetto era un candidato idoneo alla mutazione, quindi si e' proceduto al suo trasferimento".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Ya no hay más información en este Vial de recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: That is the end of the data contained on this Memory Vial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Non ci sono altre informazioni in questa Fiala della Memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Insubordinación, encarcelado... Es cierto, yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Insubordination, imprisoned ... That's right, I was ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Insubordinazione, incarcerato... E' vero, io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: ¿Recuerdas algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: ... *Exhales*
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Ricordi qualcos'altro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Sí, no todo, pero poco a poco voy recordando algunas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Did you remember something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Si'. Non ricordo tutto, ma poco a poco mi stanno tornando in mente alcune cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Recuerdo que, cuando era humano, trabajaba en algo relacionado con la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Yes. Not the whole picture, but bits and pieces are returning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Ricordo che, quando ero umano, lavoravo in un ambito legato all'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Luego me topé con alguna injusticia, algo que no podía aceptar. Ahí fue cuando le di la espalda al sistema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: I do recall having some kind of role tied to alchemy back in my human days.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Poi mi sono imbattuto in un'ingiustizia, qualcosa che non potevo accettare. E' stato allora che ho voltato le spalle al sistema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Esta forma es el precio que pagué por ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Then I came across something unjust—something I couldn't accept. That's when I turned against the system.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Questa forma e' il prezzo che ho pagato per questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Si pudiera devolverte a tu forma original...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: And this form is the price I paid for that defiance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Se potessi riportarti alla tua forma originale...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: No hace falta, no pasa nada. Es el precio de mis acciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: If I could somehow return you to your original form ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Non serve, non preoccuparti. E' il prezzo delle mie azioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Sin importar el motivo, fui en contra de las leyes por las que me regía en ese momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: Don't. It's all right. This is the price I pay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: A prescindere dal motivo, ho infranto le leggi che allora ero tenuto a rispettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Eso es todo. Es culpa mía y de nadie más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: No matter the reasons, I broke the laws I was meant to uphold at the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: E' tutto. E' colpa mia e di nessun altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Eres muy fuerte, Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: That's all there is to it. This is my burden to bear, not yours.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Sei molto forte, Elnath.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: ¿Tú crees? Si de verdad lo fuese, las cosas no habrían acabado así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: ... You're strong, Elnath.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Davvero? Se fossi davvero cosi' forte, le cose non sarebbero finite cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..src: Gracias por la información. Tus camaradas están en la torre de control. Ve con ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..ref: You call this strength? If I were truly strong, things wouldn't have turned out this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_170..dst: Grazie per le informazioni. I tuoi compagni sono nella torre di controllo. Raggiungili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: ¡Yumia Liessfeldt! Mi agradecimiento tienes por rescatar a mis camaradas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: Yumia Liessfeldt! My thanks I give to you, for rescuing my comrades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Yumia Liessfeldt! Ti sono grato per aver salvato i miei compagni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Me alegro de que todo el mundo esté a salvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Sono felice che stiano tutti bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Acabamos de volver, pero tengo que pedirte un favor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: I know we just got back, but I've got a favor to ask ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Siamo appena tornati, ma avrei un favore da chiedervi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Lo que podamos haremos para ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: Do whatever we can to help, we will.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Faremo tutto il possibile per aiutarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Hemos descubierto que Corleonis tenía un centro de investigación en la reserva de agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: We were told Corleonis had a research facility at the reservoir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Abbiamo scoperto che Corleonis aveva un centro di ricerca presso il bacino idrico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Queremos llegar hasta allí, pero el puente del camino está elevado. ¿Hay alguna manera de bajarlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: We want to reach it, but the bridge along the path is still raised. Is there some way to lower it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Vogliamo raggiungerlo, ma il ponte lungo il percorso e' ancora sollevato. C'e' un modo per abbassarlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Primero, la torre de control debe repararse, sí. Sin embargo, tiempo tardará.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: First, repaired the control tower must be. However, time it will take.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Per prima cosa, bisogna riparare la torre di controllo. Ma ci vorra' del tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Un par de días dadnos, ¿vale? Nos encargaremos de esto, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: Give us a few days, can you? Handle this, we will.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Un paio di giorni darci, potete? Di questo ci occuperemo, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Claro que sí. Gracias de antemano.
Tal vez sea momento de volver a la base e informar de nuestros hallazgos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: Now then, maybe it's time we head back to the base and report what we've learned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Forse e' ora di tornare alla base e riferire quello che abbiamo scoperto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: Is it all right if I join you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Vi dispiace se vengo con voi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Aún tenemos que seguir vigilándote. Le preguntaremos al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: We do still need to keep an eye on you. We should check with the chief about that as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Dobbiamo comunque tenerti d'occhio. Dovremmo parlarne anche con il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..src: Si me lo permitís, os seguiré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..ref: If you're willing to allow it, I'll follow your lead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_180..dst: Se siete d'accordo, mi affidero' a voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Parece que eres el centro de todas las miradas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: Looks like you're the center of attention.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Sembra che tu sia al centro dell'attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Les he hecho un resumen por encima, pero aun así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: I gave them a general rundown, but still ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Ho dato loro una panoramica generale, ma comunque...
