eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..src: Qué ganas tengo de enseñarte el resultado. Espero que sueltes un gran "AY" de la emoción, ¡yo casi no puedo contenerla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..ref: I cannot wait to show you the finished product. I hope that you're looking forward to it every bit as much as I am!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..dst: Non vedo l'ora di mostrarti il risultato. Spero che tu faccia uscire un grande "OH" dall'emozione, io quasi non riesco a trattenerla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Yikes, you look pretty down. What happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Ehi, sembri abbattuta, cosa ti succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: Ah, eres tú... Ya terminé la maqueta de la que hablamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Oh, it's you. I finished the model I mentioned before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Ah, sei tu... Ho finito il modellino di cui parlavamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: ¡Anda! ¡Qué alegría...! ¿No? ¿Por qué tus "ay" no han sonado alegres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Wow! That's great news ... isn't it? What's got you feeling so glum?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Caspita! Che bello...! No? Perche' i tuoi "oh" non suonavano allegri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: No me salten las onomatopeyas porque tengo el corazón hecho pedazos. Como la maqueta. Se me cayó al suelo... No quiero recordarlo, no me atrevo ni mirar adónde hizo "crac".
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: My moment of joy was swiftly dashed when it fell and broke into pieces. It's such a sorry sight now, I can hardly bear to look at it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Non riesco nemmeno a tirare fuori onomatopee, perche' ho il cuore a pezzi. Come il modellino. E' caduto per terra... Non voglio ripensarci, non oso nemmeno guardare dove ha fatto "crack".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: Para colmo, con ella también desperdicié vuestros esfuerzos. La erradicación de los monstruos, el material conseguido... todo para nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Moreover, all your efforts went to waste. The monster eradication, the material gathering ... all of it for naught.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Per di piu', con esso ho anche sprecato i vostri sforzi. L'eliminazione dei mostri, il materiale ottenuto... tutto inutilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: No te preocupes por mí, estaré bien, pero yo sí que me siento mal por ti. ¿Te importaría enseñármela?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Honestly, that doesn't bother me, but I do feel bad for you. Would you mind letting me see it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Non preoccuparti per me, staro' bene, ma mi dispiace proprio per te. Ti dispiacerebbe farmela vedere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: Creo que puedo arreglarla. ¿Me permites tomarla por un ratito?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Penso di poterla riparare. Mi permetti di prenderla per un po'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: ¿Me lo di-dices en serio? Mira que tiene un "chimpún" de detalles y piececitas. ¿No será un engorro de los de decir "basta"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: I'm pretty sure I could fix this! Would you mind letting me hold on to it for a little while?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Me lo di-dici sul serio? Guarda che ha una "marea" di dettagli e pezzettini. Non sara' un lavoraccio da far dire "basta"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: Y-you're certain? It has an awful lot of finicky details. You're sure the construction isn't too complex?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: Certo che no! Conta su di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..src: La verdad es que transmites mucha seguridad. Está bien, confiaré en tu saber hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..ref: It's fine! You can count on me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_120..dst: E' vero, trasmetti tanta sicurezza. Va bene, mi affidero' alla tua abilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: ¡In-cre-í-ble! Estaba hecha un cuadro, ¡y has conseguido que recupere todo su esplendor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: I-incredible ...! It was entirely in pieces, and yet you restored it to its former glory!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: In-cre-di-bile! Era ridotta in mille pezzi, eppure sei riuscita a restituirle tutto il suo splendore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: Le he hecho unos retoques, ya que estaba, para que no se vuelva a romper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: I did a little fine-tuning while I was at it, so it should be less likely to break again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Ne ho approfittato per fare qualche ritocco, cosi' non si rompera' di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: ¿Qué clase de ángel salvador eres? No me lo digas, ha sido de muy mala educación por mi parte hacerle esa pregunta a mi salvadora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: Just what sort of genius are you? No, posing that question to my benefactor would be uncouth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Che specie di angelo salvatore sei? No, non me lo dire, sarebbe stato molto maleducato da parte mia fare quella domanda alla mia salvatrice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: En fin, ahora siempre tendré un pedacito de esas vías para admirar cuando me apetezca decir "ooooh". ¡Muchas gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: In any case, now I'll always have a piece of that railway with me to admire. Thank you so very much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Insomma, ora avro' sempre un pezzetto di quei binari da ammirare quando mi andra' di dire "oooh". Grazie mille!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: Perdona, he estado pensando mientras arreglaba la maqueta y... creo que es estupendo que hayas encontrado algo que te anime tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: You know, I was thinking while I was fixing it, and ... it's nice that you have something that gets you all fired up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Scusa, ho pensato un po' mentre riparavo il modellino e... credo sia fantastico che tu abbia trovato qualcosa che ti entusiasmi cosi' tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! ¡Estoy muy de acuerdo contigo! ¿Significa eso que también te has quedado prendada de las vías?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: My, my, my! I couldn't agree more! Does that mean that you've also fallen in love with the rails?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Oh, oh, oh! Sono perfettamente d'accordo con te! Significa che anche tu ti sei innamorata dei binari?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: ¿Y a qué esperamos? ¡Vayamos a verlas! Así te puedo señalar las partes que más me gustan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: What are we waiting for?! We absolutely must head back to the tracks, so that I can point out all of their best features!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: E cosa aspettiamo? Andiamo a vederli! Cosi' posso indicarti le parti che preferisco!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! ¡Digo...! No, no, estoy bien así, gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: My, my, my! Er, no! That's fine, thanks!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: Oh, oh, oh! Cioe'...! No, no, sto bene cosi', grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..src: (No puede ser... ¿¡Se me ha pegado su forma de hablar!?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..ref: (Wait, when did I pick up that catchphrase?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_130..dst: (Non e' possibile... Mi si e' pure incollato il suo modo di parlare!?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: Je, je. Ya estabas tardando, cazadora gourmet legendaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Heh heh. I've been waiting for you, legendary gourmet researcher.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Eh, eh. Eri in ritardo, leggendaria cacciatrice gourmet.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: ¡Vaya! Qué sorpresa verte por aquí. ¿No hay en esta región poco más que minerales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Wow, I'm surprised to see you here. But, isn't this region mostly home to minerals?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Caspita! Che sorpresa vederti da queste parti. In questa regione non c'e' nient'altro che minerali, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: Ay, cuánto te queda por aprender... Entre ellos están los manjares más deliciosos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Hahaha, you have much to learn. There are delicacies to be found amongst them!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Oh, quanta strada devi ancora fare... Tra questi si nascondono le prelibatezze piu' deliziose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: Entre la flora, la fauna y todo lo demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Tra la flora, la fauna e tutto il resto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: Vale, tienes razón. Algo habrá por aquí que crezca del suelo y que, por lo tanto, pueda considerarse un manjar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Okay, true. It's not like nothing grows here. I could see some of it being a delicacy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Va bene, hai ragione. Qui qualcosa che cresce dal suolo ci sara', e quindi potra' essere considerato una prelibatezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: ¡Lo vas pillando! Entonces, ¿te darás ese gustazo y vendrás a compartirlo conmigo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Now you're getting it! So, on that note ... would you indulge me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Stai capendo! Allora, ti concederai quel piacere e verrai a condividerlo con me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: Ahora que ya hemos llegado tan lejos, me sentiría mal si rechazara tu petición. Cuenta con ello, a ver qué encuentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Well, I've gone along with this so far. It feels like it'd be wrong to turn you down now. Sure, I'll see what I come across.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Dopo essere arrivati fin qui, mi sentirei in colpa a rifiutare la tua richiesta. Puoi contarci, vediamo cosa trovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..src: ¡Estupendo! Esa respuesta es la guinda del pastel. Lo dejo, entonces, en tus manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..ref: Brilliant! I couldn't have hoped for a better answer! I'll leave things in your hands, then!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_140..dst: Splendido! Quella risposta e' la ciliegina sulla torta. Allora lascio tutto nelle tue mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..src: ¡Atiza! ¡Sí que había un manjar escondido en el metal! Sabía que mis deducciones eran acertadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..ref: Behold! There was a delicacy within the metal! I knew that my deductions had to be correct!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..dst: Caspita! C'era davvero una prelibatezza nascosta nel metallo! Sapevo che le mie deduzioni erano giuste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..src: Nunca entenderé por qué te hacen tan feliz estas cosas. Ni lo lejos que estás dispuesto a viajar para encontrarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..ref: I don't think I'll ever get over how happy this stuff makes you. Or how far you'll travel just to try and find it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..dst: Non capiro' mai perche' queste cose ti rendono cosi' felice. Ne' quanto lontano sei disposta a viaggiare per trovarle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..src: He de reconocer que no poder ir a buscarlas en persona me frustra un poco, es como si no me estuviera dando el capricho al completo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..ref: Not being able to go searching for it myself is slightly frustrating, mind you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..dst: Devo ammettere che non poterle cercare di persona mi frustra un po', e' come se non potessi godermi il piacere fino in fondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..src: Toma, tu recompensa. Te la mereces como "experta en manjares".
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..ref: Here, your reward. You deserve it, as a master of delicacies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_150..dst: Tieni, la tua ricompensa. Te la meriti come "esperta di prelibatezze".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: Magnífica... La arquitectura aladissiana es una barbaridad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Magnificent ... Aladissian architecture is nothing short of splendid ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Magnifica... L'architettura aladissiana e' una cosa pazzesca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: ¡Me encanta! La mayoría de los edificios de Eustella se construyó sobre cimientos de madera maciza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Precisely! Most Eustellan buildings are built on a foundation of sturdy lumber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Mi piace tantissimo! La maggior parte degli edifici di Eustella fu costruita su fondamenta di legno massiccio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: Me atrevería a afirmar que, no solo la mayoría, sino todos. De todas las construcciones de Eustella que conozco, no hay ni una que innove en ese sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Dare I say all of them? I do. Out of all of the Eustellan architecture that I know, there isn't a single one built otherwise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Oserei dire che non solo la maggior parte, ma tutti. Di tutte le costruzioni di Eustella che conosco, non ce n'e' una sola che si discosti da questo schema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: En cambio, los edificios de Aladiss de esta zona se levantan sobre cimientos de metal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: The Aladissian constructions in this area mostly seem to have been built on metal foundations, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Gli edifici di Aladiss di questa zona, invece, sorgono su fondamenta di metallo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: Eso complica un poco el proceso. Verás, cuanto más grande es la estructura, mayores deben ser las piezas. Forjar objetos de metal a esa escala es todo un desafío.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Which further complicates things. The larger the structure, the larger the pieces have to be. And accurately manufacturing metal objects at those scales is quite challenging.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Il che complica un po' il processo. Vedi, piu' grande e' la struttura, piu' grandi devono essere i pezzi. Forgiare oggetti di metallo a quella scala e' una vera sfida.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: No me preguntes cómo, pero superaron el escollo para edificar esta maravilla. Humm... ¿Cómo lo habrán hecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Somehow, they surmounted that issue and made this stunning building. Hrm ... How would this have been constructed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: In qualche modo hanno superato quell'ostacolo e costruito questo edificio stupefacente. Mmh... Come avranno fatto a costruirlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: Vaya, cómo te gusta hablar del tema. ¿Te gustaría que alguien investigara las estructuras aladissianas por ti?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Wow, you sure are passionate about this. Would it help if I did some research on Aladissian structures for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Vedo che l'argomento ti appassiona parecchio. Ti farebbe comodo se facessi qualche ricerca sulle strutture aladissiane?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: ¿Ha-hablas en serio? La verdad es que hay varias que me interesan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Y-you'd do that?! In that case, there are a number that I would love to learn more about!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: D-dici sul serio? In effetti, ce ne sono diverse che mi interessano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: ¿Seguro que no te importa estudiarlas para mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: You're sure you wouldn't mind looking into them for me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Sicura che non ti dispiaccia studiarle per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: En absoluto. Aunque me vendrían bien algunas indicaciones como novata...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Not at all. But, it would help if you could give me some more information to go by.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Per niente. Pero' mi sarebbero utili alcune indicazioni, visto che sono alle prime armi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..src: Claro que sí. Hay tres proyectos en concreto que podrías estudiar, cada uno más impresionante que el anterior. ¡Gracias por tu ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..ref: Of course. There are three in particular that I'd like you to look into, each just as stunning as the last. Thank you in advance for your assistance!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_160..dst: Certo! Ci sono tre strutture in particolare che vorrei farti studiare, ognuna piu' impressionante della precedente. Grazie in anticipo per il tuo aiuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..src: A simple vista, esto es... una casa normal y corriente. Con excepción de los cimientos, todo está hecho de madera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..ref: This looks like ... a regular house? Aside from the foundation, everything is made out of wood.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..dst: A prima vista, questa e'... una casa normalissima. A parte le fondamenta, e' tutta di legno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..src: Seguro que podríamos recrear algo así en los tiempos que corren.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..ref: We could probably recreate something like that nowadays.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_170..dst: Scommetto che potremmo costruire qualcosa del genere anche al giorno d'oggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..src: ¿Esto es un complejo residencial? Para mi gusto, es un poco agobiante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..ref: Is this ... a housing complex? It looks a little cramped for one, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..dst: Ma questo e' un complesso residenziale? Per i miei gusti, e' un po' angusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..src: Más que arquitectura, podrían llamarlo "arquitortura", je, je...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..ref: I'll bet that rent was just as high back then as it is now, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..dst: Altro che architettura, questa e' proprio architortura, ah ah...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..src: Bueno, seguro que un arquitecto podría aprender mucho con solo mirar este edificio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..ref: Either way, there's probably a lot that an architect could learn from looking at this building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_180..dst: Comunque, un architetto potrebbe imparare molto anche solo osservando questo edificio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..src: Por muy poco que entienda de arquitectura, hasta yo sé que construir algo así de metal sería una auténtica proeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..ref: Okay, I might not be an architect, but even I can tell that making something like this out of metal would've been one heck of an achievement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..dst: Di architettura non ne so molto, ma persino io capisco che costruire qualcosa del genere in metallo sarebbe un'impresa eccezionale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..src: No se me ocurre cómo podríamos copiar este sistema. Y no solo me refiero al proceso de construcción, no tengo ni idea de cómo subir los materiales necesarios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..ref: We couldn't even hope to copy something like this. Manufacturing aside, there's no way we could get the pieces up that high.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..dst: Non saprei proprio come potremmo replicare questa struttura. E non parlo solo della costruzione: non ho idea di come riusciremmo a portare fin lassu' i materiali necessari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..src: A una parte de mí le gustaría que este trabajo ayudara a nuestra generación de algún modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..ref: Still, it would be nice if this work helps someone figure that out in our own time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_190..dst: In fondo, mi piacerebbe che questo lavoro aiutasse in qualche modo la nostra generazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..ref: Did you find everything already? That was fast!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..dst: Hai gia' visto tutto? Che rapidita'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..src: Hemos traído todos los datos que hemos podido recopilar. Ten en cuenta que no somos expertos y nuestro examen no es detallado ni nada por el estilo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..ref: We just brought the information we could gather. We aren't experts, so we couldn't do any detailed examination or anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..dst: Abbiamo portato tutte le informazioni che siamo riusciti a raccogliere. Non siamo esperti, quindi non abbiamo potuto fare un esame approfondito o altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..src: No pasa nada, los detalles son cosa mía. Solo puedo daros las gracias por procurarme toda esta información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..ref: That's all right, picking it apart is my job. Still, I can't thank you enough for gathering this for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..dst: Non c'e' problema, analizzare i dettagli e' compito mio. Ti sono comunque immensamente grata per aver raccolto tutte queste informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..src: Voy a esforzarme al máximo para recrear estas estructuras, aunque solo consiga recuperar una pequeña parte de ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..ref: I'm going to work my hardest towards recreating some of these structures, even if it's only a small portion of one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_200..dst: Mi impegnero' al massimo per ricreare queste strutture, anche se riuscissi a ricostruirne solo una piccola parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: Hello! How's the investigation into all that architecture going?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Ciao! Come procede lo studio di tutte quelle architetture?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: ¡Nada mal! Tengo una idea aproximada de cómo encajan las piezas de este puzle. De hecho, me pilláis trabajando en algunos planos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: Not bad at all! I've gotten a decent idea of how everything was put together. Right now, I'm working on drawing up some blueprints.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Non c'e' male! Mi sono fatta un'idea abbastanza chiara di come fosse assemblato tutto. In questo momento sto lavorando a dei progetti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: La construcción es un concepto simple que se repite sin importar la época. Si tienes la información necesaria, te sorprendería lo fácil que es recrear los pasos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: No matter the era, construction is still construction. With enough detailed information, it's surprisingly easy to work out how it was done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: A prescindere dall'epoca, costruire e' sempre costruire. Con informazioni abbastanza dettagliate, e' sorprendentemente facile capire come sia stato fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Eso significa que con planos nuevos, ¡podrías recrear esas edificaciones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: So, with your new blueprints, you could recreate those buildings!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Quindi, con i tuoi nuovi progetti potresti ricreare quegli edifici!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Bueno... quizá me he pasado de simplista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: Er, well ... It's not quite that simple.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Ehm, beh... Non e' proprio cosi' semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Se construyeron con unos materiales de primera categoría. Conseguir unas menas tan sólidas no será moco de pavo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: They were built using some truly high-end materials. Getting ore that strong is no easy task.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Sono stati costruiti con materiali davvero pregiati. Trovare un minerale cosi' resistente non e' affatto facile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Lo que busco se halla en los lomos de los cangrejos ermitaños que viven en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: What I'd need has to be harvested from the backs of the hermit crabs that live in this area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Quello che mi serve si ricava dal dorso dei granchi eremiti che vivono in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: ¿Solo eso? Es coser y cantar para nosotros. ¡En eso somos unos expertos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: That's it? That'd be pretty quick work for us. We can totally handle it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Tutto qui? Ci metteremmo pochissimo. Possiamo occuparcene senza problemi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: No, pero no os puedo pedir tal cosa, sería imprudente y me saltaría varias normativas. Se lo pediré a los otros miembros del equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: No, that would be asking far too much. And reckless, to boot. I'll ask the other team members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: No, sarebbe chiedervi troppo. E anche una bella imprudenza. Lo chiedero' agli altri membri della squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Pero ¡si hacemos cosas así todos los días! Además, me ha picado el gusanillo y ahora quiero saber más de estos viejos edificios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: Seriously, we do that kind of thing all the time! Besides, I'm interested in these old buildings, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Davvero, facciamo cose del genere in continuazione! E poi anche a me interessano questi vecchi edifici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..src: Iremos a buscar cangrejos ermitaños y te traeremos los materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..ref: We'll take down some hermit crabs and get that ore for you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_210..dst: Andremo a caccia di granchi eremiti e ti procureremo quel minerale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: ¡Aquí traemos la mena de los cangrejos ermitaños! ¿Es lo que querías?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: Here's your hermit crab ore! Is this the right stuff?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Ecco il minerale dei paguri! E' quello che volevi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: ¡Lo es! ¡Vaya que sí! ¡Y has conseguido la cantidad necesaria!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: I-it is! Oh, wow! You really did manage to harvest some!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: S-si'! Oh, wow! Sei davvero riuscito a estrarne un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: Ahora ya puedo completar la receta para el material... Pero voy demasiado rápido, primero debo analizar la mena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: Now I can finish the recipe for the material ... is what I would like to say, but I do need to analyze that ore first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Ora posso completare la ricetta per il materiale... o almeno, vorrei dirlo, ma prima devo analizzare quella mena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: No puedo construir algo y luego cruzar los dedos para que no se venga abajo, es mi obligación garantizar que soportará cualquier inclemencia y que perdurará en el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: You can't just build with it and hope for the best. You have to make sure that it's strong enough, and that it will last.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Non puoi costruirci qualcosa e sperare che vada tutto bene. Devi assicurarti che sia abbastanza resistente e che duri nel tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: Ah, vale. Tomo nota: a pesar de tener los ingredientes necesarios, no se recomienda comenzar la construcción sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: Oh, okay. Even with all the right ingredients, it isn't like you can get straight to making it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Ah, capisco. Anche avendo tutti gli ingredienti giusti, non si puo' passare subito alla realizzazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: Claro, al fin y al cabo, en estos edificios vivirán personas. No se podrán habitar si no son seguros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: It's going to be used in buildings that house people, after all. It can't be used if it's not guaranteed to be safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Dopotutto, verra' usato per costruire edifici in cui vivranno delle persone. Non si puo' usare se non si e' certi che sia sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..src: No nos debería llevar mucho rato. Con suerte, ya estará todo listo la próxima vez que vengas a verme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..ref: Still, that shouldn't take too much longer. With any luck, everything will be ready the next time you check in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_220..dst: Comunque, non dovrebbe volerci ancora molto. Se siamo fortunati, sara' tutto pronto la prossima volta che passerai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: Hey! How are those blueprints coming along?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: Gracias a tu contribución, ¡he acabado! Estoy iniciando los preparativos para construir un prototipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: Thanks to your contributions, they're all done! I'm just about to start working on a prototype.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: Grazie al tuo aiuto, sono tutti pronti! Sto per mettermi al lavoro su un prototipo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: ¡Vaya! ¿Tanto has avanzado? ¡Sáltate ese paso y construye directamente el edificio!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: Whoa! You're already that far along? So, you can just skip to making the real thing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: Wow! Sei gia' cosi' avanti? Allora puoi saltare direttamente alla costruzione vera e propria!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: Eh... no, no puedo. Me ciño a la normativa. Una construcción de esa envergadura me exigiría papeleo, tiempo y mano de obra que ahora mismo no tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: E-er, no ... It doesn't quite work like that. That level of construction calls for more time and manpower.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: E-ehm, no... Non funziona proprio cosi'. Una costruzione di queste dimensioni richiede piu' tempo e manodopera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: ¿Y si nos encargamos nosotros? Tenemos experiencia construyendo bases y no tiene que ser tan diferente. ¡Acabaremos en un momento!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: What if we did it, then? We've made bases before, so it can't be too different. We'd have it done in no time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: E se lo facessimo noi, allora? Abbiamo gia' costruito delle basi, quindi non dovrebbe essere molto diverso. Lo finiremmo in un attimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: ¿En un momento, dices? La normativa dice que... ¡Y qué más da! Has cumplido con tu palabra siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: "No time," you say? That strikes me as—No, you've accomplished everything you said you would so far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: "In un attimo", dici? Mi sembra... No, finora hai sempre mantenuto la parola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: Si dices que puedes construirlo, ¿quién soy yo para negártelo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: If you say that you can construct it, I'll leave things in your capable hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: Se dici di poterlo costruire, allora mi affidero' alle tue mani esperte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..src: ¡Qué ganas tengo de ver el producto final!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..ref: I look forward to seeing the finished product!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_230..dst: Non vedo l'ora di vedere il prodotto finito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..src: Hemos seguido tus planos a rajatabla. ¡Espero que te guste cómo ha quedado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..ref: We followed your blueprints exactly. I think you'll love how it turned out!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..dst: Abbiamo seguito i tuoi progetti alla lettera. Spero che il risultato ti piaccia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..ref: Y-you're already finished?! You really are a master carpenter ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..dst: Ma hai gia' fi-finito?! Sei davvero una maestra falegname...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..src: No, solo una alquimista que se ha acostumbrado a construir bases.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..ref: Nah, just an alchemist who's used to base building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..dst: No, sono solo un'alchimista abituata a costruire basi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..src: Ya veo... No sé muy bien a qué te refieres, pero me alegro de haber confiado en tu talento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..ref: Y-you don't say ... I don't really understand what you mean by that, but I'm glad that I trusted in your abilities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..dst: D-davvero...? Non capisco bene cosa intendi, ma sono felice di essermi fidato delle tue capacita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..src: Y gracias por creer en mis planos y construir esto por mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..ref: And thank you for believing in my blueprints and building it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_240..dst: E grazie per aver creduto nei miei progetti e averlo costruito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: ¡Ah, la alquimista! ¿Ya has paseado por las preciosas calles de Calumna, la capital?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Ah, the alchemist! Did you see the streets of the beautiful capital, Calumna?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Ah, l'alchimista! Hai gia' visto le splendide strade di Calumna, la capitale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Pues sí. Y, por algún motivo, veo que estás de muy buen humor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Yes. But you sure seem to be in good spirits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Si'. Ma sembri proprio di buon umore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: ¡Cómo no estarlo! He soñado con este momento desde el día que me uní al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: But of course! I've been dreaming of this moment from the day I first joined the Research Team!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Ma certo! Sognavo questo momento dal giorno in cui sono entrato nella Squadra di Ricerca!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Y pensar que veré Calumna con mis propios ojos... ¡No existe mayor alegría para un historiador de Aladiss como yo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: To think I would see Calumna with my own two eyes ... As a historian of Aladiss, there is no greater happiness!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Pensare che potro' vedere Calumna con i miei occhi... Da storico di Aladiss, non c'e' gioia piu' grande!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Pero me temo que ahora empiezan los verdaderos problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Eppure, e' proprio qui che iniziano i problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Al desastre provocó la debacle de Calumna. Seguro que la mayoría de los registros se han perdido para siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Calumna has been ravaged by the disaster. I'm sure the majority of its records have been lost to time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Il disastro ha devastato Calumna. Sono certo che la maggior parte dei suoi documenti sia andata perduta col tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: No dejo de pensar que ese edificio parece un aula magna. Quizá allí dentro estén esperándome documentos interesantes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: This building looks like some kind of assembly hall. If I could get inside, I might be able to find some documents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Questo edificio sembra una sorta di sala delle assemblee. Se riuscissi a entrare, potrei trovare dei documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Entiendo que no vas a buscarlos por los monstruos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: ... So the issue is the monsters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: ... Quindi il problema sono i mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Correcto. Los monstruos campan a sus anchas por los alrededores. ¡Ni se me ocurriría poner un pie allí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Correct. The rampant monsters in the vicinity have made it impossible to enter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Esatto. I mostri che infestano la zona mi impediscono di entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Ah... El sueño de mi vida, tan cerca y a la vez tan lejos... No puedo creer que todo acabe aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Ahh, my lifelong dream, on the verge of becoming reality. To think that it may end here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Ah... Il sogno di una vita e' a un passo dal realizzarsi. E pensare che potrebbe finire qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: Vale, vale, no pongas esa cara. Yo me encargaré de esos monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Okay, stop looking at me like that. I'll clear out the monsters for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Va bene, va bene, non guardarmi cosi'. Mi occupero' io di quei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..src: ¡¿En serio?! ¡Oh, alquimista, mil gracias! Mi sueño está en tus manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..ref: Really?! Many thanks, good alchemist. My dream is in your hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_010..dst: Davvero?! Grazie infinite, brava alchimista. Il mio sogno e' nelle tue mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..src: Perdón por hacerte esperar. Ya no deberían quedar monstruos por la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..ref: Sorry to keep you waiting. The monsters should be gone now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..dst: Scusa per l'attesa. Ora i mostri dovrebbero essere spariti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..src: ¡Cómo agradecerte esta ayuda tan valiosa! Por fin puedo continuar mi investigación sobre la historia de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..ref: You have my gratitude. Thanks to your assistance, my research into Aladiss's history can continue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..dst: Ti sono davvero grato. Grazie al tuo aiuto, posso continuare la mia ricerca sulla storia di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..src: El día en que publique mi trabajo, te dedicaré unas líneas en mis agradecimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..ref: When I finally publish my work here, I will be sure to write your name in the acknowledgments!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..dst: Quando finalmente pubblichero' il mio lavoro, ti citero' senz'altro nei ringraziamenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡qué honor! ¡Buena suerte en la investigación!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..ref: Ahaha, I'm honored. Good luck with your research!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_020..dst: Ahah, ne sono onorato. Buona fortuna con la ricerca!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: ¡Yumia, qué oportuna! ¿Puedo pedirte una opinión sincera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: Oh, great timing, Yumia! Can I ask for your opinion on something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Oh, Yumia, sei arrivata proprio al momento giusto! Posso chiederti un parere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: El jefe nos ha pedido que arreglemos la carretera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: The chief asked us to fix this broken road, you see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Il capo ci ha chiesto di riparare questa strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: Y no sé si es falta de experiencia o qué, pero no nos apañamos para avanzar con las reparaciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: It might be a lack of expertise, but we can't seem to make any progress with the repairs ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Forse ci manca l'esperienza, ma non riusciamo proprio ad andare avanti con le riparazioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: Ya veo. Ahora que me fijo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: I see. Hold on a moment.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: Esta carretera es muy peculiar. Está hecha con unos materiales interconectados con energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: What a strange road this is. The materials it's made of are all connected by energy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Che strada strana. I materiali di cui e' fatta sono tutti collegati dall'energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: Si logramos transferir la misma energía a lo largo de la carretera, debería volver a la normalidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: So flowing the same connecting energy through the road should return it to normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Quindi, se facciamo fluire lungo la strada la stessa energia che li collega, dovrebbe tornare come prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: No sé si funcionará, pero probemos a ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: I'm not completely sure it'll work, but why don't we try it out and see?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: Non so se funzionera', ma perche' non proviamo e vediamo che succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: Sí, por favor, haz lo que puedas.
(Si reparamos la carretera, iremos a favor de los planes de Basilius y nada me gustaría menos...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: (Fixing the road is like helping Basilius's plans, which is a little annoying ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: (Riparare la strada significa assecondare i piani di Basilius, e la cosa mi da' parecchio fastidio...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..src: (Pero, si la dejamos así, nos complicaría la vida a la hora de ir de un lado para otro. ¡No nos queda otra que repararla!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..ref: (But leaving it like this would certainly be inconvenient for getting around. Might as well try fixing it!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_030..dst: (Ma lasciarla cosi' renderebbe di certo piu' difficile spostarsi. Tanto vale provare a ripararla!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..src: Vaya... Has podido arreglarla. Gracias por tu ayuda, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..ref: Wow ... You really were able to fix it. Thanks for your help, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..dst: Wow... Sei riuscita davvero a ripararla. Grazie per il tuo aiuto, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..src: Me alegro de que todo haya salido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..ref: I'm just glad it all went well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..dst: Sono solo contenta che sia andato tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..src: Hay otras carreteras en mal estado como esta. Si las ves, ¿podrías repararlas por nosotros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..ref: There are other broken roads like this out there. If you see any more, could you fix them for us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..dst: Ci sono altre strade dissestate come questa. Se ne trovi altre, potresti ripararle per noi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..src: (Repararé todas las que pueda para ayudar al equipo de investigación.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..ref: (I should fix as many as I can to help out the Research Team.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_040..dst: (Ne riparero' quante piu' possibile per aiutare la Squadra di Ricerca.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Saludos. ¿Puedo solicitar la asistencia de la venerable alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: Greetings. May I humbly ask the venerable alchemist for her assistance?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Salve. Posso chiedere umilmente l'aiuto della venerabile alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Claro, ¿de qué se trata? Estoy aquí para ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: Sure, what is it? I'll do whatever I can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Certo, di cosa si tratta? Faro' tutto il possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Me uní al equipo de investigación para estudiar a las especies autóctonas de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: I have joined the Research Team in order to study the endemic species of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Mi sono unito alla Squadra di Ricerca per studiare le specie endemiche di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Todas y cada una de las que hemos descubierto y observado hasta la fecha presentan factores fascinantes en el mundo de la ecología.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: All of the endemic species discovered and observed so far have had truly fascinating ecology.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Tutte le specie endemiche scoperte e osservate finora hanno un'ecologia davvero affascinante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Sin embargo, una especie endémica que solo habita la región de Lacuna ha entorpecido nuestro avance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: However, one endemic species which only lives in the Lacuna region has been making investigation difficult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Tuttavia, una specie endemica che vive solo nella regione di Lacuna sta rendendo difficili le indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Seguro que ya los has visto. Son unos seres humanoides y huecos que vagan por Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: I'm sure you've seen them. The hollow-looking, humanoid beings that wander around Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Sono certo che tu li abbia visti. Quegli esseri umanoidi dall'aspetto vuoto che vagano per Calumna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Me gustaría pedirte que te enfrentaras a esa especie para recabar más información al respecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: I'd like to request that you do battle with that endemic species, for the sake of gathering information on them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Vorrei chiederti di combattere contro quella specie endemica, cosi' da raccogliere informazioni su di loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Su temperamento es hostil y atacarán al menor indicio de tu presencia en su territorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: They have a vicious temperament and will attack immediately if you get the slightest bit close to them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Hanno un temperamento feroce e ti attaccheranno appena ti avvicinerai anche solo un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Ya veo. Eso explica el retraso en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: I see. That explains why your investigation isn't so easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Capisco. Ecco perche' le indagini sono cosi' difficili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Exacto. Precisamente por eso necesito que las observes en combate. Eres fuerte: no te costará enfrentarte a ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: Indeed. So to that end, I would like you to observe them through battle, since you have the strength to fight them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Esatto. Percio' vorrei che li osservassi durante il combattimento, visto che hai la forza necessaria per affrontarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: Vale, lo haré. Si descubro algo, te lo contaré enseguida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: All right. I'll go fight them and let you know if I figure anything out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: Va bene. Andro' a combatterli e ti faro' sapere se scopriro' qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: (Esto podría guardar relación con los planes de Basilius.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: (This could definitely be related to what Basilius is planning.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: (Questo potrebbe avere sicuramente a che fare con cio' che sta progettando Basilius.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..src: (No hay tiempo que perder. Debo llegar hasta el final.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..ref: (Time to fight hard and get to the bottom of things.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_050..dst: (Non c'e' tempo da perdere. Devo andare fino in fondo.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: (Qué raro, percibo un rastro débil de maná que emana de ellas, pero no parecen estar vivas del todo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: (That was strange. I can sense some faint mana from them, but they don't really seem to be alive.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: (Che strano, percepisco una debole traccia di mana provenire da loro, ma non sembrano del tutto vive.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: (La bióloga mencionó que su «temperamento era hostil»...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: (The biologist said they had a "vicious temperament" ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: (La biologa ha detto che avevano un "temperamento aggressivo"...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: (Pero es como si fueran marionetas que reaccionan al movimiento. No sé si se les puede atribuir una emoción como tal.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: (But it's more like they're dolls that react to anything that moves. I don't know if emotion has much to do with it.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: (Ma e' come se fossero marionette che reagiscono a qualsiasi cosa si muova. Non so quanto c'entri l'emotivita'.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: Ah... ¿Podrían ser muñecas fabricadas con alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: ... Oh. Maybe these are dolls made by alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: Ah... Potrebbero essere bambole create con l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: (Aunque no podría asegurarlo. Si fuera así, ¿por qué fueron creadas?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: (I can't be certain, though. If that is the case, why would they have been made in the first place?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: (Anche se non posso esserne certa. Se fosse cosi', perche' mai le avrebbero create?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..src: (Ya lo pensaré luego. Ahora debería hablar con la bióloga.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..ref: (I can ponder that later. For now, I should go back to the biologist.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_060..dst: (Ci pensero' piu' tardi. Per ora, dovrei tornare dalla biologa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Así que no notaste una actividad emocional. Gracias por estos datos tan interesantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: So you didn't sense any emotions while fighting with them. Thank you for this valuable information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Quindi, combattendo contro di loro, non hai percepito emozioni. Grazie per queste preziose informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Eh... Creo que estos monstruos podrían haber sido fabricados por alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Um ... I think those monsters might have been made by alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Ehm... Credo che quei mostri potrebbero essere stati creati da alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: O, por lo menos, es mi intuición como alquimista. No puedo explicarlo con otras palabras, pero algo me dice que han sido hechas por un humano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: As an alchemist myself, I just have this feeling about it. It's hard to explain, but they feel man-made.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Da alchimista, e' una sensazione che ho. E' difficile da spiegare, ma sembrano fatti dall'uomo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Entiendo. La intuición de una alquimista, ¿eh? En ese caso, debes estar en lo cierto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Interesting. An alchemist's intuition, you say? In that case, it's quite possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Interessante. L'intuito di un'alchimista, dici? In tal caso, e' del tutto possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Huh, you just believe me? That was awfully quick ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Eh? Mi credi cosi', senza fare domande?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: La intuición de una persona que está familiarizada con un tema es siempre sinónimo de experiencia. No hay nada más fiable que eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: The intuition of one who walks a particular path comes from a wealth of experience. Nothing is more believable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: L'intuito di chi percorre una certa strada nasce da una grande esperienza. Non c'e' nulla di piu' credibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Sobre todo, cuando estamos hablando de una alquimista como tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Especially coming from an alchemist as experienced as yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Soprattutto se viene da un'alchimista esperta come te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Ja, ja, ja. Qué corte que te lo digan a la cara...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Ahaha. Being praised so directly is embarrassing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Ahaha. Mi imbarazza ricevere complimenti cosi' diretti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Bueno, seguiré investigando desde este punto teniendo en cuenta la información y las teorías que me has presentado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: Well then, based on the information and theories you have given me, I will continue investigating on my end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Bene, allora continuero' le mie indagini sulla base delle informazioni e delle ipotesi che mi hai fornito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..src: Si logro algún avance, te haré llamar. Gracias de nuevo por tu aportación a la ciencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..ref: If there are any new developments, I will get in touch. Thank you again for your assistance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_070..dst: Se faro' qualche progresso, ti faro' contattare. Grazie ancora per il tuo contributo alla scienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: ¡Hola! ¿Has averiguado algo sobre esa especie autóctona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: Hello! Have you figured out anything about that endemic species?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Ciao! Hai scoperto qualcosa su quella specie autoctona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Sí. He observado un fenómeno trascendental durante mis estudios. Justo iba a contártelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: Yes. I observed an interesting phenomenon during my studies, and was thinking of telling you about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Si'. Durante i miei studi ho osservato un fenomeno straordinario e stavo pensando di parlartene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Entre ellos hay un espécimen concreto que se diferencia de los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: It appears that among them, there is one type of specimen that is unique from the others.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Tra loro c'e' un esemplare in particolare che si distingue dagli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Todo lo que sé es que son inertes, como estatuas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: What I know at this point is that they are as still as statues ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Tutto quello che so e' che sono immobili come statue...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Y que se pueden avistar en diferentes zonas repartidas por la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: And that they are located in various locations all around the capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: E che si trovano in diverse zone sparse per tutta la capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Eso es. Me gustaría que fueras a verlas por ti misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: Indeed. I'd like for you to go see them for yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Esatto. Vorrei che andassi a vederle di persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Me encantaría que, como la última vez, me comentaras cuál es tu opinión como alquimista. Me ayudaría enormemente en mi investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: Like last time, if you could share your opinion as an alchemist, it would help my research immensely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Mi piacerebbe che, come l'ultima volta, mi dicessi quale sia la tua opinione da alchimista. Sarebbe di grande aiuto per la mia ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..src: Claro. Ver para creer, ¿verdad? ¡Yo me encargo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..ref: Sure. Seeing is believing, right? Leave it me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_080..dst: Certo. Vedere per credere, no? Ci penso io!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..src: (Este es el monstruo que mencionó la bióloga. Tenía razón, no parece que vaya a moverse.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..ref: (So this is the unique specimen I was told about. It certainly doesn't look like it can move.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..dst: (Questo e' il mostro di cui parlava la biologa. Aveva ragione, non sembra proprio che si muova.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..src: (Es frío al tacto... Es como tocar un cascarón vacío.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..ref: (Its body feels cold ... Almost like an actual empty shell.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..dst: (E' freddo al tatto... E' come toccare un guscio vuoto.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..src: (Se parece bastante a las otras, aunque no se mueve. Puede que no la hayan equipado con esa función...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..ref: (It looks the same as the others, but it doesn't move. Maybe it's not equipped with that function?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_090..dst: (Sembra uguale agli altri, ma non si muove. Forse non e' dotato di questa funzione...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..src: (Todo es muy raro. No me atrevo ni a imaginar el objetivo del alquimista que las fabricó.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..ref: (In any case, these sure are strange. The alchemist that made these must have had peculiar taste.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..dst: (E' tutto molto strano. Non oso nemmeno immaginare quale fosse lo scopo dell'alchimista che le ha create.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..src: (Es posible que Basilius esté detrás de todo esto.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..ref: (Maybe it was Basilius who made these after all.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..dst: (E' possibile che Basilius sia dietro a tutto questo.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..src: (Si ha usado el Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso para restaurar Calumna...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..ref: (If he used the Almighty Memory Vial to restore Calumna ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..dst: (Se ha usato la Fiala della Memoria onnipotente per restaurare Calumna...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..src: (Puede que estas cosas hayan surgido como consecuencia de la restauración...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..ref: (These things could also be part of that restoration ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..dst: (Forse anche queste cose sono il risultato di quel restauro...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..src: (Lo que significa que existían en Aladiss hace tiempo, ¿no? No, imposible, habría sido demasiado peligroso.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..ref: (Which would mean they were in Aladiss back then, too? No, surely that would've been too dangerous.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_100..dst: (Il che significa che esistevano ad Aladiss gia' da tempo, no? No, impossibile, sarebbe stato troppo pericoloso.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Como pensaba. A diferencia de las animadas, no percibo ni rastro de maná en esta.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (Just as I thought. Unlike the moving ones, I don't sense any mana from this one at all.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Come pensavo. A differenza di quelle in movimento, non percepisco nemmeno una traccia di mana in questa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Y, si no hay maná, no hay alma.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (If there's no mana, that means there's no soul.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (E se non c'e' mana, non c'e' nemmeno un'anima.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Por lo tanto, el monstruo inerte y los edificios ruinosos de Calumna comparten ciertas características.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (So then, that unmoving monster and the half-reconstructed buildings of Calumna are the same.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Quindi il mostro immobile e gli edifici in rovina di Calumna hanno delle caratteristiche in comune.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (La restauración de Basilius no ha terminado. ¿Será que todavía no han recibido un alma?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (Basilius's restoration isn't finished. Does this mean they're still missing their souls?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Il restauro di Basilius non e' ancora terminato. Significa che sono ancora privi di un'anima?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Almas reanimadas que vagan entre edificios a medio restaurar...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Anime rianimate che vagano tra edifici restaurati solo in parte...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Eso implicaría... que estos seres están vinculados con Basilius...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (Wait. To Basilius, could these specimens be ...?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Aspetta. Per Basilius, questi esemplari potrebbero essere...?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..src: (Creo que aquí no hay nada más que ver. Y tengo unas cuantas ideas que contrastar con esa bióloga.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..ref: (Well, I think that's all there is to find, and I've come up with some ideas. I should go back to the biologist.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_110..dst: (Credo che qui non ci sia altro da scoprire, e mi sono venute in mente alcune idee. Dovrei tornare dalla biologa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Ya veo. El emperador Basilius las creó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: I see. They were made by Emperor Basilius ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Capisco. Le ha create l'imperatore Basilius...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: No tengo pruebas que respalden esta conclusión, pero es lo más probable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: I don't have hard proof. But it seems likely from what I saw.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Non ho prove a sostegno di questa conclusione, ma mi sembra la piu' probabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Creo que Basilius... deseaba crear ciudadanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Credo che Basilius... desiderasse creare dei cittadini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Seguro que, hace tiempo, mucho antes de que Aladiss fuera destruida, Calumna era una ciudad con una gran población.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: I'm sure back then, before Aladiss was destroyed, there were lots of people living in Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Sono certa che, molto tempo fa, prima che Aladiss venisse distrutta, Calumna fosse una citta' densamente popolata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Y hasta que el pueblo de Aladiss pudiera volver a la vida, quería poblar la zona con estas criaturas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: So until the people of Aladiss could be brought back, these were used to populate the area ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: E cosi', finche' il popolo di Aladiss non fosse potuto tornare in vita, voleva popolare la zona con queste creature...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: (Pero ¿qué concepción tiene Basilius de los ciudadanos?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: (Just what did Basilius think citizens were?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: (Ma che idea aveva Basilius dei cittadini?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Sea como sea, creo que he alcanzado el límite de mis capacidades como investigadora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: Whatever the truth may be, it seems we've reached the limits of investigating the matter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Qualunque sia la verita', credo che siamo giunti al limite delle nostre indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..src: Muchas gracias, Yumia. Has aportado mucho a mi estudio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..ref: Many thanks, Yumia. You've been a great help to my research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_120..dst: Grazie mille, Yumia. Sei stata di grande aiuto per la mia ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: Ah, Yumia, eres tú... Qué lejos hemos llegado, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: Oh, it's you, Yumia. ... We've finally made it this far, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: Oh, sei tu, Yumia. ... Siamo finalmente arrivati fin qui, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: Sí... Disculpa que lo diga, pero me da la sensación de que estás un poco nervioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: Oh, sir. You seem a little nervous?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: Oh, signore. Sembri un po' nervoso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: B-bueno, claro que lo estoy. Por fin vemos la luz al final del túnel con los objetivos del equipo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: W-well of course I am. The Research Team's goals are all coming to a head, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: B-be', certo che lo sono. Gli obiettivi della Squadra di Ricerca stanno finalmente per concretizzarsi, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: Eso me recuerda que necesito que me hagas un favor, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: That reminds me. Yumia, I have a favor to ask you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: A proposito, Yumia, avrei un favore da chiederti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: (En Lignumbria me trataba de una manera muy distinta...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: (He was so harsh towards me back in Ligneus ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: (Quando eravamo a Lignumbria era cosi' duro con me...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: It's nothing. So, what do you need?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: Non e' niente. Allora, di cosa hai bisogno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: Me gustaría que fabricaras armaduras con alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: I'd like for you to craft some armor, using alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: Vorrei che realizzassi delle armature con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..src: Nos han informado de que los monstruos de la región de Lacuna son muy feroces. Necesitamos protegernos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: We've received reports that the monsters in the Lacuna region are ferocious. Our members are in need of better protection.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: Ci hanno riferito che i mostri della regione di Lacuna sono feroci. I membri della squadra hanno bisogno di una protezione migliore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..ref: I-I see. Okay! I'll make some sturdy armor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_130..dst: C-capisco. Va bene! Realizzero' delle armature resistenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: ¿Qué te parece? Yo diría que han quedado bien, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: What do you think, sir? I think they turned out well myself, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Che ne pensa, signore? Secondo me sono venute bene, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Sí, desde luego. Los compañeros del equipo estarán más tranquilos con estas armaduras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: Indeed. The team members will be pleased to have armor like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: E' vero. I membri della squadra saranno lieti di avere armature come queste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: ¿Recuerdas lo que te dije en la región de Lignumbria?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: Do you remember what I said to you back in the Ligneus region?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Ricordi cosa ti dissi nella regione di Lignumbria?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Me dijiste que fuera consciente de cuál era mi lugar y que recurrir a un tabú era una desgracia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: You said things like, "Know your place," and, "Relying on the taboo is a disgrace."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Mi dicesti cose come: "Conosci il tuo posto" e "Ricorrere al tabu' e' una vergogna".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Siento de corazón todo lo que dije. Sé que la disculpa llega tarde, pero de verdad que lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: I'm truly sorry for what I said back then. It may be too little, too late, but I mean it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Mi dispiace davvero per quello che ti dissi allora. Forse ormai e' troppo tardi, ma lo dico sul serio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Agradezco mucho tu implicación con el equipo. Nunca habríamos llegado tan lejos sin ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: I really appreciate what you've done. The Research Team would have never gotten to this point if it weren't for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Ti sono davvero grato per tutto quello che hai fatto. Senza di te, la Squadra di Ricerca non sarebbe mai arrivata fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Aunque todavía no he logrado desprenderme de ese miedo al tabú... No es algo que desaparezca de la noche a la mañana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: Not that fear of the taboo is completely gone. Something like that won't just disappear overnight ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: La paura del tabu' non e' ancora svanita del tutto. Una cosa del genere non scompare da un giorno all'altro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Pero quiero que sepas que no queda nadie en el equipo de investigación que te considere mala persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: But at the very least, there is no longer anyone in the Research Team who thinks you are a bad person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Ma almeno nella Squadra di Ricerca non c'e' piu' nessuno che ti consideri una cattiva persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Gracias, agradezco que me digas eso. Creo que por fin siento que el equipo me acepta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: It means a lot for you to say that. I really feel like I'm finally being accepted by everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Grazie, mi fa davvero piacere che tu me lo dica. Credo di sentirmi finalmente accettata da tutta la squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..src: Lo dicho, Yumia Liessfeldt: espero seguir contando contigo de ahora en adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: So then, Yumia Liessfeldt, I hope we can continue to count on you from here on out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Allora, Yumia Liessfeldt, spero di poter continuare a contare su di te d'ora in avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..ref: Yes, you can! I'll be counting on you too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_140..dst: Grazie, puoi contarci! Anch'io conto su di te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: I tuoi strumenti sono cosi' belli...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: Y-yeah? What's this all of a sudden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: S-si'? A cosa e' dovuto tutto questo all'improvviso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: Las herramientas que usas en combate, ya sabes, las que disparan fuego y relámpagos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: Those tools, the ones you use in battle. You know, the ones that spit out fire and lighting ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: Gli strumenti che usi in combattimento, sai, quelli che sparano fuoco e fulmini...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: (Does he mean my Flammes and Plajigs?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: (Stara' parlando delle mie Flammes e dei miei Plajig?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: Es que, ¡guau! Son TAN chulas. Estás haciendo feliz a mi niño interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: I mean, sheesh ... They're SO cool. My inner child gets riled up just thinking about them!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: Cioe', dai... Sono COSI' belli. Mi si accende il bambino interiore solo a pensarci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: Ah... Entiendo. A tu niño interior.
¡Es que son lo más! Ojalá pudiera usarlas algún día, aunque solo fuera una vez...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: Oh, they're so nice! I'd like to use them someday, even if just once ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: Sono proprio fantastici! Mi piacerebbe usarli un giorno, anche solo una volta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: Eh... Si tantas ganas tienes de probarlas, te las puedo fabricar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: ... Um. If you want to use them that badly, I'll make them for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: ... Ehm. Se hai cosi' tanta voglia di provarli, te li preparo io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: ¿Quéééé? ¿En serio? ¡Sí, por favor! Tanto tiempo soñando con ellas, ¡y solo tenía que hablar contigo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: Wha—really?! That would be great! Turns out all I had to do was ask!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: C-cosa? Davvero?! Sarebbe fantastico! Bastava chiedere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..src: (¡Debo hacerlo lo mejor posible! Está claro que un buen resultado le sacará una sonrisa.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..ref: (If I'm doing this, I'm going to give it my all! Let's put a big smile on his face!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_150..dst: (Se lo faccio, daro' il massimo! Gli faro' spuntare un bel sorriso!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..src: Aquí tienes. He aprovechado para hacerte toda clase de herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..ref: Here you go. I went ahead and made a bunch of different ones for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..dst: Ecco qua. Ne ho approfittato per preparartene di diversi tipi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..src: V-vaya... Lo que siempre he deseado, ahora está en la palma de mis manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..ref: W-wow. The tools of my dreams, right here in my hands ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..dst: W-wow. Gli strumenti dei miei sogni, proprio qui tra le mie mani...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..src: Bueno, seguro que no hace falta que te lo diga, pero no se las lances a otras personas, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..ref: Oh yeah. I'm sure you know this already, but don't throw these at people, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..dst: Gia'. Immagino tu lo sappia gia', ma non lanciarli addosso alle persone, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..src: No, no, ¡claro que no! Las usaré con responsabilidad. ¡Y con estilo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..ref: Of course. I swear to you that I will use these responsibly, and stylishly!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_160..dst: Certo. Ti giuro che li usero' con responsabilita'... e con stile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: Me había imaginado los edificios de Aladiss de mil maneras diferentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: The buildings in Aladiss are all pretty hard to fathom ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: Mi ero immaginato gli edifici di Aladiss in mille modi diversi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: Pero este... ¡debe de ser un teatro! ¿O no? ¿Tú qué opinas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: But this one, this has got to be a theater! You think so too, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: Ma questo... dev'essere un teatro! Non credi? Tu che ne pensi?
