eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: S-sí. Este lugar sería la platea y por allí quedaría el escenario...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: Y-yeah. Maybe this area was the seating, and over there was the stage ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: S-si'. Questa zona doveva essere la platea, e laggiu' c'era il palco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: Es enorme, ¿verdad? Me pregunto qué obras representarían en aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: It's so big, though. I wonder what kind of plays they were putting on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: E' enorme, pero'. Chissa' che genere di opere mettevano in scena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: Sí. He investigado por mi cuenta, pero me temo que no he encontrado nada al respecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: Yeah. I was just searching for any clues about that, but I haven't found anything promising.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: Si'. Stavo cercando indizi al riguardo, ma temo di non aver trovato nulla di promettente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: Si quieres, te podría echar una mano. Me daré una vuelta de reconocimiento por la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: If you'd like, I could help you investigate. I can start with a quick search around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: Se vuoi, potrei darti una mano con le indagini. Comincero' con una rapida ricognizione qui intorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..src: (Y, si encuentro alguna reliquia, le pediré a Flammi que la escanee. Así no quedará pista sin estudiar.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..ref: (If I find any relics, I can have Flammi do a scan on them. Maybe we'll find some clues that way.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_170..dst: (Se trovo qualche reliquia, posso chiedere a Flammi di scansionarla. Forse cosi' troveremo qualche indizio.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..src: «Señoras y caballeros. Gracias por tan distinguida presencia».
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..ref: "Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for your patronage today."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..dst: "Signore e signori, grazie per essere qui oggi".
"Lo spettacolo di oggi e' "Tertius, il Mascherato"".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..src: «Una historia que trata de aventuras, repleta de risas y llantos, que retrata a los héroes y alquimistas que fundaron Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..ref: "It's a tale of adventure full of laughter and tears, woven together by the heroes and alchemists who founded Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..dst: "E' una storia d'avventura, ricca di risate e lacrime, che intreccia le vicende degli eroi e degli alchimisti fondatori di Aladiss".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..src: «Durante el espectáculo, habrá un toque de magia. Por su seguridad, rogamos que permanezcan sentados en todo momento».
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..ref: "Magic will be used during the show, so for your safety, please remain seated throughout the performance."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..dst: "Durante lo spettacolo verra' usata la magia. Per la vostra sicurezza, vi preghiamo di rimanere seduti per tutta la durata della rappresentazione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..src: (Una historia de aventuras... Son las mismas temáticas que representamos en las obras de Eustella.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..ref: ("A tale of adventure," huh? ... The themes don't seem much different than the plays we have in Eustella.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..dst: (Una storia d'avventura, eh? ... I temi non sembrano poi cosi' diversi da quelli delle opere che mettiamo in scena a Eustella.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..src: (Me sorprende que usaran magia. Sin duda, serían dignas de ver.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..ref: (But that part about using magic sounds interesting. I'm sure it must have been amazing ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_180..dst: (Ma quella parte sull'uso della magia sembra interessante. Dev'essere stato uno spettacolo incredibile...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: «Últimamente, las obras se deshacen en alabanzas al emperador. Ni siquiera se molestan en ocultarlas, ¡menuda pantomima!»
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: "All the recent plays have been nothing but praise for the emperor. It's so obvious, I'm starting to get sick of it!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: "Ultimamente, le opere non fanno che tessere le lodi dell'imperatore. E' talmente palese che comincio a non poterne piu'!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: «Siempre estás con lo mismo. Es una obra, ¿por qué no tratas de disfrutarla y punto?»
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: "You always think too hard about things. It's just a play, why not enjoy it for what it is?"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: "Pensi sempre troppo. E' solo uno spettacolo, perche' non te lo godi e basta?"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: «La representación de hoy no ha estado nada mal. Sobre todo, aquella bailarina, je, je. ¡Qué portento!»
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: "I quite enjoyed today's program. That one performer's dance, especially. She was incredible!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: "Devo ammettere che la rappresentazione di oggi mi e' piaciuta. Soprattutto quella ballerina, eh eh. Era straordinaria!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: «Sí, tienes razón. El elenco estaba muy bien seleccionado.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: "That much is true. I can't place the blame on the cast, after all ... "
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: "Questo e' vero. Dopotutto, non posso prendermela con gli attori..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: (Así que las obras ensalzaban la figura del emperador. Las usaban de propaganda política.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: (Programs that were praising the emperor? It seems these plays were a form of propaganda.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: (Quindi le opere esaltavano la figura dell'imperatore. Le usavano come propaganda politica.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..src: (Un espectáculo de danza, qué interesante. Me pregunto si estaría relacionado con la alquimia.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..ref: (The performer's dance sounds interesting. Makes me wonder if it had something in common with alchemy.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_190..dst: (Uno spettacolo di danza, che interessante. Mi chiedo se fosse legato all'alchimia.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: El Vial de recuerdos contiene un texto. Procedo a leerlo en voz alta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: It appears the Memory Vial contains a string of text. Reading it aloud now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: La Fiala della Memoria contiene un testo. Procedo a leggerlo ad alta voce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: «Como espada y líder de este clan, os hago esta promesa, compañeros: no importa las dificultades que nos acechen, ¡jamás nos detendrán!»
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: "As a swordsman and clan leader, I swear to you my friends. No matter what difficulties we face, we shall not be stopped."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: "Come spadaccino e capo del clan, vi faccio questa promessa, amici miei: qualunque difficolta' ci attenda, non ci fermera'!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: «Mientras conserve un hálito de vida, os protegeré».
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: "As long as I draw breath, I will protect you all!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: "Finche' avro' un alito di vita, proteggero' tutti voi!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: «Oh, dioses, no me abandonéis. Vigilad a mis descendientes y a mi pueblo. Oh, Aladiss, que tu gloria y paz no conozcan final».
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: "O gods above, protect me, my descendants, and our people. O Aladiss, let thy peace and glory be everlasting!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: "O de'i, proteggete me, i miei discendenti e il mio popolo. O Aladiss, che la tua pace e la tua gloria siano eterne!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: No se ha conservado el título, pero todo apunta a que es un fragmento de una obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: The title hasn't been preserved, however it is likely a passage from a play.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: Il titolo non e' stato conservato, ma sembra proprio un passaggio di un'opera teatrale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..src: ¿De una obra? ¿Podrían ser los versos del protagonista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..ref: From a play? Maybe the protagonist's lines?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_200..dst: Da un'opera teatrale? Potrebbero essere le battute del protagonista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_210..src: (No tengo muchos detalles, pero debería informar de lo que hemos encontrado hasta ahora.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_210..ref: (I don't have all the details, but I should at least report what I know so far.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_210..dst: (Non conosco tutti i dettagli, ma dovrei almeno riferire cio' che abbiamo scoperto finora.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..src: Hola, he estado explorando el teatro y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: Excuse me, I did a little investigating inside the theater myself, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Scusate, ho fatto qualche ricerca all'interno del teatro e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..src: Jamás había oído hablar de «Tertius, el enmascarado». ¿Habrá algún registro en Eustella de su contenido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: I've never heard of this "Masked Tertius" before. I wonder if there are any records of it left in Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Non avevo mai sentito parlare di "Tertius, il Mascherato". Chissa' se a Eustella ne e' rimasta traccia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..src: ¡Ay, lo que daría por saber más de estas obras y de la magia que empleaban!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: I'd love to know more about the other plays, and the magic they used in them too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Ah, quanto vorrei saperne di piu' su queste opere e sulla magia che usavano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: If only there were more relics left behind ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Gia', se solo fossero rimaste altre reliquie...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡bueno! No podemos esperar que las pistas nos llamen a la puerta. Indagaré por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: Ahaha, well we can't expect everything to just fall into our laps! I'll do a little more digging.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Ahah, beh, non possiamo aspettarci che tutto ci capiti tra le mani! Faro' qualche altra ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..src: ¡Lo que hemos averiguado no es moco de pavo! Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..ref: At the very least, what we did find out is a big step! Thanks so much for your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_220..dst: Almeno quello che abbiamo scoperto e' un bel passo avanti! Grazie mille per l'aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: De nuevo observando el teatro, ¿eh? ¿Has descubierto algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Ah, you were looking into the theater again, right? Any new discoveries?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Ah, stavi dando un'altra occhiata al teatro, vero? Hai scoperto qualcosa di nuovo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: No he dejado piedra sin remover y no sabes qué. En un golpe de suerte, ¡he encontrado el guion de «Tertius, el enmascarado»!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: I've left no stone unturned. In a stroke of luck, I was able to find the script for "Masked Tertius."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Non ho lasciato nulla d'intentato. E non sai che colpo di fortuna: sono riuscita a trovare il copione di "Tertius il Mascherato"!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: ¡Oye, menudo hallazgo! ¿Y por qué sigues por la zona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Wait, isn't that a major discovery?! If you have that, why are you still hanging around here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Aspetta, ma e' una scoperta enorme! Se ce l'hai, perche' te ne stai ancora qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: No sé, de repente mis pies me trajeron al teatro. Este lugar me hace echar la vista atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: I kinda just found myself walking here. This place really brings back memories of the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Non lo so, mi sono ritrovata a camminare fin qui. Questo posto mi fa tornare in mente il passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: Sí, antes de ser aventurera, dirigía una compañía de teatro. Pero tuvimos una discusión sobre el salario y nos separamos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: I was the head of a theater troupe before I became an adventurer. But we had a fight over money and broke up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Prima di diventare un'avventuriera, dirigevo una compagnia teatrale. Ma abbiamo litigato per i soldi e ci siamo sciolti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: Mi plan era unirme al equipo, ahorrar algo de dinero y volver a crear un proyecto similar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: I hoped to join this investigation, save some money, and try running a troupe one more time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Speravo di unirmi a questa indagine, mettere da parte un po' di soldi e provare a rimettere in piedi una compagnia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: Siempre ha sido mi sueño. Es lo único a lo que me aferro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: It's been my dream for a long time. It's the one thing I can't let myself give up on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: E' il mio sogno da tanto tempo. E' l'unica cosa a cui non posso rinunciare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: Sé a qué te refieres. No rendirte por un sueño es algo que puedo entender. Cuentas con mi apoyo al cien por cien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Your dream, huh? I support you one hundred percent. I know the feeling of not wanting to give up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Il tuo sogno, eh? Ti sostengo al cento per cento. So cosa vuol dire non voler rinunciare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: ¿Te puedo ayudar con algo? Puedo transportar materiales o fabricar lo que necesites.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Is there anything I can help with? Taking something somewhere, or making something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: C'e' qualcosa che posso fare per aiutarti? Portare qualcosa da qualche parte o fabbricare qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: ¿Fabricar? Pues... ahora que lo dices, se me ocurre una cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Making something? Well, if you insist, there is one thing I can think of ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Fabbricare qualcosa? Beh, se insisti, mi viene in mente una cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: El héroe de «Tertius, el enmascarado» lleva una máscara de bufón en el primer acto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: The jester's mask that the hero of "Masked Tertius" wears in the opening act.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: La maschera da giullare che l'eroe di "Tertius il Mascherato" indossa nel primo atto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..src: ¡Claro, cuenta con ello! La terminaré en un periquete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..ref: Of course, just leave it to me! I can do that no problem.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_230..dst: Certo, lascia fare a me! Ci riusciro' senza problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: ¡Hala! ¡Qué maravilla! ¡Es exactamente como la describían en las acotaciones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: Whoa. This is amazing! It's exactly like the materials described!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Wow. E' incredibile! E' proprio come viene descritto nel copione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: Me alegro de que te guste. Espero que le des mucho uso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: I'm glad to help. I hope it will find a lot of use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Sono felice di averti aiutata. Spero che ti sara' utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: ¡No lo dudes! Después de la molestia que te has tomado en replicarla, ¡la usaré para hacer mis sueños realidad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: Of course! You went through the trouble of making it, so now I just have to make my dream come true!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Certo! Ti sei data tanto da fare per realizzarla, quindi ora non mi resta che realizzare il mio sogno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: Me harán falta más elementos de atrezo, claro, pero por algo se empieza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: There are still other props and such that I need to prepare, but this is a huge first step!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Devo ancora preparare altri oggetti di scena e cose del genere, ma questo e' un primo passo enorme!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: Iré a buscarte cuando haya montado una nueva compañía. ¡Ven a vernos, señorita alquimista!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: I'll get in touch with you once I get my troupe set up. Please come see us, Miss Alchemist!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Vi cerchero' quando avro' messo in piedi una nuova compagnia. Venite a trovarci, signorina alchimista!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..src: ¡Claro que sí! Me encantaría veros actuar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..ref: Of course! I'm looking forward to the day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_240..dst: Certo! Non vedo l'ora di vedervi esibire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Sí, sí. Es incluso más bonita de lo que me imaginaba. ¿Verdad que sí, alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Oh yes, it's even more beautiful than I imagined. Don't you agree, Alchemist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Si', si'. E' ancora piu' bella di quanto immaginassi. Non sei d'accordo, alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Eh... ¿Me das una pista de a qué te refieres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Uh ... What exactly are you talking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Eh... Mi dai un indizio su cosa intendi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Ah, ¿acaso no es evidente? ¡De la hermosa y blanca arquitectura de la capital!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Isn't it obvious? The beautiful white architecture of the capital!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Ah, ma non e' evidente? Della splendida architettura bianca della capitale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Este diseño tan magnífico pone a prueba la imaginación y los conocimientos sobre la historia. Cada detalle, cada innovación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: The magnificent design tempts the imagination to ponder history, every detail bold and innovative ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Questo magnifico design stuzzica l'immaginazione e invita a interrogarsi sulla storia. Ogni dettaglio e' audace e innovativo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: ¿Eres capaz de reconocer su belleza, Yumia? ¿Y el encanto que rezuman los edificios de la capital?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Yumia, you too recognize the beauty, no? The myriad charms of the capital-style buildings!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Riesci a riconoscerne la bellezza, Yumia? E il fascino che emanano gli edifici della capitale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Y-yeah, now that you mention it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Si', ora che me lo fai notare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡lo sabía! Y sé lo que te propones. Quieres participar de esta camaradería y compartir tus gustos con más personas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Haha, say no more! Yes, I know what it is you wish to say. You long to become our like-minded comrade!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Ahahah, non aggiungere altro! Si', so gia' cosa vuoi dire. Desideri unirti a noi e condividere i tuoi gusti con altre persone!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: Sin embargo, Yumia, para ser nuestra camarada, debes demostrar tu pasión por la Arquitectura con «a» mayúscula.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: However, Yumia, if you wish to be our comrade, you must first prove your passion for the architectural arts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Tuttavia, Yumia, se vuoi unirti a noi, devi prima dimostrare la tua passione per l'Architettura con la "A" maiuscola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: ¡Y sí! ¡Eso significa demostrar tu creatividad! ¡Construye un edificio que capture el estilo capitalino aquí mismo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Which means, yes! Display your creativity! Construct a building that captures the capital style upon this very soil!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Ebbene si'! Devi dimostrare la tua creativita'! Costruisci proprio qui un edificio che catturi lo stile della capitale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: ¡Ah, ya entiendo! Quieres ver si es una verdadera camarada a través de la calidad de su trabajo. ¡Me impresionas, compi!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: I see! You'll determine if she is a true comrade from the quality of her work! Very impressive, sir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Ah, capisco! Vuoi capire se e' una vera compagna dalla qualita' del suo lavoro! Davvero impressionante, capo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: ¡Esperamos grandes cosas de ti, alquimista! ¡Ábrenos tu alma y rinde pleitesía a la Arquitectura! ¡Ja, ja, ja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: I expect great things, Alchemist! Lay bare your soul, and create a magnificent homage! Ahahaha!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: Abbiamo grandi aspettative, alchimista! Aprici il tuo cuore e rendi omaggio all'Architettura! Ahahahah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: Hehehe, this is quite exciting, sir!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..src: (No quieren escucharme. Supongo que no pasa nada por intentarlo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..ref: (They won't listen to reason. I guess I can try and make something.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_250..dst: (Non vogliono ascoltarmi. Immagino che potrei provare a fare qualcosa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: ¿Qué os parece? He intentado usar toda mi creatividad, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: How's this? I tried to make something creative, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Che ve ne pare? Ho cercato di usare tutta la mia creativita', ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: Mmm... Esto... ¡Esto es arte! ¡Un desenfreno de creatividad! Muy buen trabajo, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: Hmm. This ... This is true art! Creativity unbridled! Splendid work, Alchemist!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Mmm... Questo... E' arte! Un'esplosione di creativita'! Ottimo lavoro, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Se puede ver tu alma en los detalles, Yumia. En cómo has conservado el estilo clásico y refinado de la arquitectura capitalina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: It is. While preserving the old yet advanced style of the capital architecture, Yumia's creativity shines through!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Sono d'accordo. Si vede la tua anima nei dettagli, Yumia. Nel modo in cui hai preservato lo stile classico e raffinato dell'architettura della capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: Compi, no hay nada que pensar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Amico, non c'e' nemmeno da pensarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: Sí, no puedo ponerle un pero. ¡Yumia! ¡A partir de ahora eres nuestra camarada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: Yes, there is no room for critique. Yumia! I acknowledge you as one of us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Si', non ho nulla da ridire. Yumia! Da oggi sei una nostra compagna!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: Ahora, si tienes tiempo, nos gustaría conversar sobre la belleza de la arquitectura de la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Ora, se hai tempo, ci piacerebbe parlare della bellezza dell'architettura della capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: ¡Sí! Trae café. ¡Cuando nos ponemos a hablar, nos dan las tantas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: Let us now discuss together the unparalleled beauty of capital-style architecture!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: Si'! Porta il caffe'. Quando ci mettiamo a parlare, facciamo notte!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..src: ¡A-ah! Esto... Me temo que tendré que perderme esta reunión. ¡Nos vemos en la próxima!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..ref: Yes! I imagine we will talk through the night, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_260..dst: A-ah! Ehm... temo che dovro' saltare questo incontro. Ci vediamo al prossimo!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: La próxima vez, habrá que prepararse mucho mejor. ¿No crees?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: We need to be more thoroughly prepared than ever before! You agree too, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: La prossima volta dovremo prepararci molto meglio. Che ne dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Sí, claro, siempre hay que ser precavidos. Pero... ¿por qué estás tan nervioso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: Y-you seem really fired up. But I agree with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Si', certo, bisogna sempre essere prudenti. Ma... perche' sei cosi' nervoso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Los monstruos de la zona son peligrosos y hay que tomárselo en serio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: The monsters around here are strong. We have to take them seriously.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: I mostri della zona sono pericolosi e bisogna prenderli sul serio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Claro que sí, pero es lo único que me pone nervioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: That's right. But that's not the only reason.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Certo, ma e' l'unica cosa che mi rende nervoso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Has estado lidiando con amenazas más peligrosas de lo normal y tarde o temprano nos tocará a nosotros medirnos las fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: You all have been taking on a threat far beyond the usual monsters, and we will clash with them ourselves soon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Hai affrontato minacce ben piu' pericolose dei soliti mostri e prima o poi tocchera' a noi misurarci con loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Cierto. Da miedo pensar en cuándo llamarán a nuestras puertas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: True, it's scary to think about the possibility of them coming here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Gia'. Fa paura pensare a quando busseranno alla nostra porta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Por eso hay que prepararse para lo peor. Y esforzarnos por mantenernos en forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: That's why we need to prepare for the worst, and do our best to have the base in tip-top shape!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Per questo dobbiamo prepararci al peggio e impegnarci a mantenere la base in forma!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Lo que me lleva a pedirte algo, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: And so, I have a request for you, Alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: E cosi', avrei una richiesta da farti, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Ja, me olía que dirías algo así. ¿Cómo puedo ayudarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: Hah, I had a feeling you'd say that. How can I help?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Ah, immaginavo che avresti detto cosi'. Come posso aiutarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Quiero ampliar nuestro territorio. ¿Te importaría hacer unas cuantas edificaciones aquí y allá que nos sean útiles en un futuro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: I want to expand the base facilities. Can you build some here and there that may prove useful in the future?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Voglio ampliare il nostro territorio. Ti dispiacerebbe costruire qua e la' qualche struttura che potrebbe tornarci utile in futuro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..src: Vale, no me llevará mucho. Prepararé la base para lo que esté por venir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..ref: Okay, that seems doable. I'll get the base ready for anything!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_270..dst: Va bene, non ci vorra' molto. Preparero' la base per qualsiasi evenienza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..src: ¡Sí que te has dado brío! Buen trabajo, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..ref: Looks like you did it. Great work, Alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..dst: Ti sei data da fare, eh? Ottimo lavoro, alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..src: ¡Gracias! Me gusta echar una mano al equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..ref: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..dst: Grazie! Mi piace dare una mano alla squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..src: No lo olvides, alquimista, tú también eres parte de este equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..ref: Don't forget, you're part of that "everyone."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..dst: Non dimenticarlo, alchimista: anche tu fai parte di questa squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..src: Si alguna vez necesitas algo, ven corriendo a la base. El jefe y todos los demás te ayudaremos encantados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..ref: If you ever need anything, come back to the base any time. The chief and the rest of us will be glad to help you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_280..dst: Se ti serve qualcosa, torna pure alla base quando vuoi. Il capo e tutti noi saremo felici di aiutarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: Mire por donde mire, los edificios son deslumbrantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: There are beautiful white buildings everywhere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Ovunque guardi, gli edifici bianchi sono splendidi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: Aun así, no me desprendo de esta sensación de soledad. No queda ni un alma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: But it feels lonely. There's no sign of people living here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Eppure, mi da' un senso di solitudine. Non c'e' traccia di persone che vivano qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: Altus, ¿estás tristona? ¡Aquí es un lugar animado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Tall One, feeling down? But this is a lively place!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Altus, sei giu' di morale? Ma questo e' un posto pieno di vita!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Lively? I don't know about that ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: Un momento. ¿Qué hace un Alber aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Wait. What is an Alber doing out here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Aspetta. Che ci fa un Alber qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: ¿Eh? Pues traspasé ese muro transparente y mullidito. ¡Y aquí me quedé a vivir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Hm? I went over the fluffy transparent wall. I've lived here ever since!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Eh? Ho oltrepassato quel muro soffice e trasparente. E da allora vivo qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: ¿Vives aquí? ¿Y no es peligroso? Los monstruos rondan por la zona, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: You live here? Isn't it dangerous? There are monsters in this area, aren't there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Vivi qui? Non e' pericoloso? In questa zona ci sono mostri, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: Sí, a montones, sí. Me da un miedo enooorme, pero ¡no tanto como para plantearme una mudanza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: There a lots of them, yeah! It can be super-duper scary, but not enough to make me move!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Ce ne sono un sacco, si'! A volte fanno una paura tremenda, ma non abbastanza da farmi traslocare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: (Pero esto es el centro de Aladiss. Aquí podría ocurrir cualquier cosa sin previo aviso.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: (This is the center of Aladiss. Anything could happen here.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: (Ma questo e' il centro di Aladiss. Qui puo' succedere di tutto.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: (No podría estar tranquila dejando a un Alber aquí a su suerte.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: (I'd feel terrible if I left the Alber here and something bad happened.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: (Mi sentirei in colpa a lasciare qui un Alber, col rischio che gli succeda qualcosa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..src: ¿Te puedo ayudar con algo? Un objeto, alguna herramienta que necesites para protegerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Is there anything I can do to help you? An item, or tool to protect you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: C'e' qualcosa che posso fare per aiutarti? Un oggetto o uno strumento per proteggerti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..ref: Wooow, well thank you, kind Tall One! That would be amazing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_290..dst: Woooow, grazie, gentile Altus! Sarebbe fantastico!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: ¡Ay, requeteay! ¡Cuántas cosas útiles! ¡Es como una piñata de herramientas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: Wooow! So many things to use! It's like a party!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: Woooow! Quante cose utili! Sembra una festa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: No debes usarlas todas a la vez... O sí, según necesites. Las hice para no preocuparme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: I hope you don't use them all at once ... Well, it's fine I guess. I did it for my own ease of mind, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: Spero che tu non le usi tutte insieme... Beh, immagino vada bene. In fondo l'ho fatto per stare piu' tranquilla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: ¡Luego iré a visitar al ermitaño! Ese viejito sieeempre está durmiendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: I'll have to talk to the hermit later! Always sleeping soundly, that one!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: Piu' tardi dovro' parlare con l'eremita! Quello dorme sempre come un sasso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: Sí, sí. Un Alber ermitaño que vivía aquí hace muuucho, pero que muuucho tiempo. ¡Es un sabio!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: The hermit's an Alber that's lived here a long, long, looong time. They know everything!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: L'eremita e' un Alber che vive qui da tantissimo, tantissimo, tantissimooo tempo. Sa tutto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: Vive cerca de las tumbas. Deberías ir a hablar con él, altus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: Their house is by the graves. You should go visit, Tall One!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: La sua casa e' vicino alle tombe. Vai a fargli visita, spilungone!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: (Así que un ermitaño... ¿Y vive en esta ciudad solo?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: (A hermit, huh? They live in this empty city all alone?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: (Un eremita, eh? Vive da solo in questa citta' deserta?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..src: (Podría saber algo de Aladiss. No pierdo nada por ir a charlar un rato.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..ref: (They might know something about Aladiss. It sounds like it would be worth talking to them.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_300..dst: (Potrebbe sapere qualcosa su Aladiss. Vale la pena parlarci.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..src: Mmm, ese Alber dijo que la casa del ermitaño estaba por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: Hmm, that Alber said the hermit's house should be somewhere around here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..dst: Mmm, quell'Alber ha detto che la casa dell'eremita dovrebbe essere qui nei dintorni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: Oh, is that them? Excuse me! Are you the Alber hermit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..dst: Oh? Sara' lui? Mi scusi! E' lei l'eremita Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: One may say I am, one may say I am not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..dst: C'e' chi dice che lo sia, e chi dice di no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..src: Lo que sí te diré es que llevo mucho tiempo esperando tu llegada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: All that is for certain is that I have waited long for your arrival.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..dst: L'unica cosa certa e' che attendevo da tempo il tuo arrivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..src: Supera mis pruebas, alquimista visitante del exterior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: You shall overcome my trials, visitor from the outside world—modern alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..dst: Supera le mie prove, alchimista moderna venuta dal mondo esterno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_310..ref: What?! What's this all of a sudden?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: I see. Just as I had predicted.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: Uf, uf... P-pero ¿qué pretendías? ¿Por qué me has lanzado ese monstruo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: *Huff* *Huff* Wh-what's the big idea here?! Why did you send that monster at me?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: *Uff* *Uff* M-ma che ti salta in mente?! Perche' mi hai scagliato contro quel mostro?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: No te exaltes, muchacha. Si no pudieras con un monstruo como ese, no tendrás nada que hacer contra él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: Chirp not, child. If you can't handle a monster like that, you have no chance of toppling him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Non agitarti, ragazza. Se non sai affrontare un mostro del genere, non avrai alcuna possibilita' contro di lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: "Him"? Wait, are you talking about Basilius?
One may say I am, one may say I am not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: C'e' chi dice che lo sia, e chi dice di no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: ¿Tanto te cuesta responder sí o no?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: Would a simple yes or no hurt?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Cosi' difficile rispondere con un si' o con un no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: Sea como sea, tu fuerza es real. Parece que puedo descansar en paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: In any case, your strength is true. It seems I can rest easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: In ogni caso, la tua forza e' autentica. Posso tirare un sospiro di sollievo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: Te otorgo una recompensa por haber superado la prueba. ¡Acéptala, alquimista!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: I grant you your reward for overcoming this trial. Take it, young alchemist!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Ti concedo una ricompensa per aver superato questa prova. Prendila, giovane alchimista!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: M-muchas gracias. Pero no he entendido nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: Th-thank you, I guess? I still don't understand what's going on, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: G-grazie, credo? Pero' non ho ancora capito cosa stia succedendo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: No has entendido nada... todavía. Todo se te revelará en su momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: You need not understand yet. All will be revealed to you in time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Non devi ancora capire. A tempo debito ti sara' tutto chiaro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: Hasta pronto, alquimista moderna. Te dejo que averigües por ti misma la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: Farewell, modern alchemist. I leave the rest—and the "true" one—to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Addio, alchimista moderna. Affido a te il resto... e quello "vero".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: Y se marcha. Con la de preguntas que tenía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: They left. I wanted to ask more questions ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Se n'e' andato. E io volevo fargli altre domande...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..src: ¿De qué verdad hablaba? Ni siquiera me ha dado una pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..ref: Who is the "true" one? I don't even get a hint?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq04_320..dst: Di quale verita' parlava? Non mi ha dato nemmeno un indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: ¡Tsk! ¿Dónde se habrá metido ese idiota? ¡Cuando más lo necesito!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Tch! Where'd that idiot run off to? Now, of all times.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Tsk! Dove diavolo si sara' cacciato quell'idiota? Proprio adesso, poi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Huh? Hey, aren't you a relic hunter?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Eh? Ehi, ma tu non sei una cacciatrice di reliquie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Sí, bueno... Ahora soy pescador a media jornada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Ah, yeah ... Though, I'm more of a part-time fisherman now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Gia'... Anche se ormai faccio il pescatore part-time.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Necesitaban a gente para sacar adelante la nueva aldea, así que me presenté voluntario y ahora finjo que sé llevar mi negocio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: They were looking for more folks to run this newly-established village so I applied to work here, and now I pretend that I know what I'm doing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Cercavano gente per mandare avanti questo villaggio appena fondato, cosi' mi sono candidato. E adesso faccio finta di sapere cosa sto facendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Fair enough. Is fishing going better for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Capisco. Ti trovi meglio a pescare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Ja, ja, ja, no está mal. Y la faena no es para tanto. De hecho, ¡hasta es divertida!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Haha, it's not too bad. I don't mind the work. Heck, it's kind of fun.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Ah ah, non va poi cosi' male. Il lavoro non mi dispiace. Anzi, e' anche divertente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Oye, perdona, no tengo tiempo para parlotear. Debo encontrar a ese idiota. Puf... Seguro que está por ahí varado en alguna costa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Wait, no, I don't have time to chat. I have to find that idiot.<CR>*Sigh* ... He's probably washed up somewhere along the shore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Aspetta, no, non ho tempo di chiacchierare. Devo trovare quell'idiota. Uff... Sara' finito da qualche parte lungo la costa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Es verdad, ya lo habías mencionado antes, ¿a quién estás buscando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Sorry, you were saying something about that before. Who are you looking for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Giusto, me ne avevi gia' parlato. Chi stai cercando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: A otro tipo que ha venido a ayudar con las incursiones. ¡El problema es que se le da fatal navegar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: This other guy that's here to help with the pioneering. Problem is, he's downright awful at steering a boat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Un altro tipo venuto qui per dare una mano con le spedizioni pionieristiche. Il problema e' che e' un disastro al timone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: No recuerdo ni una vez que haya atracado en el puerto sin más. ¡Ni una! Siempre acaba estrellándose en una playa de las de por aquí. En serio, da más preocupaciones que alegrías...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: I don't think he's ever come straight back here. Not once. He always ends up washing up on a nearby beach. Seriously, he's more trouble than he's worth ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Non credo sia mai tornato qui senza intoppi. Neanche una volta. Finisce sempre su una spiaggia qui vicino. Sul serio, e' piu' una seccatura che altro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: Si ves a alguien que parece un pez fuera del agua, ¿podrías decirle que le estoy buscando y que se dé prisa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: If you spot someone who looks like a fish out of water, could you tell him to hurry back here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Se vedi qualcuno che sembra un pesce fuor d'acqua, potresti dirgli di tornare qui in fretta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..src: ¡Claro! De hecho, iremos a por él directamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..ref: Sure thing! Actually, we can go make a point of looking for him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_010..dst: Certo! Anzi, andremo a cercarlo apposta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..src: Humm... Ese barco está roto... y no lleva aquí mucho tiempo. ¿Será el navío del pescador perdido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..ref: Hm, that's a broken boat ... and it hasn't been there long. Is this the boat the missing fisherman was in?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..dst: Mmh, quella barca e' rotta... e non e' li' da molto. E' quella del pescatore scomparso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..src: Si fuera así, y viendo la fuerza que haría falta para romper un barco de estas características, podría estar en graves problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..ref: In that case, considering the force it would've taken to break a boat like that, he could be in serious trouble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..dst: In tal caso, considerando la forza necessaria per rompere una barca del genere, potrebbe essere in grave pericolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..src: Espero que haya salido de esta y se haya ocultado por la zona. A lo mejor hay alguna pista por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..ref: I really hope he managed to get away and is just hiding somewhere. There's got to be a few more clues around here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_020..dst: Spero che se la sia cavata e si sia nascosto qui nei dintorni. Forse c'e' qualche indizio da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..src: Humm... Más trozos del barco. Entonces, la persona que iba a bordo no debería andar lejos de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..ref: Hm, more pieces from that boat. The person who was in it shouldn't be too far away, then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..dst: Uhm... Altri pezzi della barca. Allora, la persona che era a bordo non dovrebbe essere lontana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..src: Deberíamos comprobar las ruinas... ¡Vamos a echar un vistazo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..ref: ... Those ruins might be a good place to check. Let's go take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_030..dst: Dovremmo controllare le rovine... Andiamo a dare un'occhiata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: A-are you lot humans?! Please, help me!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..src: Está bien, cálmate. Eres de la aldea pesquera, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: It's okay, just calm down. You're from the fishing village, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..dst: Tranquillo, calmati. Vieni dal villaggio di pescatori, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..src: Sí, eso es. Sa-salí con el barco, pero me llevó la corriente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: Y-yeah, that's right. I was out in the boat, but I got swept away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..dst: Si', esatto. Ero uscito in barca, ma la corrente mi ha trascinato via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..src: Y para colmo de males, un grupo de monstruos hicieron pedazos mi embarcación. Tuve que salir huyendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: To add insult to injury, a group of monsters smashed my boat to pieces. So, I ran all the way here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..dst: E come se non bastasse, un gruppo di mostri ha fatto a pezzi la mia barca. Cosi' sono scappato fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..src: Lo debes de haber pasado mal, pero ya estás a salvo. Te escoltaremos de vuelta a casa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: That sounds like a rough time, but you're safe now. We'll escort you back home.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..dst: Deve essere stata dura, ma ora sei al sicuro. Ti riaccompagneremo a casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..src: Sí, pero antes vamos a acabar con los monstruos que te perseguían. Espera aquí, ¿vale? No te muevas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..ref: Yep. But before we do, we're going to take care of those monsters that were chasing you. Just hold tight, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_040..dst: Si', ma prima ci occuperemo dei mostri che ti inseguivano. Aspetta qui, va bene? Non muoverti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: Whoooa! You already got all of them?! You guys are amazing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Wow! Li avete gia' sconfitti tutti?! Siete incredibili!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: Bueno, estamos acostumbrados. Vamos, regresemos juntos a la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: Well, we're pretty used to this. Come on, let's get you back to the village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Beh, ormai ci siamo abituati. Forza, torniamo al villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: ¿Te han atacado los monstruos? Así que eso era... Muchas gracias por salvarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: A monster attack? So, that's what happened ... Thank you so much for saving him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Ti hanno attaccato i mostri? Ecco cos'e' successo... Grazie mille per averlo salvato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: Lo importante es que ha vivido para contarlo... Aunque él seguro que prefiere evitar más naufragios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: All that matters is that he made it out, safe and sound. ... Though, it would be nice if he didn't get swept away again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: L'importante e' che sia vivo e in salute... Anche se di certo preferirebbe evitare altri naufragi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Lo he obligado a aceptar trabajos dentro de la aldea, así que no creo que se vuelva a quedar varado en un futuro próximo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: Haha! He's gotten restricted to jobs within the village, so I don't think anyone'll need to worry about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Ah ah ah! L'ho costretto ad accettare lavori nel villaggio, quindi non credo che rimarra' di nuovo bloccato da qualche parte tanto presto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: ¡Hasta él sabía lo mal que se le daba el trabajo de marinero! Tendrías que haberle visto la cara de alivio cuando se lo comenté.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: Honestly, even he knew he was a lousy sailor, so he was pretty relieved to hear it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Persino lui sapeva di essere un pessimo marinaio! Avresti dovuto vedere quanto si e' sollevato quando gliel'ho detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..src: Aun así, no volveríamos a verle ninguna de sus caras si no llega a ser por ti. Gracias de nuevo por intervenir y traerlo de vuelta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..ref: Still, he might not've lived to see today without you. Thanks again for getting him back safely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq05_050..dst: Eppure, senza di te forse non sarebbe arrivato a oggi. Grazie ancora per essere intervenuto e averlo riportato sano e salvo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..ref: Hey, Tall One! I want to ask you something ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..dst: Ehi, spilungone! Volevo chiederti una cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..src: Mi amiga quiere mudarse aquí, pero no tiene casa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..ref: My friend is going to move here, but they don't have a house ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..dst: La mia amica vuole trasferirsi qui, ma non ha una casa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..src: Sabes hacer todo tipo de cosas, ¿no? Necesitamos más lugares donde vivir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..ref: You can make lots of things, can't you? I want more places to live ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..dst: Sai costruire un sacco di cose, vero? Ci servono altri posti dove vivere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..src: Sí, ya estaba haciendo planes al respecto. Voy a hacer los preparativos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..ref: Yeah, I was just making plans for that. I'll get everything ready.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_010..dst: Si', stavo gia' facendo dei piani al riguardo. Preparero' tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_020..src: Ya está. Espero que os guste mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_020..ref: It's all done. I hope you like it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_020..src: ¡Gracias! ¡Estoy deseando que mi amiga vea su casita nueva!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_020..ref: Thank you! I'm gonna take my friend to go see it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_020..dst: Grazie! Non vedo l'ora di farlo vedere alla mia amica!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: ¿Qué pasa? Parece que estás en apuros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: What's wrong? Looks like you're struggling ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Che succede? Sembra che tu sia in difficolta'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: ¡Altus! No me da tiempo a hacer los gorros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Tall One! I can't make hats in time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Spilungone! Non riesco a fare cappelli in tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: Todo el mundo está yendo a explorar y los gorros se estropean muy rápido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Everyone's going exploring, so their hats get damaged fast ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Tutti vanno in esplorazione e i loro cappelli si rovinano in fretta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: Sé hacer gorros perfectamente, pero ¡no puedo seguirles el ritmo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: I can make new hats, but I can't keep up with demand!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: So fare cappelli, ma non riesco a stare al passo con la richiesta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: A lo mejor te puedo ayudar. He aprendido a hacer gorros hace poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Maybe I could help? I learned how to make hats recently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Forse potrei aiutarti? Ho imparato da poco a fare cappelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: ¡Anda! ¡Mis deseos se han cumplido! Pero tienen que ser muy resistentes, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Oh! My wish has been granted! But they've got to be pretty tough, y'know!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Oh! Il mio desiderio si e' avverato! Pero' devono essere davvero resistenti, capito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: Lo pillo, tienen que ser de gran calidad... ¡Yo me ocupo, lo haré lo mejor que pueda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: I see, so it's got to be high quality ... Leave it to me, I'll do my best!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Capisco, devono essere di alta qualita'... Lascia fare a me, daro' il massimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Great! Then it's up to you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Grande! Allora conto su di te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: ¿Podrías repartirlos también? Una amiga salió a explorar en el árbol y necesita su gorro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Oh, could you also make the delivery? I've got a friend exploring on the tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Oh, potresti anche consegnarli? Ho un'amica che sta esplorando sull'Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..src: Claro. Se lo llevaré cuando termine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..ref: Got it. I'll take it over once I'm done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_030..dst: Capito. Glielo portero' appena avro' finito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..src: Me han pedido que fabrique un gorro y te lo traiga. ¿Qué tal está?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..ref: I got asked to make a hat and bring it to you. How is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..dst: Mi hanno chiesto di fare un cappello e portartelo. Che te ne pare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..src: ¡No está nada mal, altus! ¡No se romperá con facilidad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..ref: Not bad at all, Tall One! This won't break so easily!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..dst: Niente male, spilungone! Questo non si rompera' cosi' facilmente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..src: Oye... ¿Podrías hacer otros cien como este?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..ref: Hey ... could you make another 100 of these?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..src: (Pues sí que les gustan las aventuras...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_040..ref: (How many adventures are they going on ...?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..src: ¿Has visto un gato por aquí últimamente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: Have you seen a cat around here lately?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: Hai visto un gatto da queste parti ultimamente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: A cat ...? Uh, I don't think so ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: Come mai ti interessa quel gatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..src: Pues... quiero que sea mi amigo. Justo cuando me estaba planteando hablarle, salió corriendo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: Why are you interested in a cat?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: Beh... vorrei diventare suo amico. Proprio mentre stavo pensando di parlargli, e' scappato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: Actually ... I want to make friends with it. As I was wondering whether I should talk to it, it ran away ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..src: Estamos planeando explorar la zona, así que a lo mejor podría buscarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: Abbiamo in programma di esplorare la zona, quindi potrei provare a cercarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: We're planning on adventuring around here, so maybe I could look for it?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..src: ¡La última vez que lo vi estaba debajo de ese gran árbol! ¡Avísame cuando lo encuentres!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: L'ultima volta che l'ho visto era sotto quel grande albero! Avvisami quando lo trovi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..src: Debajo del árbol... Vale, empezaré a buscar por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..ref: I last saw it under that big tree! Tell me when you find it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_050..dst: Sotto l'albero... Va bene, comincero' a cercare da li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: Creo que no está por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: It doesn't seem to be here.
What are you looking for, Tall One?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: Me han pedido que busque a un gato...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: Actually, I was asked to look for a cat ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..dst: In realta', mi hanno chiesto di cercare un gatto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: ¿Ah, sí? Pues el gato me ha dicho que se iba a un lugar donde haya muchos juguetes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: Oh? That cat actually told me it's, "Going somewhere with lots of toys."
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..dst: Ah si'? Quel gatto mi ha detto che "andava in un posto con tanti giocattoli".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: ¡Hala! ¿Que te lo ha dicho? ¿El gato... te lo ha dicho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: Wow! Wait, "told"? The cat ... told you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..dst: Caspita! Aspetta, "detto"? Il gatto... ti ha parlato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: Humm... Bueno, gracias. Me has ayudado mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: Um ... Anyway, thanks. That's a big help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..dst: Ehm... Comunque, grazie. Mi sei stato di grande aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..src: (Algún lugar donde haya muchos juguetes... ¿Dónde podrá estar?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..ref: (But, "somewhere with lots of toys" ... Where would that be?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_060..dst: (Ma "un posto con tanti giocattoli"... Dove potrebbe essere?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..src: ¡Ahí está! ¡Ese es el gato que estoy buscando!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..ref: There! That's the cat I'm looking for!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..dst: Eccolo! E' proprio il gatto che sto cercando!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..src: (Se ha ido corriendo... Pues sí que es asustadizo.)
(Humm... ¿Qué podría usar para llamar su atención?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..ref: (It ran ... Talk about a cautious kitty.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_070..dst: (Mmm... Cosa potrei usare per attirare la sua attenzione?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..src: Vale, a ver qué tal con esto.
Ahora tengo que traer aquí a esa Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..ref: Now's my chance to bring that Alber here.
Thank you for finding it, Tall One!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..src: ¡No hay de qué! Venga, es tu oportunidad de hablar con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..ref: No problem! C'mon, this is your chance to talk to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..dst: Di niente! Dai, questa e' la tua occasione per parlargli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..src: Es como si dejara atrás a un hijo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..ref: I feel like a parent seeing their kid off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_080..dst: Mi sento come un genitore che saluta il figlio alla partenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..src: ¡Anda, altus! ¡Gracias por hacerme la casa antes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: Oh, Tall One! Thanks for making my house earlier!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: Oh, altus! Grazie per avermi costruito la casa prima!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..src: No hay de qué. Todo es parte de nuestra colaboración en el proyecto de exploración de Enrika.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: Oh, don't mention it. It's all part of working with Enrika on the pioneering plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: Ma figurati. Fa tutto parte della collaborazione con Enrika al suo piano pionieristico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: If I had another request, would you take it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: Ho un altro incarico. Potresti occupartene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: I guess it depends on what you ask.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..src: Pues... me gustaría tener un lugar para jugar con un montón de Alber. ¿Es muy egoísta por mi parte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: Um, well, I want a place to play with my friends. Would that be selfish?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: Ecco... mi piacerebbe avere un posto dove giocare con tanti Alber. E' una richiesta troppo egoista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..src: ¡En absoluto! Eso no es nada para la hija del propietario de una tienda de herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: Sure! That's no sweat for the daughter of a tool shop owner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: Certo! Per la figlia del proprietario di un negozio di attrezzi e' un gioco da ragazzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..src: (Un lugar donde jugar... ¿Y si les hago unos juguetes que les gusten?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..ref: (A place to play ... Maybe I'll try making some play equipment they'll like?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_090..dst: (Un posto dove giocare... E se provassi a costruire dei giochi che possano piacergli?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..src: Os he hecho algunos juguetes. Id a jugar y pasadlo muy requetebién.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..ref: I've made some play equipment. Try playing with them along with your friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..dst: Ho preparato dei giochi. Prova a usarli con i tuoi amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..src: ¡Halaaa, altus! ¿Eres capaz de hacer cualquier cosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..ref: Wooow, Tall One! Can you really make anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..dst: Wow, Altus! Sai davvero fare di tutto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..src: ¡Je, je! ¡Si consigo adivinar cómo se hace, sí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..ref: Heh heh! As long as I can guess how it's made!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..dst: Eheh! Se riesco a capire come si fa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..ref: Thanks a lot, Tall One! I'm gonna go play with my friend!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_100..dst: Grazie mille, Altus! Vado a giocare con i miei amici!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: This is called a Calum tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: Questo si chiama albero di Calum.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..src: Así que te enteraste de primera mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: I see, so you heard firsthand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: Capisco, quindi te l'ha detto direttamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..src: Pero este arbolito no tiene muy buen aspecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: But this sapling doesn't look good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: Pero' questo alberello non sembra stare molto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..src: Ya, parece más pequeño que los demás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: Yeah, it seems smaller than these other trees ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: Gia', sembra piu' piccolo degli altri alberi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: Tall One, can you make some food for it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: Altus, puoi preparargli qualcosa da mangiare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..src: (¿Algo de comer? Querrá decir agua, tierra y abono, ¿no?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..ref: (Food? In other words, water, soil, and fertilizer, right?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq06_110..dst: (Qualcosa da mangiare? Intendera' acqua, terra e fertilizzante, no?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Veo que un arma de lo más peculiar usas, alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Using quite the distinctive weapon you are, alchemist.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: La he adaptado bastante a mi gusto, así que sí, es bastante peculiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: I've customized it quite a bit for my own use, so it's fairly unique.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: L'ho modificata parecchio per adattarla alle mie esigenze, quindi e' piuttosto unica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Mm, ¿me la das? La necesito, sí, para llevar a cabo mi labor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Hm. Give it to me, would you? Need it, I do ... To carry out my duty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Mmh. Me la daresti? Mi serve... per compiere il mio dovere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: What do you mean by your duty?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Perfeccionar la creación de armas de alto nivel. La tarea que me encomendó mi maestro es mi labor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Perfecting the creation of high-grade weaponry. My duty, that is—the task entrusted to me by Master ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Perfezionare la creazione di armi di alto livello. Il mio compito, si': l'incarico affidatomi dal Maestro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Un último paso queda, antes del bastón dar por finalizado. Examinar el tuyo agradecería, así es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Before the staff is completed, one final step there is. Greatly appreciate being able to study yours, I would.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Prima che il bastone completato sia, un ultimo passo resta. Poter esaminare il tuo, molto apprezzerei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Ya veo. Entonces, ¿qué te parece si te entrego mi bastón a cambio de la receta de esas armas de alto nivel?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: I see. Then how about I give you the staff in exchange for the recipe for that high-grade weaponry?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Capisco. Che ne dici se ti dessi il bastone in cambio della ricetta per quelle armi di alto livello?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Por supuesto. Si completarlo consigo, así lo haré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Yes. If complete it I do, share it I will.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Certo. Se completarlo riusciro', condividerla faro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..src: Trato hecho, pues. Dame un momento para preparar el bastón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..ref: Then it's a deal. Just give me a moment to prepare the staff for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_010..dst: Affare fatto, dunque. Dammi solo un momento per prepararti il bastone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..src: ¡Magnífico! Por mi cuenta conseguirlo no podía, no. Por fin mi labor podré completar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..ref: Remarkable! Think of this myself, I could not. At last, fulfill my duty, I can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..dst: Notevole! Da solo, non avrei potuto idearlo. Finalmente, il mio compito portare a termine posso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..src: Siento la espera, sí. Toma, del bastón un recuerdo, aquí tienes. Usarlo podrás si eres alquimista, o deberías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..ref: Apologize for the wait, I do. Here, a memory of the staff, this is. If an alchemist you are, able to use this, you should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..dst: Per l'attesa, mi scuso. Ecco, un ricordo del bastone e' questo. Se alchimista sei, usarlo dovresti poter.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..src: Un recuerdo del bastón... Parece que podría ser la clave para una nueva receta. Gracias, ¡lo probaré de inmediato!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..ref: A memory of the staff ... This seems like it could be the key to a new recipe. Thank you, I'll try it out right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..dst: Un ricordo del bastone... Sembra che potrebbe essere la chiave per una nuova ricetta. Grazie, lo provero' subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..src: (Se dedica en cuerpo y alma a su labor, incluso sabiendo que Corleonis ya no... ¿Continuará también su investigación?).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..ref: (He's dedicated to his duty even now that Corleonis is no more ... I wonder if he'll continue his research.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_020..dst: (Si dedica ancora al suo compito, anche se Corleonis non esiste piu'... Chissa' se continuera' le sue ricerche.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..dst: Armi da fuoco, usi tu, non e' cosi'?
Con le armi da fuoco, sono abile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..src: ¡En el blanco puedo dar de todas las dianas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..ref: Bullseye every one of those targets, I can!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..dst: Ogni bersaglio, al centro colpire posso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..src: ¿Tú podrás completar lo mismo que yo, tremenda hazaña?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..ref: The same feat, can you also accomplish?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..dst: La stessa impresa, compiere anche tu puoi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..ref: (What is this, some kind of challenge ...?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..dst: (Che succede, e' una specie di sfida...?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..src: No lo pillo muy bien, pero puedo intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..ref: I don't really get it, but I guess I'll give it a try?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_030..dst: Non capisco bene, ma credo che ci provero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..src: Qué sorpresa la mía. Nada mal se te da, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..ref: Surprised, I am. Half bad, you are not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..dst: Ma che sorpresa. Niente male, te la cavi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..src: Como alabanza a tu destreza, entrega de esto te hago, sí. ¡Una posesión de lo más preciada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..ref: To commend your skill, present you with this, I do. A prized possession!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..dst: In premio per la tua abilita', questo ti consegno, si'. Un oggetto molto prezioso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..src: (Los Geni de Aladissia son de lo más extraño...).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_040..dst: (I Geni di Aladissia sono davvero strani...).

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: Mmm, me alegra verte por aquí, altus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: Hm. Fancy meeting you here, Tall One.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Mh. Che coincidenza incontrarti qui, spilungone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: Podría decir lo mismo, aunque nunca pensé que me toparía con gentes Alber en Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: I could say the same to you. I never expected to find an Alber in Aladissia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Potrei dire lo stesso di te. Non mi sarei mai aspettato di trovare un Alber ad Aladissia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: Me dedico a la investigación. Viajo de un lugar a otro en busca de materiales poco frecuentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: I am a wandering researcher. I journey from place to place in search of elusive materials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Sono una ricercatrice itinerante. Viaggio da un luogo all'altro in cerca di materiali rari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: (Esta Alber es bastante peculiar, sin duda...).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: (This Alber sure seems like a strange one ... )
If I may, might I ask a favor of you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Se posso, vorrei chiederti un favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: Uh, is there something you're having trouble with?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Ehm, c'e' qualcosa che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: He viajado hasta estas tierras buscando un objeto concreto, pero me está resultando imposible dar con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: I traveled to this land looking for a specific item, but it's proven impossible to locate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Sono arrivato in queste terre alla ricerca di un oggetto in particolare, ma si e' rivelato impossibile trovarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: Si lo encuentras, te agradecería que me hicieses entrega del mismo. A cambio, ¡te daré algo increíble!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: Should you find some, I'd be grateful if you'd share it. In exchange, I'll give you something nice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Se dovessi trovarne, ti sarei grato se me ne cedessi un po'. In cambio, ti daro' qualcosa di bello!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..src: Claro que sí. Si lo encuentro, te lo daré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..ref: Sure. I'll bring it your way if I come across any.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq07_050..dst: Certo. Se ne trovo, te li portero'.
